tei:div.tei:p: 'am: zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las:gsol 'debs bar pha lam sel sdus pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas bzhugs so:

ga6rdo: na mogu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: gagararigabye cha dad mos gdung shug drag po yis gu ru yid la dran byas nas dus drug gsol 'debs 'di nyid bskyar bar ra zhi nges ga༅ tshig yin sam shā e ma tong sku gsum ston pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi: thugs sprul 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung khyad 'phags rig 'dzin sku la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad: thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba smin grol byas gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rab tu sbar gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad la gsol ba 'debs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nyon mongs gdung ba tsha zer drag po yis mnar ba'i dmus long 'gro khams kha lo bsgyur: bcom ldan gu ru drug la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'byub par byin gyis rlobs: spre'u tsha rgyud gnag blo rmong gtum pa rnams: thugs rje thabs kyis dam chos lam la bkod: mkhan slob chos

gsum sku la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag bzhengs mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgon me gsal bar byas: rje 'bangs rig 'dzin tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas thugs kyi dgongs pa las can bu la bzhag gu ru thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal ba dang: sgrub mchog bsam pa yid bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i sasamasalhag pa'i lha mchog nyid la gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:nam zhig 'ami ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe: rang snang dag pa dpal ri pad ma'i zhing: ston 'khor rnam par dag pa rab mched nas: 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shog oṃ.ātwa:badz+ragu ru pad+ma sirnyi

brten: / de ltar gsol ba bawa pa yis phyi nang gsang ba'i bar pha sel sh+kas dang rtogasapa'i yon to 'phel dbang dang dngos grub thob par lur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal the po med do sa ma rgya rgyargya gu rgyabardar+yā lhacesapa 'di'apar chung bston skye rtagasacan gyis bskul ngobadag 'dra nusaldan rdo ༄dag par phab te yi ge pa nipad+ma tha semasakyis bgyis pa'o

bsko: zab gsangardo rje snying po las sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang gi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so:badz+ra: them medaphan na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye shasganargazlo/ dad dang mos gus gdung ba drag po yis thal sbyar snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do e ma rdo gdod nas ye sangs rgyas pa kun tu bzang: lhun grub 'gags med rigs lnga gangs chen mdzang thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan rdo rje sems: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod chos kyi 'byung gnas dga' rab rdo rje dang rdzogs chen ston pa rig 'dzin shrī seng: mkhas shing grub pa mañdzu mi tra la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: 'ja' lus rdo rje'isku brnyes pad ma 'byung bi ma mi tra ye shes bka' rgya mtsho zag phung 'od skur grol ba mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: blo gros dbang byug khye'u chung ye shes dbyings: don gnyis mthar phyin rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga: brtul zhugs mthar phyin bdud 'dul rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so

bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: don gyirig 'oran dpa' bo rol pa rtsal: chos nyid klong rdol rdo rje khro bo lod: snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: skye med dbyings las dgongs pa ma g.yos kyang: thugs rje'i rang gzugs rdo rje'i bla ma yis: rjes bzung dbang skur blo sna chos la bsgyur: phyi nang rkyen zhi sa lam mthar phyin nas: kun tu bzang po'irgyal sa zin par regag: de ltar gsol btab phyi nang bdud las rgyal nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo' zla ltar 'phe la dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su rnam par 'gyur the' midado rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rmang byung rdo rje snying po'i chos sde rnams grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gnyad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus ngaspuladapa' nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu lo sa dang nges shesagasal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grams la ltos dang mthong bka' gsang thub par srung shig ra nus skal med lag tu ma shol a tham rgya las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sam yu rgyargya rgya

bskye sa: brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen gegs so gterargyagatadargya sbasargyazabargya gsang rgyagu rgya mo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thiskasnyi zhes pa 'da'ang rdo rje'i lung gis bsngagasapa'i skyisamachog pad+ma nor busardzas sna tshogs dang bcas nasayang yang bskul ba dang chos bdag pad+ma chosa'ashel rgya mtshodangaslob bu yi shesarat+na sar rnams kyisanan du bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rje 'bros phug ḍak+ki'i 'du gling nas rig 'dzan dpa' bo mkha' 'grosabyin rlabs mdzad pa'i gnasanas pad+ma' gsang brda zab rmo lasazhal bshusate dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarbam 75

gtsasdo: chos nyid dgongasapa'i klong mdzod las sku phreng gsol 'debs byin rlabs gnad 'bebasabazhugs so badz+ra na mo gu ra we e ma rdo skye med chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang: ma 'gags rang grol longs sku snang mtha' yas thugs rje rmad byung rnal 'byor nus ldan par gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod thub pa'i spyan sngar 'phags pa sha ra'i bu o rgyan yul byon chos gsal trig na pa nor bu go leb yang dag mngon gyur dpal gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: bod khams mun selapad+ma'i spyan snga ru 'brog mi lo tsā khye'u chung ye shes blo: bstan pa'i phyi mo nor bu don grub la gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod dgongs pa mngon gyur rnal 'byor mkhar nag pa: sbyor sgrol thabs mkhas mgon po rdo rje dang chos kyi mdzod 'dzin he pa chos 'byung la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: zab gter mnga' bdagabadud 'dul rdo rje dang: grub brnyes dbang phyug dpa' bo rol pa rtsal

chos nyid klong rdol rdo rje khro lod la gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod mkha' spyod gnas nyul ye shes rdo rje dang: zab gsang sgo 'byed rdo rje drag po rtsal:brtul zhugs mthu stobs nus ldan rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: ma 'ongs bstan pa'i nyi ma kun skyong gling gcod spyon drag bshad rol ba'i rdo rje dang o rgyan bde chen gling pa ye shes mdzod: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: gdug pa tshar gcod rdo rje bsam 'grub rtsal: 'brul zhig rnal 'byor o rgyan zhig po ba: thabs mkhas spyod pa bskyangs ba'i mkha' khyab rje gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon tse( rgyan las 'phro gling: byams pa'i spyan sngar byang sems ral gri 'dzin: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas mos pa mtha' yas grags: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: de ltar sku yi 'phreng ba bsam mtha' yas: yid la dran zhing rtse gcig gsol btab mthus: khreg chod chos sku'i dgongs klong mngon gyur nas: gang shar sku dang ye shes rol bar mthong: thod sgal snang

—8rdo: bzhi'i nyams len mthar 'byol te:zad pa gsum rdzogs gzhen nu bum sku'i sbubs:'ja' lus 'pho ba chen por sangs rgyas shog:de ltar mos gusagasol bawa byin rlabs 'jug phyi nang gegs bsam pa lhun gyis grub sam shā rgya rgya rgya ces pa'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtshodang/lasaldan lasarab zhesabyas dar dang shos bu bcas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nu ldan rdo rjes 'bro mug mkha' 'gro 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarbamaṅgale/

'am: dam chos thug gter 'dus pa las sde brgyad ar la gtad pa'i drag sgrub me lce'i 'khor lo bzhugs soḥ—8rdo na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 2)3 khyung bzlog gas thabs man ngag gi rgyal gdon 'byung po.ar la gam 'byin gtor 'bigs pa'i rdo nus kyis bse mo brtsal ba'i las gas dang 'khor krugs 'dren pa'i brtul zhugs kyisasde brgyad gtang ru'adzin pa yi man ngag me lce 'bar ba 'di mthong thos dran pa'i sleb chog gi bdud rtsi zab pa'i marna 'di zungasaḥ ma māḥhrī rta khyung drag po'i zhal gyis gdug pa 'dul bdud 'jomasardo rje'i gar la skyabs su mchi bar du gcod bya gcod byed nga bdag kunaḥye shes rig pa'i gtor ba'i sems bskyed doḥlan gsum rjesasu lta ba gyad sku ni nyim skyes stong pa ye shes gsang ba'i zhal 'pho med rdo rje gu ru drag po'i sku rta zhal khyung gdong mtshan ma'i gdon 'dul bshadaḥrdo rje phur pa sdig phag mtshon thun 'gyed rgyal bsen srog 'dren gnam lcags dbal phur ldan khyang gshog rjeb cing kla rig zas su zaḥdri ma mi zhim dpag tshad rgyang grags 'phro/sdig khyang phag seng 'gyed

pa'i rdzu 'phrul can dus mtha'i ra tsa'i gshed bskul ar la gtad oṃ gu ru ar tsig ne rtsig hrīhūṃkhro phaṭaḥrā tsa bse mo bidzā.a tham rang nyams sbyar na legs na/11 sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa ni/hūṃ hrīḥdrag po khyung klus sa bdag klu gnyan 'daraḥdabang 'bar bas srid gsum gdug pa 'tharaḥdamar nag me phreng sku la phyag 'tshal bstod ces bstod gdon 'dul zab pa'i za yig niḥ /rang sngags khri yis dbang bskur nas khong du btang ba'i rgyal bsen gyi4gnod pa sna tshogasa'ajoms par raḥsam māḥslar yang dzos kyi sbyor ba ni gu gul khyung sder dang lcags sdig yungs dkar spang spos dang gza' sdum klu bdud rdo rje dang stag sha zhib btul ril bu bya rang sngags 'bum gyis dbang bskur nas dri bab niḥhrīḥkhro trig shwaX trig shāḥrā tsa dun liḥganod byed bse mo khug dzaḥtri rā tsa'i srog chodaḥzud zud 'da' na rā tsa'i tsit+ta

bsko/: tsa'i tsit+ta gas gsaX mo 'dre'i sha bo/la bur chod chod ya tri ya ya tri ya rā tsa bse mo'i sgog snying brang shag tshal rbad sod dza ram̐ hur thum bh+yo drag lor me lce 'bar ba 'dis gdug pa can gyis srog snying gdar byad phur rngod gtong thamasacad thub yon tan bsam gyis mi khyabasasoḥsam yuḥ3)ces kyang sngag skyesadabang phyug dam pa kun bzang dngapad+ma chosa'athel rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bskul ba dang dgos gal gyi do gal dang bstun nas kho bo bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa sarbamaṅga le

—8 snye: gab pa'i sham lnga dzi shā91na/ mo gu ru artsig nirtsig hrīḥhūsgosaḥphaṭaḥ sa bdag klu gnyan bisne ta krita re ram̐ na ga'i gdon tshogasa'adi yisagazhom par 'gyuraḥs ma shāḥrgya rgya rgyaḥ mo gu ru artsig nirtsig hrīḥshā khro phaṭaḥ gri sri gri btsan be+esde ta krita re re gri shi lung po 'di'i rdul du brlagaḥ sam ga rgya rgya rgya ma gu ru artsig gertsig trīḥ(ཿkhrophaṭaḥ nye 'gong zhing 'dre bisne ta krita re ram̐ nye 'gong zhing 'dre'i za kha 'di yi chadaḥ ma shā rgya rgya rgyaḥ o gu ru artsig —rtsig trīḥ(ཿkhroḥphaṭaḥ za 'dre god sri bisne ta krita re ram̐ḥ phung byed gdon tshogs 'di'i rdul du rlogaḥ sam shā rgya rgya rgya tsug gu ru artsig nirtsig hrīḥ(ཿkhro phaṭa be+e ze dam sri bisne ta krita re ram̐ rtag tu 'tshe ba'i 'byung po drung nas 'byinaḥ sam sruḥrgya rgya rgya drag sgrub me lte'i 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i gab don lnga pa 'di rin chen brda' yi sgrom lasabadus chosabadag dharmā kun bzang dang kirti 'gyur med rgya mtsho rnams dgyesapa'i rgyu gyur ma la

/'di: khyed shes dad pa drag po yis smon lam 'di ltar gdab par bya na mo gu rtsa spyi bor dza lasto ra'i rgyan gcig puX dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma dam pa dngaḥ bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang gis0 bdag gi smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang po mdzod skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad duḥ log lam kla kle'i dbang du mi 'gyur zhing nang ba sangs rgyas bstan zhabs tshud pa dang dge sdig blang dor 'jug ldog mkhas par shogaḥ sems can pha mar mthong ba'i 'du shes kyis0 gnod 'che'i bsam sbyor spyod pa mi rtsom par rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod lam bzhinaX phan dang bde ba ster ba'i mthu ldan shog phyi tshul chos brgyad dgras dbang mi 'chor zhingaḥ nang gi rnam rtog g.yeng bas mi bslu b.raḥ thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nasaḥ dpal mgon bla ma'i mnyes pa 'grub par shog rigs bzang blo rno the tshom dra ba chod theg chen chos la yid ches glo thub nasaḥ nyin mtshan snying po'i sgrub la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i lam grogs lha dang srung mas mdzodaḥ rdo rje bla ma mig dang snying bzhin bstenaḥ grogs la brtse

gdung dag snang shugs 'byung 'phel snang srid sgyu mar shes pa'i lta ba yis 'khor 'das 'dzin zhen rang gshis grol bar sgo gaX ma brtsal ye yin lha sngags thugs kyi gsang ma sgrub rang chas rtsa rlung thig le'i khams ma 'dres 1nga gsal ngo rang thugs rjes gshisaḥ ji bzhin ma nor ma bcos rtogs par shogaḥ shin tu 'byung dka' kun bzang thugs kyi bstan rtogs pa'i 'bras bu dus su smin pa la lam log lam stor 'khrul dbang mi 'chor bar nges don rtogs pa'i lta bsgom thob par shog rlung sims gnyis snang bag chags phra rag kun spros dang spros med shin tu spros med kyiX ma lus dag smin sbyangs rdzogs mthar phyin nas pad+ma he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shog med snang stong gzugs tsam gyi 'gro ba'i khamasaḥ gang la gang 'dul mdzad phrin rmad byung bsaX thabs mang thabs zab thabs mkhas la drangs te 'khor ba dong sprugs byed por bdag gyur cig de ma thob pa'i skye dang tshe rabs kun rmad byung rdo rje'i don ston bla ma dngaḥ 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur rta khyung he ru gaX chos nyid blo bral rtogs pa'i lta ba dang ldan

—8rdo: nas don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung gyur cigaḥdza ya dza ya su dza yaḥde ltar smon lam su gdab pa rig 'dzan zhing du the mi sa ma shā rgya rgya rgyaḥzhes rta khyung drag po'i bsnyen sgrub byed tshe thun dang po'i skabasasu 'di ltar btab na legs snyams nas kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyisadabyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni snying nor shechasabagyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarbam la/

—8/de: smon lam gnyis pa niḥ yo sā steḥ sku gsum kun dngos pad+ma thod phreng dang che ba'i dbang phyug rta khyung drag po rtsalaḥ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gter chen rin po ches rnam pa kun tu thugs rjes ma dor skyongasaḥ snyigasama'i smag rum dzad pa'i rmongs pa bdag nad mug mtshon 'khrugs mtha' mi'i gzeng pas gziraḥ nag phyogs 'dre srin gdug pa'i dbang bsgyur teX skyabasadang re sa khyed rnams las gzhan ci phyi chos byis pa'i chos brgyad las dben zhing nang rkyen nyon mongs dug lnga bdud bzhi grolaḥ gsang ba rlung dang sems la dbang bsgyur nas bya ba dgu sprugs byed la mnga' brnyes shog med dang mi shesargyus med tshig gsum bsten sgo gsum bya btang byar med ngang la gnas ci byung re ltos dkon mchog khyed las med thugs rje rgyang thag ma ring bka' drin canaḥ lam log srid pa'i btson rar tshud pa'i 'gro med snang 'khrul ba'i gcong rung zug rngus mnaraḥ thar med las la a 'thas yang 'khrul ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di las bsgral du gsol gang la bsam pa'i phrin las chags thog bral sngon smon

thugs bskyed dag pa'i 'bras bzang pos gdul bya'i zhing khams ma lus yongs khyab pa'i phrin las byed po dpa' bo khyed las suX rgyal tshab sprul sku zab gter mdzod 'dzin pa da dung dus ngan tshe lo bcu ba'i bar nub med 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon mdzad bdag kyang gsar gyi thu bor 'gyur bar shogaḥ gsang sngagasardo rje theg pa'i bstan pa laX bshad sgrub lag rjes gol 'chug med pa dang 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du dbugs dbyung ba'iX smon lam gegasamed yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig de ltar dge 'dun 'du tshogasadus smon lam btab na stobs tshad med bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang 'gro don thog med 'byung bar 'gyuraḥsamawāḥ zhesapa'angabadud 'dul khyung drag rol ba rtsal gyis smrasate yig ge ris byed snying nor zhechas bgyisapa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma leḥ

—8 snye: gsum pa ni na mo pad+ma raye rgyal kun ye shesardo rje pad+ma 'byung mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugasaX skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad duḥbasam don chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs dal rten rin chen chud du mi gsan paraḥ thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin shog thams cad mi rtag sgyu ma'i rang bzhin canaḥ shes bya dpe bcu'i zhen 'dzin ldog par shog srid rtse nasabazungan rag yan chad duX sdug bsngal rang bzhin shes nas ldog par shogaX kun rdzob don dam drang nges shan 'byed cing mnyams rjes gang gtsor lam byed nus par sgo gaḥ mi bsru ngesapadakon mchog rin po cheX tshe rabs skyabs su bsnyen pa'i mthu ldan shogaḥ theg chen rtsa ba rin chen byang chub sems rgyal sras dam pa'i rnam thar bzhin bsnyen 37ga tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes suḥ rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs 'pho bar shogaḥnges gsang 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad byar med blo 'das rig pa rtogs par shog rnam shesatshogs brgyad sems kyi cha dag nasaX rang byung ye shes btsan sa zin

par shog thod rgal snang bzhi'i yon tan mthar phyin nas gachen nu bum skur gtan srid zin par shogaḥ gdangs kyi 'khor ba dbyings su ma stongs paraḥ gang 'dul sprul ba rgyun chad med par shogaX bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje'i bla ma yisaX thugs kyis bzhed don bdag gis 'grub par shogaX rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i bden stobs kyisaḥbadag gis smon lam gang btab 'khru/ba par regagaḥ bden pa dpang btsug chud mi za drang srong bden pa'i zhal bzhes yinaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rtso zhes pa rta khyu drag pos sgrub pa' dus su kho bo bdud 'aroms khyung drag rtsalagyis dag par smras te yi ge pa ni lungazin shes yabagyisapa dge legs 'phelaḥ sabomaṅga 'i dge'o bkra shis so/

gtsasdo: bza' tshogs niḥ mo āXhūṃ bde stong 'byu ba lnga 'dus pho brang dbusaḥ 'khor lo gsum gnyis srog shing ka ba gsumaḥ gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i dpa' bo dngaḥrdo rje rnal 'byor ḍak+ki'i byur bur gtamasaḥ lhan skyes ye shes pad+ma he ru gaḥ gsang sngags 'du ba paṇa grub rgya mtsho laḥ dga' bzhis drangs ba'i byang chub sems kyi rgyun ro mnyam rdo rje'i tshogs ston mtha' yas paḥ rjes su 'gro ba'i pho nya dbang phyug masaX mchod cing bskang nas khams gsum gdos grol te mi shig sgog gzugs grub pa'i he ru gaX khams lnga dwangs mar smin nas dbang bsgyur shog ma hā a nu rā ga a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes nus ldan rdo rjes so skyid ātuḥ lcags la brdal bas yon tan phun sum tshogasaḥbatung ba'i dwangs ma rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i rgyan tshogs brgyad rang rtsal drag pa'i tshogs la 'bul chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i dga' ston bzhesaX nus ldan pas so/

ga6sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i sngon 'gro chab byung sbos byung bzhugs soḥr mi: 4mnya14 na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye bsang chu bshamasal byin brlabs niḥ hū bisne ta kṛta phaṭaḥ bsang chu'i nang du hū las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyel ba ljang sngon g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa khro bo'i chas du ma rdzogs par gsal ba'i sku yi cha thams cad nas khro chung rdul phra rab tu 'phros pasaḥ 'byung po dam sri thams cad rdul du brlag pa dang mchod rdzas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rol bar bsgyur nus pa'i mthu ldan du dmigs laḥ hū bisne ta kṛta tshin+ta tshisto hū phaṭaḥ nyer gcig brjod lha nyid 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rol bar dmigasaḥ de nas mchod pa'i dzos la 4 byung niḥ hū bisne ta kṛta bsang ngo oṃ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod rnams su phyi mchod bkod mjes nyer spyod rnam pa bdun gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos 'dod yon drugaḥ sman gtor rak+ta rdo rje'i rig ma lnga bde chen sbyor mchod bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i rdzasaḥ kun

khyab nam mkha' mtha' bral klong yangs nas sgyu 'thul bde chen ltad mo mtha' yas pa dbyings las bton te ye shes dbyings khyon bkangaX pad+ma drag po'i gsang gsum bskang phyir spro 'khor ba dong sprugs bar du nub med gyuraḥ.o sarba bid su ra su ra a parta ya a parta ya hobadz+ra pu dza sarba spa raṇa dzaḥmadza sngagasagag yang rgya cho brjod denasabadud rtsi sbosabyung niḥsadri med dbyings la nyes grib mi dmigs kyang phral byung kun bawas rkyen gyi dri mas bsladaX rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i mi bzhed gyur ba'i nongasaXye shes dri med ngang du sangs gyur cigaḥsang sa le sang rnga ye swā snyare badz+ra dha pe pra tits+tsha pu dza me ga sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye aḥ/༷de ltar 4byung sbo byung bya mdza rdzasadagyesapa'i sprin du sharaḥsal tshegabad ra ga4ba gangashagan4paslorak+tabade klonganasaḥdagobasnyen sha ming da log so 'a bra'aba'i rangabasrelalas sngonadabangabazang po 'brasabusamatho rtog ge'i bloyisam bslad kyapadon gyitho masanamalar mnyamaḥrang mthong ༅gyisasgrobakha tshodregasabasgolnga4tso ra jaḥsamamā rgyargyargya gu mir maḥlhaḥzhesachos dgaralakhurabagasumadapablams྾bsku'atshar khorabadud lamasacadragartsalagyishag par pha4r+sā ma le/

'am/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX drag sgrub me lce'i 'doralo'i gsol 'debs bdud dpung zilaganon bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye thaza rgyal kun ye shes rdo rje che pad+ma 'cho gnasamangonagyur ngang e mahoḥ mtha' grol klong yangs bde stong pho brang nas pad+ma 'byung gnas dri med gangs can mtshor gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhom nus pa'i mthul rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobasaX rngams brjid srin pos thod btegs dpal ri nasaḥ 'gro ba'i mgon po rak+ka thod phreng laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhom nus pa'i mthul rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs ye shes me ri 'bar ba'i grong dkyil nas gu ru drag po dmar nag me phreng laX gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhom nus pa'i mthul rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs gdug pa klu 'dul khyung zhal dmar nag rngamasaX dbang chen hi yas sde brgyad dam la 'dogasaḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhom nus pa'i mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin

gyis rlobasaḥ gnam lcags rwa gdengs rdo rjes rgyal bsen 'daraḥ rab 'bar phur bas 'byung po ar la gtadaX gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhom nus pa'i mthul rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs bdud 'joms phag sdig khyung seng stag mo 'gyed dam sri brgyal byed dri ngan phyogs bcur 'phro gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhom nus pa'iX mthul rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs mgo phreng sbrul do mi lpags sked chings mdzes khyung gshog sdeb cing klu rigs zas su za gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhes nus pa'i mthul rtsal med du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs gnam lcags dbal phur dus mtha'i me ltar 'baraḥ phung sri'i snying 'dar rak+ta sob sob khol gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhom nus pa'iḥ mthul rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs dran pa tsam gyis sde brgyad dpa' skong zhing sgrub pas 'jigs tshogs ming gi lhag mar byed gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung gzhom nus pa'i mthul rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobasaḥsred na mtshungs med yi dam

ga6 sdo: dpa' bo khyod 'bral med rang sems chos kyi 'khor lor bzhugasaḥs lam rtsal rdzogs me ri 'bar ba sarigs 'dus bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med regagaḥde ltar gsol btab byin rlabasa'ajug rgyal bsen gdug pa'i sbyor ba zhi 'byung po.ar gtad sgog snying lhud shin tu zab pa'i rno so yod sa mamā rgya rgyargya gu rgyaḥlha gsung mchog rak+ta'i mtsho gling nas dge bsnyen sha mi go ra yis dusatshig bstan pa zhal re gro rten 'brel dge phyir shog skyar pheb brdathem ka / maṅga le cesachos bdag snying nor dam pa kun bzang dang pad+ma chosa'athel rgya mtshoganyisakyisanan bskul dang grogs rat+na sa rasabaskul ba rnams don dang ldan phyir bdud 'jom khyung drag rtsalagyisadag par phab pa zhal gro

'am: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las rol mo byin rlabs kun bzang chos sgra bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye rgyathago rol mo rdul sprugasasangs sbyangs bya stong nyid lta ba rtogs pa yisaḥ hū 1 rtag gyi rdo rje snang ba zang thal byedaḥ chos dbyings dril bu'i mtha' bral dgongs pa mtshon bcu drug ltag sprod dpa' bo yab yum rdzas bya ba yongs grub rol mo ting ting shagaḥ khams gsum chos sgras khyab pa'i rnga bo che grags stong chos 'khor bskul ba'i mkhar rnga dngaX kha grags dbyangs nyan rgyal ba dgyes pa'i sprinaḥ snyan 'gyur ye shes glu yi mchod pa rnamasaX ka dag klong las gzugs kyi bkod par ngomasaX rdul snyed rgyal ba'i zhing kun mchod byed cingaX stong gsum 'jig rten chos kyi rang sgras khyabaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa mthar phyin shogaḥ o badz+ra ghaṣ+ṭi dharmā shabha ri ti a hā de nas bgrangs phreng byin rlabs ni yo sarba dharma ga ga na āX phreng ba rnams bde gnyegs zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor du gsal gdabaX 'phreng lung ye shes lnga yi

gsang lam la mdo 'dzin kun bzang yab yum gyi dgongs nyams la dgyes par rol ba'o kun kyang bde ba chen po'i gzi byin 'bar te gar mdzad byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyi rdul snyed rgyal ba'i zhing gi gzi byin bskul bar mos lha tshogasakun gyizhal nas gsang sngags snying po'i rang sgra 'u ru ru sgrogs pas 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon dwangs bcud byin rlabs dngos grub kyi rnam pa ma lus pa bsdus nas bdag sgrub pa po la stsol bar dmigs laX snye rutso ram ṇipra war+bhan yeswā hā dbyangasagasal rten snying lan gsum brjod me tog 'thor la rab tu gnas samagaḥye dbang chen gsung ga gsang mdzod na pad+ma rak+ta bde klong nas dge bsnyen sha mis sprad pa'i brda srid len bral ba'i ring bsrel lasaḥ sngon smon dag pa'i gnad gsang krol bstan 'gror phan phyir shog skyar phebaḥsamashāḥrgya rgyargya gu stsa brdanimaḥlhaḥzhes pa 'di'ang sngagasaskyesaral khur bu gsum slob busnyim nas bskul ngor mi sdog phyirakho po bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyisadag par phab pa dge legathanga'aphel sa mar+sha le/

bskyes: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥskyabs sems tshogs bsagasadangos grub dpal stsole bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mogu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ shākya'i 'a thal sbyar mos gus ra med pas mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le me dpung gi klong na gu ru pad+ma rta khyung drag po rtsal la rig 'dzin paṇa grub rgya mtshoḥyi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bka' sdod pho nya rgya mtsho rtsa gsum sprin gyi phung po thams cad kyis bskor nas rang cag rnal 'byer pa la zhal gyi phyogasaḥsbyan gyis gzigasaḥthugs brtse ba chen pos rtag tu srung zhing bskyab par dmigs la skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni na moye nas ma bcos rang grol rtsa ba gsum yongs 'dus rigs stong rta khyung drag po rtsalaḥbadud 'joms rdo rje gar dbang bshad pa la gang shar rang grol rjen pas skyabs su mchiX lan gsumaḥhoḥganyis snang sems kyis bzos pa'i 'khor ba'i 'phreng srid par lu gu rgyad du 'khyams pa'i 'groḥmatha' grol klong yangs sku gsum sar 'god phyiraḥlhag mthong rdo

rje rnon pos gdeng bskyed do lan gsum yo aḥsgro thams cad mnyam nyid chos sku'i dkyil 'khor laḥngo mtshar lta ba dag pas phyag 'tshal loḥ snang srid ma bshams ye rdzogs bkod chen po tshogs drug rang grol rtogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul a 'thas gzung 'arin rtsol sgrub sems kyi nongs klong chen chos kyi dbyings su bshags bgyi'o dus gsum ka dag kun bzang dgongs mnyams laX yid ches dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngoḥnam mkha mtha' khyab gdul bya'i zhing rnams laḥ sku gsum mdzad pas chos 'khor bskor du gsolaX don gyi ston par gshegs bzhud mi dmigs kyangaX skal ldan mos ngor yun du bzhugs gsol 'debs dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs gcig bsdus teḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo bar bgyiX nam mkha'i mtha' yas yid can 'gro ba rnams rang rig mngon gyur nang dbyings sa thob shogaX masgopa ni sa āḥ〉ཿ stong gsum bkod mardzas bye ba phrag brgya'i dpalaX phung khams rtsa 'khor bde stong mchod pa'i sprinaX kun gzhi tshogs drug bkod pa rig par drilaḥ thams cad 'ub

—8rdo: chub ye shes klong du bsdusaḥgashi bzhengs bla ma rta khyung drag por 'bul0 dgyes bzhes 'khrul ba ka dag dngos grub stsol tre rat+namoṇ+ḍal badz+rathu dzi te.atuXde nas tshogasago bsdu ba niḥdzahūṃbohoḥtshogs kyi zheng rab 'byams 'od du ltems kyi zhu nas bdag cag rnams la thim pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rol bar dag smin rdzogs par bsam 31ཿde ltar phul bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib pa kun dag don gnyis 'grubaḥsamago yemabade chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta dga' ba'i klong rin chen sa gter phyur ba las dge bsnyen sha ma'i gos can gyis sprad pa'i rang bsrel dam pa nyidaḥsngon smon dag pa'i gsang ba mthong rten 'brel dag pa'i dpal du shar skal med rnamasal gsang rgya sdom sgo 'di srung shag yang le beraḥsama'i rgya rgyargya gu rgyabarda /maḥdziḥzhes pa 'di' lu zin ral khur bu gsum gyi bzhed pa dang nye charanyi ma na kyang bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'dul khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarbamasgol/

btsasdo mar rdzas byin tshos bsdus pa niḥ o swā bha was sbyangs rig stong ye dag chos sku'i mkha' dbyings lasaḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul ting 'dzin mchod pa'i sprinaḥ bde sbyin rdo bye daX ma'i gar dang bcasaX dbang chen pad+ma dgyes bskang sprin du spelaḥ yo badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃḥ mchod sngagasospel sngags bcas te spro sam tso 'gyur med mos gus rgya mtshor nusaldan pasaspel ba

bar: dwamachos thug gter 'dus pa las sngon gtor bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye ༷ bsgo sgo dkar skyems lams la sbyangs spel bsgyur chos nyid nam mkha' mdzod du sgo hūdza stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten chen po ru dbang bsgyur sa yi lha mo bstan ma dngaḥ sa bdag lto 'bye tsang kun sa 'dzin dpal dri za zud phud lnga pa yul lha'i gtsoXsrid pani lha dgu gangs dkar nyi shu gcigaḥ phyi nang gsang ba mchog sprul sde brgyad dngaḥ lha klu drang sgong dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kunaḥ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nyid las skad :ga yud tsam thogs pa med par byon0 bza' ba dkar gsum 'bru yi gtor ma bzhesaḥ btung ba g.ya' gangs chab dang ja chang stobasaḥ dgyes bzhes dkar po dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzod gzhan yang rnam 'gyur khro la rngams tshul 'chang las su dgra 'dul sgod pa sgol la dgyes zas su dmar sprod khams gsum yud kyis bsgoraḥ sgog la dbang za nag phyogs dregs pa'i tshogs rta

khyung drag po'i dmabasgrags tha tshig 'dir yud tsam dbu 'phang dma' bzhin gus bcas te dgyes byon sha khrag brgyan pa'i ba ling ta bzhes la dgra bgegs dam sri tshar bcad nas sangs rgyas bstan srung sems can phan bde spel sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog dus drug srung zhing skyongs grub 'bras rtags spel 'jig rten dpal yon kun bsdus la mthun snang rnal 'byor dpal du stsolaḥganyer bcol bzhin duphrin las rab 'byams sgrubs0 bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sam yā phud skyems mchod cing phrin las yol thog med yid bzhin 'byung bar ra sa bde chen gsang ba dbang gi ོgas pad+ma rak+ta'i mtsho gling du dge bsnyen bkra shisazla zhal gyis rin chen brda mdzod sgom rgya gtadaḥsngon smon dag pas phrin las mthong 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda grolaḥ ma lcargyargya rgyagu rgyabardathimasnyizhesapa 'di'ang losabadag ral khur bu gsum dang bla ma dam pa bi masabaskul ngor khob bdud 'jam khyung drag stsal sa mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda lasazhalabashusate dag par phab pa dge legasa'aphelaḥsarbamaṅga zha

bsko: dam chos thugasagater 'dus pa lasaḥ dbang chen rta khyung drag po sgrub pa'i cha lag sngon gtor chang glud bsngo ba bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ ༄snye114 bdag nyid skad cig gis dran rdzogs gnyug ma'i lha sku dbang chen he ru ka dmar po g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dur khrod dpal chas kyis mdzes par brgyan zhingaḥ zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor thabs su bsgrad paX che btsan gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud cing ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du snang srid zil gyis gnod par bskyed doḥ de'i spyi gtsug nas rta skad drag po stong gsum khengs par sgrogs pas lha srin dregs pa dam sri 'byung po thams cad dbang du sdud cing dam la 'dogs par bsam mo na moḥ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i 'dre bgegs dam sri 'byung po las dang rkyen las byung ba thams cad sprin yul mgron du khug cig oṃ sarba byu ta a ga ya dza dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ o swā byu

was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las 〉ཿlas rin po che'i snod du o las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung por gyuraḥ sa āḥhūṃḥ lan gsumaḥ sam bha ra dnga.a ka ros glud gtor zad med gar+ṣa du spel de nasagayo po las kyi lha rang nyid dbang chen gnas su gyur pa las bdud 'joms rdo rje pad+ma drag po rta khyung rngams pa'i brtul zhugs can dpa' brjid bzod par dka' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan par bskyed doḥ o gu ru artsig gartsig hrī hūṃ khro bisne ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭaḥ bka' ba ོ gzhung ltar gtong/glud gtor bsngo ba niḥ ( hrīḥ mi dbang log 'dren 'byung po niḥ dug lngas myos pa'i rang rgyud can 'dod la gdung zhing 'khu ldog rkyenaX skye 'gro'i srog sdud sha khrag spyod nyin mor 'jab cing mtshan du rgyu sgrub la skabs lta glegs tshol byed da la'i mdangs dang mar me'i 'od rol mo'i sgra dang bdud rtsi'i bcud rak+ta'i dpal dang gtor ma'i rtsi sbos kyi dri dang rnal 'byor tsher gnod 'phrog rku ba'i 'byang po rnams ska glad 'bras chan mar me dang zhal zas chang bu 'theb skya dang nam mkha' mda' 'phang sha chang sogs 'dod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam paḥ sngon

badz+ra: gyi lan chags sbyangs phyir bsngo phra0/ gyi rkyen gegs bsal phyir 'bulaḥ rang rang yid dang mthun par sproX dga' mgu bde ba'i tshul gyis spyodaḥ da ni lan chags bu ma na sodaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir ma 'tshe b.raḥ bgegs rgyal 'dzadar bcas da song zhigaX sarba bisne ga〉〉 hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab bsrung ba'i gur khang rims brgyad gtamaḥ bar chad g.yul ngo dbyings su zhi bsgrub 'bras chud mi za bar 'byung sa ma yuḥye 4 dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde klong nas dge bsnyen sha ma'i sprad pa'i brda sbas don rdor tshig rang grol loḥs ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu rgya brda zimaḥdziḥ ces pa 'di' chos bdag ral khur bu gsum gyis bskul pa dang nye char bla ma be+e mas bskul ngor bdag 'dra bdud 'joms khyu drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba ma zug/

—6sdo: dam chos thugasagater 'dus pa las drags 'khros 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i byin 'bebs thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ rngonalha dad dang mosagusaja med pas byin go dbab par bya ba ni dam ldan sgrub pa po rnamasakyis mos gus tshad med pa byas pa'i mthus rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thams cad nas rtsa gsum zhi khro sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi ye shes gzigs pas dgongs nas sgyu 'phrul rdo rje phyag rgyar bzhengs te bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la byin chen dbab par bsam la hū hūṃ dzaḥ dbus mtha' rmed pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las bde gshegs zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyang rab 'bar rta khyung drag po'i skur bzhengs laḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol rngamasabarjid me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nasaḥ khrag 'thung khro bo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyang rab 'bar rta khyung drag pos skur bzhengs la sgrab pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol bde gshegs bkod rdzogs rdo rje dbyings klong nas

bdun brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ rab 'bar rta khyung drag pos skur bzhengs laḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ yishes gcig la rnam rol mtha' yas pa'iḥ mdo sgyu sems phyogs rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor kunaḥ rab 'bar rta khyung drag po'i skur bzhengs laX sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsolaX lto nub rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas rig 'dzin slob dpon sras 'khor brgyud par bcasaḥ rab 'bar rta khyung drag pos skur bzhengs laḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥsku mtshog 'gyur med 'od gsal klong yangs nasaḥ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' sras 'khor bcasaḥ rab 'bar rta khyung drag pos skur bzhengs laX sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ gsung mchog 'gag bral bde 1nga rol pa nas pad+ma gsung gi rdo rje gtso dang 'khoraḥ rab 'bar rta khyung drag pos skur bzhengs la sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ thugs mchog 'gyur med gting gsal klong yangs nasaḥ gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa sprul 'khor bcasaḥ rab 'bar rta khyung drag

—8 de: pos skur bzhengs la sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsolaX bde stong 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i gzhal yas nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga rig sngags zhing skyes bcas rab 'bar rta khyung drag pos skur bzhengs la sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsolaḥ mngon spyod lhun gyisagrub pa'i gzhal yas nas khro rgyal yak+ka me dbal sras 'khor bcas rab 'bar rta khyung drag pos skur bzhengs laX sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol tshad rmed grin las thugs rje'i klong yangs nasaX las mdzad pho nya yang g.yog bsam mtha' yasaX rab 'bar rta khyung drag pos skur bzhengs la sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams sras 'khor bcasaḥ phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa yisaḥ bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas dang yod byad kun lha dang zhing khams phyong grol dag mnyam gyi rngol ba chen thor byin chen dbab tu gsolaX yodz+nyān dhartu.a be+e ya.a āX hā/ nam mkha' gang ba'i lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la thim

pas dag smin rdzogs par bsam mo de ltar byin dbab nyamasartogs 'phelaḥsamamā pad+ma rak+ta bde klong nas dbang chen gsung gi brda mdzod las chos bdaga'agyur mod rgya mtshalangor bdud 'a misadrag po rtsal gyisaphab dge bas bdud dpung 'dul bar shogaḥsarba maṅga /

bskyes: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX drag khros 'bar ba'i 'dor lo'i byin 'beb ye shes gze bskyed bzhugs soḥbadz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 〈pesgo dad mos shugs bskyed pas 'ad skad doḥ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te rnga yab nas o rgyan rin po che ston 'khor sgyu 'phrul gyi phyag rgyar bzhengs nas bdag cag sgrub pa po la byin chen phab cing dbang mchog bskur par bsam la hrī skye med chos sku spros dang bral mod kyangaḥ rang bzhin thugs rje phyogs ris mi dmigs pasaḥ ye shes sgyu ma rta yi brtul zhugs suḥ bzhengs nas snang gsum dri ma dbyings sbyor phyiraḥ don dam ye mnyam chen por byin chen phob 'khrul 'khor bkod pa gzhi la sangs ba dang0 lhan skyes nyi ma'i 'od chen rab 'bar teḥ chos sku'i mkha' dbyings 'bras bu'i gter rgyas nas sku gsum brdal khyab chen por byin chen phob dbab bskul spros pa gdod nas ka dag kyang rten 'brel tsam du gdul bya'i mos mtsho rtsa ye shes gzigs ldan bla ma drag po yiḥ dngos grub mchog rtsol

dam tshig mi g.yel b.raḥ dbyings rig gsang mjod rtogs pa'i sgo phyes nas chos zad blo bral mngon gyur byin phob cig dz+nyā na dhartu badz+ras maya ashe shaya a.aX de ltar byin phab nyamasartogasagazi byin 'baraḥ sa ma māḥ.e bdechen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong rin chen snying po phyur ba nas bgo skal dge bsnyen sha mis sprad de don smon lam dag phyir mthong rtog ge'i blo tshag gang ma bslad brda tshig rjen ner bkod pa 'di rtag tu skyong shig dregs pa'i tshogs bka' log lag tu ma shor cigaḥsamawāḥrgya rgya rgya gu byu brdachamaḥsnyiḥces pa 'di'angasngags skyesabu gsum dang btsun pagimasabaskul ngor khom bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba ma le/

badz+ra: byin bskul ni dkyil 'khor mchod rja sa rnams las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis bskul te rnga yab nas o rgyan rin po che ston 'khor dang bcas pa sngon gyi thugs dam las bzhengs te lho nub gyi nam mkha' la byon nas: 'ja' zerazeraḥ mdangs 'bar 'baraḥ 'od lam lamaḥ byin zib nib byung nas bdag gnas yo byad rnams la byin chen 'bebs cing dbang chen bskur nas rtogs pa mngon du gyur bar bsam laḥ bzhedas bskul gyis gsol ba gdab par bya'o 'di yanganusaldan pasathol byung du bkod pa'oḥ ces gi phyi badz+ra gu ru ༷ṭ+wāṃ ༷/dī phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsaḥ trīX ya rtsit+ta hrīng trīng dza dza badz+ra ko ka ra sarba sirnyi pha la e a ra li trī trī tho pho a she sha ya a āḥ zhes so/ nus ldan pas so/

bar/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ rab 'bar drag khyung zil gnon rtsal gyi byin 'beb 'od zer phung po bzhugs soḥbadz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ 241 sha go spos dud bto rol mo sgrogs snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad doḥ hū dzaḥ sto nub srin yul thod pa'i sku mkhar nasaḥ 'jigs byed raku thod phreng gtso 'khor bcasaX gu ru rta khyung drag po'i skur bzhengs laḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa bskyed ༷ ye shes sku mchog dri bral rdo rje gzi 'gags med gsung gsang pad+ma 'bum sprin 'khyilaḥ gting gsal 'khrul bral bde ba'i mdangs ngoms la sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa bskyedaḥ yon tan dpal ldan nam mkha' mdzod kyi klongaX phrin las bdud 'joms me rlung 'khyil ba'i garaX dug gsum gdon 'dul yang sprul bsam yas pas sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa bskyedaX gnas yul dur khrod gsang 'dzin dus mtshan dang dus sbor chags sgol shugs thob chen mo yisaX phyag brnyan la ma dun skyes dbang mor bcas sgrub pa'i gnas

'dir byin phob rtogs pa bskyedaḥ khams gsum dbang bsgyur skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag srid pa thal 'byin 'jigs tshogs drung nas 'byin tshad med rang mdangs sprul pa bsam yas pas sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin phob rtogs pa bskyed gnas khang rnal 'byor dwa la yod byad kun zhing dang gzhal yas lha ru byin gyis rlobs rtsa rlung thig le dam tshig gsum gyi rten bde stong rta phag drag por dbang bskur zhig nyi zla skar tshogs bkra ba sems kyi mkha' gsal dang stong dang 'gyu cha la sgra de ltar chags pa phyi nang gi 'byung khams dag du bzhed nas nyi zlo skar tshogs la stog ge ma byed mapha rig stong bla ma drag por rgyas btab nasaḥ ye rdzogs don dam me ri 'bar ba'i zhing 'pho bgrod bral bar lhag mthong gdengs thob regagaḥ dz+nya na dhartu mu dra sarba sa ma ya pho pho dzaX de ltar byin dbab rtogs pa rgyasaḥdon 'grub chos kyi rgyal por 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ ye ma bde chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong ran chen snying po phyur ba las bgo skal dge bsnyen sha mi sprad smon lam dag pa'i gsang gtad mthong skal pa dman la 'tshor mi rung sam yu rgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes chosabadag ral khur bu gsum dang/ bla ma dzims bskul ngor bdag 'dra bdud
—8sde: 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba maṅga la/
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥsde brgyad zil gnon drag sgrub dbang drag 'bar ba'i 'dor lo bzhugs soḥ

gtsardo: na mo gu ru padh+wa ka ra yeḥ na byusmothu4 snasgo sgyus rab 'jigs dus me 'bar ba 'di sgrub pas rgyal bsen 'bog cing rgyalaḥ'abyung po ga yang nye mi nus sde brgyad gdug pa'i srog snying lhud dus kyi rgyal nad rims yams sel byad kur rbod gtong 'jigs tshogasabazlog bkra mi shis pakun gzhes 'gyur ze tshom me do sam shāḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi dban pa'i gnas su dam rgya bsdams phyi ltar gtor ma nyid la brten nang ni bla rdo sgog 'khor loḥgasang ba sgrub phur ril bu bsags rnam lnga nyer spyod yo byad bkrams phyi nang sgyu 'grul bral ba ru lta ba'i ོngas dang sgom pa'i srog spyod pa'i 'phrang bsal brtul zhugs kyis gang shar rang grol dgongs pa skyongs mi 'gyura'as sku'i ga ra gyis btab re dogs lta bas la dor nas kun mkhyen nye ru ka dpal gyi go 'phang mchog de bsgrod par gyisaḥsamashāḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ3)'byung ba snyegasama'i las dbang gi dus kyi nad gdon rkyen sna tshogs theb pa rlung dang khams la theb rgyu ba rtsa dang thog gur brten mi bde'i 'khrugs slong sna tshogs bskyed de phyir rtsa rlung thig le'i khamasaḥye shes lha dang pho nya yis byur bkang 'byung 'jug 'dzab rgyan bskungs bkod pa 'gros bzhi'i brtsal zhugs kyis spos bral 'od gsal nang nas 'char nyon mongs las kyis mdwad rgya grol snatshogs zug rngu rang sar yal 'ad ba'i nad rnams thams cad zhi tshe ni nyi zla dang

bskyes: mnyam zhing lus po yangs shing 'gro 'dug sla tshe yi rig 'dzin grub pa sogs ya mtshan nam mkha'i mthar mnyam moḥs mgo rgya rgya rgya gu mi3je sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsumaḥ dang po rnam grangasabadun gyi bstan tha 'irgyad dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni na mo ye grol nam mkha' lta bu'i rig pa 'di bcos bsgyur 'pho 'gyur bral ba zang ma thalaḥ rta khyung drag po me phreng ye shes skuḥbadud 'joms rdo rje rtsal la skyabs su mchiḥ gnyis pa sems bskyed ni hoḥ tha snyad mtshan ma bral ba don dam pa so so rang rig rjen pa lhag pa'i lhaḥ bar du gcod bya gcod byed nga bdag kunaḥ lhag mthong rig pas thal 'byen sems bskyed doḥ gsum pa tshogs bsags na na mo lta ba don gyi lha sku mjal phyag 'tshalaḥ 'od gsal 'khor 'das rgyan bzhugs mchod pa 'bulaḥ gzung 'dzin tha snyad sgro btags dbu mar bshags ye nas rdzogs pa chen por rjes yi rang0 dgongs brda don dam brgyud pa'i chos 'khor bskoraḥsku dang ye shes mngon gyur g.yo med bzhugs spros dang spros med dge kun chos skur bzhagaḥ mi gnas mi dmigs kun bzang sa thob shogaḥ bzhi pa bgegs bskrad ni hā ni nga

bdag mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gdon tshogs la tshogs drug rang grol 'dod lnga'i dga' ston ster rnal 'byor sgyu mar rtogs pa'i brtul zhugs la glags blta skabs tshol mi nus chos skur gzhigaḥ 4 hūṃphaṭa lnga pa srung gabor niḥtrī stong nyid lta ba gzhom med nam mkha'i gur rig pa 'od gsal g.yo 'gul bral ba'i gzhiḥ nga bdag mtshan ma rang sar bcom pa'i mtshon 'di la gnyis su snang bas 'tshe mi nusaX dz+nyā na rak+ta sne drug pa byin 'beb niḥ4 nyi mi gnas bde klong pad+ma 'od zhing nas rngams brjed drag khros rta khyung zhal sbyor skuX dmar nag me phreng gtso 'khor sprul dang bcas gnas 'dir byon la rig pa'i byin dbob cig snye badz+ras we sha ya.a sa bdun pa mchod sa byin rlabs niḥtrī yul drug gsal sgor shar ba'i 'dod yon sprin sna tshogs rgyan gyi bkod pa bsam mtha' yas tshogs yul mtshan ma rang grol gter chen po ngo mtshar gang shar rnam grol rgyan du bkodaX sgo aḥhūṃha hosdiḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi rnam grangs 'byuḥdang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni ྅ཿmtha' 11la nā nga yangs ba la khyab nam mkha' cheX rang bzhin 'od gsal thig

badz+ra: le gra zur bralaḥ zung 'jug rten snang /༷ dmar 'od lnga 'byugs lhun grub rten dang brten pa'i rgyu ru shar oṃ aḥhūṃ badz+ras ma dhī tso gnyis pa lha bskyed niḥ hrīḥ'akhrul ba ru bzlog ye shes dbyings bsgral ba'i lhun grub 'byung ba lnga klong yum gyi mkharaḥ t+t+waṃlas thod mkhar gru bzhi sgo gru ldan nyi zla'i seng skar zhing chen bla bre dang ba su ta yi zab mig bsgril 'phyang gnam lcags 'ur mos gzer gdab rak+ta sbyaraḥ rkang gi shar bu rtsib ma'i mda' yab phub zhing gi ba dan gdugs dang rgyal mtshan mdzes de dbus chos 'byungadamar nag e yi dbusaX rgyal bsen sde rgyad spyi chings bsnol ba'i kharaḥ sgrudamar las bskyed dmar nag me phreng sku zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum dmar zlum 'khrugs smar smin me 'bar zhal gdangs mche bzhi gtsigasaḥ shangs nas saglu 'brug stong ldir bzhin sgrogs dmar sel ral bajes thod skam dbu rgyan bcing rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma leb rgan 'khyil bshad gla nyi yas dregs tshogs dam la 'dogs rngams pa khyang zhal smag nag span zung 'khyilaḥ lcags rwa gzengs shang kring kring

༷nga ༷nga sgrogs klu rigs lnga gsol phyag gi gnas su son phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje rwa gdengs gzengs rgyal bsen 'byung po'i sgog dbugs lhud par byedaḥgayon gyi dang pos gnam lcags phur pa gzir dus kyi gdon tshogs 'thar zhing 'bigs par byed g.yas phyag tha ma'i dur phag mgo dgu 'dzin g.yon gyi 'og mas lcags sdig mgo dgu bsdams rang 'dra'i tshogs dang stag seng khyung dmar 'phroX ra tsa bse mo klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul 'byung po bsngangs shing 'bogs brgyal ring bar byedaXkhyung bde gas rngams pa g.yas dang g.yon du gzengasaḥthogs med las la myur ba'i phrin las ldan mgo phreng sbrul do mi lpags sked chings brgyan sku smad gnam lcags dbal phur me stag 'phro pho nya lce spyang sna tshogs bu yug 'tshubs dri ma mi zhim dpag tshad rgyang grags 'phro smon log bdud sde'i dpung tshogs ring zhing byer spyi bor rig bdag rakru thod phreng rtsalaXdamar smug he ru ka dpal rol stabs bzhugs phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa'i bhan+ta brtenaḥdar dpyangs rus rgyan stag shams rgyan du 'chang de yi phyi

badz+ra: rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi laḥ shar du dus mtshan dmar mos bhan+ta stob lto ru dus spyor sngon mos tsit+ta 'dzinaḥ nub tu chags sbyor skrug nag kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams byang du shugs sgrol ser nag lcags phur gziraḥ kun kyang gcer bu mi lpags zhing g.yang gsolaḥ ral 'phyangs nu pad rgyas shing khro 'dzum sgegs me rlung 'dzabs ma'i dbus na gar bsgyur 'gyingaḥshar sgor dbang phyug nag po ral gri phyaraX lho ru gshin rje tshe bdag thod dbyug 'dzinaḥ nub tu badz+ra ki la lcags phur 'drilaḥ byang sgor seng ha ḍak+ki gri thod 'dzinaḥ kun kyang rang rang rgyan cha 'jigs tshul spras phyogs bzhi'i bdud dpung rdul du rlog par byedaX rab 'bar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bskyed lha tshogs gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon lasaḥ 'od 'phros rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing rnams dang rngams brjid pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nasaḥ gu ru drag po yab yum gtso 'khor bcas phyag rgya yig 'byu phyag mtshan rnam pa rtsa spyan drangs dbyer med bde ba chen por bsreḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa niḥ hū sdi chags med bde stong 'od gsal pho brang nasaḥ rang byung rig sku

dmar nag me phreng rtsal rta zhal khyung gdong rngams pa'i gar dang bcasaḥ 'od gsal mnyam brdal dwa lar gshegs su gsol phyiyirgyad pa mtshad gzug mu ge solaX nang gi rkyen snang nad yam brgyal nad bzlog gsang ba bde sdug nyam kyi bye brag kun gang shar rang grol bde klong sgrol ba'i phyiraḥ dmar nag miphreng 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol rgyal bsen dregs pa'i srog la dbal phob cigaḥ sa badz+ra sa mas dzaro bzhi pa bzhugasagasol niḥ trīḥ chags bral gosar bde stong zla nyi dang0 log 'khrul rū tra rgyal bsen bsgol ba'i khar drag po 'jigs byed rngams pa'i dbal bstan nas bsgrub pa po la brtse ba'i zhal mdangs stonaḥ dz+nya nas mas ti)lhan lnga pa phyag la'i ni na mo skyo'agagasa'agyur med bde chen ye shes skuḥ rang byung thugs rje brtse bas 'gro rnams sgrol yid bzhin nor bus gdul bya'i re ba skongs dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal loḥn mon ma hoḥ drug pa mchod pa ni 〉 nyi gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin rā tra bsgral ba las dbang yul phung khams skye mched don snying bcas tshogs yul rang grol rig pa'i rgyan

badz+ra mchod rnams lhan skyes bla ma drag po'i dal du 'bul bdag med mnyam pa chen por rab bzhes nas 'khor 'das dag mnyam rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ.o ma hā panyu 5 dza hoḥ bdun pa bstod pa niḥ hūṃ nyi dmar nag me phreng rngams brjid khros pa'i skuḥ dbang chen hi sgras sde brgyad dam la 'dogs zil gnon khyung glus sa bdag klu gnyan 'tharaX rta khyung drag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod phyag g.yas rdo rje phag 'gyed rgyal gdon 'dul g.yon pa lcags phur sdig pas dam sri 'daraḥ dbal phur rngams pas bdud dpung ar la gtadaḥ rab 'jigs dus me 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ye shes me yi gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin bsregs dug rlung 'tshubs mas byad phur rbod gtong gtor sdig khyung phag seng 'gyed pas 'byung po 'dul rdo rje pha lam gar la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ gang sku mthong bas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma 'gagasaX bzhad glu thos pas srid pa rnal bor byedaḥ dran pas mod la 'jigs tshogs ming lhag 'gyuraX lha mchog thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal bstod dpa' bo'i dgyes bskyed bde stong dga'

bzhi'i gzugs ma rung 'byung po 'thar byed pho nya 'gyed ngo bo gcig las rang bzhin rdul ltar g.yo phrin las mtha' yas dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod 'di bzung ji srid sku gsum mngon gyur bar lha mchog thugs kyi thig le dang 'grogs nas phyi nang gzhan gsum tha snyad spros pa kunaḥ rig pa 'od gsal klong du dag gyur cigaḥ brgyad pa 'dzab kyi mchod pa niḥtrīḥ dam tshig sgog gi go rur shar ba yi ye shes gting gsal ting 'dzin 'gyur med sgogaḥ 4 dmar rig mdangs bde ba'i 'khor lo lasaX nus pa stobs brgya'i zer mdangs g.yo ba yisaX kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub nad gdon rkyenaḥ mi gnas mtha' bral dbu ma'i klong du sangasaḥ nyams rtogs 'od gsal ting 'dzin rig mdangs rgyas thams cad mnyam nyid bla ma drag por sharaX gzung ba sna tshogs me ri 'bar bar dag 'dzin pa klong grol ye shes lha ru sminaḥ gnyis med mnyam nyid spros mtha' bral bar rdzogasaḥ kun khyab rang rig 'dzab kyi mchod pa 'bul oṃ gu ru artsig nertsig hri hūṃ khro phaṭaḥ ki la ya gnod byed sarba bisne ta krita ram̐ reX yengs med rig pa gzengs

—8rdo: bstod nas ting 'dzin 'khor lo zhal sbyor bar gnod byed gdug tshogs ar la gtoḥ 'khrul bun zad sar skyol bar byedaḥsamag dgu pa sgrub 'dzab niḥ hrīḥ chos nyid stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi khyonaX rdo rje khro chen rngams pa'i brtul zhugs kyisaḥ mtshan 'dzin dug gsum gdon tshogs ma lus pa shes rab yum gyi mkha' ru brtung zhing 'thags thams cad 'od gsal drag po'i dal du sadaḥ gnod bya gnod byed nga bdag ka nas dag mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang mdangs 'dzab mchod 'bulaX sa gu ru artsig nertsig hri hū khro phaṭa rgyal bsen dza/ gnyan gyi 11ga la gī la ya rbadaḥ ting 'dzin khro bo'i 'od zer 'gyed bzlas pa 'brug gi sgra bzhin 'ur dgongs pas dug gsum rtog pa gcod gzhes med rdo rje'i 'dzab la brtsonaḥs ma māḥ bcu ba las sbyor 'dzab dmigs na hrīḥ khams gsum yongs sgrol lta ba'i gdan sa dzatsho tha snyad blo bral sgom pa'i lhar bzhengs nasaḥ gzung 'dzin mtshan rtog spyod pas tan ghan bsgyuraḥ mtha' grol klong yangs rig pa'i ra bar btsud rkyen gyis mi shig pad+ma drag po rtsal ༷ dug gsum gdon la za ba'i srin por shar srid gsum snang shes thal 'byin phrin las myur0

rab 'jigs dus me 'bar la rtags tu bltaX ma rig gzhi la sangs ba'i 'dzab mchod 'bulaḥ gu ru artsig nertsig hri hūṃ khro phaṭaḥ ra tsa 'khu na rdu bur shig shigaX 'da' na ra tsa'i tsit+ta phyung phyung ldog na ra tsa'i tsit+ta gtub gtubaḥ ra tsa bse mo nā ga tsig tsigaḥ a hab habaḥ be the'u sod sodaḥ gnod byed 'byung po'i kha 'dar 'daraḥ snying 'dar 'daraḥ srog 'dar 'dar zhe sdang snying la ram̐ ram̐ 'dod chags khrag la sbud sbud gti mug sha la rbad rbad phrag dog dbug la ye yeḥ nga rgyal rus la dza dzaḥ rtsa dbugs srog la yi shud dzaḥ tsit+ta phyung phyungasaḥ thun thunaḥ dza dza0 trag raka srog chod zud zud ki li ki la ya sarba bisne rba hūṃ phaṭaḥ drag sngags me lce'i 'khor lo 'di bzlasapas rgyal gdon 'byung po 'dul phrin lasanus stob bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsalaḥsam mā gsum pa rjesarim tshog mchod ni rnam grangs bco lnga'i sgo nas bstan dang po tshogs rdos byin rlabs niḥ sa ༷sa brdal khyab ka nas dag pa'i gzhong pa rtsa sna tshogs ma 'dres shar ba'i dgyes mchod tshomasaḥ gang shar rang grol dgongs pa'i byin rlabs nas tshogs drag zhen med lnga mo'i 'dod yon smo o

badz+ra: aḥ/ badz+raspa raṇa khaṃ gnyas pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren naḥ hū hrīḥ snang ba mtha' bral dur khrod me ri 'baraḥ srid par dngos zhen bcom pa'i dga' ston tshogs dug gsum rang grol sha rus khrag chen gtam shes rab sgron me tshul khrims dri bsung 'thul rig stong rjen grol 'dod yon bsam mtha' yasaX rkyen ngan lam sgong phyag rgya gar dang bcasaḥngo bo ka dag rang bzhin 'od gsal klong thugs rje mnyam par brdal ba thig le'i sprinaḥ dga' ston sku gsum bkod pa lhun gyis grubaḥ o aḥshāḥ'og min pad+ma brtsegasapa'i klong yangs nas rgyal kun thugs rje phrin las gcig bsdus paḥ bdud 'joms rdo rje pad+ma drag po rtsalaX gshegs bzhugs spros mtha' bral ba bla ma'i skuḥ don dam ngo bo nyid du gnyis med kyangaX rten 'byung gdul bya'i mos 'dod bskang ba'i phyiraḥ ye shes sgyu ma rta yi brtul zhugs can drag po khyung glus gdug tshogs 'dar bzhin du rang bzhin tshogs la spran 'dren gshegs su gsol sgrub pa po yi chags nyams bskang ba dngaḥ dngos grub ma lus myur du thob pa'i phyir bsod nams ye shes tshogs

chen 'di rol laX gting gsal sku dang yon tan mngon gyur shogaḥ o badz+ra gu ru pad+ma kro ta sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod ni hūṃ hrīḥ rab yangs brdal khyab ka dag gzhong pa ru lhun grub tshogs gtor 'dod lnga'i lha mor bcas ro mnyam rdo rje'i mchod sprin mtha' yas paX ye shes sgyu 'phrul pad+ma drag por 'bulaḥ o ma hā gaṇa tsakrapu dza khā hiḥ bzhi pa bar bshags niḥhoḥ gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur nasaX rtag chad mu bzhir gol ba'i nongs pa dngaḥ sor byang sngags sdom nyams pa'i nyes sgrib kunaḥye shes rig pa chos skur bshags bgyi'oḥ badz+ra sa ma ya snyi shukhyeyaX lnga pa bsgral ba niḥ / bh+yoḥshes rab mtshon chen bdag med phur ba'i dbal nga bdag mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i ru trar gdabaḥ rnam shes dbyings sbyor phung khams dum bur gtibasaX khams gsum 'khrul 'khor bde gshegs dgongs par bsreḥ sarba duhra mā ra ya phaṭaḥ drug pa stabs mchod ni 〉 hūṃḥ ma rig bsgral ba'i dbang lnga don snying bcas chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i zhal du bstabasaḥ zang thal mgrin bar+sād spros bral stor byub nas pad+ma drag po'i sras

gtsasdo: su byang chub shogaḥ sarba rū tra ma ra yā me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha re khā nyi bdun pa lhag ma niḥ hū spyo rdo rje bde gshegs gsung gsang rdzogs pa'i garaḥ pad+ma drag por dam mnos gnyer thob pa'iḥ ma sring gang ling 'bar ma dbang phyug rnams chos nyid stong pa'i mkha' la shugs kyi 'groḥ brda dang bshugs pa gar dang glu la dgyesaḥ gsang sngags mtshan tsam 'dzin pa gtsug tu bkuraḥ bde stong spros bral 'od gsal mnyam rtogs bskyedaḥ rlung sems ting nge 'dzin gyi drod tshad nyulaḥ rnal 'byor grogs mchog sgrub pa zab mor gdung bdag dang khyed rnams g.yar dam gcig pa steX dad pas 'bod do dam tshig gnas 'dir byonaḥ pham phab lhag ma'i brngan mchod 'di bzhes laḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsang lam nyer bstan nasaX dwangs ma 'od sku bdag gis 'grub pa dzasgyu gegs med yid bzhin stsol zhig dam tshig can ma ma hrīng bā ying ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ brgyad pa pha tho ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ dang po sangs rgyas mi g.yo mgon po dang sgyu 'phrul ston pa rigs lnga gangs can mtshor mi mjed skyabs mgon pad+ma thod phreng dngaX rig 'dzin

brgyad dang rje 'bangs lo paṇa gyi sbyan sngar khas blangs mna' bor dam mnos pa'i pho mo ma ning dregs pa rgya mtsho yis gsang sngags bstan dang der 'dzin 'dus sde dngaḥbastan pa'i sbyin bdag rnal 'byer sku tshe dngaḥnyamasartogs yon tan legs tshogs ma lus paX yar ngos zla ltar spel bar zhal bzhes bzhin0 brngan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes laX bde skyid chos dang ldan pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥmatha' yidamag chogs du ru ka yi sdeX thar med sa bon sgrub pa'i nyams pa can ༷ skal dman na rag skye nges zhing bcu tshang bka' la 'khru zhing dam la 'gres pa'i bdud dam sgonyi'anargyal bsen klu gnyan gtodaḥ nag phyogs sde brgyad gzings pa ling pa'i tsheḥ sma phab zil gnon ar la gtad pa yi tha tshig blang bzhin dam bsgrags 'dir gson laḥ'adod lnga rang 1 la mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ dgra dang bgegs la bka'i chad pa chod nyes pa tha dag ming gi lhag mar gyur rdzogs ldan snang ba dar rgyas phrin las mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā dgu pa bstan ma niḥ bh+yoXche dbang reg 'jin pad+ma rgyal po yiḥ

ba ra spyan sngar khas blangs chos gter gnyer gtad pa'i brtan g.yor dbang bsgyur tshe ring mched lnga dang rten 'brel 'byung ldog legs nyes so 'dzin pa'i ma mo bcu gnyis bran g.yog 'khor dang bcasaḥ lhab lhub rgyan dang dril g.yel bshud pa glu brda dang thal mo zhing gi g.yab mos 'apodaḥ 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs dbu 'phang dma' tshul gyis bshal chus skyems dang bā ling brngan mchod bzhes rnal 'byer bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bzlog mthun snang phrin las rgya mtsho gegs med sgrubs mtha' mi dbus 'tshubs dmag 'khrugs rtsod pa sogasaḥ 'jigs rten rgud pa ji rnyed bsal ba dngaX bkra shis rdzogs ldan dpal bskyed phrin las sgrub ༷ dam la ma 'da' ma mo bstan ma'i tshogs ma ma hrīng ma ma trī bā ling ta khā nyi r+sā pa rta bro niḥ hū 〉ཿ stong gsum rnam par dag pa'i mkha' dbyings suX dbang chen rta glu rngams pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: gnyis snang bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma kun bshigs nasaX rnam kun mchog ldan yum chen mngon gyur shogaḥ e dam sri ma ra ya rbad nan nan u r+sā ༄ga dngos grub ni

sno mi gnasaye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nasaX dbang chen pad+ma drag po 'khor bcas kyiX gsang gsum 'gyur med rdo rje'i dbang dngos grubaX skal ldan sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol rtsa sngags mthar sirnyi pha la a la la ho r+sā gnyisabazod gsol ni hoḥ gdod nas dri bral rig pa chos sku laX 'da' nyams srung 'tshams las 'das ka dag ngang 'on kyang gnyis 'dzin sems kyi mdud rgya las gol shor nor 'khrul chags nyams ci mchis bshags badz+ra sa ma ya.uḥ bcu gsum brdzo smon niḥ hoḥrnam dkar dge kun ma lus gcig bsdus nasaḥ 'khor gsum yongs dag dmigs med chen por bsngoḥ tha snyad mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor kun rnam grol rdzogs chen sku gsum mngon gyur shogaḥlan gsumaḥ bcu bzhi bsdu ldang ni hoḥ snang cha thabs su shar ba'i lhar snang kun rim bsdus 'od gsal ka dag rjen par u slar yang rten 'brel thabs mkhas kyis spyod phyiraḥ'od gsal sgru ma lta bu'i phyag rgyar bzhengasaḥ ā phaṭa bco lnga shes brjod ni na moḥ dbang chen rta glas 'jigs tshogs zil gyis gnon drag khros bla mas 'khyal 'khor rba klong

bas/ skem rngams brjed khyung zhal dug gsum gdon la gsheḥpad+ma drag po rtsal gyi bkra shis shogaḥdaga' ston bya zhing me tog 'thor rol mo sgrogs la shes yos skyongs gnad des don gnyis lhun gyis grub bar chad gamul lasarnamaparargyalaḥs maya rgya rgyargya gumi.aḥbade gshegasagasung gnas dga' ba' tshalaḥpad+ma rak+ta bde klong nas chagasabral ḍak+ki 'bum sprin 'khrugs bde stong pad+ma'i 'dzum tshal las dge bsnyen sha ma ko ra yis dus tshig bstan pa zhal gro zhang byin che mtha' btsan phran lasamyur shin tu zab pa'i rten 'brel yodaḥsam brda thi ka ḍaḥces chos bdag dam pa kun bzang dang pad+ma chosa'athel gnyis kyis bskul ba dang grogs rat+na sa ra bskul ba rnams don dang ldan phyir bdag 'dra rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rjes dag par phab pa maṅga thoḥ

—8rdo: ma t+t+waṃ hūṃ hūṃ ka kha kha dza0 ga ba nga ā tsa pa tsha wa ༷ za 'aḥ ra saḥ sha bhaḥ k+ta ṭa dha 'iX rte haḥ ca zha cha maḥ ra ṭa nya ṇa a riḥ e u o li zhes gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig la dpa' bo dang dpa' moX rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma ༷ tsan+ta dang tsarnyiX e o dang wa baṃ zung 'jug re bzhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i rjes chags kyi ros khams gsum srid gnas dbang du bsgyur zhing rdo rje'i go bgos nas 'jigs med las kyi dpa' bor gyur te bgegs bdud dam sri nye mi nus par bsam moḥ bdo skad cig la sad nas nus ldan pasasal ba dge dngas ma'i 'khor lo lngar rgyas gdab rgyu lnga ye shes khungs su sbyor dbang po dngas ma bzhir rgyas gdab dgongs pa brda dang snyan brgyud 'char srid sgo gnyis dang snyigs ma zung gtsang sbra gnyis bcom gnas gsum sdomaḥ tshig bzhi'i mtsho la rgyas btab pas skye ba gnas bzhi'i bag chags bcom srid sgo gnyis po bsdam pas rgyas mar gyis gnas gsum grogs khyer 'jigs gdong lnga khrims gyi bdag po'i rgyal rdzogs zin rtog la dbang bar byed dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma'i mdzad pa'i phran las chags thogs bralaḥ sarba maṅga le/

—8rdo: smon lam ni na mo gu ru hūḥ phun tshogs 'byung gnas lnga ldan lus kyi sbubasaḥ kun rtog rang grol srin gling brgyad bcu'i rtseraḥ tshogs brgyad cer grol thod phreng sde brgyad dbusaḥ bde stong zag bral 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rje yid chos 'ub chub rol byed he ru gaḥ nga bdag dbyings 'byin rta khyung drag po rtsalaḥ dug gsum gzhigs sgrol zhal gyis gzigs stangs ngomasaḥ snang shes thal 'byin dregs ldan snying la gziraḥ bdud bzhi rtsad gcod phyag gi dkyil 'khor naḥ mu bzhi dbyings sgrol dpa' rtags du ma 'chang 'khor ba dong sprugs rgyan dang cha lugs mdzesaḥ ye shes gzegs tshul gtso dang 'khor du ngomasaḥ gting gsal sgo 'byed zhi lhag me rlung 'khyilaḥ phyogs ris mi dmigs 'od gsal bum skur bzhugasaX blo bral rtogs pa mthong ba'i rnal 'byor laX rdo rje la mas brda thabs phyag rgya yis chos nyid mngon sum dpal ri'i sgo rgya 'byedaḥrin chen dun mas dga' bzhi'i zugs mig bcas nyams snang gong 'phel rak+ka'i 'du gral skyelaḥ pad+ma kha khas bde chen rol ston bcasaḥ rig pa tshad pheb drag khros sbyan

sngar 'god las rab shugs thob gar gyi rnam 'gyur bcas chos zad pad+ma rgyal po'i sras su byedaX rten 'brel gzhir sangs kun rtog mtshang stong nas ma rig sprin grol rig pa ye shes klong gdod ma'i chos sku'i gtan srid zin par shog gdangs kyi zhing khams rgya tshad las 'das paraḥ 'dren ston gang can mtsho yis byed par shogaḥ cesamawa bzhag sgo ltang byasatshe rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer na lhan skyesamakha' 'gros bsdod de ltar mdzad pa snang ba'i mod la myur b.ranusaldan pas bris pa dge sabo maṅgalo/

'am/: ma chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ sde brgyad ar la gtad pa'i drag sgrub me lce'i 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i dam 'dogs gab chung zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ sazlasmi dmar gtor skyems gams byin tshos teḥ hrīḥ bdag nyid gang shar rang grol he ru ka slob dpon pad+ma snang srid zil gnon sku che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs blta ltang gzir bdud 'joms rdo rjes glu dbyangs sgrogs par gsal dza sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' nyan dregs pa'i gtso phur srung bcu drug dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig srog bdag gza' klu bdud rgyal skyes mchog ging ma yam bstan ma 'khor bcas dam la 'dus hi dbang chen rta glu sgrogs pa'i dam tshig 'diraX phyi nang gsang ba mchog sprul sde brgyad dngaḥ rang rang rigs su gtogs pa'i dregs pa can ma lus dbu 'phang dma' bzhin dam la 'dus kring dug gsum las skyes 'byung po rang rgyad canaḥ sad dang ser ba thog gi sna 'dren zhingaX nad yams hur thum rgyags 'gyel ngan gtogs rnams bka' bsgrags dam gzir sgog dbab 'dir 'dus shigaX

eḥ skye 'gagasamed pa chos sku'i mkha' dbyings suX rnam rtog bdud sprin ji ltar 'tshubs na yang ye shes me dang shes rab rlung gis gtor bar du gcod bya gcod byed ka nas dgaḥ snyi slob dpon sdig gon khrag 'thung nag po yisaḥ ma 'khu dam la 'dus shig a cig tsig pakru si hūṃ tsit+ta shag shag dzaḥ bka' 'phrin khyod la gzir ro sam wāḥnyo bdag ni o rgyan pad+ma'i rgyud 'dzin yin khyed rnams lha 'dre de yi rigs dang 'khor cha ru gtogs tshad dad dang gus pas 'dus brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes laḥ thog mtha' bar gyi bka' las ma 'da' zhig theg chen snying po'i bstan ston zhing bcas srungasaḥ mi 'tshams 'byung po dgra sde'i tsit+ta gtubs thams cad skye med uru gtad cing bzhagaḥ rig stong snying rje'i 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur drag po rgyu bde lam bde 'bras bu bde bde ba chen po'i mdzad pa mthar phyin shogaḥ de ltar dam bsgrags masagator mchodaḥpho nya las la chun par 'gyur sam shā ye ma dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde klong nasaḥrin chen dpal gyis byur ba la kho bo'i bgo skal dge bsnyen gyis 'dzum pa'i dpal bcasagatad pa

—'di: la smon lam dag pa'i gsang sgo grol skal med rnams la a tham rgya rang rtsar brten pa'i skyes bu bdun sgo 'dir bsod nams skal ba 'dzom shar phyogs blo gros rgya mtsho dang ke kirti zung re gsal sto phyogs pha la kairti dang dz+nyā na badz+ra dpal dang ldan nub phyogasatshul khrimasa'ajigasamed dang rgyal mtshan ming can dam tshig dag byang phyogs dkon mchog mtshan can dang 'jam dpal gzhon nu bkra shis dge de dag dus su phun tshogasa'agyur rang skal sprod cig thugs kyi srasaḥ samakā rgya rgyargya gu mi brda nim lha zhesapa 'di'ang lung zan bu gsum dang bla ma bu ma dngarat+na sa ra rnam kyisabaskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyisadag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥs maṅgal/

'am/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i bskul ba rdo rje'i gad mobazhugs soḥbadz+ra: namo guru pad+ma raye 11bci sha chen spos bsregs tshil dud bdug rol mo sgra rngams dbyangs bcas teḥ hū hūṃ dza 'jigs rung srin po'i grong khyer dpal ri nasaḥbadud 'dul pad+ma rgyal po lo paṇa bcasaX thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs shigaḥ che ba'i stobs bskyed rta khyung drag po'i tshul rmongs pa klu 'dulakreng trīng 'brug ltar sgrogs bshad pa hi yas sde brgyad 'dar zhing 'bog khyung gshog rlung gis sa bdag gnyan gtod brgyal dmar zlum spyan 'khyel dug gsum 'byung po bsregasaḥ gnam lcags rdo rjes nyams pa'i snying rtsa 'byin rab 'bar phur bas za 'dre dam sri rlogaḥ phag nag mtshon 'debs mtha' ma'i gnya' gnon zhing lcags sdig gtser bas rgyal bsen snying khrag lhadaḥ dbal phur gzi yisakhams gsum g.yo zhing basbod me rlang 'tshubs mas bdud bgegs dam sri bsregs dpa' brjed 'jigs rung rngams pa'i

brtul zhugs kyis nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i gdon tshogs rdul du rlogaḥ nyid las mi gzhanaganyis med go cha'i lhaḥ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las stobs rdzogs pasaX rgyud lngas bsdus pas ma rig 'khrul 'khor kun ye shes chen po'i klong du da sbyor zhig0 las byed phag khyung sdig seng glog ltar 'khyug drag khros phra ba til gong byur 'dra bsaḥganyis su snang zhing rlang por spyod pa rnamasaḥ stong nyid snying rje'i dgongs par da sgrol zhigaX gnasayul bcu drug dus mtshan ma bzhi dang la ma dun skyes dbang phyug kha kha ste phyi nang gnyis su rgyu ba'i ma tshogasakyisaḥ 'byung khams bde chen mkha' spyod zhing du sbyor 'char byed nag pos mtha' ma'i 'phrul rgya gtor las gshin rngams pas zhing bcu'i don snying rngub bdud 'dul dpa' bos 'khrul 'khor thal mar 'byinaX dam tshig mkha' 'gros 'jigs tshogs mkha' la gtor dpa' rngams 'dod lnga'i dga' ston 'di bzhes la gnyer bcol phrin las rab 'byams thogs med skrubasaḥ bden pa dpang btsug chud mi za bar mdzod rten 'brel 'khor lo kun rdzob legs nyes kyisaḥ yo drang

(6/8: thig gis dbye mdzod dam tshig can ma bul ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yā0 zhesabarjod gtor skyems mchod par bya mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grubaḥsamagaḥ.e bde chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong rin chen snying po phyur ba las dge bsnyen sha mas sprad pa 'i brda smon lam dag pas gsang rgya bgrol 'dod sred can la 'chor mi rung thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shogaḥsamag rgya rgya rgya gu phyabarda' zemaḥlha zhes pa'ang lung zinasngagasaskye bu gsum dngabatsun pa je ma bskul ngoraḥbadud 'jom khrag 'thung rtsal gyis dag par phab pamarba masgol/
'tho: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥdrag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i bsrung ba rtsa lha bgo ba rgyan byi shog drilabazhugs soX

—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye thamadza/31 rtsa rlung khams rnams lha ru sad ye shes phyag rgyas gar dang sbyor nad gdon rkyen snang kun las rgyal shan tu zab pa 'i rno so yodaḥs ma yuḥrgya rgya rgya bdag nyid pad+ma drag po yi sku dbus dwangs gsal bzhin bzang ma'iX chos kyi 'khor lo shar ba'i nangaḥ gser gyi mchod rten tshon gang baḥ seng khri tshad med bum pa breX chos 'khor gdugs tog nyi zla mdzesaX lcags kyi drwa ba mig mang risaX kun kyang sdig phag phra mos gtams bum ster gnam lcags rdo rje niḥ rwa gdengs me yi tshwa tshwa 'phroḥ ste bar pad nyi zhal spyor khar gtsug dor 'khor bsgyur khro bo niḥ ser nag rngams brjed khros pa'i sku dur khrod dpal chas gar nyams rdzogs g.yas g.yon 'khor lo phur pa 'drilaX zhabs gnyis gyad kyi stabs su bsgradaḥ ste bar khro bcu'i 'du 'phro 'gyed phyogs bcu'i gdon chogs gzir zhing 'big thugs shar dbyings gsal ga'u dza rig pa'i ngo bo hūṃ dmar nagaḥ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor sharaḥ rang dang srung bya'i ming yig rtse srung sngags rgyal po zung gis brtenaḥ rab 'bar gsang ba'i snying po ni ye shes

bam: lug rgyud me phreng 'khor zer gyis 'byung po sngangs shing brgyalaḥ dri mas gdon tshogs ring bar byedaḥ pho nya mang pos dam sri 'tharaḥ gzhom med rdo rje'i gur khang dkrigaḥ sgo srung gsang ba'i bdag po niḥ mthing nag khro gtum dpal chas brgyanaX phyag gnyis rdo rje sdig pa bsdamasaX rngams brjed dus me 'bar ba'i skuX zhabs bsgrad gyad kyis bdud dpung gnonaX thugs mchog rol ba'i dal du sgomaX drag khros longs spyod 'khor lo rtsa dbang chen dmar nag thod sbrul 'dzin rta glu sgrogs shing dregs tshogs 'dulaX khro gtum drag pos gad rgyang ldir dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams sprasaḥ bde gshegs gsung gi rdo rjer dmigs bde chen 'gyur med 'khor lo stse shes rab ye shes me bo che 'od snang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshedaX ser nag ral gri po ti 'dzinaX khro gtum dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs rgyal kun sku yi rdo rjer sgomaḥ rab 'bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lnga niX dbus mthing rigs bzhi phyogs mdog tshulaḥ zhi la khro tshul ldan pa'i sku kun kyang gri thod kha ṭaṃ brtenaḥ rus rgyan gzig

shams gar thabs rolaḥ mthing nag ral bajis phag skad ngur ma rig 'khrul pa ru bzlog byed yon tan yongs rdzogs dpal du bskyed lte 'og chu srin rngams pa'i zhalaḥm rung bdud dpung gzhom phyir ngoms don dam bde skyongs 'khor lo steḥ 'jigs byed yakru me dbal skuḥ ljang nag khro gtum khros pa'i nyamasaḥ tho ba me zhags phyag char 'dzinaḥ zhabs bsgrad dug gsum gdon tshogs gnonaX me rlung 'tshubs dbus 'bying thabs rol dur khrod chas rnams rgyan du 'chang sprul pa thog ser 'khrigs bzhin 'tshubasaḥ bde gshegs phrin lasaspyi gzugs sharaḥ thabs kyi rang bzhin ro ma yang dbang chen rta yis rnam par gtams shes rab phra ba rkyang ma'i klong ༷ dgyes spyor phag mo skar ltar 'khrigasaX mtshan 'dzin rū tra'i gshed du shar dbang chen drag khros ral gseb tuX pad+ma thod 'phreng nam mkha'i mdogaḥ kha tswa bhan+ta phyag char 'chang gru mor thod rnga bkal ba'i sgas rig 'dzin paṇa grab rgya mtsho dngaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro smin ltar snadaḥ bde gshegs sprul sku'i dal du sharaḥ de steng ye shes ga ru ṭaḥ dmar nag rlang gi

badz+ra: gshog pa gzengs klu gnyan rol zhing kring kring sgrogs ༷ rwa bar nor bu 'od stong 'baraḥ sa gsum gdon tshogs 'dar zhing dngangs rang 'dra'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyedaX bde gshegs longs sku'i dal du bsgomaḥ de steng pad+ma 'dabs stong giḥ ze 'brur snang ba mtha' yas dmar longs sku'i rgyan cha bcu gsum sprasaX tshe mda' g.yas la bum pa g.yonaḥ snang dang stong pa zung 'jug skuḥ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gis bskor sgrub la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobasaḥ bde gshegs chos sku'i dal du bskyed drag khros rngams pa'i dbal phur lasaḥ pho nya lce spyang glog ltar 'byugaḥ mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'bebs me rlung dug gi na kun 'thibasaḥ dus mtha'i 'byung po 'bogs brgyal byed nad yams sna tshogs bsregs cing skemasaX dug gsum gdon gyi snying khrag lhudaḥ pad+ma drag khros rngams pa'i sku zil gnon 'jigs byed gī la yaX dgra gdon bgegs kyi gshed du bzhengasaX tha snyad mtshan ma'i 'khrul sprabs bshig ye shes gting gsal dal sgo 'byedaḥ rwa chen de ni lha yi bskyed rim ste las kyi rim pa dang po'oḥs ma

shā rgya rgya rgya rgyal srung dzos kyi spyor ba la gla nag rtsi dang yungs dkar dang gu gul thang phrom 'bras bu dang mu zi ser bo lnga btags nas 'bras chang khu bas ril bu ni til gzung bya zhing rta bon nyid bsregs pas khu bas na bza' gsol rtsa sngags sham du 'ad sbyar nas o ra tsa tsig tsig s+t+waṃ bha ya sto bha ya ma ra ya byer byer 'bog brgyal sum̐ sod rbad bye ba bzlas la byin gyis brlabs bsregs bdug khong btang rkyen las rgyal rgyal gdon nye bar mi nus soḥsam shāḥrgya rgya rgya rgyal bsrung 'khor lo bcing ba la cog lu'i khu bas gser shog laḥ sa byi la nag mo'i blun khyimasabya dmar bo' khrag sngar kyi rdzas lnga bcas srung 'khor la byugs mchan tharkusloja rgargadzabajadradārāgrudra111zasgo sgo/sargasathajojub mirmotsha zhal shepa /snyug sbug phyir dril la cas g.yogaḥ.a dang tsag zhes bya ba yi mig mang bkod la

—8/sde: lnga zhab bawas ril bu thal dkar gzugasaḥdabang lag khu ba'i gcig tu dril rgya rkag rtsi gsol bsam ser gsaḥrtsa sngags sham du 'di nyid btagasaḥ.arak+ta khol byungs rasmo yaklo bse mo shā na mo tshal tshal yo yo gtub gtub byer byer cit+ta khol myog 'bog brgyal thul thulaḥ'abum ther bzlas nas byin gyis brlabs bsregs bdug khong du btang ba na mo 'dres nye bar mi nus soḥs ma māḥrgya rgya rgya mo 'dre'i kha chi sa bawas 'dod na bya mo nag mo' snying shun la rgya snag rdzas lnga bsres pa yi khyi dmar bo' khragabong ngusatso spunaḥrgod kyi migasngar kya sa lnga 4sa srung lor la byung gos shesaltaramab gong bgo mthogabo da mithathapo'adri rtsozhe dazu'i kha za — sgome snye nye pa rnyali ra ra.a4da bolanar+sāramu snyug ma' phya na dkris la rgod gyis 4 rab tu gnas mgul 'chang 'dre mo'i rkyen las grol sa ma māḥrgya rgya rgya yang cig zayiga'adinaga'aXltarabri ((rdo rdzas ni r+sāng ga'i khrag ar nag ga 'bras bu sdag nag ga rus pa sogs 'thag pas phye mas khu bas bam mo/dmar nag ba gsum byugasaḥr sngags khri yi byin gyas bar+ṣas khong btang mo 'dre'i rkyen las grolaḥsam yuḥrgya rgya rgya klu gam bsrung ba'i rdzas sbyor la gla nag rtsi dang

klu bdud pa glag sder khyung mchu phag mche lnga zhib btags ril bu sbal gzugs byaḥ 'ol ba te lo' khrag gis dril re gyi khu ba rtsi gsol nas sngo sang ras kyi thum bur bya rtsa sngags sham du 'di nyid btagasaḥ sa nātshan ram̐ re sa na ga khol khol sa na ga khrol khrol sa na ga sa bdag gnyan gtod tsig cig mar mar 'gul 'gul tsag tsag gtub gtub khrol khrol chom chom byer byer re ram̐ dza rbad 'bum phrag lnga brjod byin gyis brlabs mer bsregs dud bdug khong du btags de yigs bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi gdug rtsub zhi ba dang 'byung po de dag nye mi nusaḥ sam māḥ rgya rgya rgya klu gnyan gtod kyi kha chings ba'i srung gcor gdags na 'di ltar bya bya pho dmar po' snying shun la rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa lan tshwa dang dug dang rta yi rak+ta yis snotā cha1〈snang / 'chang ba po la sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyi sbyor bas mi tshig par srung shig rak+ṣa rak+ta gas za je rnasan sna chu skyar gyi sha sha bas rkang / ṣe sha mi rwa khrag rna ba'i rtso sngar gyi rdo lnga 4 zung lor la byugs go sha shes ltar ro mar gong ltar sgron shing khong stong gi phyi nas dril la la cas g.yog mig zum sum bsgrags ri mo bya mgul 'ching sa bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sbyor ba mi tshug goḥsamagaḥ rgya rgya rgya yang cig za yig 'di ltar briḥ dzosani mdongs sngomi

ga'adi: bya'i sgro mdong klu 2da rdo rje gla rtsi mar dug gsum byugs rang sngags khri yis byin gyi brlabs kho rgyal bsen kluganyan sde brgyad kyis grib gdon 'joms pa' thabs zab mo rgya snag bzang drug bsres pa yis gza' 'joms mgo dgu khrag ma na 'joms gtod bzlog mu ser bo mapha sabadag gshed rta khrag mar the'u rang 'joms byed tsher nag sprag bdud kyi dug ཿming rwa gagos mababagegs dang ma mo'i gshed phag khrag ma grab gdon 'joms pa'i sa sbyor de rnam 'joms gzung sngags ci rigasapa'i ra ba dun shig phe lang hūṃ phaṭaḥsmra bcad bslo bzhin mgo ske dang ro stod sogs la bzhi skor btabaḥre re bzhin du sngags rtsi'i go cha 'di srog las btsa' shes byas nas 'chong rkyen snang bzlog par the tshom med sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya nus ldan stobs ldan za ya

sngags 'di khri bzlas rab tu gnas tsa gong dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying lan bdun brjod la khur mid btangaḥ mi tshig ma 'byung snga thog shu rten 'brel las la sbyar ba na bzlas pa dung phyur lnga ru 'gyuraḥshin tu zab po a tham rgyaḥ sa ma shāḥrgya rgya rgya de ni dzos sngags bsrung ba ste las kyi rim pa gnyas pa'o gu phya kha ཿ bdag nyid drag nge 'i rtsa ba'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa spros te rtsa lha rnams dang go cha'i lha rig bdag rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgongs pa mdzad mthu stobs phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i nus pa dang gzi mdangs bskyedaḥ nad gdon sdig sgrib 'joms pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'gyed gang la gzas shing dmigs pa de ming gi lhag mar gyuraX khyad par 'byung po gnod byed rgyal bsen klu gnyan sde brgyad thams cad 'bog brgyal thul thul song bar bsam la rtsa sngags sham med mthar khyen amai dhe wa ayuḥ sirnyi 〉hrīḥ rte ga ru ṭā hūṃ phaṭaḥ ma hā gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sarba sirnyi (ཿ hrīṣ+ṭi waṣ+ṭa ta na na (ཿ pad+ma ta krid khyasto wa/ hūṃ badz+raphaṭaḥ ḍasko ni ha'ishisahūṃX badz+ra sno yakū/ rak+ka sno mahwa dhe

—8sde: wa ka la ya man+ta ka badz+ra ki li ki la ya badz+ra seng ha mu kha hūṃX aXya maḥduX rtsatsaḥshaX na mā ra ya tsakra kro ta hū hūṃ hū hūṃ hū hūṃ hū hūṃ hū gyi badz+ra yaka dung dung ru ru bha sha phe khyi ma bye gri seng ha ma hūṃ phaṭaḥ rgyal bsen klu gnyan kyi srog la rbad sod sodaḥ bzlas sngags chu po'i rgyun ltar bzla 'khor 'das dpal yon dbang 'byor zhing phrin las rnam bzhi thog med 'grub bdud dpung dam sri zil gyas gnon khyi dkar byi ba byi la dang 'bags seng glang dmar bcom pa yi rtag mtshan bzang po 'char bar 'gyur the tshoms med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma shāḥ rgya rgya rgya go cha'i lha sngags bzlo ba ste lasarim gsum bcas tshang ba'o gu rgya ye maḥ ngan lam rgyal mchog sprul pa yis gsu mtshog rak+ta'i mtsho gling nas dge bsnyen sha ma'i brdas bskul tshe rang rkyen brnye dmar po'i gegs dus bdud a las chas pa'i sri bse mo zung ga rkyen snang kun dran pas gzhom mdzad zab pa'i chos rten 'brel don dang ldan pa'i phyir rin chen shog skyar phab pa'o skal med rigasal a tham rgya thugs kyi sras dang 'phad parashogaḥ samamā rgya rgyargya gter rgyagatad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang chos bdag snying nor dam pa pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtshodangadabang chen kun bzang bstan 'dzan dar rgyas zung gis bskul ba dang grogs rat+na sa ras nan bskul
gyi thabs bzang po bskul ngor bdag 'dra rgyal mtshog bshad pa'i rdo sadag par phab pa dge'o/dge'o/ dge'o/ legasaso/sarba ma yo/

bsko: dam chos thugasagater 'dus pa las srung ba las kyi gab chungabazhugs so0 badz+ra: namo gu ru pasmoka rayeḥ spyorgyazlasasgo dregs pa'i rgol ba tshar gcod cingaḥphas rgol ngan sbyor byad phur dang ban bon stong gis dmod zor gyis mi ma bsrung ba'i ra gur ni bdag nyid rta khyungadrag por gsal ba'i thugs gar khro bo gtsug tor 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba ser gsal rngams brjid bltar mi bzod pa'iX g.yas gser gyi tsakra rtsib stong dang ldan pa phyar ba la pho nya mtshon thun char ltar bab te dgra bgegs rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po thams cad tshar gcod cing rdul du brlag par bsamaḥ g.yon dbang gi zhags pa bsdams pas 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal pon ma lus pa bsdus te bsrung ba'i gur khang la bstims pas 'pho 'gyur gzhes gzhig dang bral bar bsam nang khang ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang thugs rten rin po cher brten cing dur khrod dpal chas rtags su bgo zhing gyad stabs kyi pad nyi rol zhing me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'o de yi thugs gar ye shes

sems dpa' ting 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte b.raḥ phra mo'i sems dpa' trī0 dmar po ring cha tshag drag dang ldan pa me rlung sdig khyung gi tsha tsha 'phro bas rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po thams cad bye ma dum bur 'thag cing gsol nas rjes lhag rdo rje'i me yis bsregs par bsam srog de yi khong seng su gsang ba'i srung gur/ཿ mthing gsal dwangs ma 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa zhig tu bsgomaḥ slad 'khor gyithig ler rang gortsa ba'ibla ma de rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par gsalaḥ zla tshes kyi ga'ur yi dam rtses gang che dngaḥ ha khog gi g.yas ngos su srung bya pho rigs g.yon du mo rigs mdun du bu slob rgyab tu 'khor g.yog rta phyugs nor longs spyod dang bcas pa gsal gdabaX 'aḥchung nang du chos skyong dam canaX zhabs kyu'i nang du sde brgyad kyi snying po gan gyal du gnon cing dam tshig gnad la dbab pas dregs pa mi srin pa'i rigs can san las la 'byun bka' 'khu dam log pho mo tshar gcod drol du brlag par bsamaḥ snyen nam sa madrucha d+marmasasko rna sa sita tapa dreḥ tshe snyi ma laḥ sa shad+maraḥ
