—8rdo: ma pra te ghi ra badz+ra dharma uṣ+ṭi ṣa tsakra wan+ti sarba yan dra man+t+ra mu la garma bhan+ta rna tatra rna kil yanan ma martsit+ta krita ye na ke nartsit+ta kṛtesarban dhichin+da tshin+ta snyin+ta bhin+ta ci ri ci ri ki ri ki ri ma ra ya sodaḥ hū :hūḥ hūṃ(je ༷ hūtsū hūṃḥ hū ༷ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaX bsrung dmags gnad dang ldan pa yas phrin lasalhun gyis grub par khruraḥ sa ma yu sde brgyad zil gnon drag sngags ni skyid log tri pa la nanaḥ sa ga pa sha nanaḥ nā ga du du nan me ma me ma nanaḥ tsid tsa ra tsid tsa ra nan ༷ rbad kra ko sha ya rbad kra ko sha ya nanaḥ ho ra ho ra nan baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu nanaḥ gnod byed sde brgyad rgyal bsen dam sri pho mo bka' la mi nyan paḥ ka pa tsa yaḥ klag klagaḥ rtsi du sod tsi du sodaḥ 'khor ba dul dulaḥ gdul shig srog gtub ha la bha ti rbad nan gnod byed rgyal bsen dam sri pho mo'i lus ngag yid gsum rlag rlagaX g.ya wāk+ka tsit+ta nanaX sod cig chings shig dum bu gtub cigaḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'gyedar dang bcas pa la srungs shig rak+ṣa bzlas pa sa rgyal bsen sde brgyad kyi sbyor ba' mi tshugasamapāḥrgya rgyargya kun〉badz+ra du natsakra rdi hūṃḥ bsrung ba kun gyi rgyal po 'ad bzlas pas

'gal rkyen kun lasagrolaḥsamamāḥsnyen mdun badz+ra rtsat+ta shag shag thum ril bye kun thub bsrung sngags 'di bzlasan ban bon kun rgyu'i byad las grolaḥs mashāḥyin trig shag /phaṭa tsit+tarak+ṣaX gzhom bral go cha 'di bzlas na gnod byed 'byung po dum bur 'groḥs mawāḥ( badz+ra rak+ṣaḥbasrung ba gcig chog 'di bzlas na 'gyur med rdo rje lta bur 'gyuraḥs mashā rgya rgyargya shin tu zab pa'i snying nor skor bde klong rak+ta'i mtsho gling nas rgyal mtshog bshad pamirdo rjesabastonaḥrang ga phan bde 'byung ba'i phyir chos bdagaral khur kun bzang gis bskul ba don dang ldan pa' phyir nu ldan rdo rjesaphab pa'oḥsarba ma loḥ

ga6sdo: gab pa'i shog drilalhaḥ de steng dug khyung me yi 'od zer 'baraḥ rwa bar snang mtha' bskal bzang sangs rgyas rdzogs rtsa lha'i gnas rnams go cha lha lnga sharaḥ ye shes dal dbus thugs rten 'od 'bar klong ༷ gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur dpal chen khro bo bcuḥ gnam lcags rdo rje nyi zla kha sbyor sbubasaḥ rig pa hūṃ dmar hriḥmatshan rtsa gsum dang bka' sdod pho nya bsrung bya nor longs spyodaX 'pho 'gyur gzhom bral srung ba'i ra gur gtams0 ye shes lnga rdzogs sku gdung 'bar ba laḥ ba spu 'od zer lnga yi dra gur glong phrin las sdig phag khyung nag bu yug 'tshubasaX 'byung po gdon tshogs rgyu ba'i skal ba med0 glag blta bar gcod chos kyi dbyings su sgrol mi 'da' rdo rje'i ting 'dzin mchog 95 gnatha ཿ bdapa mā mnyam bzhag gi sgrom rgya las nus ldan pas so/

brten: na mogu ru pad+ma ka ra ye rwabarlocha 8) drag por dmar nag me phreng giḥ mdun bskyed bca' thabs zhal shes ltar rtsang dra gtor thag gdugs ru dar mtshe yungs ke shing dug gis brgyan shin tu rngams shing brjed par bya rang nyid drag po'i ting 'dzan gyis lta stang gzags la 'di skad doḥ e mi'agyur bdostong spros dang bral ba'i mkharaḥ dbang chen yum lnga'i btags pa'i gzhi ma laX 'pho med rus pa'i ri rab brjid ldan kharaX spyoḥlas thod mkhar gru bzhi dbang 'od 'baraḥ ur mos gzer gdab rak+tas zham chu 'phyoḥ ba su'i 'phyang pa tsit+ta'i mdo 'dzin dang lha brgyad ka ba gza' chen ka zhu dang rgyu skar gral kheb ru sbal mig tshag mdzes rkang gi shar bu sgal tshig mda' yab dngaX zhed chen bla grelag pa'i 'phan yab dang nyi zla'i seng skar klu brgyad ka gdan bting 'dod snam dmar por rdo rje'i rig ma brtse 'bar b.li'od 'byugs dur khrod brgyad bkod rdzogasaX de dbus rin chen zur brgyad khri yi kharaX bde stong kha spyor zla nyi chos 'byung dbus dregs pa gza' klu the'u na kha sbrabs shingaḥ bdud btsan rgyal bsen gan skyal 'gyel ba'i stengaḥ hūṃ dmar spro bsdus yongs su

/'di: gyur pa las dmar nag me phreng dbu dgu bco brgyad phyag0g.yas gsum dkar la bzhad pa'i zhi tshul ldan g.yon gsum dmar la gshe ba'i rngams mdangs ngoms dbus gsum spug nag khro gtum drag shul can rtsa bdun spyan zlum dug gsum gdon tshogs bsregasaX mche ba tshad med bzhi bzhis 'gro khams 'dulaḥglog dmar ljags brkyang ma rig rū tra rolaḥshangs rnams hūṃ glus khams gsum g.yo mgul byedaḥsmar smin me yi tsha tshas srid gsum gzhomaXsnyan cha nyi zla'i 'od kyis mun khams 'joms ljang sngon ral pa gyen brdzes khams gsum 'dulaḥbade gshegs yongs rdzogs thod skam dbu rgyan laḥye shes lnga ldan dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phuraḥdabang chen rta dbu rngams pas sde brgyad 'dul drag po khyung glus sa bdag klu gnyan 'daraX rtsa phyag dang pos gnam lcags phur pa 'drilaḥgayas 'og gnyis pas brdung byed tho ba phyaraḥgasum pa gsang ba'i las bskul rnge'u chung brdzung bzhi ba rgyal bsen zil gnon rdo rje gdengasaḥlnga pas 'khor ba'i rgyan gcod gri gug 'dzin drug pa shes rab ral gri me

'bar phyar0 bdun pa klu rigs lnga yi ske nas bsdamasaX brgyad pas phag nag mgo dgu las la 'byedaX g.yon phyag gnyis pas mun sel nyi ma bsnamaḥgasum pa skye med don ston dril bu sgrogasaḥ bzhi pa dregs tshogs 'dar byed tsit+ta bsdamaX lnga pas khams gsum rgyan rol thod khrag rolaḥdrug pa 'byung po gzhob bsregs me dpung 'dzin bdun pas gza' klu rgyal po spyi ching bsdam ༷ brgyad pas lcags sdig mgo dgu pho nyar spro mtha' gnyis bzlog pa'i phyag rgya drag du sdebs khyung bsregag rngams pa g.yas dang g.yon du gzengasaX 'byung po rdul brlag dri ngan dpag tshad 'phroḥ sdeg khyung phag seng dug gsum gdon 'dul 'gyed kun rtog gnas dag mgo phreng brgyad cu sprasaḥ pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rus rgyan dang bya ba lhun grub dar dpyangs ljang sngon 'phuraX gti mug rgyan shar sbrul chun phyag gdub dngaX 'dod chags dbyings rol mi lngags rked chings byasaḥzhe sdang spros bral stag lngags stod du bcingasaḥ nga rgyal mtshan ma rang grol glang go sbrel lte 'og chu srin zhal nas 'brug stong rdir glog dmar ljags 'khyug gdon tshogs

btsasdo: 'bog brgyal byedaḥ dbal zur g.yas nas sgrol byed pho nya 'gyedaḥ g.yon ngos lce spyang mang po rlung ltar 'tshubs rgyab nas thun mtshon sna tshogs char ltar 'bebasaX log gsum las ni me rlung dug zer 'phroḥ phur rtse dug gsum gdon bsnol snying la zugaX ngo bo chos sku 'gyur med gdos po bralaḥ rang bzhin 'od gsal brda don rtags rdzogs sku thugs rje ma 'gags gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan dwangs gsal 'od sku'i bde chen 'khor lo nas 'jam dpal ser nag ral gri glegs bam 'dzinaḥ khro bo'i chas rdzogs gyad gyi 'dor thabs bsgrad sku mchog 'gyur ba med pa'i dal du sgomaḥ longs spyod 'khor lor dbang chen rta mgrin dmaraḥ thod dbyug phyar zhing sbrul gyi zhags pa bsdamasaḥ rta skad 'dul glu dmar ser ral dbus rngamasaḥ gsung gi dbang phyug rngams spyod khro chas rdzogasaX chos kyi 'khor lor gsang bdag gtum po mthing bsrung ba'i mchod rten 'khor bsgyur khro rdul 'khrigs ye shes dal srung rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzadaḥ khro chas rab rdzogs me klong gyad kyis rolaX thugs mchog g.yo ba med pa'i dal du

bsgomaḥ sprul pa'i 'khor lor mkha' 'gro sde lnga ni mthing dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i gzi 'od 'bari gri thod 'jin zhing gar stabs rus rgyan dang gzig shams dar dpyangs me long dril g.yer brgyan ral gseb phag skad ngur bas rmongs tshogs 'dul rerkongs yon tan yid bzhin nor bu bsgom chu srin zhal dbus bde skyongs 'khor lo sa khro chen yak+ka me dbal rngams pa'i sku smug nag rdo rje phur ba gdengs thabs 'dzin khro chas rab rdzogs me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus: brin las 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dal du sharaḥ thabs chen dwangs ma ye shes rta yi gtamasaX shes rab gsang chen bde stong phag sprin 'khrigs bskyod pas bskul te 'bar ba cher g.yos nas:byang chub sems gyi sprin 'khrigs zhing kun mchodaḥ 'khor 'das dpal yon dngas ma kun bsdus bstimasaḥ lha tshogs dga' bde stong pa'i 'khor lo lasaḥphun chogs lnga yi khams gsum rol rtsed bsgyur rdo rje gar gyis zhe sdang rā tra 'dul bde klong pad+mas mo gdon bse mo 'thar gnyis med bsreba'i ma rig gti mug sangs chos khams bcom pa chos nyid khro bo

bskye/sa: ni gar dgu'i nyams ldan 'jigs rung srin por sharaḥ spyi gtsug klu 'dulagatsug rgyan thod phreng rtsal mthing gsal gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug spras phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon pas bhan+ta 'dzin gru thor rnga bkalachenang gsal rang sgra yisaX rgya bod paṇa grub dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams thugs dam gnad bskul gu ru nyid la bsduḥsgrub pa po la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabasaX de steng longs spyod rdzogs sku ga ru ṭā me yi phung po rlung gi gshog pa canaḥ nyi zla'i spyan 'khyil bar snang go skabs 'byedaḥlcags kyi mchu sder rwa yis ltas ngan 'joms mjug mar rgyal mo gdong mo las la 'gyedaḥ g.yas g.yon gshog sdebs ma rung rkyen snang bzlogaḥ sa bdag klu gnyan gtod rigs zas su za dus mtha'i 'byung po 'dul ba'i dpal du sharaḥ rwa bar pad ma 'dabs ma stong ldan pa'i ze 'bru snang mtha' dmar gsal longs spyod rdzogasaḥ bcu gsum rgyan spras mda' dar tshe bum 'dzinaX 'chi med ye shes rdo rje grub pa'i sku dwangs ma lnga sang snang stong zung 'jug bskyedaḥ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi 'khor kyis bskoraḥ

sgrub pa po la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobasaḥ gnyis med bde stong rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyisaX phyogs bzhir pad+ma dam sri bsgol ba'i khar shar du dus mtshan dmar mos bhan+ta stobasaḥ me dpung 1nga nas gar bsgyur gang phran 'byed lho ru dus spyor sngon mo'i tsit+ta stobs ral pa bsigs shing rlung nag 'tshubs dbus 'byingaX nub tu chags sbyor sgrug nag kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnamasaḥ dug sprin klong nas tsit+ta ba su rolaḥ byang du shugs sgol ser nag lcags phur gzir sprin dkar klong nas phag dkar sprul pa 'gyedaḥ kun kyang gcer bu mi lpags sbrul do dang rusapasargyan 'ching khro gtum ha ha rgodaḥ ral 'phyang nu pad rgyas shing mkha' la 'phyoḥ me rlung dug sprin 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bskyedaX shar sgor dbang phyugalcags kyi ral pa gzingasaḥ mthing nag ral gri me rlung zhags pa bsdams srin po 'khros 'dra gtum rngams bzod dka'i nyams gcer bu dug rlang 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bsted lho sgor gshin rje tshe bdag char sprin mdogaX lir+sha bsgreng shings ma he glang rgod bcibasaḥ mi lngags go bsgos smral dang mgo phreng sgrasaḥ dgra sta zhags bsdams me

gtsasdo: dpung 'tshubs dbus 'gyingasaḥ nub tu badz+ra ki la ud+mal mdogaX dmar ser ral bsdes thod skam dbu la brgyan sbrul dang mgo phreng dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phuraX phyag gnyis sgrol phur 'dril zhing sku smad ni: lcagasaphur rme yi tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'phroḥ 'byung po dam sri'i snying la thog ltar 'bebasaḥ me glog dug gi ngad rlang phyogs bcur 'phro0 byang du bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong g.yu ral sprugs shing seng chung thog ltar 'bebasaḥ gri khug thod 'dzin mchan khung kha ṭ+wāṃ brten dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur rol chos 'byung e klong dam sri pho mo gnon me rlung rab 'phro sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro maḥ saya 'bum sde nyid kyi rnam rol ngoms de rgyab dregs pa pho mo ma ning rigasaX rlung gi shugs can rdzu'aphrul thogs ltar myuraḥ yeshesamatshon 'dzin zhing bcu'i dgra la 'debs sbyor dang sgrol stobs gsang sngags bstan la gdung0 pad+ma drag po'i bka' bzhin 'phrin las myuraḥ legs nyes stong 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'iḥ bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs thams cad bskyed lha tshogs kun gyi gnas

gsum zla pad nyiraḥ brten bcas rdo rje'i sa bon 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag yas 'phrosaX rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus dang rnga yab gling nas pad 'byung gtso 'khor bcasaḥ gu ru drag po'i gsang ba gsum du bzhengasaḥ bskyed pa'i dam tshig pa la sib sib bstim gnyis med zung 'jug chu la chu bzhag bzhin dbyer med bde stong mnyam pa nyid du bsreḥ o gu ru artsiganertsig nyi /khro phaṭaḥ kha ḍak+ko ling pa ḍak+koḥ ni la ḍak+ko phe leng ḍami mahwa dhewa yam ra tsa badz+rakai laya seng hā ḍak+kis midhe waḥ ga ru ṭabadz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal yaman+ta dpad+ma ta krita badz+rapa ṇidhak+ko niha 3rnasaḥ badz+ra sno yakru3 rakru sno tsakrakro nya // sno // sno hūṃ hūṃ ñtsa (ཿ sarba༄rmā pa la snyehra pa la log pa la aḥyaḥmaḥnyu tsa gaḥnaḥsarbas pa ri wa ra badz+ras maya dzadzaḥ bzhud glu sbyar spo snyan pa'i dbyangs rol mosasgrasabaskul spyan 'dren cing dbab bstims bzhug gsol phyag mchod bstodaḥ bzlas pa 'dzab dbyangs rgyun gyi bskul phrin las rab 'byams thogs med 'grub ze tshom med do mawāḥrgya rgyargya ske rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes skuḥ o rgyan pad ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ

—8(: zab mdzod ngan lam sprul ba la pha nor bsgo skal dam par son dus kyi snyigasamar gyur pa na ra tsa bse mosacho rol rtsubs de tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi gsung gnas rak+ta bde ba'i mtsho dge bsnyen sha mis gnyer ba yis zab gter brgyud pa bdo ru son ma dang ḍak+ki'i glu yisabaskul brda don gsal sgo nang nas sad rten 'brel snang gzugs phyi nas mngon 'di yang sayisagater du 'dug gsang bkrol rang rkyen sna 'ga' sel byin rlabs no nas bsam mtha' yas the tshom med do sam ku rgya rgya rgya gu rgya gter rgya gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya brda thimaḥlhaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mu ta dang kun bzang bstan 'dzan rgya mtsho'i zung gis bskul ba dang grogasarat+na sa rasanan bskul rten 'brel bzang por mthong nas bdag 'dra dbang chen dgyesapa rdo rje'am pad+ma 'gro mgon gling pasadag par phab pa dge leg 'phelaḥ sarba masgo le bkra shis so/

—8/sde: tshom bu bkod pa ni snying po brjod pa tsam gyis lhag pa'i lha gang dang gang yin pa de dag skad cig gis rgyan cha lugs ma 'dres gsal bar skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs nas dam tshig sgrub pa'i rten du bzhugs nas rnal 'byor pa la mchog thun dngos grub kyi char chen po dbab pa'i rten dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs par bsam laḥm gu ru artsig rtsig nyisnyikhrophag sam yatswaḥm badz+ragu rupad+ma thod phreng rtsalabadz+ra sam ya dza sirnyipha lahū ཿ sam yastoXm pad+ma khro garu ṭa hūṃ phaṭa sa ma yastoḥ3 a mi dhe wa amu0 sirnyi /hṝX sam yasaX yin yaman+ta gahū phaṭa sam yasto0 67 h+yaṣ+ṭṛ wa/ phaṭa sam yasto 67 badz+ra pa ṇi hūṃ phaṭaX sam yas oṃ ḍak+kini nyaphini sa: phaṭaḥ sa ma yasto slo badz+ratu yakru hū rakruhū sam yastoḥs badz+ra kha ḍak+ki ni hūṃ sam yasaḥ.o rat+na be+eng pa shāsko ni/ཿ sam yasaḥs pad+mani la ḍak+ki ni hūḥ sa ma yatswaḥ3 dmiphe ling ḍasko nihūḥ sam yastoḥskyid mahwa de wa dṛ ral pa can snyi sam yas ma yam ra tsa satwa meya snyi sam yastoḥ37 badz+rakai lishī laya

sno sam yas slo badz+rabadha ḍak+kini sno sam yas sa badz+rakrota hūṃka ra sno sam yasaḥ.a badz+rakrota bidza ya3 sam yasaX oṃ badz+rakrota nilan tan+t+rargyu sam yatswa o badz+ra krota ya marnya gsaḥ sam yatsā ཿsa badz+ra krota ār+yas tsa la hūṃ sam yatswaḥsnye badz+ra11ta rgyalho wa/ཿ sam yatswaḥs badz+ra11ta apa rartsat+ta sno sam yatsāḥsnyen badz+ra11ta a mṛ ta〈spyo li(ཿ sam yas oṃ badz+ra krota tī lo kyabaṃ dzaya /༷ sam yatsā ma badz+rakrota mahwa ba'i hūṃ sam yasaḥ.o badz+ragu rudhe wa ḍak+ko nitsan tsosno sam yatsā ces tshom bu ma 'dres legs par bkod yang lha sngags la snyen āḥ/cas dṛ〈〈rnyi snyi zhes gdag cing bum pa sa blugs bya'oḥ yang lha sngags kyis mjug nyusarba bisnan(laṭaXs mas s+t+waṃḥ de ltar yongs ོgas lha bum sogs sgrub sa bkram cing rta gon bya des ni sgrub pa mthar phyin cing nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phelaḥsamawāḥrgya rgyargya cesarang slob mitris ming gis bskul ngor nus ldan pas soḥsarba ma lo

bar: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag gsas 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i bum bskyed dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeX dza rgyun bab dri bral dri bzang sbag bla med so lnga'i gtams par bya dzos blugs lha grangs sngags kyas phul dwa lar bkod te nyer spyod bkramasaḥ hrīḥ chos nyid mi 'gyur bde stong 'od gsal klongaḥ rgya tshad las 'das bum pa gzhal med khang dur khrod thod mkhar bkod rdzogs pad nyi'i kharaX gza' klu dregs pa spyi chings bsgol ba'i stengaḥ hrīḥ dmar las byung rta khyung drag po'i skuḥ dug gsum gdon 'dul zhal gsum phyag drug pa khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs me rlung 'phyoḥ mgo phreng sbrul do mi lngags rgyan du 'chang rta dbu khyung gdong bzhad pa'i dregs tshogs 'dar g.yas gsum rdo rje phag nag gri gug 'dzinaX rang rgyud blta ba'i 'byung po 'bogs brgyal byedaḥ g.yon gsum lcags phur sdig nag thod khrag bsdams khams gsum mtshan ma smra gsung thugs su sboraḥ smra smad dbal phur 'byung po'i gdan la rol khro gtam chags 'khyal mtshan

tha ka dag byedaḥ rang byung bde klong kun rdar chen mo yiX dkyil 'dzar lnga ldalhon las lha lngas mdzes ro ma ye shes rta yi dal du bzhugs rkyang chen rdo rje phag gi rdul sprin chags nga bdag du tra'i mtshan ma dbyings su sbyor dus mtshan ma dzasbaganas spor dbang phyug tshogasaḥ sgo srung sde bzhi bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs ma 'dres dwangs ma'i thatsho ru gza' skar bzhin ye shes sgyu 'phrul bde stong rol rtsed bsgyur khrog gis bsku') ye shes 'khor lo kunaḥ rta khyung drag po'i rnam par ro gcig bsreḥ spyana'edragoms ga mja cing bstod de nas 'dzab kyi bsgyur kha niḥ 3 dmaco ga bskyed dza'isngags 'khor mchod sprin gyis zil gnon drag po'i gsang gsum dgyes bskang nas dbang byin yon tan spyo mtshor char bab ltar skal ldan dpal du nub med stsol bar dmigs bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa bya go mja bstod rjes shu snga ( ཿ dragagasas bdud dpudza zil ga nanal gyi lha tshogs na dang brten par bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang ro gcig 'dres par gyaraḥ de nas las bum bskyed bzlas ni shu byu smrangs las kya bum sde dmigs pa'i ngang las dur

badz+ra: khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba rngams brjid me dpung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su lhaXdamar yongs su gyur pa las dbang chen he ru ka dmar po g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon bhan+ta 'dzin paḥ dur khrod dpal chas mdzes par klubs shing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par gsal ba'i sku la khro chung nyi rdul ltar 'phros zhing 'khyugs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rab 'bar bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas pad+ma kro ta ye shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par bskul te dam tshig pa la sib sib bstimasaX sku yi cha thams cad nasadabang chen bde ba'i gzi byin 'khyugs pa'i byin rlabs g.yos te char ltar bab pas bum pa gang bar bsamaḥ ma h+ya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭaḥ brgya stong gang skabs bzlas pa'i mthar sngags kyis mchod cang bstod pa niḥ hūṃ trīX sgegasabashad ha la'i sgra sgrogs drags tshogs 'dul gtum rngams khros pa'i rnam 'gyur bzod dka'i gzi ma chags thabs kyis rol rtsed du mar bsgraraX khams gsum dbang sngad rta mchog rgyal por bstod bum pa'i lnga 'od du zhu ba nas bum chu la thim pas bag chags bkra zhing

bgegs dpung 'joms pa'i mthu ldan du gyur par dmigs laḥ las chu nusamathu phun tshogs nas phrin las gang bsam thogs med 'grubaḥ sam lha yemaḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma'igasang mdzod brda pad+ma rak+ta bde klong nas dusasu dge bsnyen chen pos bstsalaḥ smon lam dag pas gsang rgya grol snod min rigs la a tham rgya thugs sra bu yi dpal du shogaḥ sam yu rgyargya rgya gargya brda thimadzoḥces pa'ang lung zin bu gsum da bla ma 'i masabaskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jom khyung drag rtsalagyis spel ba dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma li/

(6sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las drag khros ril bu'i bsnyen sgrubagadug pa kun 'dul zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—'di na mogu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ zajache'iḥ sdeb sbyor zhi drag gang ltar kyang rin chen bum bzhugs dal dbus bkod rnam lnga nyer spyod mdzes par bkrams marga 'dzin rtog pa stong par sbyangs hrī ma skyes ye stong chos sku'i ngang nyid lasaḥ 'gags med lhun grub rang byung gzhal med khang sgo gru rta babs mtshan rdzogs pho brang dbus gza' klu rgyal bsen spyi chings bsnol ba'i kharaḥ thabs shes nyi zla zhal sbyor gdan gyi stengaḥ rig pa hrīḥdamar 'phro 'du zhu ba lasaX ril bu'i rang bzhin rta khyung drag po'i sku khro 'dzum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs sdang mig bsgrad rta dbu khyung gdong bzhad pas gdon tshogs 'dul g.yas phyag rdo rjes dam sris snying khrag 'byinaḥ g.yon pas sdig nag gtser bas rgyal bsen 'bogaX khyang gshog sdeb cing tsho rigs zhal du 'drenaḥ ngad lngan dri yis 'byung po brgyal bar byed mi lpags sngal do mgo phreng rus pas brgyanaḥ stu smad dbal phur gza' smra

rgyal bsen gziraḥ 'od 'bar me yis ma rig 'byung po bsregasaX gdug rtsub po nyas dug gsum bdud dpung gzhomaḥ gcig las rang 'dra sa ya dung phyur spro dpa' rngams stobs ldan bla ma drag po rtsal rta dbu khyung gdong bzhad pa'i he ru ga0 rgyal kun gsang rdzogs rdo rje'i sa bon bcasaX ma 'dres bde chen gsung gi 'khor lor sharaX gnas gsum 'od zer srog gi lcags kyu yis rtsa gsum rgya mtsho spyan drangs ro gcig bsreḥ de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshalaḥmachod cing bstod la 'dzab dmigasani bum pa spyo las rang byung gi gzhal med khang yangs pa'i dbus suḥ ril bu rnams bla ma rta khyung drag po rtsal gsal ba'i sku yi 'od zer gyisaḥ 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te gnyis med bde ba chen pos rang bzhin du bzhugs par dmigs laḥ bsnyen pa/ sarba pañtsa a dṛ bīsne ta kṛd ram̐ ram̐ mchan dang nye bsnyen bzla ā 'dzog rten khyenakhams thams cad yongs su khyab pa'i gzhal med khang gi nang du ril bu rnams gu ru drag po rta khyung bzhad pa rtsal gyi sku re re las kyang brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung byur grangs med pa spros teḥstong

—8 sde: khams gang zhing kun gyis 'dzab dbyangs ti ri ri bsgrags pas snang srid g.yo zhing 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed par dmigs laX sgrub sngags dang sgrub chen gyi bsnyen sngags sham duḥ a ra pa tsa mi ta hrī da ye swā hāḥ hūX ril bu rta khyung drag po rtsal du gsal ba'i sku las pho nya mtshon thun spros pas nad gdon 'byung po dam sri sde brgyad thams cad 'bog brgyal thul thul brlag cing bsregs par bsam la las sngags sham du sarba pathu ska dṛ ta kusgoli (ཿ aḥya65ཿdubasatsamigaḥn7)sno ta krita phaṭaḥ de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni hoḥ bde gshegs rgyal kun yongs 'dus bla ma dgongasaḥ tshogs sbyor mi slob lam gnas rig 'dzin gyisaḥ bsnyen cing skrub pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo laḥ tshe chos dpal nor zas dang longs spyod dang thun mong grub brgyad mchog gi dngos grub rnamasaḥ da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol sarba sidhi pha la oṃ uhū hrīḥ bsnyen cing sgrub pa rtags thon bya bar ga bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal tsheng ring nad med lang tsho dar bkra shis dpal yon rgya mtsho 'byoraḥs ma māḥye ma bde chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong ku ru kul las zur mig g.yo dmar mo sgra sgrogs

rtag tu rgyu dge bsnyen sha ma'i gos bzang po'i bsod namasanor gyi skal bar bstsalaḥ smon lam dag pa'i ring bsrel mthong brda don gsal sgo sgrib med gzigs sam māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimalhaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zan ral khur bu gsumagyis bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang bla ma bī ma nas kyang bzhed ngor bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo waṃ/

bsko: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥdrag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i hūṃ sgrub dregs pa ar gtad bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 71canarjes dmar nag me phreng la gas nas de yi hūṃ bsgrub zab mo bstan spyi don sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po byugs bdug brab gsum gyis phur ba la ni gzi byin bskyed rak+ta ha nyi ( bhisne ta krid phaṭaḥkarma du ca bh+yo0 rtsa sngags mthar dz+nyā na mu hā sarba sa ma ya stoḥlha grangs dang mthun legasapar bkod de nas lding khrir 'god pa niḥhrīḥbade stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang dbusaḥchos 'byung zla gam e yi 1nga yangs su ma chags pad+ma mdzes pa'i khri yi khar 'jigs tshogs zil gnon rta khyung drag po rtsalaḥdagongs pa'i dbyings las sgyu 'phrul phyag rgyar ngoms dam chig dag pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsolaḥ.a la la hos ma yā nyiṣ+ṭha lhan gnyis pa dngos gzhi lha bskyed ni hrī chos nyid mi 'byur spos bral ka dag klong gnyis snang dregs tshogs dug gsum 'byung po'i khar ma stes ye rdzogs bla ma drag po rtsal rta zhal khyang gdong rngams pa'i brtal zhugs

'ching khyung gshog sdeb cing klu rigs zas su za dur khrod chas rdzogs ye shes me rlung 'phro ༷ gnam lcags rdo rje phur pa gdeng thabs 'dzin dregs tshogs rgyal bsen dam sri 'bogs brgyal byed sku smad dbal phur dam sri'i snying khar zug 'jigs tshogs zil gnon drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogs drag po lha lnga sha za mkha' 'gro bzhiX khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs sgrug nag 'bar kun kyang phyag mtshan gnam lcags phur pa 'drilaX sku smad dbal zer 'byung po'i snying la gzir rdo rje'i gad rgyang ha hi 'byug ltar sgrogs sdig khyung phag seng tshwa tsha skar ltar 'khrugs gdon bgegs 'bog brgyal byed pa'i dri ngan spro rang 'dres khro chung nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pas sde brgyad dam sri skye med dbyings su 'thar grags stong glu dbyangs hūṃ sgras 'khor ba 'jigs ye shes thugs kyi rdo rjes gzung 'dzin gtor gang shar rang grol pad+ma drag por bltaX a u eḥgazhir bzhengs pad ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor la spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod bstod spros pa bralaḥ ye rdzogs mthong ba'i sku gsum lhun gyis grubaḥ khyab brdal rig stong

—8rdo: rdzogs chen mngon gyur ngangaX gsum pa 'dzab gyi lusal gcor niḥ trī sku gsum rang la rdzogs pa ma rig pas 'khor 'das ris chad sems kyi 'phyang thag kunaX 'gags med rdo rje'i glu yi brtul zhugs kyisaḥ mtha' grol klong yangs dbu mar rgyas gdab poḥ grags stong hūṃ glu yid bzlasabya dgongs pa skye med ngang la bzhagaḥsam shāḥ hrīḥ rlung gi rta byas nyi zla'i 'pho bsgrod canaX phyi nang 'jigs pa gsum gyi char gtogs shingaḥ kun gsal me long sgrib byed dri ma kunaḥ ye shes gting gsal rdul bral klong du āḥ bde ོ gsang ba hūṃ glu gyeraḥ ma māḥ hrīX lta dman 'jigs tshogs blo yi dri ma dang skye rga na 'chi kun btags 'khrul ba'i rkyen glo bur rmongs pa'i dri ma rab rib kun chos nyid mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings su zhi grags stong hūṃ glu shub bur bzla sa ma shāḥ hrīḥ theg tshogs ma 'dres mkhyen pa'i blo gros dang ye shes 1nga nas mjal ba'i rtogs pa'i sgo sa lam rim 'jugs thod rgal 'gros mgyogs gnadaḥ yon tan ma lus phyogs ris bral bar rgyasaX don dam dgongs pa'i glu dbyangs lenaḥs ma māḥ hriḥ na la ba dbyings grol dug gsum gdon tshogs

gziraX mtha' grol lta bas sde brgyad dbyings su gcun 'pho med dgongs pas rnam rtog ar la gtadaX skye 'gags spros bral rig par 'ub chub dbangaḥ mtha' grol dgongs pa'i hūṃ glu gyeraḥ sam shāḥ hrīḥ yul med mthong bas thogs bcas bdud sma phabaḥ gzhi med rig pas zogs med gab yul storaX ro mnyam rtogs pas dga' brod mtshan ma grolaḥ zang thal rjen pas snyems byed bdud 'dul drag / glu shub bur brjod pa yis phyi nang sde brgyad dam la 'dogs dug gsum 'byung po 'bog cing brgyalaḥ skabasatshol dam sri'i snying khrag lhudaḥsamayuḥ sde brgyad srog snying phul ba dang mkha' la 'phur zhing gcan gzan zhenaḥ 'brong gamag bkol la nyi zla btingaḥ 'bagasaseng bcom dang glang dmar bsad khyi dkar byi ba byi la bcom sre mong khyi ra phag gsum btulaḥ de sogasam mtshan can gyi ltas dngosanyams lam rnamasal 'charaḥ / sgrub grub pa'i rtagasamatshan noḥs mgaḥye maḥ dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i ba daḥ dge bsnyen sha mi sprad brda las smon lam dag pasagasang sgo mjalaḥsamawāḥrgya rgya rgya gu ma brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhesapa 'di'angakhun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgya dang dharma sto dzam k+ṣe sar dzasabaskul ngor khobo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyisadag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba maṅga le/ dge'o/ bkra shigaso/

badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX drag khros 'bar ba'i 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i dbang bskur rgyas gdab gyi gab don bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ 61rta dad pa mos gus ja med pas rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul teḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par steng gi nam mkhar byon nas rin po che sna lnga'i bum pa thogs te bum chu'i dbang bskur lus kyi cha shasakun du khyab cing brdal bas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad dag par byas dbang bzhi ye shes kyi rang zhal ci bzhin pa mngon sum du mthong chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las dbang rtags su snang ba mtha' yas gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i cod pan gyi dbu brgyan par bsamaḥ sa ma hā pra te snye k+ṣa na dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa ad+ma ko3je sa ma hwa a da〉 dzā na badz+ra swā byu wa ad+ma ko3nyaḥ au ma hwa sa ma ta dzā na badz+ra swā byu wa.ad+ma ko3je o ma hwa shu bye ta dzā na badz+ra swā byu wa ad+ma ko3jeḥ o ma hwa kṛ te nuṣ+ṭha

nadz+nya nabadz+ra swā bha wa.ad+ma ko3nyaḥ zhes dbang bskur bas rgyal ba rnams kyi rgyal tshabs su mnga' gsol 'khor 'das kyi spyi dpal chen por dbugs dbyung 'khor ba dong sprugs byed pa'i ded dpon du gzengs bstod mthu stobs nus pa rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par byin gyis rlabs par byas so oṃ ā& swāhwa dz+nyān panyuladz+ra sam yas a snyi ṣiñtsa tram̐ slar yang spyomar zla ba la gnas pa'itsan dkar poX mgrin par pad+ma la brten pa'i.ā dmar poX snying gar nyi ma la bzhugs pa'i/ sngon po gsum gnas pa la rgyal kun gsang gsum gcig jogs kyi lha snam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pas sku mi 'gyur bar rgyas gdab snang mtha' dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pas gsung mi 'gag par rgyas gdab mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pasathugs mi gzul bar rgyas gdab par bsam laḥs busadha ras mas s+t+waṃ:ṣ+ṭha badza āngad+ma dhar sam yatsā tikhyabadz+raḥ ( badz+radha ras maya stohaṃṣ+ṭha badz+ra denas rdo rjelis bon rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros te rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang rngams brjed rnga yab

ga6/sdo: dpal gyi ri bo nas o rgyan rin po che yab yum ston 'khor sgyu 'phrul drwa ba thams cad bla ma rta khyung drag po'i rnam par spyan drangs te bdag mdun bum gtor ril bu'i lha tshogs rnams la sib sib bstims moḥdamags pas dbang bskur rgyas gdab byaḥsam shāḥye mam chags bde chen gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong dbang mdzod rin chen sgom rgya las dpal bcud rig pa 'dzin la shar snying nor 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i ngor kho bo khyung drag rtsalagyis phab dge ba bdud dpung 'dul bar shogaḥsarba maṅga la/

bsko: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag 'khros 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i dgyes bskyed skyems mchod zab mo bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ sgom41 bcud ldan pañtsa a dṛ taḥ dkyil 'khor lha la bstabs byas teḥ sa u hūḥ rgyal dgongs brda snyan shog ser tshig gi rgyud chu bo bzhi phab drug ldan bla ma laX rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bulaḥ rtogs pa mngon du gyur ba'i dngos grub stsolaḥ mdo sgyu sems phyogs bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs rgyud sde'i sprin 'dus rta khyung drag po la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul klong chen dgongs pa mngon gyur dngos grub stsolaḥ klu 'dul khyung zhal dbang chen rta skad sgrogs gza' the sde brgyad zil gnon drag po la ༷ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul che btsan srid na mtshungs bral dngos grub stsolaX dbal ngar srid gsum 'byung pos bzlog mi btubaḥ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i mtshan rtogs dbyings sgol la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bulaḥ gnyis snang rā tra 'dul ba'i

dngos grub stsolaḥ nyid kyisku la rigs lnga'i zhing bkod rdzogasaḥ dbu gtsug sku gsum ston pa mnyam rol la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul sgo gsum rdo rjer sbyor ba'i dngos grub stsal dur khrod sha za mched bzhi'i bde stong stobs la ma dun skyes dbang mo bde sbyor laḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bulaḥ lhan skyes gnas yul mngon gyur dngos grub stsolaḥbadud 'dul mched bzhi dregs tshogs yongs kyi rje dbang chen lha lnga khams gsum sgog bdag la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul dregs pa bran du khol ba'i dngos grub rtsolaḥphug gsum sdongs lnga gling drug dbang byed pa'i pad+ma'i bka' nyan pho nya thams cad la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul chos mthun bsam pa lhun grub dngos grub stsol ma hāsarba pañtsa.a mṛta khā re khaX ye don dam bdob mchog gi thig le de mtshungs bral bhan+tar bsnyil nas rgyal ba mchodaX gsang gsum byin rlabs dngos grub zab mo'i bcud skal ldan smrab pa po yi dpal du sharaḥsarba sirnyipha laspyon uhūṃ dzini 'khor ba dbyings

gtsasdo: sgol rak+ta'i skyems mchod dang snang srid bcud sbyar ro mnyam bā ling ta gzung 'dzin dbyings sgrol thabs shes mnyam sbyor skyems zag med ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul ltad mo'i gnas chos nyid mi 'gyur lta bu'i mchod pa rnams dbang drag bdud dpung zil gnon dal du 'bulaX 'khor ba chos skur sangs ba'i dngos grub stsolaḥ ma hā rak+ta bā ling ta gha na sa ma ti dharma dhar du ma ha pu dza sa ma ya hoḥ de ltar phul ba'i dgyes pa bskyed tshogasardzogasasgrib dag don gnyis 'grub sam mā bde mdzod dbang gi bum bzang las rin chen snying po loyi gter dus smin sbas don rdor tshig bkrol skal pa can gyi dpal du shog 'di'ang 'gyur ba med dgye phyir 'gro phan khyung drag gling pas soḥ sarba maṅga le/

ga6rdo: hrīḥ gzhi dbyings gdod nas dag pa chos sku las lhun grub rang gsal ma 'gags longs sku'i sprinaX gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags canaḥsprul sku pad+ma drag po rta khyung rgyalaḥ 'di na ye shes gzigs pa chags thog bral rdzong 'phrang srog ldan 'khor 'das gsang bcud len0 sku gsum rgyang thag mi ring rang ngo snyedaḥ'abras bu nyi ma shar ro a la la rtsa sngagasabo da mdun bskyed 'dzab kha dbye ba 'di snang srid brda dper shar banus ldan rdo rjesakhyad chos so/sarba maṅga le/ aḥ hūḥ rang snang mi shig zangs mdog dpa' ri nas rang rig bla ma pad+ma thod phreng rtsal rang rtsal sgyu 'phrul rol pa 'khor dang bcasaḥ rang gsal sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir thugs dam bskulaX rang 'khrul a 'thas dug gsum rgyal bsen gdon rang grol gdod ma'i chos skur 'god pa dngaḥ rang shar snang grags rig gsum lha sngags thugasaḥ rang byung ye grol rtogs pa'i 'dzab rgyun skyongasaḥrang 11la pad+ma he ru'i dgongs par blta'aX sgrub sngags bzlo 'dzab bskul 'di thag le lu gu rgyud kyi zer nasanus ldan pasabakrol ba dge'o/

btsasdo bharnya bdud rtsi bsgrub pa ni hūṃ dum gcig mi yi nor bu ka pā la brda rtags bkod pa phun tshogs gzhal med dbus rig pa rang snang bla ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ stong nyid gar dbang rnal 'byor yum dang rol gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i nye 'du rdzogs 'bar bas zhu bde bcu drug dga' bzhi'i rgyunaḥ byang chub sems bcud 'khor 'das dwangs ma yis khams lnga 'dus pa sku gsung thugs nyid du smin byed zag med ye shes bdud rtsir dmigs hrīḥ be sto dhi tsit+ta a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉ཿ zhes bsnyen sngags dang / o ma hā gu ru sa ra bye ma hā su kha spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥ se ha ra ṇa hūṃḥ zhes sgrub sngagasadang / 31 hrītsho a dṛta kusgoli rdo a1 )yi me pra be sha ya a be sha ya a aḥ zhes las sngags so 'di yang slob bu dhe wa bskul ngor kho bo khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba ma le/

ra /sde: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i bdud rtsi phud kyi bskang ba bsam 'phel nor bu bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye tshun141 rin chen brtar ba'i ja chang skyems sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te lha gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas teḥ hū hrī rngams brjed srin gling rnga yab dpal gyi ri bde stong spros bral pad+ma 'od 1nga nas bdud 'joms rdo rje gu ru drag po rtsal rta dbu khyung gdong bzhad pa'i gar bsgyur gyisaḥ 'bar ba'i sku mchog 'od zer stong 'khyugs bzhinaḥ dbang chen gsung gi glog gzer 'phro ba dngaḥ ye shes thugs kyi dpa' brjid bsam mtha' yasaX dri bral bde stong ḍak+ki'i gar g.yo zhing phrin lasasgogs pa med pa'i stobs dang bcas dga' ston bdud rtsi phud kyi 'du bar phyon dad pa dam tshig dag pa'i mos ngor bzhugs mtha' grol lta ba dag pas phyag bgyi'oX oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dz+nyā na dhartu tiṣ+ṭha lhan na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas phud mchod 'bul ba ni ma āḥhūḥ rgyal dgongasabado snyan shog ser tshig gi

brgyud zhi ba rigs brgya bde gshegs dpal dgu dngaḥ mdo sgyu sems gsum phag khros seng ge'i gdong bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskangaḥ sa dang dkyil 'khor bdag po pad+ma 'byung gu ru drag po rta zhal khyung gdong bzhadaḥ sdeg khyung phag seng las byed rdul ltar 'tshubasaḥ bdud rtsi phud kyi chod sa thugs dam bskang sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshedaḥ gsung gi dbang phyug pad+ma he ru gaX thugs kyi gsang 'dzin sngags bdag rdo rje 'dzin bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskangaX yon tan kun 'byung mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang brin las mnga' bdag yaka me dbal rgyalaX srid gsum rlabs kyis gcod pa'i ma sring tshogasaḥ bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang bde stong dpal sbyin dus mtshan mched bzhi dang la ma dun skyes dbang mo kha kha'i gdong dbang phyug las gshin seng gdong ki la āḥbadud rtsi phud kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskangaX gzhan yang bka' gter gnyan gyi srung ma dngaX pha skyes rgyud srung ma lha le'u'i lha dgra lha yul lha grogs lha 'go ba'i lha

gtsasdo: bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang tshe rabs las lha da lta skyobs byed lhaḥ 'go zhing sdong grogs mdzad pa'i pho nya ba phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi sde brgyad rnamasaḥ bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ de nas phrin las bcol ba ni (3 skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyis bka' skyong ba'iX mdo sngags bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin dregs pa'i gtso skyes bu ging drug dbyings kyi ma lnga dang ma ning sde drug ye shes 'jig rten gyi dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsolaḥ srid na ya mtshan che ba'i mchod sprin gyis rtag par gsol mchod mnga' dbul dbu 'phang bstod thugs dam dgyes bskang phrin las bcol ba ni rgyal bstan yangs pa'i tha grur spel ba dngaḥ der 'dzin tshe sgrub mtha' ru phyin pa dang thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub nyin mor gyuraḥ sbyin bdag 'byor rgyas tshe dpal bsod nams bskyed rgyal khams spri dang dgos su chos grwa 'diraḥ gnod cing 'tshe ba'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang legs tshogs dpal yon bkra shis rab rgyas shingaḥ

bstan pa'i 'dabs su 'jig rten dbang sdud cing mngon spyod drags pos dgra bgegs rlag pa dang phrin las rab 'byams dbyar gyi chu gter bzhinaḥ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi dpal du stsolaḥ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon ltar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan gegs med mthar phyin mdzod: tshe sgog dam la 'tshe ba'i rgyal bsen bdudaX skye med chos kyi dbyings su ar la gtod 'gag bral gdul bya'i dpal mtsho ma stong par rtag par bkra shis rgya mtshos khyab brdal mdzodaḥ zas nor dpal yon gtam gyis 'brel ba kun lto nub dpal rir rig 'dzin gral 'khod mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ 'dod don gsol gdab bzod gsol niḥ ho ye shes las grub legs nyes stong 'dzin pa'i dregs pa sde lnga dam can rgya mtsho dgongasaḥ bdag rmongs 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur mi dge'i lasaḥ gang bgyis mi 'chab 'gyed gnong drag pos bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya ā de yis don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung phrin las kun 'grub the tshom medaḥ sa ma pā pad+ma rak+ta'i mtsho gling nas dge bsnyen sha ma'i gos bzang pos gtad pa'i rin chen brda mdzod las dam tshig gsang ba'i zab rgya

—8/sde: grol don gnyis lhun grub dge legs 'byor sam māḥrgya rgya rgyaḥgu bdozem snyi zhes pa 'di 'ang lu zin 'gyur med rgya mchos bkra shisalha reg thabs shes mtshon pasardzas dang rin chen g.yu yi skyes bcas bskul ba dang nye char bla ma bī masakyang bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyisadag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba maṅga le/
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ bka' srung drag po mched lnga'i gsol sgrub gdug pa tshar gcod bzhugs soḥ

gtsasdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeX shā1cha'i mchod bskang brten sgrub gtor ma bshams 'gugs bstim bsang sbyangs byin rlab ni gtor sgod bhan+ta lcang lo can gyi nang duḥ gtor ma de nyid yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs dngos su bskyed la na moḥ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bden pa dngaX yi dam rta khyung drag po'i bden pa dang gnasagasum ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bden pa dang bka' sdod pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i mthus0 spyir mtshog gsum bstan pa'i spyi dgraḥbashes gnyen dam pa'i sku dgra khyad par du rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis brdar baX spyi dgra yid la sems paḥ da dgra thad du brdo ba'i rgyal blon 'bangs gsum dgra rkun jag shom byed mi rnams kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cigaḥ lan gsumaḥbastims shigaX dzatshuḥrbaḥhoḥ dbyings nas thun mtshon gyi char bab pas dgra bgegs pho mo'i sha khrag rus gsum nam mkhar mnyam pa'i sprin du gyur ma uhūṃ srung ma

—8/snye: brten sgrub mchod bskang mnyes pa'i rdzas thams cad rnam pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus gsum las byung ba ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dngos po 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pa mig 'phrul lta bu'i gter chen po gcig tu gyuraḥm ma hā me sa rak+ta cit+ta ko ni ritai badz+ra pu dza sa pha ra ṇa kho hū rang nyid rta khyung drag por gsal ba'i mdun dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbusaḥ zla gam dbang gi zer chen 'khyug pa'i klong pad+ma nyi ma zla phyed gdan gyi khar trīyig dmar por 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bstims yongs gyur dbang phyug ma hā de wa niḥ dmar gsal pad+ma rwa ga'i gzi 'od 'bar chags pa'i nyams rgyas zhi ma khro 'dzum sgegasaḥ ljang che na ral pa thod cog zla phyed brgyan zar bus sku rgyab kheb cing liṅga bsgrings nor bu'i phreng ba sum rim gyad stabs bzhugs phyag g.yas lcags kyus 'gro sngo dbang du bsnadaḥ g.yon pas zhags pas snang srid bran du sdomasaXdabang gi 'od chen rab tu g.yo zhing 'byugaḥ g.yon du bde ba'i rgyas 'debs u ma dmar zhi 'dzum chags

nyams rgyas shing yab la btudaḥ ral pa thor cog pad+ma'i gdengs ka mdzes rin chen snyan cha mgul phreng do shal spudaX phyag g.yas pad+ma'i lcags kyu yab la regaḥ g.yon pa 'dod 'byung gter bum dku la brten nu 'bur bde stong gsang ba rab tu rgyas mirim 'gugs 'ching sdom phyos ma bzhi dngaḥ dpal mgon bdun cu dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams sku la btud cing phrin lasathogs med sgrub dam ldan srung zhing dam nyams gshed mar gsalaX shar du dbang chen pad+ma ki la yaX dmar gsal zhal ga ga phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgradaḥ mche ba bzhi gtsugs drag po'i gad rgyang sgrogasaḥ mgo phreng sbrul chun thod skam dbu rgyan mdzesaḥ dar sna'irtsad pan nyi zla'i snyan cha gsal rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs sku smad dbal phur niḥ rdo rje'i me rlung 'phro bzhin dgra la gzir phyag g.yas bhan+ta dmar bkang zhal du khyer g.yon pas zangs phur dam nyams snying la gzir khro chung pho nya mang po glog ltar 'byugs sbyor sgol mngon sprod las la rngams par bsted lho ru za byed gtum rngams chen po niḥ sku mdog dmar gsal bzod dka'i gzi

ba sko: mdangs ngoms zhal gyi dkyil 'khor glang po'i gdong pa yis ma rtog rmongs pa'i 'brul 'khor bzlog par byedaḥ mi lngags sbrul chun mgo phreng rgyan du 'chang bskal ba'i dug rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su 'bying g.yas phyag dgra stu bsnams pas zhing bcu sgrol g.yon pas sgod zor zhing bcu'i snying la brdagaḥ zhabs bsgrad liṅga bsgring shing chags nyams rgyas 'bar ba'i sku mchog khros pa'i nyams ldan gsal nub tu gnod sbyin btsan rgod yangs le ber dmar nag khro gtum spyan mig glog ltar 'khyugasaḥ am gtsigs mnan bsdams dar gyi la thod mdzes rin chen snyan cha rat+na'i mgul rgyan byasaḥ dbang gi ber klubs 'khor gsum sked par 'chang rga gong byed 'bying rol ba'i thabs su brjedaḥ rta mchog bra bo rlung gi gshogs ldan gyis rmig bzhi lcags grub rnga rngog g.yu las byasaḥ mtshegs sgra lding 'gros mgyogs pa'i rlabs shugs ldan phyag g.yas btsan zhags dam nyams ske la bskor g.yon pas mdung dmar zhing bcu'i snying la 'bebasaX me glong dud sprin 'tshubs ma'i dbus su 'bying ri khyi gcan

spyang mang po rjes su 'bring btsan bya rgod smug tshogs ni steng du ldang las byed btsan rgod sna khrid glog ltar 'byug ru 'dren sde bzhis las byed rga ra raḥ bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bsam yas pa ma 'dres nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin lam mer gsalaḥ byang du bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong0 sku mdog dmar nag srin mo khros 'dra'i nyams seng zhal rngams pas gzigs stangs phyogs bcur g.yoX g.yu ral gseb nas seng chung glog ltar 'khyugaḥ dar dpyang rus rgyan dril g.yel mjes pas brgyanaḥphyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan btsug zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur rol sku lus bkod par rig sngags zhing skyes kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bye ba sa ya 'gyed chos 'byung dmar nag bam gdan snying gar brdzis ye shes me lnga rab 'bar 1nga na 'bying che btsan srid na mtshungs dpe bral bar bskyedaḥ kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon dang thugs sgog las spros 'od zer lcags kyu yisaḥ rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes paḥ kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spran drangs

ga6 sdo: bstims sha chen spos bsregs rol mo sgrogs snyan pa' dbyangs kyis spyan 'dren niḥ hū hrī ༷ grong khyer sum brtsegs lha yi dkyil 'khor nas: 'jig rten dbang phyug chen po gshegs su gsolaX rngams brjid khrag 'thung rol ba'i dur khrod nasaḥ bdud 'dul pad+ma ki la gshegs su gsolaḥ 'byung po zel gnon shwa khram rtsis kyis bdag las gshin glang gdong 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol skye 'gro'i srog bdag rnal 'byor dam la gdung gnod sbyin btsan rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsolaḥ mkha' spyod bde ba chen po'i pho brang nasaḥ bdud 'dul drag mo 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol phrin las bzhi la mnga' brnyes dam tshig 'dzin sprul pa bsam yas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ sa badz+ra dharma pā la sarba sa ma yā dza dza bams gsol niḥ hū hūṃḥ lha dbang lha yi ja ma stobs po che drag po rigs bzhi rang rang g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ dam la gdung bzhin dad gus rnam 'gyur bcasaX ja rdo srog 'khor sgrub pa'i rten la bzhugasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya rteṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ phyag 'tshal ni na moḥ dam chig gces par 'dzin pa'i rig pa

'dzin gang na gnas der srung skyobs mi g.yel ba'i rdo rje'i bka' skyongs dam can rgya mtsho la lha phyag 'tshal lo brtse bas srung skyobs mdzod na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod lagal ni pa hrīḥ mtshan bcasabadud tshogs bsgral ba'i sha rus khrag dpa' bo dgyes bskyed dza gad a mṛ taḥ dngos 'dzin dag pa'i phyi nang gsang mchod sprin rkang gling thod rnga bshug glu brten sgrub dar dgyes bskang mchod gtor 'dod yon nam mkha'i mdzod mdor na thugs dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyisaḥ srog bdag pho nya sde lnga'i dgyes pa bskangaḥ sangs rgyas bstan srung sems can phan bde spel dug gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po zil gnon zhing rnal 'byor chos mthun bsam pa lhun grub mdzodaḥ sa ma hā de wa badz+ra gī la ya ya ma ra tsa tsatu shu la tri seng ha mu kha sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā asnye pabye sogs shabha du pa dharma mahwa pañtsa rak+ta ba ling ta me sa ko ro tsa na ko ni ri ti ba su ta la kha kha khā nyi kha nyi dam nyams pa'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs rgyal bsen dam sri pho mo rnams mngon smod drag po'i las kyis tshar chod cigaḥ sarba a mi ka ya sarba

—8rdo: a sirnyi ye swā hā gsol mchod ni kyeX khams gsum dbang phyug ma hā de wa dngaḥ gshin rje gshed dmar pad+ma ki la ya gnod sbyin btsan rgod bdud 'dul seng gdong maḥ rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings las 'dir byon laX sgyu 'phrul gar gyi 'khri shing rten la bzhugasaḥ dam tshig gsang srog gcig pas phyag 'tshal lo mngon mtho nges legs byed por mnga' gsol bgyi phrin las rgyal bstan srung phyir dbu 'phang bstodaḥ snang srid sgyu ma'i dga' ston 'bul gyis bzhesaX nyams bskang tshogs ston dpal rol dgra bgegs sgrol 'di phyi'i dge legs sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ grangs bsogs phrin las lhun gyis grubaḥs mag bstod pa niḥ hū trīX thugs rje'i gter 'chang dbang gi rgyal po niḥ 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs lha yi ja ma cheḥ legs nyes 'khor 'das snang ba'i byed por sharaḥ dbang phyug ma hā de wa khyod la bstodaḥ mtshan bcas gdon gyi snying 'byin ki la ya sde brgyad bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal ya mar+sāX ste 'gro'i srog dbugs bdag po yangs le beraX bde stong dpal ster bdud

'dul ma la bstodaX rgyal bka' nyan zhing bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin paḥ legs nyes so srung zhing bcu'i don snying 'byinaX bskul na las myur rbad na mthu che ba'iX drag shul pho nya dpung dang bcas la bstod de nas phrin lasabacol ba niḥ ( bh+yoḥ rgyal ba'i bka' gsang ja med snying po yiḥ bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs ba'i tha tshig can dregs pa sde lnga dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogasaḥ shin tu zhi zhing dgyes pa'i 'dzum bcas dgongasaX bdag ni tsho gcig byang chub sgrub pa laḥ smon log rgyal bsen dam sris rgol byung naX skye med dbyings su ldog bral zil gnon mdzod byang chub sgrub la log spyor dgra sde rnams ming gi lhag mar gyur ba'i phrin las mdzodaX snang srid chos skur lam khyer byed pa la 'drer 'dzin rtog bdud dbu ma'i dbyings su sgrolaḥ zab mdzod thugs gter bshad sgrub sgom pa la nyer 'ama'i 'jigs pazhi ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ dngos grub dpal yon nyams rtogs phan bde'i stsoḥ mi nyams rtag tu 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzodaḥ lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa ma lus paḥ bdag nyid drag po'i dbang du 'as bar mdzodaḥ bstan pa'i sming por 'tshe

gtsasdo: ba'i dgra bdud bgegs mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod cig bka' dang dam la mda' sam māḥ 'dod gsol gdab ༅gas pa na ho ma rig nyon mongs sems rtog dbang gyur teḥ sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa dang srung ma'i thugs 'gal dri ma'i nongs pa kun ye shes bka' sdod rgya mtshor bshags bgyi'oḥbadz+ra sa ma yā ā ye ge brgya bas bzod gsol phul des ni phrin las rab 'byams 'grubaḥsam shāḥ ye 4 rgyal dbang gsang chen gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong rin chen snying po phyur ba nas dge bsnyen sha mis sprad brda lasaḥ daro sa grub skal pa son pa las smon lam dag pa'i sa ler gzigs gzhan 'phan nyi ma'i 'od mdangs rgyasaḥ sam māḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥgu brda nimaḥlhaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtshosabakra shis lha reg dbang mdog cod pan rin chen g.yu byang bcas nas bskul ba dang / nye char chos bdag ral khur rnams gnyis dang bla ma ni mas bskul ngor/ kho bo bdud 'jom khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

gtsasdo: gtor nag ༅masal 2gas gtsos byaḥrang nyid drag lo dzi 'dzin gyis hrī srid na mtshungs bral mtha' ma'i gnyan gnon pa'i dbang phyug 'char byed nag po 'khor dang bcasaḥ'adir gshegs bshos nag sha khrag chang skyems bzhesaḥmatha' dmag dus 'khrugs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥgrang bsogs gtor ma dgra phyogs dor dmod por dmigs bya rdul du rlogaḥsam māḥrgya rgya rgya ces kyang chos bdag ral khur bu gsum la pad+ma bde spyod gling pas phulaḥsarba masgo la/ ཿlcags mkhar bam gzugs 'gugasabastims bya drag po rngams pa'i brtul zhugs kyas yaḥ'ajigs rung las ga na 'bar ba'i tshogs kyi mched0 mi rta bam chen bsgol ba'i khri steng nas:dgra gshed tshe bdag nag po spyan 'dren gshegasaX zhing bcu'i sha khrag tsit+ta krum krum rol rngams pa'i zhal hom ri rab zom 'dra'i klong mtha' yi dmag tshogs dpung dang bcas pa bstabasaḥdagyes pas hab sgras sa gsum shig shig g.yoḥbade bas skan sgras dug gsum 'byung po 'dar bshad gar glu yi srid rtsa dum bur gcod glal ba glog 'khrug srid gsum gdug pa rngub za byed chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstodaX

drag shul khyad chos ston pa'i phrin las mdzod sgog bdag khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab ma g.yel gsang sngags bstan pa dar rgyas mdzodaḥ zhes brjod phrin la thogs med 'grub /dī/ ༵ ༷/byesgo dī kha lo bsgyur shesarab nyi ma klong nas 'char tshe bdag skam pa dgra la sdebaḥs ma shā rgya rgya rgyaḥzhesachos bdag ral khur bu gsum dang bla ma pim grogasarat+na sar dgyes phyir pad+ma 'gro 'dul dbang byug gling

—81 dmar gtor bshams la 'gugs gzhugs bya mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod du spel rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyisaḥ rol mo bsgragasal 'di skad doḥ hū bh+yoḥ bskal ba'i dug rlung me yi dkyil 'khor nas0 bdud dpung zil gnon gnyis snang thal mar 'byinaḥ rdo rje srin po badz+ra ki la yā 'dir byon ma rig rū tra'i sha khrag rolaḥ mtshan 'dzin bse mo rgyal gdon sma phab nas drol 0byor chong skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod ༷ grangs bsogs phud gtor rgya cher phul don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyuraḥs mgo rgya rgyakyo zhes chos bdagaral khar bu gsum dgyes phyirabaje chen dbang phyug gling pas spel bsarba masgo le/

ra snye: dmar gtor rtsang mtshe khrag gisabyugasaḥ 'gugasagazhugs byin rlabs thub nasaslar bh+yoḥ ma skyes rdzogs pa chos sku'i dbyings klong nas 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs rje bdud 'dul ma gdung sems brtse bas bu yi mos ngor byon mtha' mi'i byad bzlog dus kyi rgud pa solaḥ dpa' skyems brngan bzhes rnal 'byor nyams rtogs spel bde stong spros mtha' bral ba'i gzi 'bar nasaḥ las med tshogs rjer 'khod pa'i phrin las sgrub rdo rje'i zhal bzhes ma g.yel sa ma māḥ grangasabasogasaphud skyemasagatsang sar gshegs phrin las lhun grub bde stong 'baraḥ ma shāḥrgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes chos bdag ral khur bu gsum dang sgogs dang bcas pa dgyes phyir nusaldan pad+ma bde spyod gling pas spel ba ma ye

—'di: phud gtor gams la byin gyisams rang nyid drag po'i r+ṣa 'dzin gyisaḥ hrīḥ bde chen rak+ta 'khrul ba'i 'dod khyims nas glog dmar 'byug 'dra'i dge bsnyen chen po ni chu dar mdzes pa sha ma'i gos su bgo klu rta rlung gshogs bcibs shing rba la bskyal thogs med myur mgyogs sngon gyi dam tshig can pad+ma'i zab gter gnyer chen bdag la sbyin dgos rgu dus su spel ba'i gtang rag duḥ dkar bshos gang ri lhun po lta bu la bkra shis rja sa rtags klu sman 'o chab bcas mchod do sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangaḥ bde stong spros dang bral ba'i gzi 'bar nas: srid zhi'i sa mkhan dpa' bo khyod nyid phyar rnam mang thos sras mnga' thang nor sna zhu chos mthun dge mtshan 'od stong sbar bzhin duḥ lha mi mthun sbyor rnga yab dpa' rir 'khod 37 rgyan pad+ma'i phrin las mthar phyin thegag grangs bsogs 'phrin bcol don gnyisa'agrub dgyes pa'i zhal bzang dung ltar ngoms sa ma ya rgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes chos bdag ral khur bu gsum dang yang snying pad+ma'i mtshan can la nus ldan 'gro ladul dbang phyug gling pas spel ba ma la/

—snyed: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ bstan bsrung yongs rdzogs kyi gsol mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa brin las lhun grub bzhugs soḥ—8rdo na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeX skon rang nyid gtum po' nga rgyal gyis mdun tu bka' srung dregs tshogs gsal mchod rdos bsang sbyangs byin rlabs nas 'dod pa'i yid kyis brjod par bya o unyu rang mdun aḥlas dum gcig bhasto rtsa 'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba sha khrag rigs ye ram̐ khaṃ las byung ba'i bsregs gtor bkrusaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi zag med ye shes rdzas rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams kyi dbang drag shan dmar ma hā dhe wa'i skuḥ tshogs kyis bdag po legs ldan phyag bzhi pa bdud mgon seng gdong las byed bya rog gdong gur zhal phyag drug ma ning tsi ma raX dreg chen bco brgyad sde dpon sum bcu dang mi mgon dkar po ya ma ra tsa dngaḥ shan pa kus 'debs zangs ri dgra 'joms rtsalaḥ gza' mchog chen po dam can rdo rje legs lha srin sde brgyad pho rgyad dpa' bo'i sde gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs e ka tsa

ti yak+ka nag mo dang dpal ldan lha mo sha za kha mo che rdo rje g.yu sgron tshe ring mched lnga dngaḥ phur srung bcu gnyis myur mgyogs nges nus ma dmag zor rgyal mo dbang phyug nyi shu brgyadaḥ brtan ma bcu gnyis lha mo mo rgyud rigasaḥ gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs klu bdud btsan dang spu gri mched gsum steḥdrag mo spun gsum thang lha rma chen spom dge bsnyen nyer gcig 'brong ri sgrug po dang rdo rje legs pa rnga la stag rtse sogasaX gter bsrung phyi nang gnyis skyong sde tshogs kyis gser skyems phud bzang rin chen ngar btab paḥsha khrag dam rdzas 'dod dgu'i longs spyod kyis gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las rnams sgrub sangs rgyas bstan skyongs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod dge 'dun sde spel slob dpon sku tshe bsringasaḥrnal 'byer don 'grub sbyin bdag bde rgyas mdzod0 khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chosaX phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang nad mug mtshon 'khrugs ming gi lhag mar gyuraḥ legs tshogs bkra shis rdzogs ldan ltar smin nasaḥ

—8rdo: dus gsum kun nas dge zhing bde legs shog bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥces brjod phrin las rab 'byamasa'agrub the tshom med do samag rgya rgya rgya gu zhes pa'ang chos kyi bdag po dharma'i mab can gyis bskul ngor bdag nu ldan rdo rjes bris pa'oḥdage'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/legs so/sarba maṅga la/

ga6sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i bshags pa ma rig mun sel bzhugs so ༷badz+ra na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ rwa sag a gdod ma'i ye gzhi chos sku kun tu bzangaḥ gzhi snang rigs lnga yab yum thub pa drugaX phyi sems bzhi da1phyag rgya moḥ nang sems yum dang 'thar byed tshogs rnams dgongs0 bdag ni ma rig gsum gyis dbang gyur teX rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyi shu rtsa bdun dngaḥ yan lag nyer lngabacu 'chol ba sogasaḥ bla ma lha dang mched kyi spyan sngar bshagasaX rdo rje rgyal por sri zhu ma bgyis shingaḥ bla med snying po dang du len ma nus sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi don ma mthongaX grogs la brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshagasaḥ yang dag don la rmong shing tshig la 'char lta ba dman zhing sgom yun thung ba dang spyod pa rtsang zhing 'amangon rlom byasaḥ rang lam phyin ci log tu gyur ba bshagasaX sangs rgyas rang la rdzogs pa ngo ma shesaḥ sems can rten 'brel yin pa don ma rtogasaḥ tha snyad tshig gi rjedra

chags sdang byasaḥ kun rdzob sgyu mas baglus pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ stongaltahad posargyu 'bras khyad du bsadaḥ rtag ltar gol zhing chad mthar lhung ba dngaX rtog ge'i rjes 'brang yang dag don la bslad theg chen snying por rmongs pa mthol lo bshags mtha'abral mid pa'i gnas lugs zhal ma mjalaḥ thig le nyag gcig 'ub chub don ma rtog bar med phyal mnyam ye grol ngang ma mthongaḥ gnas lugs lhun grub ma rtog mthol lo bshagasaḥ chosakyidabyings su bshags bya bshags byed dbenaX tha snyad tsam du sor byang sngags kyi sdomaX spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig bstan slob lam 'di don nyam chags dri gang bshagasaḥ rnala'abyor chen por 'da' nyams srung mtshams bralaḥ mi slob dgongs pa mkha' ltar dag klong bshagaḥ ayis dang po semasakyi dri ma bshags bar du rnam rtog mtshan ma stong tha ma rig stong ka dag ngang bzhag pas chags nyams dri kun grolaḥsamawāḥmi bde chen gsang ba gsung ga mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong pha cig bla ma'i nor skal sbaḥdus bab dge bsnyen sha mis gtadaḥ sbas don rang bkrol gsang ba mthong skal med rnams la a tham rgyaḥsamashāḥrgyargyargya gu phyo brdathemaḥsnyiḥ zhes
ra sa: 'da'ang lung zin sngags nag bu gsum dang bla ma ni masabaskulangor kho bo bdud 'a(masakhyung drag rtsal gyisadag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sa ma le/

ga6/sdo dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag sgrub dang 'brel ba'i rdzas bskang rgyal ba dgyes sprin bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ la sgo dzos bzhi dkyil spyor lhar bstab steḥ hū trīḥ bde chen dbang drag rol ba'i dkyil 'khor duḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a dṛ 'bul nyon mongs chags pa bsgral ba'i bcud chen poX yi dam drag khros gzi byin bskyed phyir 'bulaḥ snang srid rnam dag bcud sbyar bā ling taḥ rta khyung rngams pa'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul ma rig rmongs pa'i mun bsal sgron me 'diḥ ye shes snang ba rgyas phyir lha la 'bulaḥ dgyes bskyed ro nus ldan pa'i dza gad 'diX gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas phyir lha la 'bulaḥ mtshan 'dzin rtog pa dag pa'i tshogs mchod 'diX chag nyams sgrib pa sbyong phyir 'bul bar bgyi a la la ste dgyes pa chen por rol0 de ltar phul bas lha rnams bskang rnal 'byor chag nyams sor chud 'gyuraḥsam shāḥye dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong pha nor dpa la gya bum bzang las dge bsnyen sha mis bstsal ba las gsang gnad zab sgo lags pa mthong

skal med lag tu ma shor cigaḥ sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thimaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zinasngagasaskyesabu gsum dang bla ma bī ma nas bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal rgyas dag par pha ba pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba maṅga le/

ra /sde: gos bsdusaniḥ re ye khoḥ o āhū 'jigs tshogs zil gnon rta khyung drag po'i zhal gar dgu rngams pa'i brtul zhugasadapa' bskyed nasaḥ du tra bsgral ba'i dga' ston tshogs 'khor laḥ dgyes sbyor rdo rje'i glu dang bcas te byon bdag med mnyam pa nyid du rol ston bzhesaX rig zhal sems su bzung ba'i nongs pa bshags gnyis snang rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' ston bstabasaḥ ma rig gzhi la sangs phyir thugs dam bskangs sgyu lus 'od skur 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol sku gsum mdzad pas 'khor ba casang sprugs thegagaḥ de ltar phul bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag dbang phyin dngos grub thob he ru ka dpal mngon gyur nas gzhan phan phrin las bsam mi khyabaḥs ma māḥrgya rgya rgya rak+ta gsung gi mtsho gling nas kho bo rgyal mchog sprul bas rnyed skal ldan nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i phyir rin chen shog skyar bkod pa yasaḥphrin las kun bzang nor bus bgyas dge ba'i tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shogaḥsarba maṅgale/

bas: de nas tshogasal rol ba ni kye gzigs shig rdo rje slob dpon rgyalaḥ 'di ni mtshan ma dag pa'i rdzas blang dor yid chos bral ba ru de bzhin nyid du dgongs te rolaḥ zhes drangs rdo dngos grub rgyal po che ba'i skyes 'di la the tshom byar mi rung rang bzhin dag pa'i brtul zhugs kyis ye shes gcig rol bdag phyag 'tshalaḥ a la la hoḥ len pa pos tshem 'dir 'tshogs bsod namasabaskal ba bzang theg pa mchog gi dam rdzas 'diX myong grol sngags kyi dga' ston bzhes rdo rje'i tshig ltar bdag yid spro si(sapha latsan yisahūṃ zhes tshogasal rol dbang chen gsang ba'i chos skor las snying nor 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i ngor bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsalagyis phab dge bsa'abrel tshad don ldan shogaḥ sarba ma la/

'am/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las drag khros 'bar ba rtsal gyi dgyes bskyed chogs grin gdab pa'i skor bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ misgon/ slob bus phyag dang zhe so4sa hoḥ 'jigs tshogs zel gnon bdud 'joms rdo rje rta khyung drag po rtsal dam ye sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dwa la 'khor dang bcas pa dgongs su gsolaḥ deng 'dir lha'i thugs dam bskang zhing rnal 'byor ba'i nyams pa gso phyir tshogs 'khor gzhung bzhin du 'bul lags na bzhes par ci gnangaḥ zhes zhu ho rngams brjed pad+ma 'od kyi zhing gi bkod par shar ba'i ston 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs khyed rnams kyis chos nyid kyi lta ba mkha' ltar dag pas 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul gyi dga' ston rig par shar bas ting 'dzin 'phrul mo che 'bul stobs spel khyab rdul rnyed kyi zhing du sprin lags naX pad+ma drag po rta khyung bzhad pa rtsal gyis bzhes pa gnang ngo zhes phran gdab po a hoḥ gling mchog rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo ston pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang rta khyung drag po rtsal sku lnga mtshan brgyad kyi sprin

'khrigs pa'i da lar bdag cag gis tshogs bsags pa'i skal pa dang ldan na ngo mtshar chen po 'bul bar bgyi lags soḥ a lal hoX zhes spro mngon 'bul chogs snyedad bhasnyo dum bu gcig pa stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang duḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba rdag gzhib 'dod yon gyi bkod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur de yang reXlas mes ma dag pa thams cad bsregasaX yoḥlas rlung gis dngos 'dzin thams cad gtoraḥ kho las chus bag chags thams cad bkrus nasaḥgazugs rdo rje ma la sogasamachod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang bar spros teḥ kun gyi phyag na phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin mtha' yas pa thogs teḥ dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rta khyung drag po rtsal dang rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thams cad la khyab par spel bas thagashes(1lha thams cad kyi thugs dam bskang zhing dgyes pa bskyed par gyur cig rten snying nam mkha' mdzod kyis spel chogs snangad lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du tshogs rdzas de nyid zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs dngos su gsal laX namoḥ

gtsasdo: rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dngaḥ yi dam rta khyung drag po ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyongs srung ma rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad tshogs tha ma dmigs pa'i rten 'di la myur du khug cig yo badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaX hūm hoḥ tshogs bsgral bya lhag ma'i sgod bhasnyo lcang lo can gyi nang du bzhes lhag dang drangs lhag zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyuraX pañtsa a mṛ ta hū ha ho hriḥ lhag sdud kyi pho nya dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams 'du ba chen po pham phab kyi dga' ston la gshegs shig byon cigaḥ e a ra li rding trīng phe pho lhag ma gtongaḥ a las bharnya yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba'i 'dod yon zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir gyur oṃ āḥhūṃḥ lan gsum bskul ba dang cha tho gtangaḥrin po che'i sgod du bshal chu zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur tshepahuḥ lan gsum bstan ma gasto na moX bla ma drag po rta khyungazel gnon rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa'i mthusaḥ sgrub pa zab

mo la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri shul le spun dgu bse rag dbul sri pho mo thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab gsal ba'i 'og rol du khug cigaḥ dri' dre'u ra dza dun ting nan dri'u ya ma skrun dgu nan dri'u bse rag spun dgu nanaX dri'u the'u rang god 'dre nan dri tri hur thum dzaḥ gzer thum drig shag ram̐ḥ sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed rgab 'dre khug 'gab 'dre'i snying la dza dza bro mnan bya gtor gzhong bkra shis rat+na mdzes pa'i sgod yangs par phan bde'i dge mtshan dpal yon gyi char chen pos yongs su gang bar gyur cigaḥ sarba a yurton pubyepuṣ+ṭi ku ru ye su snya me tog 'thor bdag mdun gyi gnas rnams las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pas mchod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par spros te rdul snyed rgyal ba'i zhing thams cad la mchod pa rgya chen po phul bar bsam laX ting 'dzin mchod pa dang dngos bshams kyi mchod rdo rje'i lha mo rnams kyi mdzes pa sku yis gar byed cing phyag gis rol mo sna tshogs 'acasal bzhin ngag nas tshangs pa'i glu dbyangs gyi rta la drangs nas lha tshogs rnams kyis sku gsung thugs la

badz+ra: bstod pa glu yi mchod pa phul bar bsam laḥdagyes bstod mul slar mchod pa'i lha mo rnams bdag mdun gyi gnas so sor thim pas skyes dang skyes lan gyi tshul du nyams rtogs 'phel zhing dbang byin thob par bsam laX ༅gas pa bsngo smon bya phyogs r+sā nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon to phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnams rten 'di rnams la brten par bzhugs su gsolaḥs su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā snya༅gsabasdu lhar ldang bya rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs r+sā'i rgyal ba sras dang 4sa pa'i thugs rgyud bskul kun gyi zhas nas bkra shis dge marga gyi glu dbyangs ti ri ri brjod cing phyag nas me tog man+ta ra ba'i char chen po bsnyil bar gyur ye po he tu sosashe4rjod rgyam ཿsalaḥ.emaḥrgyas bag gi da pasmor78klob dgo na shanasagadapa raḥshogasorigayo nga

gtsasdo dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ brgyud pa rin po che'i bskang ba yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra zhwaX thami141 stong chen dbyangs kyi rgyar mnyam pa'i sgod bcud 'dod yon tshogs su shar rnal 'byor rig pas dngas blang nas kun tu bzang po'i rgyan du bkod lha sngags ting 'dzin gragasastong sgra thams cad mash+ka pa'i dgong spyod kyi ( trīḥ dri med ka dag chos dbyings nam mkha' mdzod ye grol ye shes gzigs pa mngon gyur pa'i chos sku gdod ma'i mgon po'i thugs dam bskang sgrib bral chos nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs ༷ rang bzhin 'od gsal nges pa lnga ldan gteraḥ ji bzhin nang dbyings ye shes mngon gzigs pa'iḥ 61ngas sku rigs lnga yab yum thugs dam bskangaX mnyam nyid sgyu 'phrul rtogs par byin gyis rlobasaḥ thugs mchog gting gsal zag pa bral ba'i gteraḥ khams gsum yongs bsgal bdud rtsir rgyas btab pa'i sprul sna lag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang dri bral rig pa rtogs par byin gyis rlobasaḥ chos dbyings yon tan phyogs med shar

ba'i gter dri bral sgrom las thugs gsang sgo 'byed pa rig 'dzin hūṃ chen ka ra'i thugs dam bskang mtha' bral rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ bsod nams lhun po dgos 'dod kun 'byung gteraX rin chen sgrom las sku gsang sgo 'byed pa rig 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen thugs dam bskang rtogs pa mi nub 'bar bar byin gyis rlobasaX chags pa'i ma gos bde mchog yangs paligater pad+ma'i sgrom las gsung gsang sgo 'byed paḥ rig 'dzin na gardzu na'i thugs dam bskang blo bral shes rab 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs srid pa thal 'byin gzhom med rdo rje'i gteraḥ 'gyur med sgom las phrin las sgo 'byed pa rig 'dzin pra bha hasti'i thugs dam bskang snang shes thal 'byin rtogs par byin gyis rlobs mnyam rol klong spyod mkha' mnyam yangs pa'i gteraḥ dum gcig sgrom las phyag rgya'i sgo 'byed paX rig 'dzin dha na sang skra'i thugs dam bskangaḥ rlung sems rang dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs ye shes chags thogs bral ba snying po'i gter 'ja' lus 'od skur grub pa'i sgo 'byed pa rig 'dzin bī ma mi tra'i

ba6sdo: thugs dam bskangaḥzang thal ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs che btsan ya mtshan gzhan snang zil gnon gter dregs pa'i srog 'phrog rdo sgrom sgo 'byed paḥrig 'dzin rom bu gu rgya'i thugs dam bskang rdzong 'phrang srog ldan thob par byin gyis rlobasaḥngan sngags dmod pa'i pha rol rgol 'joms gteraXnus mthu thogs med lcags sgom sgo 'byed paX rig 'dzin shirnye gar+bha'i thugs dam bskang 'bod rbad bsad pa'i mthu stobs byin gyis rlobasaḥganas snang dag pa rab 'byams sngags kyi gter ro mnyam ye shes gzigs pa'i sgo 'byed pa rig 'dzin ro lang bde ba'i thugs dam bskang snang srid dag mnyam 'char bar byin gyis rlobs rmongs pa'i rdul bral kun gzhi'i dwangs mtsho satshogs yul rang grol pad sdong rtser son pa rig 'dzin pad ma thod phreng thugs dam bskang brgyud gsum gter mdzod rnyed par byin gyis rlobs rig pa ye shes shar ba'i gzi byin can grub rtag 'ja' lus nyi ma'i zer la pheb rig 'dzin nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam bskang rtogs pa'i bdag rgyud grol bar byin gyis

rlobs nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas pa'i langs tsho canaX grub rtags sra bstan brag las tshe chu bton rig 'dzin dz+nyā na ku ma'i thugs dam bskangaX snying rje'i gzhan don 'byung bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i drod rtag can grub rtag rjes chags bshad pa'i rta skad btonaX rig 'dzin rgyal ba mchog dbyings thugs dam bskangaḥbadag lusathabs kyis smin par byin gyis rlobs snang srid chos sku thal 'byin dgongs spyod can grub rtag bsad pa gso zhing rdzu 'phrul thobaX rig 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang gzhan lusaphyag rgyas theb par byin gyis rlobs bde chen ye shes grub pa'i lta dgongs can grub rtag gzhan phan brin las zab gter thobaḥ rig 'dzin khye'u chung lo tsa'i thugs dam bskangaX phrin las mtha' yas 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs dregs pa zil gnon nus mthu'i yon tan 'byor grub rtag ma mo lha srin bran du bkolaḥ rig 'dzin dpal gyi ye shes thugs dam bskang brgyud pa'i gdung 'chob 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs che btsan dregs pa'i sgog 'phrog brtul zhugs thobaX grub rtag

btsasdo: phur pa gdengs 'gum bsad gso grub rig 'dzin dpal gyi seng ge'i thugs dam bskang rgyal bstan 'dzin srung nus par byin gyis rlobasaXlta spyod dgongs pa gu ru nyid dang mnyam grub rtag mngon spyod thogs med phrin las 'byungaḥrig 'dzin be+e ro tsa na'i thugs dam bskang spyor sgol thabs mang 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs bod khams phur thogs yongs kyi rjer bsngags pa'i grub rtag sra brtan brag la phur pa gdab gnub chen sangs rgyas ye shes thugs dam bskang gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobasaḥthugs bskyed smon lam dag pa'i phrin las can grub rtag yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab pa rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i thugs dam bskangaX gang 'dul gdul bya 'dul bar byin gyis rlobs:smin grol sgrub pa'i drod rtags mngon gyur zhingaXgazhan phan thugs rje'i bskyed rdzogs zam pa btsugaḥyer ba'i grub chen rnams kyis thugs dam bskang dngos grub char ltar 'bebs par byin gyis rlobs dus tshig gsum du pad+ma'i rjes bzung zhing dbang bskur lung bstan man ngag gtad rgya

mdzad sprul pa'i gter ston rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangaX rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobasaḥ dbyings la gnas pa'i ye shes rjes snyogs shing rigs lnga'i rtags ldan mi mo'i tshul bzung nas rgyal tshabs sprul pa'i zhabs tog phrin las sgrubaḥ las ldan gzung ma rnams kyi bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mthong bsten la mkhas0 gdams ngag bdud rtsi btung shes zag mi 'jugaḥ gzhan don phrin las 'gyed mkhas bka' ltar sgrub chos bdag rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangaḥ ( trīḥ ma bzung yul snang dag pa'i dga' ston dngaX ma spangs nyon mongs grol ba'i tshogs ston dang ma dmigs 'khor gsum dag pa'i rol ston gyisaḥ ma lus rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang gang shar ye grol rtogs pa'i lta ba dang gang yang shar grol 'dzin med sgom pa'i ngang gang snang cer grol spyod pa ro mnyam pa'iḥ gang zhig rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskang kun gzhi'i dri ma bdag nyid gcig pu dngaX kun gsal nyon yid smob pa lhan stes dngaX kun rmongs sgo lnga'i dri ma rtog btags bcasaḥ kun tu ma rig sems kyi

gtsasdo: bag chags bshags dngos po ro mnyam chos nyid yangs par bskangaX dngos 'jin blo bral ye shes rjen par bskang dngos kun ro mnyam bdud rtsir rtogs pas bskangaḥ dngos zhen a 'thas grol bar byin gyis rlobasaḥ chags nyams sems kyi dri ma glo bur baX chags sdang 'dus byas kun rdzob rten 'brel tsamaḥ chags bral don dam bden pa rtogs gyur na chags 'khrul dri ma gzhi med rtsa bral 'dagaX nyes lhung tha snyad tsam du mthong legs kyi nyes pa ka dag lta bar sdom legs so nyes kun dag go don dam rdzong zin noḥ nyes pa'i dri bral bla ma'i thabs yin gsungaX rang dang bla ma gdod nas tha mi dadaḥ rang bzhin gshis su gnyis med mnyam bzhag naḥ rang grol gdod nas dag pa'i rtogs pa 'charaḥ rang rig sku gsum mngon gyur7) ma hoḥ de ltar bskang bsachag nyams rtog sgrib dag don gnyisalhun grub yon tan rgya mtsho'i phyugs bla ma mnyes las 'di phyi'i phan bde 'byung kun bzang rdzogs pa chen por dbang skal 'byoraḥs mawāḥrgya rgya rgyaḥzhes pa'ang bdo thabs rten 'brel du masadabang gibarda 'phral du sad pa nyid sgrubs pa chen po'i thun gseng du kho bo nus ldan gtum drag gling pas smrasate
yi ge'i risabyed snying nor sheches bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma le/

badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i bskang ba pad+ma'i phreng mdzes bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye chen ga phyi nang gzhan gsum rnam dag pas thams cad bskang ba'i rdzas su bkod gnyis med mnyam pa chen po yis don dam ye shes lha tshogs bskangaḥhū hrī bde chen pad+ma brtsegs pa'i sang yangs nasaXdri med ye shes gzigs tshul mtha' yas pa phyogs ris bral kyang gdul bya'i mos mtshor shar srid zhi bde rol skyil krung mnyam bzhag bzhugs rig mchog 'chi med mgon po'i thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni tshogs drug rang grol mchod pa dang 'dod lnga ro mnyam kun bzang sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rakaḥzag bral bde stong zung 'jug sbyor bdag gzhan rtog pa thugs rjes sgrol rkyen ngan lam slong phyag rgya garaḥkhams gsum klong grol bkra shis rtags rig stong rjen grol rgyal srid bdunaḥdug lnga cer grol rdzas mchog brgyadaḥgazung 'dzin spros dang bral ba'i tshogasaḥdon dam lta ba chos kyi

sku rang bzhin 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid rnam rgyal spyod pa thig le'i sprin shes rab rgyan mjes rig ma dngaḥ rab yangs snang ba'i dur khrod du srid pa bam gyi rol ston la phra rtogs bya gcan sha za dang kun rtog mtshang grol sha khrag rusaḥngo mtshar bkod pa bla na med phyi nang gsang ba de nyid tshogasaḥ ma bshams ye nas rdzogs pa cheḥ gang shar lha mo'i rol rtsed bcasaḥ spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yis0 dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskang snang ba yab kyi thugs dam bskang stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskangaḥ 'khor 'das gnyis med thugs dam bskangaX rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangaX thugs dam bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol hūṃ hrīḥ tshogs brgyad rnam dag rngams brjed srin po'i yulaX bde stong zung 'jug o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling mi shig thig le zangs mdog dpal gyi riḥ rang rig 'gyur med pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ ye shes ḍak+ki dpa' bo gang mkha' 'groḥ lo paṇa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas niḥ

badz+ra: tshogs drug rang grol mchod pa dang 'dod lnga ro mnyam kun bzang sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rakaḥ zag bral bde stong zung 'jug sbyor bdag gzhan rtog pa thugs rjes sgrol rkyen ngan lam slong phyag rgya garaḥ khams gsum klong grol bkra shis rtagasaḥ rig stong rjen grol rgyal srid bdunaḥ dug lnga cer grol rdzas mchog brgyadaX gzung 'dzin sprosadang bral ba'i tshogs don dam lta ba chos kyi skuX rang bzhin 'od gsal mnyam pa nyidaḥ rnam rgyal spyod pa zig le'i sprinaXshes rab rgyan mjes rig ma dngaḥ rab yangs snang ba'i dur khrod duḥ srid pa bam gyi rol ston laḥ phra rtogs bya gcan sha za dngaḥkun rtog mtshang grol sha khrag rus ngo mtshar bkod pa bla na med phyi nang gsang ba de nyid tshogasaḥ ma bshams ye nas rdzogs pa che gang shar lha mo'i rol rtsed bcasaḥ spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yis dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskangaX snang ba yab kyi thugs dam bskang stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskangaḥ 'khor 'das gnyis med

thugs dam bskang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangaX thugs dam bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥhū hrīḥkhro rgyal rngams pa ye shes khyung chen ni me yi phung po rlung gi bde ga pa gdengs rigs lnga klu yi tshogs rnams zhal du 'drenaX spyan mig nyi zla ltar 'khyil 'jigs tshogs bsregasaXlcags rwa mchu sder rngams pas byad phur bzlog kring kring hrīng hrīng sgrogs pa'i gnyan gtod 'dul rang 'dra'i pho nya nam mkha'i glog ltar 'khyugaḥlongs sku khro rgyal khyung chen thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni tshogs drug rang grol mchod pa dang 'dod lnga ro mnyam kun bzang sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rakaḥ zag bral bde stong zung 'jug sbyor bdag gzhan rtog pa thugs rjes sgrol rkyen ngan lam sgong phyag rgya gar khamasagasum klong grol bkra shis rtags rig stong rjen grol rgyal srid bdunaḥ dug lnga cer grol rdzas mchog brgyad gzung 'dzin spros dang bral ba'i tshogasaX don dam lta ba chos kyi skuḥ rang bzhin 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid rnam rgyal spyod pa thig le'i sprin shes rab rgyan mdzes rig ma dngaḥ

badz+ra: rab yangs snang ba'i dur khrod duX srid pa bam gyi rol ston la phra rtogs bya gcan sha za dang kun rtog mtshang grol sha khrag rus ngo mtshar bkod pa bla na med phyi nang gsang ba de nyid tshogasaḥ ma bshams ye nas rdzogs pa che gang shar lha mo'i rol rtsed bcasaḥ spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yis dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyiraḥrdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangaX mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskang snang ba yab kyi thugs dam bskang stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskang 'khor 'das gnyis med thugs dam bskang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol hūṃ trīḥ 'jigs rung thod pa'i sku mkhar rngams pa ru bdud bzhi rgyal bsen spyi chings bsgol ba'i khar dbang drag dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skuX khyung zhal rngams pas sa bdag klu gnyan 'dar dbang chen rta skad sde brgyad 'dul glu len drags pos sdang mig nam mkha'i glog ltar 'khyug 'jigs tshogs zil gnon gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan rdzu 'phrul thogs med phrin las khyung gshegag sdebaḥ gnam

lcags rdo rje phur pas 'byung po 'dul du tra 'thar mdzad dur khrod dpal chas brgyan gnam lcags dbal phur rgyal bsen snying la 'bebasaḥ drag pos gad rgyang nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs pho rgyud bran bkol mo tshogs dbang du sdud dug lnga las skyes gdug tshogs ar la gtad ye shes me rlung 'tshubs ma phyogs bcur 'phroḥ las byed pho nya sna tshogs bu yug 'dzabs pad+ma drag po rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni tshogs drug rang grol mchod pa dngaX 'dod lnga ro mnyam kun bzang sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor raka zag bral bde stong zung 'jug sbyor bdag gzhan rtog pa thugs rjes sgrol rkyen ngan lam slong phyag rgya garaḥ khams gsum klong grol bkra shis rtags rig stong rjen grol rgyal srid bdun dug lnga cer grol rdzas mchog brgyadaḥ gzung 'dzin spros dang bral ba'i tshogs don dam lta ba chos kyi sku rang bzhin 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid rnam rgyal spyod pa thig le'i sprin shes rab rgyan mjes rig ma dang rab yangs snang ba'i dur khrod du srid pa bam gyi rol ston la phra

—8rdo: rtogs bya gcan sha za dngaḥ kun rtog mtshang grol sha khrag rus ngo mtshar bkod pa bla na med phyi nang gsang ba de nyid tshogs ma bshams ye nas rdzogs pa cheḥgang shar lha mo'i rol rtsed bcasaḥ spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yisaḥ dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyiraḥrdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskang0 snang ba yab kyi thugs dam bskang stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskangaḥ 'khor 'das gnyis med thugs dam bskang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ / trī sku mchog 'gyur ba med pa'i pho brang nasaḥ mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs brtse ldan thugs rje'i 'od zer gdul byar 'bebs 'od chen rnam par snang mdzad thugs dam bskang gsung mchog 'gag pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas dregs tshogs dbang sdud pad+ma gsung gi lhaḥrngams pa'i bshad glu sde brgyad dbang sdud grogasaX rta mgrin khams gsum bde rol thugs dam bskangaḥthugs mchog gam ba med pa'i pho brang nas chos kyi dbang phyug gsang

ba'i bdag po niX gzhan snang zil gnon rdo rje sdig mdzub mdzadaḥ dpal chen 'byung po 'dul mdzad thugs dam bskang yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas rgyal kun dgyes bskyed bde ba kun gyi gsangaḥ ye shes dbyings las dug lnga'i gdon tshogs 'tharaḥ dpal bskyed mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas niḥ tshogasadrug rang grol mchod pa dngaX 'dod lnga ro mnyam kun bzang sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rakaḥ zag bral bde stong zung 'jug sbyoraḥ bdag g.yin rtog pa thugs rjes sgrol rkyen ngan lam sgong phyag rgya garaḥ khams gsum klong grol bkra shis rtags rig stong rjen grol rgyal srid bdun dug lnga cer grol rdzas mchog brgyadaḥ gzung 'dzin spros dang bral ba'i tshogs don dam lta ba chos kyi sku rang bzhin 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid rnam rgyal spyod pa thig le'i sprinaX shes rab rgyan mdzes rig ma dang rab yangs snang ba'i dur khrod duḥ srid pa bam gyi rol ston laḥphra rtogs bya gcan sha za dang kun rtog mtshang grol sha khrag rusaḥngo mtshar bkod pa bla na
