gtsasdo: medaḥ phyi nang gsang ba de nyid tshogasaḥ ma bshamasaye nas rdzogs pa cheḥ gang shar lha mo'i rol rtsed bcasaḥ spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yis dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangaX mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskang snang ba yab kyi thugs dam bskangaḥ stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskangaḥ 'dor 'das gnyis med thugs dam bskang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangaX thugs dam bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ phrin las gdug pa 'dul ba'i pho brang nas dregs pa'i srog 'phrog dug gsum gdon la gsheḥ ma rung rū tra'i glad pa 'gem shing gzhomaḥ las mdzad yak+ka me dbal thugs dam bskang srung ba'i rgyal po khro chen 'khor lo'i bsgyur phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul pho nya bcu ru 'gyed0 thabs chen gsang ba dbang gi 'od khyims g.yo shes rab phag gi sprin 'khrigs thugs dam bskangaḥ zhe sngang gdon la gshe ba'i sdig nag dang 'dod chags mo 'dre 'thar byed ga ru ṭaX gti mug gnyan gtod tsho 'dul dur phag sogs yang spral go cha'i lha tshogs thugs dam

bskang thugasadam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni tshogs drug rang grol mchod pa dngaX 'dod lnga ro mnyam kun bzang sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rakaḥzag bral bdostong zung 'dug sbyor bdag gzhan rtog pa thugs rjes sgrol rkyen ngan lam sgong phyag rgya garaḥ khams gsum klong grol bkra shis rtags rig stong rjen dza/la rgyal srid bdun dug lnga cer grol rdzas mchog brgyad gzung 'dzin spros dang bral ba'i tshogasaḥ don dam lta ba chos kyi skuḥ rang bzhen 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid rnam rgyal spyod pa thig le'i sprin shes rab rgyan mdzes rig ma dang rab yangs snang ba'i dur khrod duḥsrid pa bam gyi rol ston laḥ phra rtogs bya gcan sha za dang kun rtog mtshang grol sha khrag rus ngo mtshar bkod pa bla na med phyi nang gsang ba de nyid tshogasaX ma bshams ye nas rdzogs pa cheḥ gang shar lha mo'i rol rtsed bcas spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yis dam tshog nyams pa gso ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskangaḥ mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskang snang ba yab kyi thugs dam bskang stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskang

—8/sde: 'khor 'das gnyis med thugs dam bskang0 rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol hū hrīX thabs chen yab la bde ba'i rgyas 'debs pa'i ༷ dbang phyug chung ma dus mtshan dmar mo dngaḥ rū tra'i gtso mo dus sbyor rngams gtsig can dregs pa'i rgyal mo bdud 'dul chags sbyor maḥsrin po'i sring gcig sha za shugs sgrol dpalaḥ kun kyang gcer mo mi lpags zhing g.yang brgyan khro gtum gshe ba gnod sbyin rngams pa'i skuX 'byung bar dbang bsgyur ye shes dbyings la spyod ༷sha rus khrag rkang spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul can gtum mo bde sbyor ma sring thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni tshogs drug rang grol mchod pa dang 'dod lnga ro mnyam kun bzang sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor rakaḥ zag bral bde stong zung 'jug sbyor bdag gzhan rtog pa thugs rjes sgrol rkyen ngan lam gong phyag rgya garaḥ khams gsum smong grol bkra shis rtags rig stong rjen grol rgyal srid bdunaX dug lnga cer grol rdzas mchog brgyad gzung 'jen smos dang bral ba'i

tshogs don dam lta ba chos kyi skuḥ rang bzhin 'od gsal mnyam pa nyidaḥ rnam rgyal spyod pa thig le'i sprinaḥshes rab rgyan mardzas rig ma dngaḥ rab yangs snang ba'i dur khrod duḥ srid pa bam gyi rol ston laX phra rtogs bya gcan sha za dang kun rtog mtshang grol sha khrag rusaXngo mtshar bkod pa bla na medaX phyi nang gsang ba de nyid tshogasaX ma bshams ye nas rdzogs pa cheX gang shar lha mo'i rol rtsed bcas spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yis dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskang snang ba yab kyi thugs dam bskang stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskangaX 'gyesar 'das gnyis med thugs dam bskang rgyud sde rgya mdzapa'i thugs dam bskang0 thugs dam bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsolaX: trīḥkhams gsum dbang bsgyur ma hā de wa dang skye 'gro'i srog bdag gshin rje ya man+taX snang srid chos skur thal 'byen ki la ya0 byad phur rbod gtong g.yul bzlog seng gdong maḥ rang rang las byed pho nya sa ya 'bumaX bdud dpung zil gnon mdzad pa bsam yas bskyaraX mngon spod

btsasdo: drag po lha bzhi'i thugs dam bskangaX thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas niḥtshogs drug rang grol mchod pa dang 'dod lnga ro mnyam kun bzang sprin dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor raka zag bral bde stong zung 'jug sbyor bdag gzhan rtog pa thugs rjes sgrol rkyen ngan lam sgong phyag rgya garaḥkhams gsum 1nga grol bkra shis rtags rig stong rjen grol rgyal srid bdun dug lnga cer grol rdzas mchog brgyad gzung 'dzin spros dang bral ba'i tshogs don dam lta ba chos kyi skuXrang bzhin 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid rnam rgyal spyod pa thig le'i sprinaḥshes rab rgyan mdzes rig ma dngaḥrab yangs snang ba'i dur khrod du0srid pa bam gyi rol ston la phra rtogs bya gcan sha za dngaḥkun rtog mtshang grol sha khrag rusaḥngo mtshar bkod pa bla na med phyi nang gsang ba de nyid tshogasaḥm bshams ye nas rdzogs pa cheḥgang shar lha mo'i rol rtsed bcas spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yisaḥdam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskang snang ba yab kyi thugs

dam bskang stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskangaḥ 'khor 'das gnyis med thugs dam bskang rgyud sargya mcho'i thugs dam bskang thugs dam bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥganamaphud yin mag noḥ / hrīḥmangon spyod drag po'i las kyis gdug pa 'dul nyams pa zhing bcu'i sha la dmar g.yos byed rgyal bstan spyi dang rdo rje'i theg pa srungs a ti rin chen gsang ba'i drod 'dzin pa'i pho rgyud mgon po ma hā kwa la'i sde sngags bdag ma mo skyes mchog ging gi tshogs dur khrod nye gnas zhing gi srung ma dang dus 'dzin pad+ma gsung gi bka' 'khor bcasaḥ khyad par dge bsnyen dung gi phreng ba canaḥ sprul pa g.yog bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol rdo rje'i glu dang gar la dgyes par rol phyi nang gsang mchod rgya mtshos thugs dam bskangaX nyams rtogs 'gal 'khrul nongs pa mthol lo bshags ma bu lta bu'i brtse gdung tha tshig gis sgrub pa po la lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs 'jigs tshogs zhi zhing tshe dpal nyams rdogs bstedaX snga 'khyar bstan la 'khu ba'i dgra bgegs smolaḥ bshad sgrab bstan gzhi chos 'khor gtsug lag

—'di: srungasaḥ o rgyan pad+ma'i zab gter 'dzin skyongs spelaḥ mtha' yi dmag thul du rus gzengs pa bzlogaḥ bskal ba rdzogs ldan gsar tshes langs tsho yisaḥ'ajig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāX ces brjod phud skyems tshogs gtor mchod gnad des nyams bskangs tshogs chen rdzogs bar chad rkyen zhi nyams rtogs 'phel don gnyis lhun grub the tshom medaḥ sam shāḥyemaḥrgyal dbang pad+ma'i gsang mdzod brda ngan lam sprul ba'i skyes bu yi bgo skal pha nor zab pa'i gter rak+ta 'khyil ba'i mtsho ru gab dus bab lcags kyi lce gnyis kyis rgyal khams zhon tshe rtsub 'khrugs g.yo de tshe lha yi dge bsnyen gyis brda gab gsang bkrol gdul byar smin ra tsa bse mo' cho 'phrul zhi the tshom med do sam2 rgya rgya rgya gu rgya lha zhes pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang pad+ma rgyasa'aphel rgya maphyo gnyis kyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra rgyal mchog dgyesapa'i rdo rje'am pad+ma dbang phyug gling bsadag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarbamasgo le/

ba6/sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'iḥ bskang ba mkha' dbyings sprin phung bzhugs soḥga'adi: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye rjonazlas dag mnyam chos sku'i klong yangs su snang srid rig pa' gar mchod 'bul gzung 'dzin mtshan ma ka dag pas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bskang bar bya ma gāḥ 26mi hūṃ hrīḥ ma chags dri bral bde stong 'od 'bar skuḥ 'od snang mtha' yas zer 'khrigs thugs dam bskang byams dang snying rje'i gdul bya yongs la gzigasaḥ'adren mchog nam mkha' rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangaḥ gang 'dul gzigs pas nyon mongs rba 1nga skemasaX rak+ka thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs dam bskangaX rta khyung drag po'i zhal gyis bdud dpung 'jomasaX dmar nag me phreng 'khrugs pa'i thugs dam bskang mkhyen pa'i me yi ma rig mun khams 'thar sku mchog smra ba'i nyi ma'i thugs dam bskang ༷ brtse ba'i lcags kyus gdul bya'i yul kun 'dzinaḥ dbang chen rta skad bzhad pa'i thugs dam bskangaX nus pas 'jigs lta zil gnon gsang mdzod 'ching rdo rje chos kyi dbang byug

thugs dam bskangaX phyi nang 'byung khams ye shes dbyings su sbyoraX yon tan mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskangaḥ khams gsum yongs sgrol rak+ta hub kyis 'dren phrin las yak+ka me dbal thugs dam bskangaḥ zhe sdang gdon 'thar snying rje'i rgyud lnga 'dren bde zhal dus mtshan dmar mo'i thugs dam bskangaḥ 'dod chags zhi snyoms byams pas gdul bya skyongasaX dgyes 'dzum dus sbyor sngon mo'i thugs dam bskang rmongs khams zil gnon dga' ba'i zur mig canaḥ smug mo thabs mkhas chags sbyor thugs dam bskang kheng pa'i tshogs 'joms btang snyoms chen por gnasaḥ sgeg bzhad shugs sgrol ser nag thugs dam bskang smon log mtha' ma'i srog la mtshon 'khor 'debs khams gsum dbang phyug chen po'i thugs dam bskangaX skye 'gro'i srog la dbang za 'byung po'i gamo 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po'i thugs dam bskangaX srid pa thal 'byin rdo rje'i dgongs klong sbyoraX dpal chen badz+ra gī la'i thugs dam bskang ban bon kun rgyu mi dang mi min byadaḥ gzhom mdzad bdud 'dul chen mo'i thugs dam bskang chos nyid mkha' las phrin

—8rdo: las mtha' yas ngomasaḥ sprul 'khor bsam mi khyab pa'i thugs dam bskang hūṃ hrīX gzung 'dze+en chegos drug rang grol dga' ston laḥ dug gsum rnam dag sha khrag rus pas brgyanaḥ ye shes snang ba'i 'od chen sgron me bltams dpa' bo dgyes bskyed dza gad a dṛ sbyangs thabs shes dbyings spyor dkar dmar byang sems bskyilaX rig stong rjen grol bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad rkyen ngan lam slong phyag rgya gar bcas nasaḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskangaḥ lta ba gdod nas dag pas thugs dam bskang sgom pa 'od gsal 'khor yug thugs dam bskang spyod pa gnyis snang chos nyid thugs dam bskangaX 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur thugs dam bskangaX bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pa yisaḥ khyab brdal rig stong rdzogs pa chen por bskangasaḥ bskang gyur gdod ma'i chos sku mngon gyur shogaḥ lor 'das brtan g.yo rig par shar ba yas dkyil 'khor la tshogs thugs dam bskang bar byaḥsamago rgya rgya rgyaḥ tshe dbang rag 'dzan pa d+ma 'byung gang zhig gdul bya'i dpal mtshor gzigasaḥ chos rgyal mkhan slob phun sum 'tshogs ga sa ldongs chos kyis snang

bar byas gdul bya'i dpal du zab gter bstsalaḥ sgo ni ngan lam rgyal mtshog laḥ gtad rgya son nas sbas rgya btabaḥ tshogs smon las 'phro dus 'joms skabs sgo 'di 'byung 'gyur yi bstan bslu ba med dos mashāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu tsa3༄ pad ma gsung gi dal rdzogs pa rak+ta bde mdzod mtsho gling nas zab mdzod chu pho rta la rnyed rlan gyi dug ka 'dzin la bkrol chos bdagasamardo bha dra de dgyes pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar shogaḥ sarba ma 'a/

bshā: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ bka' sdod gnod sbyin yang le ber gyi bskang gsol yid bzhin dbang rgyal bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeX 41me kye rgyal dbang pad ma'i bka' nyan yang le beraḥ dbang chen gsung gi gnyer 'dzin tsi ma ra skye 'gro'i srog dbugs bdag po drag shul canaX tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do da tshur byon dgongs sngon dbyings ni tshad bzung bral bar noraḥ 'od 'bar nyi zla mun pa bsal ba'i rten 'ja' tshon ri mor bkra ba'i mig mang risaḥ srid pa 'degs byed rlung ni stobs brgyas dpal dbang chen rat+na lnga yi sa gzhi brjed de la sa bdag gnyan gyi dpal 'byor gtamasaḥgasal dag rgya mtsho rlan zhing g.yo ba'i tshulaḥ gdengs ka nor bu 'dzin pa'i dga' ston 'byil bde skyid 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo las rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las 'byung ba'i phun tshogs mdzesaX shar nas 'bru yi longs spyod ri ltar spungs mu ge'i rgud pa zhi ba'i ltad mo shar lho ru go khrab mtshon cha'i dpal gyis gtamasaX dmag 'khrugs g.yul ngo

bzlog pa'i yas su 'phrul nub tu sman gyi phung po bsam mtha' yasaḥ skye rgu'i nad yams sel ba'i thabs su spelaX byang du gter bum nor bu'i dga' ston bkramasaX phongs rgud nyams pa gso ba'i gter du sharaX bza' ba mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du spro btung ba mi 'gags ja chang mtsho ltar bskyilaḥ dar zab reg bya lho sprin ltar du sbungs ༷ gling bzhi mi yi dpal 'byor bsam mtha' yasaḥ dpag bsam lha yi dga' tshal 'dod 'byung noraḥ pad tshal khang bzang zag med bdud rtsi dang rin chen them skas bkra shis rdzas rtags dkoraḥ rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon mtha' yas pasaX gnod sbyin btsan rgyal chen po'i thugs dam bskangaḥyum mchog srog len dmar mo'i thugs dam bskangaḥ las byed rol pa skya bdun thugs dam bskangaḥ rgyal chen sku lnga yab yum thugs dam bskangaḥ gzhon nu 'ur thog brgya yi thugs dam bskangaḥ stag shar mda' 'phen brgya yi thugs dam bskangaḥ sman mdzes dor thogs brgya yi thugs dam bskangaḥ btsun pa khrims ldan brgya yi thugs dam bskangaX sngags pa phur thogs brgya yi thugs dam bskangaḥ rang rang g.yog

ga'adi: 'khor sprul bcas thugs dam bskang 'da' 'khu ldog pa'i cho 'phrul mi ston paraḥ brtse ba'i zhal bzang ngom la 'dzum mdangs stonaX dpal 'byor mnga' thang yon tan rgyas pa dang dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen spelaḥ nad mtshon mu ge 'bogs brgyal zhi ba dngaḥ chos grwa sbyin bdag rtag tu srung zhing skyongasaḥ 'gal zla dgra sde ming med stong bar mdzodaḥ dam chos thugs gter 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams tshe sgrub mthar phyin pad+ma 'od gling du skyel ba'i lam grogs mdzod cig dam tshig can de ltar bskang bas 'phrin las 'grubaḥ sa ma yāḥ e maḥ dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pa d+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong pha nor dpal sprin 'khrigs pa nas dge banyen sha mis sprad brda las gab don gsang tshig dag phyar mthongaḥ samamāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥ3kho zhes pa 'di' chos bdag bu gsum da ཿ bla ma bī mas bskul ro ra kho bo bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis dag pa ra phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sa maṅga la/

—8sde: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las rdo rje mchog rab rtsal gyis bskang ba 'byung po zil gnon bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ rtanabyu1/ hrīḥ kun khyab nam mkha' klong yangs dkyil 'khor nas stong khams dregs pa'i gtso mchog 'bar ba rtsalaX rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i 'dir byon la pad+ma'i bka' bzhin gsang sngags bstan pa srungs khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni 'bras dang mar gyi lug dkar rgyan ldan dngaḥ sba dkar tshig gsum dar tshon 'phan yab can g.ya' chu gangs chu 'o phud mngar gsum sbyaraX dkar kyis bshos bu bkra shis nyi zla'i mdzes tsan ldan spos dkar spang rgyan bsang dud dngaḥ rin chen lnga bsres mar gyi rta mchog dang bzang drug sbyar ba'i g.yag dkar ri rab tsamaḥ rnam lnga nyer spyod dam bskang ga ṇa tshogasaḥ lha klu mi yi dkar mchod bsam yas pa ting 'dzin rdo rje'i ltad mor rab spros teḥ sa brgyad sems dpa' chen po'i thugs dam bskang 'jigs byed thang lha yar zhud thugs dam bskangaX klu rgyal

ne+e le thod dkar thugs dam bskang gnyan chen gting sang dkar po'i thugs dam bskang gtod 'bar shel gyi phung po'i thugs dam bskang dri za zur phud lnga ba'i thugs dam bskangaḥ gsang mtshan rdo rje mchog rab thugs dam bskangaḥ drag khros skor gsum gnyer 'dzin thugs dam bskangaḥ thugs gter 'dus pa'i bka' srung thugs dam bskang rnal 'byor sgog gi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang phyu g.yang gter gyi bdag po'i thugs dam bskang cang shes rta yi dpal 'phel thugs dam bskangaX g.yang dkar lug gi mtsho mo'i thugs dam bskangaḥ gnag phyug mdzo 'bri 'phel mdzad thugs dam bskangaX tshe bsod dpal 'byor mthu bskyed thugs dam bskangaḥ bskang ngo drag pa zil gnon dngos grub stsolaXhūṃ hrīḥ khyod kyi 'phrin las dge bsnyen chen po niḥ dar dkar sha ma'i gos bzang rgyan du bgoX pad+ma rak+ta'i mtsho la mnga' dbang bsgyuraḥ rin chen gter kha srung ba'i dam tshig canaḥ gnas 'dir byon la brtse ba'i zhal bzang stonaX sman bshos dkar skyems mchod pas thugs dam bskang0 g.yag lug ra skyes dkar pos thugs dam bskangaX bzang drug

—8rdo lha shing dud pas thugs dam bskangaX phyi nang gsang mched rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang rmad byung ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskang dri med phud kyi bkod pas thugs dam bskangaḥ bskang ngo zab gter srung zhing phan bde spel dgos 'ded dpal loX char phob dam tshig canaḥ sarba ga tsakram hāmu dza kha hiḥ de ltar bskang bas 'phrin las 'grub don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung bar 'gyuraḥsamamāḥye rgyal kun gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong pha nor dpal yon 'byur ba las dge bsnyen sha mis sprad brda lasaḥ gab gsang smon lam dag pas mthongaḥs maya rgya rgyargya gu phya brdanimaḥdziḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zinaral 'chang bu gsum dngabla ma de ma bskul ngor kho bobadud 'arje sa khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: tho gso bsdus pa ni mchod gtor sngags dang phyag rgyas spel la 'di skad do be+e dzaḥ thub pa'i dbang po pad+ma'i spyan snga ru khas blang dam mnos rgyal chen sde bzhi poḥ 'dir byon thugs mthun mchod gtor dgyes bzhes nas rnal 'byor sgrub pa zab mo 'dzug pa laX zhi drag dbang dang rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzodaX phyogs bzhi'i 'gal rkyen bdud bgegs dam sri sgrolaḥ tshad med 'gro phan gegs med mthar phyin nasaḥ don gnyis 'byung ba'i grogs mdzod dam tshig canaX ma dhi rda raṣ+ṭa be+e tu ta ka be+e ru bhak+ta be+e shasha ma ṇa ye e dam bha li ta kha kha khā hi khā 38 lan gsum gyis phul lo phyi yi sgo sru la gtor 'bum ni gtor ma byin gyis rlabs laḥ hūḥ skye med gnas su mngon par byang chub kyang 'gags med gzugs sku'i sgrub la phan bde stsolaḥ phyi rkyen bdud thul nang bgegs dbyings su sol log rtog 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo rming bshigs nasaḥ gdod ma'i he ru ka dpal mngon gyur mdzodaḥ ces ya man+ta ka sa pā ri wā ra e dam bha lirnya kha kha khā hi kha hi ༷ lan gsum gyis phul lo nang gi sgo srung la gtor ma bul ba niḥ hrīX 'jigs byed bskal pa dus mtha'i me lta buX gdon

dang bdud bgegs dpung tshogs sma phab pa 'thar byed gzhon nu rdul gyi kha lo ba dam tshig bzhin dgongs dpa' skyems 'di bzhes la sgrub la dngos grub char phob rtogs pa spor phyi nang gsang rkyen chos kyi dbyings su sgrol dngos kun bdud rtsi grub pa'i las mdzod cigaḥ tsho badz+ra.a sritakurnya liwa(maya edam bha lernyi khakha khāhaṃ khāhiḥ de ltar phul bas phrin lasasgrub dge legs dpal gyis phyugasapar 'gyuraḥsam ga rgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang snying noratsān simasanas bskul ngor tho gsos med rags kun la sbyar rung ba 'di nyadanu ldan pas bsgrur ba masgo leḥ

—8rdo: skabs su nyu le bskrad chog ni liṅga dbang tshang zhal shes ltar bkod la gru gsum rgya ru gzhugaḥ de nas ye bskyed 'gugs bstim niḥ yigadza mdun du shā1 gsum las kyi bsha' khang dug lnga rang gshed du 'beb pa'i mtshon thun 'khrugs pa'i nang du ༷ triyas sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed dam sri nyu4 thams cad rid cing nyams thag pa'i lus can du gyuraḥ na moḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal loḥ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden mthu dngaX khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po rta khyung bzhad pa rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin zab mo'i bden pa'i mthus sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri nyuste spun dgu nag po bdud kyi rigs su gtogs pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten ming gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cigaḥ tris ga ya dza dzaḥhūṃyoḥhoḥ hū rngams brjed dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nasaḥ gdul dka' 'dul mdzad dbang chen bka' yi 'khoraḥ khyi spyang bcu drug dmu long 'brug 'dab brgyad dbang phyug gser gyi sring mo la sogs rnams 'dir byon 'dod yon mchod gtor dgyes

bzhes laḥ dam sri rdul du brlag pa'i brin las mdzodaX gnas yul so so nas khro mo kun thub rgyal mo spyan drangasaX hūṃ bh+yoḥdabang chen bka' nyan khro mo kun thub rgyal ༷rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan rlung gi gaX ga pa can srin po'i snying 'byin 'chang bar bcug nas gsol mgo phreng sbrul chun sprin dmar g.yang gzhi klubs mtsheb rngams gcigs nad khrag skyi 'dang g.yoḥ phyag zhabs zangs kyi sen rtser bskal me 'baraḥ gsang ba'i dbang phur srin po'i snying la gziraḥ dgra la babs na dug gi kha phru thobaḥsril babs na sgog snying dron mo 'phrogaḥ bgegs la babs na du pā rdul du rlogaḥ dngos grub 'phrog cing rku ba'i smon log rnams ming tsam med par thal bar brlag mdzod cigaḥ.o gha gha ta yaḥgha tayaḥsarba du caphaṭa phaṭa rku likai lasarba pashā // phaṭaphaṭaX badz+ra dharmad adz+nyā pas tisarba bisnekwa mawāk+ka ciltabadz+ra gīyi kil ya3phaṭa matsu bus partsaḥru pa rtsaX na ra rtsaX tsa me thun na sha tsā byu yakra bri na ya ga phye ma bye ma rngal phran rngal phran cibyu rbad tre+e'u tri'u rwa dzadun rting nan sri'u ya ma span dgu nan tri'u

'am: bse reg dbul sri nanaḥ tri'u ze'u rang god 'dre nanaḥ tri tri hur thim dzaḥ gzer hūṃ trig shag re sha rus khug khug sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed 'gab 'dre khug dam sri'i snying la mā ra ya dza dzaḥ hūṃ sna stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten kunaX ye shes khro bo khro mos gtamasaḥ kun kyang rdo rje'i bro la dgongasaX dgra rnams ma lus rdul du brlag bgegs dang sri kun 'thar bar byedaḥ 'gab 'dre bse rag dbul sri bcomaX phung 'dre chos kyi dbyings su bshigasaḥ yo sum+bha ni susna ni sogs ya ma dam sri raka s+t+waṃ bha ya nan de ltar byas pas sri bdud 'joms sgrub la bar chad med par 'gyuraḥsam yuḥ

badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag khros me yi 'phreng ba'i dgyes bskyed mchod sprin yid bzhin nor 'phreng bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye phya nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin spros drag khros rdul tshon dal du mchod rnal 'byor che rgyan yo byad dang snyan 'gyur glu dang rol mo bcasaḥ hū lhan skyes rang byung ye shes bde chen zhalaX ye nas gnyis med rta khyung drag por bzhugs blo yi dri ma bag rdul ka dag phyir ༷ glu gar bro yi mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes ༷ tso ma hā dz+nyān tete sno ten hūṃ phyi mchod 'bul ba niḥ hrī rnam pa kun gyi mcho ldan bde ba'i gzugasaḥ lha mo dkar ser dmar ljang mthing smug gis rgyal ba'i dgyes sprin kun bzang pū dza spro chags pa'i rdul bral mkha' khyab pad sdong spelaḥ tshul khrims dri 'thul spos sprin rnam par ldengaḥ mun sel shes rab 'char sgo sgron me gsalaḥ bde ba mchog bskyed dung zhal dri bsil byags lnga yi dga' stson bdud rtsi mtshungs dpe dbenaXgral bum rgyangs gla grags stong dga' bsted tshalaX dbyings las rang byang ye shes smong du 'bul rjes chags 'dzum

pa'i bdag gzhan don du bzhesaḥ ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs can mngon snang mdzod o badz+ra2gre dhāpe sogs shabha byudza sto nang mchod 'bul ba niḥhrī yid rig yeshes phyag rgya bde ba'i gzugasaḥ blta ba'i mi ngoms dkar ser dmar mthing ljang mthong ba'i yid 'phrog dga' bzhi'i chu bsil 'bebasaX rdo rje'i gar bcas dgyes pami sprin phung sproX mjes sdug dpe med yid 'ong bye brag dang sgra stong rdo rje'i glu dang rol mo'i rigs tshor stong 'gags med mchog gi dri dang ni stong stong ro brgya nus pa stong ldan zasaX reg stong lha gos pañtsa li ka sogasaX rgyal ba kun dngos rta khyung drag por 'bulaḥ bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes su gsol bde ba mchog gi dga' ston nub med stsolaḥ nye ru pa shabhagarnye rās spar she pūdza a ( gas mchod 'bul ba naḥtrīḥ bdoba'i mthar son stong pa phyag rgya'i gzugasaḥ sku la btud cing 'khrul ba'i sgeg mo dkar reg na dga' bzhi'i dpal 'bebs pad 'phreng sbo stong nyid bcu drag gling bu'i sga mchod 'bulaḥ 'byur ldems 'khrul chags gla ma'i dga' ston 'gyedaX rdo rje gar mas

—'di: 'khrul pa ru bzlog byed rjes chags bzhad pas sku gsung thugs yon tanaX phrin las dgyes bskang gdul bya'i tshogs chen rdzogs rgyud lnga'i bsdus pa'i 'gro ba smin cing grolaḥ o dz+nyā na mu tra la phye ma l+ya gidhi waṃ phye nirnyi a nu ra ga pū dza ho sman mja niḥ ( trīḥ dngos kun dwangs ma ye shes bdud rtsi 'khyilaX kun bzang chos kyi sku la dgongs pas bskulaḥ byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don la bslang nyan rang 'gogs nyams las sad sa lam bkodaḥ don gsum phun tshogs zeg ma mkha' khyab sproX dbang chen pad+ma 'dzum zhal dgyes pa bskangaḥ mthu dbang tshe 'phel 'gro khams dong sprugs mdzodaḥ ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hiḥ mtshan don khā hi sbyar dngos grub blang ba ni dam tshig dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i bdud rtsi las zeg ma mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor spros nas rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa bskang shing 'gro ba'i don la bskul bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po rdzogs par gyur slar bdud rtsi'i steng du sna gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs oṃ dkar udamar hūṃ mthing ga'i rnam par shar ba nyid srin sor lcags kyu lta bus

bskul nas rang gi gnas gsum du bstims pas mthu dbang tshe dang ye shes yon tan dang sku gsung thugs bcud ma lus pa thob par bsam laḥ kheḥ lce yi dam tshig rdo rje pad+mo laḥ rdo rje sbyan gyi gsang bar hūṃ bsgom nas thabs shes mtheb srin sbyar ba'i bcud chen poḥ gnyis med hūṃ sbyar dngos grub kun thob dmigasaḥ kwa ya sirnyi maḥ wak+ka sirnyitsa tsit+ta sirnyi 〉ཿ sarba sirnyi hrīḥ rak+ta 'bul ba ni raḥ'akhor rtsa rten 'brel rlung sems nyon 'khrul bsgral he ru ka dpal dgyes phyir dmar chen stobs bran dang bka' nyan las la chun pa dngaḥ mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grub gyur cig ma hā rak+ta khā hiḥ gtor ma 'bul ba naḥ hūṃX snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gzhong pa rtsa srid pa bcud kyi dpal 'byor gtor chen bshamasaḥrdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang phyir 'bulaḥ mched dang lcam dral nyams pa gso phyir stobasaḥ pad+ma drag pos bdag gzhan don du bzhes 'dod yon ro mnyam rtogs pa 'char bar mdzodaḥ ma hwa bā ling ta khā hiḥ sgrol mchod 'bul ba niḥtram̐ḥ ma stes ma 'gags dbu ma'i mkha' dbyings su rlang sems kun rtog 'dzag med bcing

—8rdo: ba yis yul dang yul can rtogs bdud rū tra bsgralaḥ khams gsum 'khor ba dbyings su stong gyur cigaX ma tram̐ du tra pra ban tsakra pra be sha ya phaṭa khā hi sbyor mchod 'bul ba niḥ hūṃḥ kun dhar chen po bde ba mchog gi gnasaX 'bar ba'i mes bskul byang chub sems g.yos teḥ 'khor lo lnga yi gzhon nu thams cad laḥ bde stong dga' ba bzhi yis mchod pa 'bulaḥ kun kyang bcu drug don la rtag bzhugs nasaḥ ma dag sgyu lus bde ba chen por smin ༷ dag pa ye shes lha ru sad gyur cigaḥ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga na a dṛ ta kurnya li ho anyu le hūṃ badz+ra pū dza hoḥ tang nge 'dzan mchod 'bul ba niḥhūḥ chos dbyings nam mkha'i rgyan gyur lha rdzas rigs bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nye ba'i nor dpag bsam ldon shing gter bum 'dod 'jo'i baḥ yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyalaḥ stong pa bar snang sa gzhi'i rgyan phun tshogasaḥ ma lus kun bzang rting 'dzin dga' ston dpal blo yis mi dpog rig pa ye shes 'phrul0 thams cad mnyam rdzogs rta khyang drag por 'bul gzung dang 'dzin pa'i gsal rtog grol gyur

cigaḥ badz+ra sa ma dhi byu dza spra ra ṇa sa ma ya hoḥ de bgo nyid mja niḥ hūḥ dbyings nyid gdod nas ka dag chos kyi sku spros pas ma gos rnam thar gsum ldan klong mkha' la mkha' thim ji bzhin de bzhin nyidaḥ gnas lugs ye mnyam mchod 'bul mnyam nyid bzhesaḥ 31 ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa.ad+ma ko3nya phyu dza rdeng de ltar mchod 'bul tshogs go rdzogs sgrib dag nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel khro bo rol ba'i gnad 'phyang gi mchod byang bkol ba'i rim po niḥ samagaḥye maḥrgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma yis ma 'ongs gdul bya las ldan dang rgyal tshabs sprul sku'i rkyen bzlog phyir bla ma yi dam dbyer med paḥ gdon 'dul rta khyung sgrub pa'i skor pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong dbang gi 'od khyam 'bar ba rtsa rin chen gter gyi rgya bsdam nas dge bsnyen dung gi phreng ba can klu mo gser 'phreng 'dzan la gtadaḥ rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe las ldan gcig la sprad par gyis des kyang 'gro don mtha' rgyasa'abyung 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'god mi bslu pad ma'i gtan tshag yin 'dod sred can la ma shor cigaḥsamag rgya rgya rgya gu phya brda zem lha zhes pa 'di yang lung zinadage leg grag pa'i dpal gyis gos dar dang gsang sngags kyi dzosamachog ka pā la 'byu sna shing tog kur bu bkang ba dang rdo rje sems dpa' me long rdul bral chags bral ka ma la'i
—'di: mtshan pa can dang bcas nas nan to chen pos bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'dul khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig sarba maṅga le/
ba'i: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥdrag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i sdig pa'i gnad byang me rlung mtshon 'khrugs bzhugs soḥ

—8/sde: na mogu rupad+ma krota radza 4 spyo shārdostob bsnyen zhing sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la dug gsum gdon gyis rgol ba dang rims yam 'gos nad byung ba da ཿgshed 4masaza kha ston pa dang glo bur god kha nga ba na drag sgrub me yi 'khor lo dang sbrel te sdig sgrub 'di la brtsonaḥs mashā dug sna bsres pa'i 'jim pa yi sdig pa'i gzugs bsnyan 'jigs par bya mdun du dmar rgya gtor ma dang g.yas su ting lo g.yon khrag rkong dpal 'bar nyi shu rtsa gcig 'dzug dmar nag rtsang gi drwa ba bya log tu rgyal bsen gzugs bkod nas de la 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni kyaḥnyes 4)ga snang —ste/ lha 'dre'i tshogasaḥpad+ma 'byung gnas bka' la 'dus rang sems 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te dug lnga log par spyod pa'i 'dreXrnam chen ngan song myong gyur canaXthams cad bden pa'i tshig la nyon rgyu 'bras baspu med yid la brtenaḥsangs rgyas bden pa'i bka' bzhin duḥ'akhore ba 'das pa'i pha rol ṣārig 'dzin gong ma'i rjes snyogs ran0 de ltar mi 'os log 'dren rigasaḥdrag po'i 'khyal 'khor chos la bkod thams cad dad tsang gus par gyis gser skyems mchod na mo dadzad mtshag gsum la phyag 'tshal loḥmachog gsum ska gsum

btsasdo: rtsa gsum bden gnyis bsgru ba med pa'i bden mthu dang khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po'i lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin zab mo'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom paX nad yams mtshon 'khrugs mi 'dod pa'i rgol ba sna tshogs slong baX rang sems 'khrul dbang du shor zhing las ngan gyi spyod pa rtsub mo la gnas pa'i rgyal bsen klu gnyan gang dang gang yin pa thams cad gzugs ming yid chags kyi rdzas 'di la khug cigaX dri a ba ya dzaḥ dzaḥ/ baṃḥho nyer gcig la mi yi bar bzlo chos bshad pa ni kyi nyon cig rang snang 'khrul ba'i 'dreḥ dug gsum dbang gyur rgyal bsen kluḥ dang po ma rig pa las byung bdag nyid gcig pus 'khrul rtsa byas lhan cig skyesapas bag chags bskyedaḥ kun tu btags pas yul rjes 'brang med la yod par bzung zhing golaX drang don chos la yid ma ches rgyu 'bras bslu med khyad du bsad nges pa'i don gyi rtogs pa med rtag chad phyogs rer gol zhing 'phyan dkon mchog chos ra bshad sgrab bshigasaḥ sems can bde sgrid 'phral du bcomaḥ mi byug

nor la god yams btangaḥza 'dre phung sri dme mkhon bslangaX sha khrag drod mor zas su spyodaX skye 'gro yongs kyi srog la 'bag las ngan sdug bsngal rgya mtshos gdungaX thar med 'khor ba'i btson rar tshudaḥ rgyal bas gzigs na thugs rje skye bdag gis mthong yang snying rje'i gnas thog mar 'khrul zhing bar du 'thas tha ma rnam smin myong gyur canaḥpaṇa chen shing gi rkang ba can 'byung po gdong gnyer rus par mngonaX mi sdug bzhin la rma rmen rdol lta log byurnye ral pa 'khyang0 rgya min rgya yis cha lugs canaX sog min sog gis spyod pa ston bslu mkhas bud med li mgo maḥ kha cig sngo gdong smra ra can khrag gis bzhin ras rnam par mnye de dang de yi rig gtogs rnamasaḥ gsang sngags bden pa'i tshig la nyon pad+ma drag 'khros bka' bzhin duḥ deng gi yon mchod bsrung bya la 'tshe bar byed pa'i yul med pasaḥ lan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la chos nyid stong pa'i dbyings su dengasaḥ tīḥ nga ni yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas teḥ 'gro ba sngag bsngal gyur la dam chos ston dang po ma rig 'khyal ngor 'dod lngas brnganaX tha ma sgo

—8 sde: gsum ltos med lha la 'bulaḥ glo bur 'khrul ngor nga dang nga yi ba thams cad ye stong spros dang bral bar gzhigaḥ a.ā lan chags bsngo ba ni byeX ma rig pa las 'khrul ba'i 'dreḥ dug gsum dbang gyur gzhan gnod mkhanaX byams pa'i ting 'dzin zas la spyodaX snying rje'i sbyin gtong 'di la 'dus ༷ dga' bde'i grogs dang nor la rol gdug rtsub btang snyoms ngang grol te ye shes chen po'i dpal thob thegag saṃ bha ras sngags brgya rtsa dang bsgrags la chang bu sku glud 'bras chan sha khrag yas sna tshogs bsngo zhing de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mab yang yang brjod la rgyas gdab par bya'o rgol ba phyir dbyung ba ni kyi ma nyes rang khar 'dug pa yis rnal 'byor bdag dang bsrung bya laḥ gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dug gsum gdonaḥglud gyi lan chags sbyangs zin pasaḥ nad rnams thams cad rang gnas bsduḥ gdon rnams thams cad phyir dbyung zhing gdug rtsub nyer 'tshe rang sar dengs nyes pa'i skyon dang bral bar mdzodaḥ o gu ru artsig nertsig hri hwa khro phaṭaḥ ha la ha la rmya khyung khyung0 bar zhum trig shagaX gdug pa smran dgu'i srog la ram̐ ram̐ ya mame khrag sodaḥ phaṭa phaṭa

sodaḥ phug phug sodaḥ thim tha ra tis durnyedz+wa la ram̐ paswā snya sgro phu le phu le phudaphudaḥha laha laphud phud rgyal bsen dam sri'i spyor ba ngan pa phud phudaḥsharnye ku ruphud phud pus ku ru phudaphudaḥwa 〈ku ru phud phud gnod byed ma ra ya ku ru phud phud lan bdun nam nyer gcig bo da ngo sprod na kye kye nyon dang ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'dre nyon mongs dbang gyur dug gsum gdonaḥ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kunaḥ rang gi sems las gzhan ma yinaḥng khyod gnyis su 'dzin pa spongs dbang po mig gi yul snang gzugs bde chen dpal rir 'dun pa khyer rna ba'i yul du grags pa'i sgraXdam chos sirnyi'i sngags su zlosaḥ yid la 'khrul rtogs gang byung yang stong nyid snying rjer lam du khyer byang chub spyod pa rlabs po che byams dang snying rje byang chub sems sngags kyi lta dgongs ya mtshan can dad pa dag snang mos gus brten sdom pa'i rtsa ba skyabs su songaḥgazhan phan srog la gnod 'tshe stsongs de lngar rgyal ba'i rjes smod na 'khor ba srid pa'i pha rol phyinaḥ thar lam mya ngan 'das la 'godaX khyod kyinasal snang rang grol phyir sga ma'i

btsasdo: lus 'di lha la 'bul brjod tshig grags stong gsung su stobasaḥ'agyu ba ye shes thugs dang bsreX ma rig chos kyi dbyings su bshigs rig pa ye shes mngon gyur naX rgyal ba'i sras mchog thob pa yinaX de don rtogs mdzod sa ma yā sdig pa'i bskyed rga ni skad cig gi rang nyid drag por gsal ba'i mdun du sprul pa'i lcags sdig nag po lus po dmar nag gnyer mas gang ba lcags kyi rwa dang 'bar ba'i spyan bsgrad paX mgo dgu nas rngams sgra tsig tsig zhes sgrogs shing rgyal bsen zhal du khyer baX dug gi rlangs pa dang me rlung gi ngar zer g.yo baXlcags kyi ser ba 'bebs zhing rngams pa'i 'brug g.yo baXlcags kyi sder tshogs bsgrad pa'i nyams pa dam sri'i snying 'dar baḥrang 'dra'i tshwa tshwa bu yug ltar 'tshubs pa de dag las spros pas 'od zer gyis rngams brjid srin yul thod pa'i sku mkhar nas rak+ka he ru ka drag po lcags kyi sdig pa'i rnam par bzhengs nas sbrul phag khyung sdig seng gi tshogs bu yug ltar 'tshubs pa dang bcas te spyan drangs la dam tshig pa yaku me dpal gyis sku dang gnyis su med par bstims mo

hū hūṃ stsa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mu mtha' yas pa na rgyal kun phrin las mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa che ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma thod phreng rtsal mngon spyod drag po'i las la da bzhengs shigaḥ hū /ཿ myur mdzad las kyi pho nya drag shul canaḥ raka pho mo'i bkur sti byed pa'i yul srin po'i rgyal po mngon spyod mthu thobs pa yak+ka me dbal 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyar bzhengs hū hūṃ sku mthong mod la dregs pa'i srog dbug lhudaX gsung sgra sgrogs pa'i 'jigs tshogs zil gyis gnon ye shes thugs kyis 'brul ba gting nas bshigs dug gsum gdon tshogs 'dul ba'i dus la bab hū hūṃ dgra la bab na mtshon chas 'khor lo bskor bgegs la bab na rab 'bar me yis gzir sri la bab na dug gi zhal chab thob thams cad ming med brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod hū 〉ཿ sangs rgyas rnams kyang mthu dang stobs ma chung yi dam lha sngags bden pa rtsal ma zhan pho nya dam can las la mthu ma chungaX mngon sgod mdzad pa 'di la nus shugs bsted hūṃ hūṃ nyon mongs a 'thas nasal ba'i las ngan 'diḥ gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba snying

badz+ra: rje'i yul da ni drag po chen po thugs rjes zungasaḥ chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i zhal du rolaḥ hū 〉ཿ ye nas dag pa gting gsal gnyug ma'i klongaX sangs rgyas sems can tha snyad dben pas gshis don dam thig le nyag gcig dgongs pa'i mthil rdzong 'phrang srog gsum thob pa ngo mtshar cheḥ hū hūṃ hūṃḥ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed rgyal bsen klu gnyan gyis phung khams skye mched la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ bha ga gha te phu ta hoḥ drag po sdig pa'i gzugs kyis gnod byed za 'dre gshed 'khyams bla rkun srog 'phrog dbugs sdud dri za pho mo'i me sa la khā hiḥ rak+ta la khā hi tsit+ta la khā hiḥ e ram̐ ram̐ ye ram̐ ram̐ḥ le ram̐ ram̐ḥ baṃ ram̐ ram̐ ༷ ma ra ya dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ḥ yas glud dang ma bsen gyi gzugs rnamasadrag po'i zhal du bstabs tshul bya 'dod gsol ni khyer cig khyer cig he ru gaX drag po rngams pa'i sdang mig can dug gsum gdon 'di gtad do bzhesaX gnod 'khrul ming med stong par mdzodaḥ lan bdun brjod sgyu drag po rngams pa'i khro zhal can ༷ khyang skad kyis sa gsum g.yo ba rta skad kyi srid gsum 'dar ba sngang mig gis gogs stong 'khyags

paX smar smin las thogs ser khol baX ral pa las lcags char 'beb pa shangs khung nas dug rlangs 'tshubs pa ljags dmar las drag sngags 'phro ba ba spu las mtshon cha 'khrigs paḥ dam 'dogs gyi rdo rje gzir ba rgyal bsen gyi snying khrag lhud paX thal 'byin gyi phur bu gzigs ba sri bdud kyi don snying 'byin paX phag sdig gi phyag mtshan 'gyed pa gdon gsum la phung thal gtong ba mtshan thos pa'i dregs pa 'dul ba sku mthong bas sde brgyad 'bog pa gsungs thos pas 'byung po brgyal baḥ mthu nam mkha' dang mnyam pa stobs thogs ngar las che ba rtsal khra tsha las grags paX che ba'i yon tan bsam mtha' las 'das pa rta khyung drag po me yi phreng ba can lhag pa'i lha mchog khyod gnad nas bskul loḥ chos byed kyi tshe srog la 'tshe bas bdud bgegs rgyal bsen la rbad doḥ skabs blta glag tshol tsam yang mi nus par 'bog tu chug cigaḥbargyal du chug cig dzul du rlog cigaḥ sha za dus mtshan ma dmar mos pho sri g.yas su bskyar la lcags mkhar dgu rims kyi nang du chug cigaḥ mi srin dus sbor ma sngon mos

'tho/: mo sri g.yon du bsgyur la rgya mtsho'i gting tu bsgyur cigaḥ ro langs chags spyor ma smug mos chung sri thad gar bsgyur la mkha' dbyings stong par dpyog shig dur khrod shugs sgrol ma ser mos dri za gshed 'khyams zhabs kyis bsgyur la mun pa nag po'i btson khang du chug cirga dbang phyug 'char byed nag po'i dgra sri rdul du rlog la zhal du rol cigaX las gshin tshe bdag 'bar bas god sri phyags gis zung la lto bar chug cigaḥ bdud 'dul kai 'a yas dam sri btson du zungs la sdang med du mdzod cigaḥdrag mo seng gdong mas byad ma rbod gtong mkhan gyis glad rgya dkrug la nus mthu nyams su chug cigaX rdo rje la ma chen mos dgra sha la grum grum rol zhig rin chen dun gyes rngams mas dgra khrag la 'ub 'ub rngub cigaḥ chags sbyor 'bar ma chen mos dgra dbug la sib sib shub cing 'dren par mdzod cig las byed kha kha chen mos dgra snying la lhag lhag rol nas ming med du mdzod cigaḥ ho smon lam log pa'i bdud pho nyams pa can gyi dgra nyes pa 'byed pa'i bgegs thar lam 'phrog pa'i bdudaḥ tshe sgog rku ba'i sriḥ

—'di: sri chu 'dre byed pa bzlogaX so bya ro zan nag po zhenaḥ ma yi mngal la re ba bzlog bu chung mgo 'phreng lag na thogasaḥ gzhen nus mdangs la bza' ba bzlogaḥkhrag 'dzag lngags thul rlon pa bgoḥ mi sha mi khrag rngams pa bzlogaḥ god sri dmar mo lag brdal masaḥ rta phyugs nor la bza' ba bzlog myur mgyogs 'phar ba rnga nag zhon glo ton sa 'gags mgo bsnyen bzlog lag na sha khog rlon pa 'dzin mi ngoms rkan rdeb glal ba bzlogaḥ dgra sri phung byed nag mo yis dgra sna god sna rkun sna bzlog0 gcan spyang sngon mo mgyogs ldan masaḥ ma nyes la yog 'khor ba bzlogaḥ lag na mdung rang rnga yab 'dzinaX rgya hor sog gi dmags sna bzlog g.yang sri nag mo re bas lus 'gong bo bse rag byed pa bzlog chibs su ri bong kha shwa bcibasaX the'u rang 'byung po'i hab thob bzlogaḥ lag pa zed cing sgod stong 'dzinaḥ gang stong phung thal byed pa bzlogaḥdur khrod 'dre mo mang pos bsgor lha 'dre yongs kyi dal kha bzlog mi nad phyugs kyi god kha zhiX kha 'gong snying 'gong bse rag bzlogaX dgra sna gdon sna gyod sna dang kha smas

gleng mo thams cad bzlog drag khros rngams pa'i bka' bzhin duḥ 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyisaḥ sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlogabazlogaḥ kyiḥ byang thang byang ri min pa'i g.yogaḥrlung ri phung sbra nag po'i sbubs ku ku phag dang tsa ra 'tshubs me dmar bya pho tsam gyi 'dabasaXmu stegs ro ha gdong dgu'i grwal dur khrod 'dre mo khyod cag song phyi mig med par da gshegs shigaḥ de rang phyin chad gnas mchog 'diraḥ 'bar ba'i me rlung dug sprin 'tshubasaX khro khyung sdigs phag thun mtshon 'gyed0 bdud bgegs nye ba'i skal ba medaḥ rang byung lhun grub srung 'gyesar bsgomaḥ snyen artsigadertsig hrī hūṃ /phaṭaX hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyis brab srung ba'i gur phub nad rims zhiḥs mamāḥrgya rgyargya 'di yangasas ldan dpa' bos sbyar sarba maṅga le/
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i mo 'dre kha phral me yi 'khor lo bzhugs soḥ

—8rdo: na mo pad+ma krota rā dza yaḥ sgopho/tsas dus ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham du 'dod chags dam sri'i yo lang 'chas shi 'dre gson 'dre grong rgyug 'tshogs btsun pa la 'khri sdom pa sku thab tu nyal nas bse rag byed rnal 'byor lus ba da 'jag par byed rdo rje'i mched lcam mkhon 'dzing gtugaḥbastan pa'i sbyin bdag bsod nams 'phrog de tshe thabs 'di la brten na bse rag mo 'dre rgyu lam gcod 'byung po'i za kha ston pa gcod byin rlabs phan yon bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥsam shā rgya rgya rgya de nas bca' tshogs rim pa ni go ba'i gzhi 'am mkhar gzhong nang khrag snas chags chags bkrams pa'i steng dur sri nag mo sre mong zhog lag na bsha' gri nad skyal 'dzin lus la sgyu ma'i rgyan gyis spras byis sri nag po dur bya zhenaḥlag na bu chung mgo phreng 'dren lus la mi lngags thul pa klubs gor sri dmar mo 'phar ba zhenaḥlag na sha khog 'dzan zhing rol dgra sri nag mo gcan spyang zhon lag na mdung ring rnga yab 'dzan g.yang sri nag mo ri bong zhon lag g.yas zed cing g.yon pa na snod stong thogs pas gzugs su bca' pho mo'i glud dang 'dod sa yas nam mkha' mda' 'phang shing ras dang bal brgyang yid mthun ci 'byor bsags khyad par mi kha' rdzas bsres pa' sgong nga mtshal gyi bh+yo bzlog can brgya'am lnga bcu nyer lnga da ཿbsdu na bdun tsam 'dzoms par bya ras

—— snye: zab dar zab 'bras chan dang sha dum chang bu mar me bsags dang po bskyed chog gyer bsgoms niḥhrīḥ mi dmigs stong pa chos sku'i ngang nyid las 'khor ba'i rang bzhin kun gzhi'i 'dam snyogs 'phrulaḥ las dbang rlung gi yid kyi mos ngo rtsa 'dod chags rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i gnyis snang gdon skye 'chi'i snang ba ston pa'i dur sri moḥ bang rtsal rlung las mgyogs pa'i sre mong zhon tshe srog tha dad gcod pa'i bsha' gri dngaX kun rtogs zug ngu'i 'khrugs slong nad skyal 'dzin sgog la dbang za shan pa dmar rgyan can de yi 'khor du dam sri 'dre mo bzhi byis sri nag mo dur bya ro zan zhonaX mi phyugs yongs kyi srid la 'jab cing sku god sri dmar mo myur mgyogs 'phar ba zhon rta dril gnag lug tsa ra'i tshe srog 'phrog ngan thabs sna dgu'i god kha phral du gtong dgra sri nag mo gcan spyang ngar ma zhon phyi sde dkrugs shing phu nu nang nas mkhon nye ba rtsod cing gza' mir nang 'thab gtongaḥ 'gogs sri nag mo ri bong kha shwa bcibs bsod nams mnga' thang snan grags thams cad 'phrogaḥ legs su mi ster nyer pa la sbor ba'iḥ

rang rang rigs gtogs shi gson grong 'dre moḥ las dbang rtsubs pa'i 'khor tshogs bsam mtha' yas bdag nyid gang shar rang grol he ru ga'i dpa' brjed ma bzod 'dar bzhin gnas par dmigs ༷ bden brjod kyi mthus 'gugs bstims bya ba ni na 57 dasko na mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ma ༷ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa dngaḥgu ru drag khros dmar nag me phreng bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi bden pa dang srung ba go cha lha lnga bdud 'dul khro bcu dus 'dzin ma bzhi srog bdag sde lnga dang bcas pa'i bka' chos nyid gdod nas stong zhing chos can rgyu 'bras basmu ba med pas bden pa'i mthusaḥ o rgyan chen po'i rgyal tshab bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyi dngos slob brgyud pa chos grwa sbyin bdag dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dur sri mo sde lnga'i rigs dang 'khor du gtogs pa thams cad mdos glud len pa'i slad du 'dir 'dus shigaḥ raklo yaklo gson 'dre mo bse rag mo shu na mo thams cad 'dus 'dus dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ be lhas gsum bdun dgu sogs gang skabs brjod mdos glud byin gyis brlabs pa ni kyeḥ 'phrul kyi 'dos ra

badz+ra: chos dbyings stong pa'i khyon mi srid dgu srid sgyu ma'i nor gter 'phrulaḥ rnam rgyal lha yi dkor las ya mtshan can lha 'dre'i yid spyod 'dod dgu tshims pa'i yas 0 mig 'phrul lta bu'i dga' ston phun tshogs gyur sngags drug phyag drug gi spel lo glud mgron spyan drangs ba ni kye sna tshogs 'phrul gyi byed po dur 'dre moX chung sri god sri dgra sri 'gong 'dre moX rang rang rigs rtogs g.yog 'khor bsam mtha' yasaX chos nyid bden mthu bsgru ba med pa'i mthusaḥ skad cig yid tsam sgyu ma'i mgron la 'dus gnod 'che'i bsam sbyor gdug rtsub dang bral bar zhi zhing byams pas rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon bden pa'i chos bshad pa ni kye ma rig pa las 'khrul pa'i 'byung po khyodaX dang po rgyal ba'i bka' 'das chags pas myos bar du gling bzhi mi yi tshe la skuḥ tha ma ting 'dzin lha sngags phyag rgyar 'tshe mi dge bcu yi khrims la skye rgu sbyor yang dag dge ba bcu yi khrims sma phab 'di 'dra'i las kyi rnams smin mi bsla bar bzod med du kha'i zug rnga chen po myong de phyir bdag gi bka' la nges par nyon mig gis mi sngag gzugs

bsnyan gang mthong yang sgyu ma rmi lam gzugs brnyan lta bur ltos rna ba'i snyan dang mi snyan sgra grags kunaḥ brag 'thegasgra bzhin bden med ngang la zhog sems la dug lnga'i rtog tshogs ci 'gyu yang shar grol klong thim chos nyid don la ltosaX 'di ltar rtogs na rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyuraḥ las ngan mimyong yang dag sa la spyod 'gro ba yongs kyi ded dpon dam par 'gyur kyeX yang cig gson dang sgyu mar zhen pa'i 'groḥ a 'thas dug lnga'i 'dams su tshud rnams la chos nyid sgyu ma'i dkor nor mi zad gteraḥ rnal 'byor rig pa'i ting 'dzin 'phrul mo che lha 'dre'iyid spyod bskangs ba'i yas 'di 'bul zag med bde ba'i ro la longs spyod bzhinaḥ bslu med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su songaḥ pha ma 'gro ba yongs la 'tshe ma byed bdag cag dpon slob chos grwa yon bdag bcas bzung pa thong la bcing pa bkrol ba dang mnan pa khyog la zhen chags 'khri ba sbongs yang dag rtogs pas rjes sgogs dam tshig srungasaḥ dbyings na bzhugs pa'i ma sring gral zin byosaḥ ma rig 'khor b.lipha mthar bsgal gyur cigaḥ sam bha ra'i

—8mi: sngags dang bsgrags la chang bu ci mang bsngo lam bstan ni kye hoḥ yang dag chos nyid rtogs pa'i skal dman rnams sgyu ma'i dga' ston 'di la spyod bzhin du g.ya' dag nam mkha' stong pa'i bshul lam bzhudaḥ grong khyer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i gnas su gshegasaḥ dpag tshad bgrang yas nye ba'i skal med pas yang dag nyon la bde bar da song zhig gal te mi dbang bzhin du glag blta na drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon rab 'khrugs teḥ mgo 'gas snying bsregs lus po thal bar 'thagaḥ sha khrag zhal gsol ming med stong par 'gyuraḥ de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shigaḥ hūṃ hūm̐ sarba snyisne gtsā bka' bgo bya zhing thun gyis brab srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya de la rab gnas me tog 'thor gnad des 'byung po nye mi nus byin rlabs rno nus bsam mi khyab bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsalaḥ sam shāḥ tshem bde chen gsang bgasung gi gnas pad+ma rak+ta 'khyil klong nas dge bsnyen sha mas sprad brda las dus su rags ldan bu la gsalaḥsnyigs ma'i rgud pa sel ba'i phyir rin chen shog skyar gsal bar byas smon lam las 'phros bskul ba'i zhingaḥyongs khyab dam sri stong gyur cigaḥ sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥzhes pa 'di'ang kho bo bdud 'joms

khyung drag rtsalagyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las rkyen kyis bskul tshe dngos gnyen du dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin ma cha'iming gis bgyi pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sabom la/btsasdo: rgya 'dre bkar ba ni ce rgya 'dre ya ma mgo dgu bya ba dang gyur+ya tsan+t+ra'i bstan shadas 'dogs mkhan dngaḥ smon log re ba nag po'i tshogs bcas rnamasaḥ sngon gyi dam bca' bzang po rjes dran nasaḥ lan chags glud gtor 'phrul nor 'di khyer laḥ rgya sog rang gnas phyogs su phyir dengs shigaḥ bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid mi 'gogs par rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shigaḥ sabosnyisne gats+tsha 'di yang dgosagal do gal bcas nusaldan rol ba' rdo rjesasoḥ sarba ma la/
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥdrags sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i bskul ba khams gsum g.yo byed zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

ga rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeX rna lathobazhes gawa drag me ltar 'bar ba'i sku rab 'jigs sran po khros pa'i gar sde brgyad gdug pa 'thar mdzad pa'i dmar nag me phreng la phyag 'tshalaḥmangon spyod lasakyi gtor ma bshams bden brdar 'gugasabastim byin gyis brlabs sha ri khrag ga rgya mtshor dmigs rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis lta ba'i gdang bskyed rngams shugs skyongs rol mo' sgra bcas gnad bskul niḥhūṃ bh+yoḥchosadabyingasadabusamatha' bral ba'i pho brang nas che ba'i stobs rdzogs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan bdud dpung zil gnon rngams brjid khros pa'i sku pad+ma drag po dmar nag me yi phreng rta zhal khyung gdong gza' klu zil gnon zhal theg dgu mtshon pa'i dbu dgu rngams zhal 'khrugasaḥzhal gdangs ljags 'dril gad rgyang 'brug ltar sgrogs bco brgyad phyag gis gdug pa 'dul ba'i mtshonaḥrab tu gdengs shing bdud bgegs thar bar mdzad dur khrod dpal chas sku yi rgyan du 'chang rngams spyod dag lnga'i 'byang po zil gyis gnonaḥska smrad dbal phur me yi tshwa tsha 'phro rgyal bsen dam sri'i sming khrag lngad par byed rtsa srin zhal nas 'brag lngir gog stong 'khyagasaḥ

badz+ra: dregs pa can gyi snying sgog 'dar bar byed pho nya lce spyang mang po rlung ltar 'tshubasaX zhing bcu tshang rnams bsgral 'dren brlag par byedaḥ rab 'bar me rlung dud sprin 'tshubs ma yis gnyis snang mtshan ma gtor bsregs stongs par byedaḥ phag khyung sdig seng sprul pa rdul ltar 'tshubs dug gsum 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo kha lo bsgyuraḥmi bzad dus me 'bar ba'i he ru gaḥ bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes la rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnamasaX mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzodaX hū trī rngams brjed 'jigs rung rak+ka srin po'i yulaX thod pa'i sku mkhar bdud bzhi bsnol steng nasaḥche ba'i stobs rdzogs srin rgyal thod phreng rtsal khros pa'i rnam 'gyur mngon spyod la bzhengs tshe 'bum phrag dbu yi 'khor ba kha lo bsgyuraḥ dmar zlum spyan rnams sdang mig glog ltar 'byugaḥ kun rmongs ma rig 'khrul pa sangs bar byed zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigasaḥ rā tra gsum gyi sha khrag srog dbugs sdud ༷ dmar ser

ral pa 'khyil zlum gzings pa yisaḥ srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'thar bar byed 'bum phrag phyag zung ye shes mtshon cha bsnamaḥrgyu drug 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo chos skur spyoraḥ zhabs rnams gyad kyi 'dor thabs tshur du bsgrad skye ba rnam bzhi'i g.yul ngo bzlog par byedaX pha rol phyin rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan drug dngaḥzad skam dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i dgongs klong spyor rngams spyod gdon 'dul stag gi shams thabs dngaḥ bya ba lhun grub dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phuraḥ'ad 'bar ste rlung nyi zla'i gzi byin 'byugasaX dug gsum 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo stongs par byed bde ba'i sku mchog rig kyi bdag po nyid bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhedasaX brgyan pa'i mchad gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes la rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnams mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzod hū hrīḥ'ajam dpal sku mchog rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nasaX bgegs tshogs dam sri 'thar byed he ru ga ya masmo ka khro rgyal rngams pa'i skaX dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i rtags su 'changaḥro sa rab ral gris bdud bgegs

gtsasdo: dum bur gtubaḥ rgyud sde'i gleg bam chos kyi snying khu yisaX 'jigs tshogs lta ba dman rnams 'thar bar byedaḥ zhabs gnyis bsgrad pas 'chi bdud pho mo gnonaX me rlung 'tshubs ma phyogs rnams kun tu g.yoḥ ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo stongs par byed sku mchog bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor yang bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaX brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes laḥ rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnamasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzodaḥ hūṃ trī0 dbang chen gsung mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas pad ma drag po rta zhal bshad pa'i skuḥ dur khrod chas brgyad rus pa'i rgyan drug sprasaḥ phyag g.yas thod dbyug g.yon pas sbrul zhags bsdamasaḥ chags sdang las byung rgyal bsen 'thar bar byedaḥ zhabs bsgrad bdud bzhi zil gnon me klong 'gying gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs rngams zhal hi ya sgogasaḥ ma rig rā tra'i dpung tshogs sma phab byedaḥ bde ba chen po pad+ma dbang gi skuX bskul lo mngon sprod drag po'i las la bzhengasaX brgyan pa'i mchod gtor

brngan ston 'di bzhes la rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnamasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzod hūṃ hrī mi g.yo thugs mchog rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nasaḥ chos kyi dbang phyug gsang bdag gtum po mthing rgyud lnga gnas 'dren rdo rje rtse lnga dang gdon bgegs 'byung po tshar gcod sdig mdzub gzir dur khrod rusargyan me klong gzi brjed 'bar rgyal bsen pho mo spyi chings gdan la bzhengs sde brgyad 'dul ba'i khro gtum rngams zhal gzigasaḥ rab 'bar me klong ye shes 'od skur shar thugs mchog bde ba chen po'i ye shes sku bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes la rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnamasaḥ mngon spyod drag posatshar gcod brin las mdzodaḥ / hrīḥ yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga dkar ser dmar mthing ljang gri gug thod khrag g.yas g.yon phyag rgya 'chang rus pa'i rgyan drag dar dpyangs gzigs shams mdzesaḥ 'od lnga'i kong na gar stabs phyed 'gying rolaḥ

—'di: haḥrizhe0 saḥbade ba'i glu dbyangs sgrogs0 thabs mchog rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgyes par byedaḥ shes rab dbyings yum phag mo mched lnga yangaḥ bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes la rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnamasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzod hūṃ hrīḥ phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nasaḥ khro bo'i rgyal po yaka me dbal niX sku mdog mthing nag char sprin 'khrigs pa'i zhalaḥ phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje nam mkhar phyar g.yon pa'iphur pa dam sri'i snying la gziraX zhabs bsgrad gyad kyis dam sri pho mo gnon dur khrod chas rdzogs me dpung 1nga na 'bying snang stong gnyis med mngon spyod drag po'i skuX bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes la rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnams mngon spod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzod ྅ hriX rngams brjed 'jigs su rung ba'i sku mchog niḥ ye shes khyung chen me yi phung po canaḥ

rlung gi gshog pa sdeb cing klu rigs zaX nyi zla'i spyan 'khyil bar snang go skabs 'gyed gnam lcags zhun ma'i rwa dang mchu sder bsgradaḥ kibhe king kring kring hring hring rngams glu sgrogs sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyi snying rtsa 'daraḥ mjug mar rgyal mo gdong mo las la 'gyedaḥ g.yas g.yon gshog sdeb than ltas mtha' dag bzlogaḥ 'jigs byed rngams zhal khro rgyal ga ru traX bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaX brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes laX rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnamasaḥ mngon spyod drag posatshar gcod phrin las mdzod hūṃ hrī tshad med rnam bzhi 'gro 'dul pho brang nas dus mtshan dmar mo bhan+ta thabs la stobs me yi 'od zer phyogs bcu kun tu 'khyilaX dus sbyor sngon mo'i tsit+ta thabs la stobs ral pa bsigs shing rlung nag 'tshubs dbus 'gring chags spyor smu nag ba su thabs la stobasaḥ dug spin kong nas kha ṭaṃ phrag la bkalaḥshugs sbol ser nag klad khrag yab la stobs sgrin dkar 17nga nas lcags phur bdud la gzir kun kyang gcer bu mi lcags g.yang

ga6/sdo: gzhi klubasaX nu pad rgyas shing khrag dang 'o rgyun 'bebasaX bzhad pa ha he bde stong gsang spyod skyongasaḥ rang 'dres pho nya sa ya dung phyur 'gyed bdud dang dam sri'i snying la thog ltar 'bebasaḥ rab 'jigs rngams pa'i sha za mched bzhi poX bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes la rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnams mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzodaḥ ( hrīḥ phrin lasarnam bzhis gang 'dul mdzad thabs mkhasaḥ shar sgor dbang phyug nag po khro gtum rngamasaX lcags kyi ral pa nam mkha'i dbyings su gzingasaX thogs ser 'khrugs pas sde brgyad gdug pa 'dulaḥ phyag g.yas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong phyaraḥ mtha' yi dmag bzlog sha khrag dum bur gtubaḥ g.yon pas me rlung zhags pa glog ltar 'byug rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhen sdomaḥling ga bsnying zhing 'bar ba'i rlangs pa 'phyoḥ phas rgol rbod gtong rig sngags brlag par byedaX nad rlangs dug rlang 'tshubs ma rab tu g.yo rgyal bsen dam sri 'bog

brgyal thul thul byed thod phreng sbrul chun dar dpyangs rgyan du 'ching rngams khros gdon 'dul skal ldan bu la byams gyad kyi 'dor stabs dam sri'i snying la gziraḥ'ajigs byed dus me 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor las bskul pho mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaX brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes laḥ rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnams mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzod hū hrī lho phyogs sgo srung yi dwags 'byung po'i gtso gshin rje tshe bdag rngams khros gtum pa'i zhal phyag g.yas dgra sta ngar mas dgra bgegs gtubs g.yon pas 'gas pas dam nyams 'ching zhing sdomaḥ mi lngags go bgos sbrul dang thod phreng brgyanaḥ liṅga bsgrang zhing ma he glang rgod chibasaḥ 'jigs byed 'khor brgyad shan pa las la 'gyed skye 'gro'i sgog la dbang za ya man+taḥ 'dul byed khro bolog tri pa la yaḥ bskul lo mngon sgod drag po'i las la bzhengs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes la rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo tshomasaḥ mngon spod drag posatshar gcod

—8rdo: phrin las mdzod hūṃ hrīX nub kyi sgo srung badz+ra gī la yaX sku mdog mthing nag be+eḍūr lhun po'i sku dmar ser ral brjes thod skam dbu la brgyanaḥ phyag mtshan sgrol phur 'dril zhing dam sri 'dul sku smad lcags phur me yi tsha tsha 'phroX ma rung rgyal bsen pho mo'i snying la gzir rus rgyan mgo phreng sbrul gyi do shal 'phyang 'thar byed gzhon nu rngams pa'i gad rgyang canaḥ sbyor sgrol drag po'i las myur dam tshig canaḥ bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes laḥ rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnams mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzodaḥ hūṃ hrī byang phyogs sgo srung bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku sedha ḍak+ki mthing nag nam mkha'i zhalaḥ g.yu ral sprugs shing seng chung slog ltar 'khyug phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod gri gug phyar g.yon pas 'khor ba rgyan rol thod khrag stsobs gzig sham rus rgyan dar dpyangs me long masaḥ zhabs gnyis gar bsgrar kha ṭaṃ mchan du brjenaḥ seng skad smogs pas mkha' 'gro las la 'gyedaḥ gang 'dul mdzad

pas rnam 'phrul sa ya 'bumaX gzhan snang zil gnon mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul maḥ bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor brngan ston 'di bzhes laX rgyal bsen bdud bgegs dgra gdon pho mo rnams mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod phrin las mdzodaX bdag ni nges pa don gyi rnal 'byor bas las su lha sgrub mgon du dkon mchog brten gos su sgrub khang gyon la rnal 'byor sgomaḥ 'gro ba'i don du theg chen byang sems bskyedaX don gnyis rgya mtsho lhur len byed pa la bar chad dgra dang bgegs kyis ma ster bsaX 'di la kun mkhyen mgon pos gzigs su gsol drag po dmar nag me 'phreng las la bskulaḥ chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho dmag la sbran sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs la za kha gtadaḥ thamasacad mthul rtsal nus stobs ma g.yel b.raḥ dgra bgegs gnyis la bka' yi chad pas chodaX mngon spyod drag po'i tha tshig ma g.yel bar dus la bab po badz+ra sa ma māḥ zhes brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs dmod bor bh+yo gdab ral pa sprugs mngon spyod rngams pa'i las rnams bya des ni dgra dpung rdul brlag

— /sdo: 'gyur the tshom med dos mamā rgya rgyargya ye maḥrgyal ba kun gyis ye shes skuḥ o rgyan pad+ma thod 'phreng gi zab mdzod ngan lam sprul par gtadaḥ dusakyi snyigs mar gyur pa na ra tsa bse mo' cho rol 'byugs de tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskul bde klong rak+ta'i mtsho gling nas dge bsnyen sha mis gnyer bka' 'gyed de tshe rten 'brel thabs kyis bskul bdo don gsal sgo nang nas sad rten 'brel snang gzugs phyi nas mngon 'di yang sa gter ya mtshan can shog skyar bkrol bas rkyen snang sel byin rlabs nus pa bsam mi khyab no nus lag tu longs dang gsalaḥs mabe+e rgya rgyargya gu phya gter rgya gtadargya sbas rgya brgya gsang rgya 3 zhesapa 'di' lung zinadharma kumuta da ཿkun bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho 'gyur med mo gusargya mcho rnamasakyisabaskul ba dang grogasarat+na sarasanan gyis bskul ro rabadag 'dra dbang chen dgyesapa'i rdo rje'amapad+ma 'gro mgan gling pas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par pha ba pa'i yi ge pa nis marnya bha tra ma rte'i bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba maṅgaye/

bam/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥdrag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i mtshon dbal bzhugs soḥbasko: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥm pa shā bdag nyid drag po'i mdun mkha' me rlung dbusaXgu ru smug nag rdo rje lcags sdig 'dzinaḥstag shams rgyan drug khro sgeg brjid nyams ldan sku las mtshon thun sdig khyung phag seng stag bu yug bzhin 'tshubs 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed bdud bgegs dgra 'joms ye shes mtshon rtse rnams rno ngar nus ldan gzas po brlag byed kyisaḥgadug rtsub dregs pa'i phyag mtshan nyid du gyur rtsa sngags mthar dri ra tsa rgyal po'i tsit+ta zungs sogs nus ngar no ba' dpal bskyed do trig shwa trig shwaḥsogs 'jig med pha lam nyid du bsgyur bdud pra ma ni mā ra ya rbad nanaḥkha la dza ma ni rbad nan rwa dza dun ling shag rbad nanaḥmo 'dre khrag shag dza rbad nanaḥnā ga brang tshal rlug rbad nan be the tri tri hūṃ rbad nan tri bo tsig tsig shag rbad nan0 shig shig dum dum rbad nanaḥtshal pa tshal pa rbad nanaḥkhro khro bh+yo bh+yo rbad nanaX rlug rlug

rbad nanaX tir tir rbad nan tshal tshal rbad nanaḥ / trigahrī khro bh+yo dza bod rbadaḥ dbang bskur bdud 'joms gzi byin bskyed des ni no la ngar bams bgo dgra dpung rdul brlag mtho du 'gyuraḥs ma mā ye gas rab tu gnas gang la gzas pa po rnams thal ba rdul du brlag pa'i rno nus gzi byin stobs dang ldan parathun zor rnams ye shes lha'i phyag cha gdug rtsub 'dre yi mtshon rnon 'jig rten mi yi lag cha gyur cig yin su pra tiṣ+ṭhabadz+ra ye swā hā me tog 'thor ye ma dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod 'dod phyil rak+ta bde ba'i klong rin chen snyi po'i phyul ba las bgo skal dge bsnyen sha mas sprad smon lam dag pas gsang rgya grol 'dod sred can la a tham rgyaḥ thugasasras bu yi dpal du shog samashā rgya rgyargya gu byu brda:miḥlha zhesapa 'di'ang lung zin sngags skyes gsum dngabla ma bī mtha bskul ngor ba ldan khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba ma tha

ga6sdo: tri ra tsa rgyal po'i tsit+ta zungs zungs ma sha rbad rbadaX ra tsa 'khu na dum bur shig shig 'da' na ra tsa'i cit+ta phyung phyung ldog na ra tsa'i cit+ta gtubs gtubaḥ ya tri yaḥ ya tri yaḥ ma tri yaḥ ma tri yaX ma zhung tri yaḥm zhung tri ya bram dzaḥ ra tsa bse mo na ga be thes hur hūṃ dza dam sri spun dgu'i srog la khung rbadaḥ 'byung po pho mo'i kha 'dar 'dar ༷ srog 'dar 'dar0 snying 'dar 'daraḥ zhe sdang snying la rngams rngams 'dod chags khrag la rbud zud gti mug sha la rbad rbad nga rgyal rus la ram̐ ram̐ phrag dog dbugs la ye yeḥ ra tsa bse mo klu gnyan dmu gtod be the9 3 bo trig shag rak+ta skyugs shig kai li kai la ya rbad bh+yo bzlogaX zhes so/'di'anganus ldan pas so/sabo ma la/

—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye0 1411rto ga mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis zhing bcu bsgral bar bya ba la las rim nyer bdun sgo nas bstan dang ngo gser skyems 'bul ba ni blang swā bha was sbyangs la stong pa'i ngang las gser skyems gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon lnga yi phung por gyur 37 ādz+nyā has hrīX kye skyabs kyimachog gyur bla ma dkon mchog gsumaX lhag pa'i lha mchog yi dam rgya mtsho dang bde stong spros bral 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro yisaḥ gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrubasaḥ rta khyung drag po pad+ma gsung gi zhalaX bdud dpung zil gnon go cha lha lnga dang sprul pa sdig khyung phag seng khro tshogs bcasaḥ gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrubasaḥ gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur ye shes khro bo bcu dus mtshan ma bzhi dbang phyug gshin rje gshedaḥ bdud 'dul ki la byad 'joms seng gdong mas gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrubasaḥ thabs chen dpa' bo mgon po pho rgyud dang rgyugs ging skyes mchog myur ging ra hu laḥ shes rab dpa' mo sngags srung mo rgyud kyisaḥ

brten: gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrubasaX rgyal ba'i bstan dang sems can yongs la gsheḥ khyad par bdag gi bka' 'khur dam la 'grasaḥ tshe srog mdangs la za ba'i dam sri rnamasaX ri bo'i rtse dang rgya mtsho'i gting la sogs gang na gnas kyang rang dbang med par khug las kyi liṅga 'di la gnyis med bstimasaX mngon spyod drag pos myur sgrol 'phrin las mdzodaX bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ gnyis pa mkhyen gzu niḥ / bh+yo mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcasaḥ ye shes gzigs pas gzu dang dpang la dgongasaḥ dgongs pa dbyings las rnam rol mtha' yas paX yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang la dgongasaḥchos nyid mkha' la thugs rje shugs kyis 'groḥ 'bum phrag ḍāk+kis gzu dang dpang la dgongs legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i bka' srung dregs pas gzu dang dpang la dgongasaḥ'abyung lnga dbang bsgyur dam rtags 'byur med 'chang dkar phyogs skyongs rnams gzu dang dpang la dgongasaḥ bdag ni zol med don gyi rnal 'byor pas nges pa'i don

rtogs rig pa'i nyi ma mjalaḥmagon du rtsa gsum grogs por chos skyong sgrubaḥ las su bstan srung gos su sgrub khang gyon rtogs pa'i bdag bcom thugs rjes gzhan snang btulaḥ kun rdzob sgyu ma'i mtshang rig las 'bras zhib don dam yestong chos sku mngon du 'gyur 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa skyongs ba laḥ dgra dang bgegs kyis rtags tu 'tshe zhing gcod legs sgrub ma ster nyes pa sna dgu bslangaḥnd dang mu ge 'khrugs rtsod sna tshogs 'gyed mtha' mi dbus khrid chos kyi khrims sna phab mdo sngags bstan pa'i bcud yal chom rkun byas dge bcu'i khrims bshig sdig la gzengs pa bstod dam las nyams 'gal 'das shing ngan tshul can zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bdud bgegs dpung rnams mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis myur du sgrolaḥ dkon pa'i tshe sgog phrol la rdul du rlog0 rnam shasda dbyengs bsdus sha khrag gzan du bsgyuraḥ bsgral zhing 'dren pa'i las la ma g.yel zhigaḥ dpa' skyems gtor ma phud mchod 'di bzhes laX rnal 'byor bka' bzhin sgrub mdzodas mawāḥ gsum pa e bskyed bya ba niḥphaṭaḥmadun du ma

—8rdo: rig 'khrul ba bcom pa'i bsgral gzhi e las gru gsum las kyi btson khang nag po kha dog la mthil yangs baḥ zhe sdang gi me 'bar baḥ phrag dog gi rlung nag 'tshubs pa0 nga rgyal gyi brag ri rnyil zhing 'dod chags 'khrugs pa'i khrag mtsho khol baḥ gti mug gi mun nag 'thibs shingaX srog gcod kyi pho nya rngams pa bcad gtub pas mtshon cha ngar ba sha zan gyi khyi nag ngu baḥ lce spyang gi glal ba ngoms shingaX sod sod dang chod chod kyi sgra sgrogs pa phyi lcags ri nag po la drag po'i rtsang phur dmar nag gi drwa ba bris pa nang bla 'dzin gyi drwa ba bkod cing mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs paḥ nad mtshon dug gi yo lang 'khrugs pa'i mtha' bskor du nye 'khor lhag pa bcu drug gis bskor ba gcig tu bskyed doḥ de yi nang duz-i tri yongs su gyur pa las bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba nyams pa bdun la gtogs paX sku dgra rnam lngar gyur pa'i dgra bo rnams kyi ru pa mdog sngo la mdangs nyams pa skya ba haṃ pa rid pa nyam thag dbugs dang bral la khad 'dar phri li li byed pa kha ngu zhing mig shi mig lag pa mya ngan kyi phyag rgya byed cing

rkang lag lcags gzer gyis theb pa bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag cing ngu skad tsi ri ri 'don zhing snying rje'i gnas su 'dug pa gcig tu gsal la0de yi snying gar sa bon dṛḥtri gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas liṅga la yang yang bstim mo yang bdag mdun gyi sku yi cha thams cad nas pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril bu mtshon cha thog pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bcing ba lngas bcing nas brub khung nang gi gzugs rten la yang yang bstim mo bzhi pa 'gugs 'dren ni na mo dkon mchog rtsa gsum sku gsum brgyud ldan rig 'dzan rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dngaḥkhrag 'thung pad+ma drag po rta khyung zil gnon rtsal gyi bka' bden pa dngaḥsku mchog 'jam dpal gsung gsang rta mgrin thugs mchog phyag rdor yon tan mkha' 'gro sde lnga phrin las yakru me dbal rtsal gyi bka' bden pa dngaḥbasrung ba 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal khro bcu yab yum dus mtshan ma bzhi rnams kyi bden

—8rdo: pa dang dbang phyug nag po lcags kyi ral pa can dngaḥ las gshin tshe bdag nag po bdud 'dul gī la yaḥ drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi bka' bden pa dngaḥ bden gnyis basmu ba med pa'i bden stobs kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rgyal bsen klu gnyan sde brgyad ma rung ba dang dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad rang dbang med par khra kyi li li nag rga ra ra byis chung khras ded pa ltar lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du gzugs ling ga 'di la khug cigaḥ bstims cigaX badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ4tha ho skabs dang bstun la mang du brjod lnga pa 'gugs las bya ba niḥ hū bh+yoḥ dbang drag pad+ma thod phreng rngams pa'i skuX 'jigs med dus me 'bar ba'i pho nya yis dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad kyi bla sgog rnam shes liṅga 'di la khugaḥ 31 badz+ra.adru sha dzaḥhṝjiḥ.a mu ga mā ra ya ad+ma sha dza dzaḥ drug pa 'chang zhing gzer ba ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ dbang drag pad+ma thod 'phreng rngams pa'i sku 'jigs byed dus me 'bar ba'i pho nya yis dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po
