badz+ra: thim pasaḥ spyi dpal khro rgyal las kyi rdo rje khams gsum rol rtsed du gyur ba'i dpa' bor dmigs la ma badz+ra kro ta rā dza hūṃ ha he phaṭaḥ brgya brjod ba pa gras marga gso ba ni bdag nyid pad ma drag po'i phyag mthil nyi zla kha sbyor ba'i bar duḥ rigs lnga yab yum kyi bde ba'i rol rtsed las byung ba'i sras phur zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngams pa sku smad mgar gyi so mal nas byung ba lta bu'i dmar zang nge ba pho nya lce spyang glog ltar 'tshubs pa sbyor sgrol gyi las la gtum zhing rngams pa gcig tu bskyedaḥde yang phyar ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar ba btab pas mod la stong gsum brlag nus paX 'bar 'khrugs g.yo byed kyi rgyal po las rang 'dra'i rdul zer 'phros pas snod bcud brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te phur pa la thim pas mthu stobs dpal yon gzi brjed dang ldan par bskyed la ma pad ma ta krita ki li ki la hūṃ phaṭaḥbargya rtsa brjod r+sā geg dgra bgeg gso ba ni skad cig gis shing bcu tshang ba'i dgra sde tshe dang sgog la 'tshe ba'i bdud dpung nyams pa can thams cad me long gi byad chu bzhin liṅga

la sib sib bstims pas gzas pa po dgra bgegs kun 'dus su dmigs laḥ du tra a mu ka sarba 'dus 'dus e sa0 brgya rtsa brjod bcu gnyis bla lu ni phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying khar btab pas bla yi ngo bo n+niX dang triḥyig dkar po'i rnam par hril gyis dril nas sras mchog sgrol phur ngang mer gyis song bar bsam la0 dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi bla sha re ma ti 'grims 'grims sha ma ru ti thul thulaX phyog myog yed yed sha ma ru ti khug khugaḥling myogaḥ ling shagaḥ ling hūṃḥtsa mun ṭi dza hūṃ be ho d+dhi0 nyibla 'ub 'ub 'dus 'dusaḥ brgya gsum tshe lung ni yang phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying khar btab pas tshe bsod nams kyi ngo bo zloḥdang tritshosag ljang gu'i rnam par phur rtser 'ub kyis bsdus teḥ khong seng nas ma dag pa'i dri ma nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo nas byung ste bdag he ru ga'i thugs gar thim pas tshe bsod nams rab tu rgyas par bsam laḥ utshe sbyoḥ dṛXgayu hūṃ triḥgayu tshe spyoḥ pukhye a yum na g.yu tshe spyoḥ bcu bzhi khrus lung ni yang phur pa'i rtse mo nas 'od zer dkar po'i rgyan byung teḥ gzas pa po'i

/'di: lus ngag yid kyi nyes sgrib thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa ltar sangs kyis dag nas dri med 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam laḥ rlojig wa ci sarba pa paṃd han shirnyi ku ruye swā hāḥ bco lnga gnas lugs ni slar yang phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying khar btab pas rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med pa dngul chus thig pa ltar 'ub kyis drangs ste khong seng nas nyon shes kyi dri ma sbyangasaḥ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo nas thon ste 'og min gyi dbyings na mnga' mdzad pa'i khrag 'thung he ru ga'i thugs gar thim te 'khrul mi shes pa'i dbyings su sangs rgyas sku dbyings brgyud nas yum mkhar bab pad+mo nas bde ba'i sku yi gsang lam brgyud te rtsib log g.yas nas thon te sras bde ba chen por sad par bsam laḥ a phaṭa a phaṭaḥ a phaṭa snyigs ma'i phung khams la ye shes kyi rang mdangs mtshon thun gyi char dbab pas gzas pa po'i kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i mtshang stong par bsam moḥ r+sā drug thun dbab ni rdo rje gdeng la hūṃ bh+yoḥ gzhom bral rig stong bla ma drag po'i skuX che ba'i stobs rdzogs 'khor 'das spri dpal mchog srid na

'dran bral dpal chen he ru ga'i sku las gnam lcags rdo rje'i mtshon char 'bebasaḥ dam nyams rgyal bsen klu gnyan srog la rbad dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po'i phung khams skye mched la rbad rbad bsabadun yi thun gdab laḥ( bh+yoḥ gzhes bral rig stong bla ma drag po'i sku che ba'i stobs rdzogs 'khor 'das spyi dpal mchog srid na 'gran bral dpal chen he ru ga'i sku las nyung thun ser rlung 'tshubs ltar 'phrosaḥ dam nyams rgyal bsen klu gnyan srog la rbad dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po'i phung khams skye mched la rbad rbad bco brgyad pa dug thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ gzhes bral rig stong bla ma drag po'i sku che ba'i stobs rdzogs 'khor 'das spyi dpal mchog srid na 'gran bral dpal chen he ru ga'i sku las sna tshogs ha las ngad zer 'phroḥ dam nyams rgyal bsen klu gnyan srog la rbadaḥ dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po'i phung khams skye mched la rbad rbad ༅ dgu khrag thun gdab la hūṃ bh+yoḥ gzhom bral rig stong bla ma drag po'i sku che ba'i stobs rdzogs 'khor 'das spyi dpal mchogaḥ srid na 'gran bral dpal chen he ru ga'i sku las 'phros

/'di: pa'i rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'tshubs dam nyams rgyal bsen klu gnyan sgog la rbad dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po'i phung khams skye mched la rbad rbad nyi shu sdig pa'i thun dbab laḥ hū bh+yoḥ gzhom bral rig stong bla ma drag po'i skuX che ba'i stobs rdzogs 'khor 'das spyi dpal mchog srid na 'gran bral dpal chen he ru ga'i sku las lcags sdig nag po glog ltar 'khyug dam nyams rgyal bsen klu gnyan sgog la rbad dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po'i phung khams skye mched la rbad rbad nyer gcig phag gi thun gdab laḥhū bh+yoḥ gzhom bral rig stong bla ma drag po'i sku che ba'i stobs rdzogs 'khor 'das spyi dpal mchog srid na 'gran bral dpal chen he ru ga'i sku las dur phag nag po sprin ltar 'khrigasaX dam nyams rgyal bsen klu gnyan srog la rbadaḥ dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po'i phung khams skye mched la rbad rbad nyer gnyis khyung gi thun gdab la ( bh+yoX gargom bral rig stong bla ma drag po'i ma che ba'i stobs rdzogs 'khor 'das smi dpal mchog0 srid na 'gran bral dpal chen he ru ga'i0 sgo las khyang dmar me phreng dzul lngar

'khrugasaḥ dam nyams rgyal bsen klu gnyan sgog la rbad dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po'i phung khams skye mched la rbad rbad nyer gsum mtshon cha sna tshogs gdab la / bh+yoḥ gzhom bral rig stong bla ma drag po'i sku che ba'i stobs rdzogs 'khor 'das spyi dpal mchogaḥ srid na 'gran bral dpal chen he ru ga'i sku las 'phros pas mda' dang spu gri mdung kha ṭ+wāṃ mtshe gtor tho ba dgra stu dngaḥ sa chu me rlung rdo thun char ltar 'bebasaḥ dam nyams rgyal bsen klu gnyan sgog la rbad dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po'i phung khams skye mched la rbad rbad nyer bzhi ral gri gdab laḥ/ bh+yoX stong gsum srog la dbang bsgyur bdud 'joms rtsalaḥ nyi zla'i 'od ldan spyan mig glog ltar 'byug ༷ rngams brjid dbal gyis dug gsum 'khrul 'khor 'dul phyag mtshan gdug pa 'joms pas mtshon chen ni khro chen mi g.yo'i rang bzhin sbu gri yisaḥ dam nyams dgra bgegs dug gsum 'byung po yiX phung khams dum bur gtub la rdzul du rlog dgra bgegs 'byung po'i sha khrag rus gsum phung khams ste mched dum bur gtub dum bur gtabasaḥ sarba rāhra ma ra ya rbad

gtsasdo: sodaḥ nyer lnga gtso du bayo ba niḥ hū bh+yoḥ stong gsum rnam dag yum gyi mkha' dbyings su thabs chen rig pa ye shes gtun bu yis dgra bgegs dug gsum phung khams skye mched brdungaḥ sha khrag rus gsum rdul phran dmar nyog gyuraX dgra bgegs ta tha ya ta thā yaste maphye mardul phranardul phran khrol bu khrol butaig gtunamā raya rbad sod sodaḥ nye drug bstabs pa niḥ / bh+yoḥ gdug pa tshar gcod pad+ma drag po yi rngams brjid gtum drag zhal gyi hom khong du dug gsum gdon bsgral phung khams skye mched bstabasaḥ mnyam nyid bde ba chen por 'dren rol nasaḥ chos nyid spros mtha' bral bar byang chub te sku gsum mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprugs shog rtsa sngagasamathar ma hāme sa kha hiḥ ma ha rak+ta ma ha tsit+ta ma haleg ro tsa na ma nyakeng ni ri ti ma hāb suta khahūṃ rdo rje'i skyogs gis lha la bstabs sbyor sgrol dgong pas 'khrul ba bshigs don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa dang mngon spyod grub par the tshom medaḥs mag nyer bdun gtor ma maza bsgyur ni hūṃ hūṃ gtor ma dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru gaX steng phyogs me ri dgu 'khrigs klong du dpag gzu dpang shan

'byed tshul bzhugs rngams 'khrugs te0 gtor ma las kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs gyur0 gibs cho sgra 'ur chems nga ro yiḥ drag po'i mtshon gdengs me rlung thog zer 'byugs phag sdig khyung seng stag mo'i 'du 'phro bcas yid brnag nyams pa'i steng du dmag dpung chos za rngams yus kyi mthu rtsal mi chung bar gang la gzas po'i dgra dpung ma lus paḥpho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas wāngs ming tsam med par thal ba rdul du rlog oṃ hūṃtrig khro bh+yo ma ṇim raṇa bh+yo mā radu na bh+yoḥ rasmo rak+ka bh+yoḥ khi ya rak+ka bh+yoḥ dṛ ka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'isnyeng la bh+yoḥ bse mo'i srog la bh+yoX sa bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yoḥ sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi sgog la bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yo tshe bla sgog gsum tshal ba dum bur rbad rbad0 sod cib sgrol shogaḥ mā raya bzlog bh+yo gtor ma dgra bo'i phyogs su rdeb bye phung dbyugs pas bsdun pa bzhinaḥ thal pa rdul du brlag par 'gyur the tshom med dosamag rgya rgyargya ye rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal thugs gsang zab gter man ngag mthil rgyal ba mchog dbyangasal bstsal ba dus kyi snyigs ma'i mar gsham du ngan lam sprul ba'i skye bu yis

—81: rak+ta gsung gi mtsho gling nas dge bsnyen sha mi brda' mdzod gnyeraḥḍazhi rnams kyi glu yis bskulaḥdapa' bo rang gi g.yul rkyen 'joms ra tsa bse mo'i thog snying 'dar don gnyis lhun grub the tshom med sam shā rgya rgya rgya gter rgyagatad rgya sbas yo ba rgya gsang rgyagu rgya brda thimalhaces pa 'di'ang lung zinasgorma'i mtshan can dang kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas gnyis kyisabaskul ngor bdag 'dra rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rje 'gro 'dul dbang phyugagling pas dag par phab pas grogs rat+na sar re smon bskang bsargyun gyur cigaḥsarba ma la/ga6sdo: khrugasathung ni na moḥmachog gsum spyi gzugs pad ma drag po yis lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin bden pa'i mthus gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs kyi tshogs rang dbang med par liṅga 'di la khug grangasabasogs go 'di yang nye bar mkho phyir saldan pas spel ba mar+sha la/
'am: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥdrag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i rngams bzlog bdud 'dul 'bar ma bzhugs so

—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad ma ka ra ye 'gos tsā/ste—117 rngams bajid dus me 'bar ba'i sku bdud dpung zil gnon he ru ga sde brgyad drags pa 'thar mdzad pa'i dmar nag me 'phreng la phyag 'tshalamangon spyod ga po'i brtul zhugs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral bzlog las byed tshe gtor gagong ru tra'i phung po la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad chos 'byung e dgra bgegs srog gi gdan du bya de steng dmar gtor gru gang ba rta khyung drag po'i gdong zhal bcas dkar rgyan me ri 'jil zum can rtsang mtshe dug nyung khrag gisabargyan de rgyab sha za'i gtor ma bzhi phyi rim dregs pa sde bzhi dang sdig seng phag khyung bzhi yang bkod phran gtor nyi shu rtsa gcig dang gshed bsgyur gtor ma rtsang ldan bzhi rtsang gi drwa ba mig mang ras rtse la 'dab chagasakhrag gisabyugs rtsa ba sha zan rak+ta sbyar ba su ta yis gtor thag bya zhing gi bla bre thog phubasadang ri dar sha sna snying gis brgyan de nyid bzlog sgrub da la byamangon spyod phrin las 'grub par ra sam ཿrgya rgya rgya de nas sman dang rak+ta sbreng nya bo'i sha khrag ston mor 'gyed dpa' shugs rngams pa brtul zhugs bskyed rol mo sna tshogs sgra sder bzhinaḥlha gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis hūṃ smoḥchos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nas 'jigs byed rngams brjid me yi phreng ba canaXkhyang zhal rngams pas ma rig kun gzhi

—'di: sangs rta gdong bshad pas rnam shes sde brgyad 'dulaX drag po'i zhal gyis 'dod khams mtshan ma sgrol zhal dgu rngams pas theg pa rim dgu spro 'jigs tshogs lta dman 'khrul ba kha lo bsgyur rtsa bdun spyan gyis snang srid sa ler gsalaḥ ma rig gnyis snangadri ma bsal bar byed zhal rnams gdeng pas 'khor 'das mnyam par rol glog dmar ljags bskyang bde stong rol rtsed bsgyuraX mche bzhi gtsigs pas 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'gyedaX smar smin me 'bar ma rig 'khrul 'khor bsregs rta khyung drags pos glu dbyangs 'byug ltar sgrogs pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon 'bogs cing brgyal dmar ser ral pa srid pa'i rtse ru 'khyilaX khams gsum rol rtsed bde ba chen por sbyoraḥ g.yas phyag dang pos gnam lcags phur pa gzir zhing bcu tshang ba'i don snying lkog mar 'byinaX gnyis pa brdung byed tho chen mkha' la phyaraX rngams byed ma rigagadon tshogs 'thar bar byed gsum pas gsang ba'i rnge'u chung snyan 'gyur sgogasaḥ dpa' bo ḍak+ki ma tshogs las la bskul bzhi pa gnam lcags rdo rje rtsa lnga gdengasaX

rgyal bsen gdug pa'i snying khrag lhud par byed lnga pa gsang ba'i gri gug mkha' la phyar nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i skye rgyun gcod par byedaḥ drug pa shes rab mtshon chen ral gri 'dzinaḥ bdag rtog 'khrul ba'i dra ba chos skur gcodaḥ bdun pa spul rigs lnga yi ske nas bsdam mdze grum klu gnyan nad rnams stong par byedaḥ brgyad pa phag nag mgo dgu las la 'gyed sa bdag gtod kyi gdug sems sma phab byed g.yon phyag dang pos sdig mdzub thugs gar brten sde brgyad 'byung po skye med ar la gtad gnyis pas mun sel nyi ma zla ba bsnamasaḥ mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gdul bya'i yul la 'gyed gsum pas dngul dkar dril bu gsung snyan sgrogs chos can mtshan ma chos nyid 'khor lor stonaḥ bzhi pas lha klu gdon gyi tsit+ta 'dzin dregs tshogs sde brgyad sngangs shing 'dar bar byedaḥ lnga pa bde skyong bhan+ta rak+tas bkang gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma mnyam nyid rolaX drug pa ye shes me dpung phyogs bcur spro nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi rgud pa bsregs bdun pas gza' klu rgyal bsen spyi chings bsdam sdang zhen

gtsasdo: rmongs pa'i 'khrul 'khor stong par byed brgyad pas lcags sdig mgo dgu pho nyar spro bdud btsan rgyal ze'u snying khrag lhud par byed tha gnyis bzlog pa'i phyag rgya thal mo sdeb phyogs bcu'i ma rig g.yo 'khrugs bzlog par byed khyung chen rngams pa'i gas ga pa g.yas g.yon gzengasaX rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan thogs med las la myuraḥ dri ma mi zhim dpag tshad rgyang grags 'phroḥ 'byung po gdon bgegs brgyal 'bog myos par byed0 sdig khyung phag seng khro chung sprul pa 'gyed dug lnga'i rang gzugs gdon gyi snying khrag rolaḥ kun rtog gnas dag mgo phreng brgyad cu dngaḥ phar phyin drug rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan drug sprasaḥ bya ba mthar phyin dar dpyangs ljang sngon dang gti mug rgyan shar sbrul gyi phyag gdub mdzad 'dod chags dbyings rol zhing gi sked chings dang nga rgyal mtshan ma rnam dag glang ko klubasaḥ ste 'og chu srin zhal nas 'brug stong ldiraḥganyis snang du tra'i glad pa 'gem par byedaḥ sku smad dbal phur me yi tsha tsha 'phroḥ rgyal bsen dam sri'i snying khrag lhud par byedaḥ dbal zur g.yas nas sgrol byed pho nya 'gyed

zhe sdang 'khrul ba'i gdon tshogs 'dul bar byed dbal zur g.yon nas lce spyang rlung ltar 'tshubasaḥ chags pa'i myos rnams bde ba chen por sbyoraX rgyab zur ye shes mtshon cha ser ltar 'bebs spyor sgrol dgongs pas 'khor ba chos skur 'drenaḥ logs gsum las ni me rlung dug zer 'phro srid pa'i dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor stong par byed ngo bo chos sku spros dang bral ba'i rtagasaḥ gdos por ma grub skye med nam mkha'i ngang rang bzhin 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i rtags 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs sku'i yon tan ldan thugs rje ma 'dres gdul bya'i yul la gzigs khro gtum gdul dka' 'dul ba'i stobs su bzhengs gang 'dul rgyan dang cha lugs ma 'dres shar bde ba chen po'i sku gsung thugs la bstod 'thar byed gzhon nu ye shes las la bzhengasaḥ 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlogaX bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub bzlog 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ zhe sdang las byung pho gdon gnod pa bzlog 'dod chags

—8rdo: las byung mo gdon g.yo zhakhrugs bzlogaḥ gti mug ma rig rmongs pa'i log sbyor bzlog gza' klu the'u rang yongs kyi zhabrul 'khor bzlog mdze rigs bco brgyad ltog pa skrang lo bzlogaḥ ma zhu dug rigs yam nad sna tshogs bzlogaḥ sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol bzlog nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi yo lang bzlog rgya 'dre me chen 'byung po rlung chen bzlogaḥ du ru ka yi 'tshubs mas gzengs pa bzlogaX lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlogaḥ rta phyugs nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlogaḥgacan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlogaḥ mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlogaX byad ma'i dmod sbyor rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bzlog thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaḥ dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag gyur cigaḥ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlog za 'dre phung sri ming gi lhag mar mdzodaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i brin las ma g.yel b.raḥ myur du drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod cigaḥ hūṃ bh+yo shar phyogs gtum drag rol ba'i dur khrod nas dus mtshan zhe sdang 'dul ba'i sha za moX rgyu

ba chos nyid nam mkha'i dbyings la rgyu0 'jug pa skal ldan gdul bya'i dpal du ngomasaḥ mdzad pa bde ba'i zhal bzang bu la stsolaḥ rdzu 'phrul rlabs kyis khams gsum yud tsam bskoraX me rlung dug sprin phyogs bcur kun du 'phyoḥ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rak+ta byugs pa'i nyams rngams pa'i nga ro sha za gdong 'khrugs maX bde bar sbyor ba'i bhan+ta dmar gyis bkangaḥ nam mkhar btegs bzhin skan sgra bcas te gzhibaX bde klong nu pad rgyas shing rak+ta 'bebasaḥ bstan bshigs rū tra khrag nad dbal gyis 'jigasaX ral pa bsigs pa'i mkha' 'gro las la 'gyed nga ro sgrogs pas srid gsum g.yo 'gul byedaX bu la byams shing dug gsum gdon la gsheḥ khro gtum dus mtshan sku gsung thugs la bstodaX ye shes dbyings las ma g.yos de bzhin nyidaX rnam 'phrul ma 'gags sgyu 'phrul las la bzhengasaX 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlog ༷ bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub bzlogaX 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan g.yo 'khrugs bzlog zhe sdang las byung pho

btsasdo gdon gnod pa bzlogaX 'dod chags las byung mo gdon g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaX gti mug ma rig rmongs pa'i log sbyor bzlogaḥ gza' klu the'u rang yongs kyi 'khrul 'khor bzlogaḥ mdze rigs bco brgyad lhog pa skrang lo bzlogaX ma zhu dug rigs yam nad sna tshogs bzlogaḥ sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol bzlog nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi yo lang bzlogaḥ rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon bzlogaX du ru ka yi 'tshubs mas gzengs pa bzlogaḥ lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlog rta phyugs nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlogaX gcan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlog0 mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog byad ma'i dmod sbyor rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bzlogaḥ thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaḥ dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag gyur cig gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlogaḥ za 'dre phung sri ming gi lhag mar mdzodaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i brin las ma g.yel bar myur du drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod cig hūṃ bh+yoX lto phyogs 'jigs byed rol ba'i dur khrod nas

dus sbyor bde 1nga thugs ni mkha' ltar yangasaḥ nam mkha'i mdog can mi 'gyur ye shes sku dmar ser ral pa nam mkha'i dbyings su 'khyil thod rgyan rdo rje rma bya'i mdangs 'od bkraḥ rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la rnam par mdzesaX spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug cing 'khyil rngams pa'i nga ro nam mkha'i mthongs su sgrogasaḥ gza' klu dregs pa zil gyis gnon par byed rdo rje gad mo ha ha phem ya sgrogasaX rū tra'i snying 'byin ma tshogs las la 'byed me rlung dug sprin 'khyil zhing phyogs su 'phyoḥ dug gsum 'byung po 'thar zhing brlag par byed ma rung ru tra'i tsit+ta stobs shing rolaX mtshan bcas rtog pa chos nyid dbyings su spyoraḥ rtog med zhing lngags sku yi rgyan du klubs chags 'khrul gdon gyi kha lo bsgyur bar byedaḥ zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur bde ba'i rol rtsed bsgyuraX ma rig 'gro drug 'khrul ba dong nas sprugasaḥ stong pa'i rnam 'gyur dus sbyor sngon mor bstodaḥ gang 'dul mdzad pa'i thabs la rnam par bzhengs 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laX steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlog0 bar gdon

—'di: dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub bzlogaX 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan g.yo 'khrugs bzlog zhe sdang las byung pho gdon gnod pa bzlog 'dod chags las byung mo gdon g.yo 'khrugs bzlog gti mug ma rig rmongs pa'i log sbyor bzlog gza' klu the'u rang yongs kyi 'khrul 'khor bzlogaX mdze rigs bco brgyad lhog pa skrang lo bzlog ma zhu dug rigs yam nad sna tshogs bzlog sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol bzlog nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi yo lang bzlogaḥ rgya 'dre me zhen 'byung po rlung zhon bzlog du ru ka yi 'tshubs mas gzengs pa bzlog lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlog rta phyugs nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlogaḥ gcan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlogaX mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlogaḥ byad ma'i dmod sbyor rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bzlog thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaḥdagra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag gyur cig gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlog za 'dre phung sri ming gi lhag mar mdzod mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las ma

g.yel bar myur du drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod cig hū bh+yoX nub phyogs pad ma rol ba'i dur khrod nasaX chags sbyor bde ba'i sku can me ltar 'baraḥ gzigs pa ri rab zom nas phyogs bcur gzigs 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gting nas klu gnyan 'dul rngams pa'i ngar sgrogs mche ba gangs ltar gcigs lta stangs stangs stabs rdzu 'phrul thog ltar 'bebasaḥ gang yang thog med nam mkha'i bya ma rta smug nag srin po khros pa'i gzi mdangs canaḥ ral pa'i gseb nas ma tshogs las la 'gyedaḥ brda dang bshud pa glu dang thal sgrags dgyesaX glal ba 'khrugs shing du tra'i sha la zaḥ sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i las la rtag tu rgyugasaḥ ba su 'dren zhing hab sgra bcas te rol dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ phrag la bkal legs nyes shan 'byed 'o khrag rgyun 'dzag maḥ rkang ba ya cig srid pa'i rtse nas gnonaḥ gtor byed rkang pas 'khor ba gting nas stongasaḥ me rlung 'byugs pas srid pa'i dra ba gtor bde ba'i 'dzum zhal yab la stobs par byedaḥ 'od gsal mnyam nyid chags sbor klong la bstodaḥ gang 'dul mdzad pa'i phrin las las

bskye/da: la bzhengs 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub bzlogaḥ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ zhe sdang las byung pho gdon gnod pa bzlog0 'dod chags las byung mo gdon g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ gti mug ma rig rmongs pa'i log sbyor bzlogaX gza' klu ze'u rang yongs kyi 'khrul 'khor bzlog mdze rigs bco brgyad lhog pa skrang lo bzlogaX ma zhu dug rigs yam nad sna tshogs bzlog sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol bzlog nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi yo lang bzlog rgya 'dre me zhen 'byung po rlung zhen bzlog du ru ka yi 'tshubs mas gzengs pa bzlogaḥ lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlog rta phyugs nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlogaḥ gcan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlogaḥ mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog byad ma'i dmod sbyor rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bzlog thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaḥ dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag gyur

cigaX gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlog za 'dre phung sri ming gi lhag mar mdzod0 mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las ma g.yel b.raX myur du drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod cigaḥ / bh+yoḥ byang phyogs dga' mar rol ba'i dur khrod nasaḥ shugs sgrol chen mo mnyam pa'i zhal mnga' ba yang dag don la mos pa thabs kyis skyongasaḥ sku ni bde bar gshegs pa'i zhing la spro gsung ni'agagasamed ru lu tshangs dbyangs sgogs thugs ni byams brtse'i 'od zer gdul byar gzigasaX gang 'dul mdzad pa sbyor sgrol ma nges ston gsang ba'i snying po gsang sngags bstan la gdungaḥ kha na ma sgos grub mtha' dman la gsheḥ nyid bzhi'i gtso mo sha za ḍak+ki ma ༷ dga' ston 'du ba tshogs la nyul zhing spyodaḥ gtsang dang ste bar 'dzin la bka' chad gcodaḥ bang rtsal glog las mgyogs pa'i 'phrin las myur dgyes ston klad khrag bcud la 'dzum bcas rol ma rig tu tra'i

—8rdo: ral pa bsigs pas seng chung bu yug bzhin 'jigs lta zil gnon bde ba'i rol rtsed mdzad kun khyab shugs sgrol chen mor phyag 'tshal bstod 'phrin las mngon spyod las la da bzhengs shig 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlog bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub bzlogaḥ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan g.yo 'khrugs bzlog zhe sdang las byung pho gdon gnod pa bzlog 'dod chags las byung mo gdon g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥgati mug ma rig rmongs pa'i log sbyor bzlog gza' klu the'u rang yongs kyi zhabrul 'khor bzlogaḥ mdze rigs bco brgyad lhog pa sgrang lo bzlog ma zhu dug rigs yam nad sna tshogs bzlogaḥ sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol bzlog nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi yo lang bzlog rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon bzlog du ru ka yi 'tshubs mas gzengs pa bzlog lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlogaX rta phyugs nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlog gcan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlog mo rtsis rmi

lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog byad ma'i dmod sbyor rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bzlog thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaḥ dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag gyur cigaX gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlogaX za 'dre phung sri ming gi lhag mar mdzod mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las ma g.yel b.raḥ myur du drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod cigaX hū bh+yo mngon spyod las kyis gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'iX shar sgor dbang phyug lcags kyi ral pa can sku mdog mthing nag khro gtum rngams pa'i sku thog ser bu yug dgra bgegs gshed du 'phroX pho tshogs zel gnon mo tshogs las la 'gyedaX sde brgyad dregs pa kun gyi gtsug na spa che btsan 'gran zla srid na mtshungs dpe bral 'jigs med pha lam mtha' ma'i gshed du bzhengs phyag g.yas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong phyar du ru ka yi 'tshubs ma gtor bar byedaḥ g.yon pas me rlung zhags pa glog bzhin 'byug rgya 'dre 'byung po me rlang zhon pa 'ching ling ga basming zhing 'bar ba'i 'od chen 'khyagaḥ phas rgol rbod gtong rigs sngags bzlog par byed

ga6rdo: nad mug dug gi rlangs pa 'khyil zhing 'phyo ༷ rgyal bsen dam sri'abyung po 'bog brgyal byedaḥ thod phreng sbrul chen dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phuraX zhabs gnyis gyad gyis rū tra pho mo gnonaḥ 'jigs byed dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skuX khams gsum dbang phyug sku gsung thugs la bstodaḥ chos nyid dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nasaḥ 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub bzlogaḥ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ zhe sdang las byung pho gdon gnod pa bzlogaḥ 'dod chags las byung mo gdon g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ gti mug ma rig rmongs pa'i log sbyor bzlogaḥ gza' klu the'u rang yongs kyi 'khrul 'khor bzlogaḥ mdze rigs bco brgyad lhog pa skrang lo bzlogaḥ ma zhu dug rigs yam nad sna tshogs brdogaX sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol bzlog nad mug mtshon nasags dus kyi yo lang bzlog rgya 'dre me zhon 'byang po rlang shon bzlogaḥ du ru ka yi 'tshubs

mas gzengs pa bzlogaX lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlogaX rta phyugs nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlogaḥ gcan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlogaḥ mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlogaḥ byad ma'i dmod spyor rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bzlogaX thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaḥ dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag gyur cigaX gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlogaḥ za 'dre phung sri ming gi lhag mar mdzodaḥmangon spyod drag po'i phrin las ma g.yel b.raX myur du drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod cigaḥ hū bh+yo lto phyogs sgo srung 'byung po yi dwags gtso mi rta bam chen bsgol ba'i khri steng nasaḥ ga na rje tshe bdag 'char byed nag po'i skuḥmathing nag rngams brjed khro gtum 'bar ba'i gar zhal gdangs ljags 'gril rno dbal mche ba gtsig ha ha hū phaṭa gad rgyang 'brug ltar sgogs phyag g.yas dgra stu shes rab mtshon chen phyaraḥ nga bdag du tra'i gzugs phung dum bur gtub ༷phyag g.yon zhags pas dam nyams 'ching zhing sdamaḥ mi lngags ko bgos dug sbrul mgo phreng brgyanaḥ rdzu

srin bzlogaḥ rta phyugs nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlogaḥ gcan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlogaḥ mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog byad ma'i dmod spyor rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bzlogaḥ thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaḥ dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag gyur cigaḥ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlogaḥ za 'dre phung sri ming gi lhag mar mdzodaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i 'brin las ma g.yel b.raḥ myur du drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod cig hūṃ bh+yoḥ nub phyogs sgo srung mthing nag rngams pa'i skuḥ badz+ra gī la zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dmar ser ral brdzes thod skam dbu rgyan cingaX dar sna'i cod pan nyi zla'i snyan cha canaX rus pa'i rgyan dang dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur zhing glang g.yang gzhi sbrul do mgo phreng sprasaḥ phyag gnyis gnam lcags phur pa dgra la 'grilaḥ dam sri 'byung po'i snying khrag 'dren par byed sku smad lcags phur me yi tsha tsha 'phro rgyal bsen gdug pa'i sgog dbugs lcad par byedaḥ ye shes me yis ma rig 'khyal ba bsregs bskal ba'i dug rlang 'dzabs mas 'byang

—8rdo: po brgyal bdud 'dul kai la ya la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ mthing nag mi 'gyur e yi klong nas bzhengasaḥ 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub bzlogaḥ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ zhe sdang las byung pho gdon gnod pa bzlogaX 'dod chags las byung mo gdon g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ gte mug ma rig rmongs pa'i log sbyor bzlog gza' klu the'u rang yongs kyi 'khrul 'khor bzlogaḥ mje rigs bco brgyad ltog pa skrang lo bzlogaḥ ma zhu dug rigs yam nad sna tshogs bzlogaḥ sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol bzlog nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi yo lang bzlogaX rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon bzlogaX du ru ka yi 'tshubs mas gzengs pa bzlogaḥ lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin banogaḥ rta spugs nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlogaḥ gcan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlogaḥ mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog byad ma'i dmed sgor

rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bzlog thams cad ma lus sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaḥ dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag gyur cigaḥ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi steng du bzlog za 'dre phung sri ming gi lhag mar mdzodaX mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las ma g.yel b.raX myur du drag rtsal khyad chos ston mdzod cigaX hūṃ bh+yoḥ byang phyogs gīl sgrogs pa'i sgo srung ma bdud 'dul drag mo zil gnon seng ge'i gdong mazing nag gzi brjid bltar mi bzod pa'i sku phyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod gri gug phyaraḥsnang ba thabs kyi rang bzhin mkha' 'gro 'gyed g.yon pas 'khor ba rgyan rol thod khrag 'dzin shes rab stong pa don dam mkha' 'gro 'byed g.yu ral sprugs pas seng chung glog ltar 'khyugasaX ral pa'i gseb nas 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'phroḥ mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum brtenaX dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin spro skye med gla dbyangs ha ri ni sa sgogasaḥ rkang pa rdo rje'i gar bsgrar thogs med g.yoḥ gnyis snang ma rig 'khyal ba kha lo bskyaraḥ bdud bzhi'i g.yo 'byug zil gyis gnon par byed

—'di: ye shes me yis ma rig 'khrul 'khor bsregs bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku gsung thugs la bstodaḥ 'bar 'khrugs shes rab dbyings nas skur bzhengs nasaḥ'adod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ bar gdon dregs pa sde brgyad gdug rtsub bzlogaX 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan g.yo 'khrugs bzlog ༷ zhe sdang las byung pho gdon gnod pa bzlog 'dod chags las byung mo gdon g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ gti mug ma rig rmongs pa'i log sbyor bzlog gza' klu the'u rang yongs kyi 'brul 'khor bzlogaḥ mdze rigs bco brgyad lhog pa skrang lo bzlog ma zhu dug rigs yam nad sna tshogs bzlogaḥ sa nad me 'bar gnyan nad chu khol bzlogaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi yo lang bzlog rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon bzlog du ru ka yi 'tshubs mas gzengs pa bzlog lo nyes sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin bzlogaḥ rta spyags nor gyi god yams tha dag bzlogaḥ gcan zan gdug pa'i za kha g.yo ba bzlog mo rtsis rmi lam

'dir byon sku glud brngan mchod rgya chen bzhesaḥdabang mdzad sgra sgrogs dmar mo'i sun ma bzlogaḥbyang phyogs 'phrin las dpal 'bar klong yangs nasaXlas rab mthar phyin mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bumaX'adir byon sku glud brngan mchod rgya chen bzhes bdud 'dul rkarma mkha' 'gro'i sun ma bzlog hūXrdo rje'i mkha' la thogs med stobs kyis 'gro 'jigs tshogs zhi mdzad bde ba'i gar chen bsgyuraX rdo rje dpa' bo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhesaX rten 'brel las kyi sun ma dgra la bzlogaḥrin chen mkha' la thogs med bsgrod pa canaXtshe bsod rgyas mdzad gser gyi lhun po 'draḥrin chen dpa' bo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhesaḥrten 'brel las kyi sun ma dgra la bzlogaḥbade chen mkha' la thogs med myur 'jug pa'iḥkhams gsum dbang sdud ra ga'i zhal bzang ngoms pad+ma dpa' bo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhesaX rten 'brel las kyi sun ma dgra la bzlog las kyi mkha' dbyings bde stong sade ga pas bsgodaX dgra bgegs rdul brlag ismo'i gzi 'od 'byugaḥlas rab dpa' bo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes rten 'brel las

—8rdo: kyi sun ma dgra la bzlog hū: chos can chos nyid klong sbyor mkha' 'gro maX ye shes spyan gsal srid pa zil gnon pa'i ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i sun ma dbyings su bzlogaḥ dpa' bo sde bzhi'i sun ma zhi klong bzlogaḥ ging dang laṅga'i sun ma bde klong bzlogaḥ dam tshig sha za'i sun ma dgra la bzlog dregs pa'i sun ma dgra dang bgegs la bzlogaḥ gzhan yang sun ma'i cho 'phrul gang dang gang rten 'grel tsam du rtogs pas rab gzigs teX ka dag kun bzang dgongs klong rab bsal nas mi 'gyur bde chen rdo rje'i sku ru bsgrubaḥ 'khor 'das mnyam brdal thig le nyag gcig ngang spros pa'i chos rnams ma lus mnyam par bzhagaḥ ces brjod dgongs pa'i dpa' gdengs bskyed brtul zhugs rig pa 'i rang ro 'tsho rnam rtogs gdon rgod glegs ma rnyed sku gsum sa labyang chub po ཿsamayuḥrgya rgyargya gu brdanimaḥsnyi rmi 'gyur bde chen dbang gi klong zla gam pad+ma rak+ta'i mtsho chags med spros bral dkyil 'khor nas dge bsnyen sha ma'i sprad brda las kho bo bdud 'joms khyung drag pas shes rab mosa'adod skong phyir du dag par phab pa maṅga la/

'am:dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ'aphrin las yak+ka me dbal gyi bzlog pa bdud dpung rdul bzlog zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥbasko: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ 381smom thun3)/bdud dpung khrul ba'i waṃn las can khro rgyal stobasakhrusal phyag la'aḥgazung 'dzin bsgral ba'i dpa' ston bstabs mi mthun bzlog pa'i las lol niḥhūṃ bh+yoḥchos nyid mi 'gyur bde stong klong yangs nasaX rngams brjid bzod par dka' ba'i gzi mdangs can khro bo'i rgyal po ya me dbal ni sku mdog ljang nag khro gtum gar dgu'i 'byudaḥzhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs ha ha rgodaX drag po'i gad rgyang nam mkha'i 'brug bzhin sgrogs dur khrod dpal chas rngams pa'i rtags rgyan 'chang g.yas phyag tho bas rgyal bsen 'byung po 'thags g.yon pa'i me zhags gzir bas dgra gdon bsregasaḥzhabs gnyis gyad kyis dregs tshogs zil gnon mdzadaḥdamar ser ral gseb me rlang ser ba 'bebs ma rig las byang dgra 'dre bgegs tshogs gshob ska lus me dang thog zer 'phro 'du yisaXdwag gsum las

skyes zhabrul 'khor dbyings su gtor snang stong ma 'dres sgyu ma'i dal du sgomaḥ rtsa khams rang 'dra'i khro chung phyur bur gtams rnam rtog ma rig gdon la gshe ba'i sku mi g.yo chos sku'i 1nga las 'dir gshegs shigaḥ dpa' ston stobs kyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ drang sgong bden tshig lha yi bka' chad bzlogaḥ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyongs rbad sngags bzlog snang srid lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ngan pa bzlog ban bon kun rgyu phra min byad zor bzlog 'byung po the'u rang dri za'i gdug rtsub bzlog gza' dang sde brgyad gdug rtsub bsam sbyor bzlog ltas ngan sna dgu than bcu g.yo ba bzlog rta phyugs mi nor god yams 'gong 'dre bzlog dgra jag choms rkun gyod phur kha smras bzlogaḥ gri kha mtshon rtse smas ngo lang ba bzlogaḥ bdud khram shwa rdil rtsis la bab pa bzlog yid kyi gzugs can gdon gyis rgol ba bzlogaḥ mi 'dod phyogs kun sdang ba'i dgra la bzlogaX bkra mi shis kun gnod pa'i bgegs la bzlog nyer 'tshe thams cad za ba'i sri la bzlog thams cad rdul rlog rig pa ka dag klongaḥ mnyam nyid chos sku yangs pa'i dgongs

—8rdo: pa ru gzung dang 'dzin pa'i 'khrul rtog rang grol nasaḥdon dam mtha' bral 'bras bu mngon gyur shogaḥde ltar bzlog las byas yis dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jigs gajod 'che'i sbyor ba rang sar dengs sku gsum klong yangs mngon du 'gyur ze tshom med dos maya rgya rgyargyaḥgu phyabadonim thiḥdabang chen gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta 'jil klong nas dge bsnyen sha mis gos can gyis sprad pa'i bdo mdzod gsal ba'i skor bdud 'joms dpa' bo khyung drag pas shes rab cha nas re skong phyir ran chen shog skyar the ba pa yi dge ba'ibadud dpung zel garten shogaḥsarba maṅgaya/

ba6sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX dpal chen khro bcu'i bzlog pa dregs tshogs zil gnon bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mo gu pad+ma ka yeḥ casasprekhyoska14 gtor chung ling ro bstabs byas teḥgam rngams bskyed la 'di skad doḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i 1nga dkyil nasaḥ drag khyung rta yi dgongs par rtag gnas pa'iḥ dpal chen khro bo rol pa'i lha tshogs rnamasaX do nub bzlog bsgyur las la drag du bskulaḥ brgyan pa'i dpa' ston mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ ma rig bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma dbyings su bzlog shar phyogs dri za'i dmag dpung g.yo ba dngaḥ mdze dreg grum bu lhog pa skrang lo'i nadaḥ zhe sdang dgra 'dres rgol ba gang byung yangaX khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal ba'i bzlog lho phyogs gshin rje'i khram kha ston pa dngaX glo mtsher mkhal mchin gzer nad g.yo ba'i rkyenaḥ nga rgyal dgra 'dres rgol ba gang byang yang khro bo chen po ya masmo gas bzlog nub phyogs chu lha pho mo'i gnod sbor dngaḥ gegs 'bras srin dang ya ma mgo gzhung nadaḥ 'dod chags dgra 'dres rgol ba

gang byung yang khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal pos bzlog0 byang phyogs gnod sbyin tshogs kyi rgol ngan dngaX snying rlung rgyu gzer khrag bshal rims yams nad phrag dog dgra 'dres spyor rtsub gang byung yang khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bzlogaX shar lho me lha pho mo'i bsregs mnan dang tsha ba'i nad rigs bsam yas ji snyed sgo ma rig las byung dgra 'dresargol ngan rnams khro bo chen po dbyug sngon rgyal pos bzlog lho nub srin po'i tshogs kyi ngan gtong dang ma zhu dug rigs mkhris pa'i nad sna tshogs nyon mongs lasabyung dgra 'dres rgol ngan bcas khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon pos bzlogaḥ nub byang rlung lha'i tshogs kyis dug g.yos dngaX grang bsil las byung nad rigs sna tshogs pa gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i dgra 'dres rgol ngan kun khro bo chen po 'dod pa'i rgyal pos bzlogaḥ byang shar bgegs rigs pho mo'i g.yo 'khrugs dang bad gan 'du ba'i nad rnams ma lus paḥ a 'thas gdon bgegs 'byung bo'i nyer 'tshe kunaḥ khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal bas bzlogaḥ steng gdon gza' skar dregs pa'i gdug rtsub

ga'adi: dang brgyal gzer gas snying nad sbos skyal nadaḥ dug gsum lasaskyes dgra bgegs 'tshe ba sogs khro bo chen po hūṃ ka ra yis bzlogaḥ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan gnod sbyor dang bying rmug nag po sum sbrel rbod gtong nadaḥ tshe dang lam la rgol ba'i dgra bgegs rnams khro bo chen po stobs po che yis bzlog pho bdud rkyen snang za byed tshogs kyis bzlog mo gdon rgol ba gsod byed rnams kyis bzlogaX ma ning 'byung po sras tshogs rnams kyis bzlog mi dge'i rtog tshogs khro mo bcu yis bzlogaḥ bzlog nga /ra 'phrin las ma g.yel myur 'a spyob mdzodaḥ de ltar bzlog las bcol ba yis mngon spyod 'phrin lasalhun gyi grub bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyalaḥ the tshom med do rdo rjes bka' sam shā rgya rgya rgya gu ma3〉pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong dbang chen gsang ba'i mdzod khang las dge bsnyen sha mis sprad pa'i brda rten 'breladusabab shesarab char bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis so dge bas gdug pa tshar gcod shogaḥsarba ma lo

—'di: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las drag khros 'bar ba rtsal gyi rtsang bzlog zab mo bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mogu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ ga sgospre107 rak+ta dmar gyi phud springs teḥ gas rngams dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ (ཿshar phyogs mi 'gyur sra brtan dur khrod duḥ rtsang gi ngo bo rdo rje la ma steḥ rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon char sharaḥ zhe sdang las byung gdon tshogs rdul du rlog rdo rje'i rigs mchog bskang rdzas bla na med chos kun me long ye shes don rtogs nasaḥ dga' brod bdud kyi mtshan ma dbyings su bzlog lto phyogs lhun mnyam yangs pa'i dur khrod duḥrtsang gi ngo bo rin chen dun skyes te rnam pa phyag brnyan gdug pa'i mtshon rtser sharaḥ nga rgyal las byung dgra bgegs thal bar rlog ༷ yon tan rigs mchog bskang rdzas bla na medaḥ chos kun mnyam nyid ye shes don rtog nasaḥthog bcas bdud kyi mtshan ma dbyings su banogaḥ nub phyogs pad 'khyil ba'i dur khrod du rtsang gi ngo bo dbang mo 'bar gsags teḥ rnam pa me rlang phyag brnyan mtshon char

shar 'dod chags las byung dam sri rdul ltar rlog pad ma'i rigs mchog bskang rdzas bla na med chos kun sor rtog ye shes mngon gyur nasaḥ thog med bdud kyi rgol ba dbyings su bzlog byang phyogs gtum rngams 'jigs byed dur khrod nas rtsang gi ngo bo las rab kha kha'i gdong rnam pa gsod gcod phra men mtshon rnon shar phrag dog las byung 'byung po 'bog brgyal rlog 'phrin las rigs mchog bskang rdzas bla na med chos kun bya grub ye shes don mthong nas snyems byed bdud kyi 'khrul 'khor dbyings su bzlog stoḥ rtsang la gnas pa'i ma sring ging tshogs kyis dkyil 'khor mtha' skyongs lhag ma'i zhal chab bzhes sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog rnal 'byor bka' bzhin skyongs yar rtse 'bar bas gza' dang rgyu skar bzlog mar rtse bskyod pas sa bdag klu gnyan bzlogaX sked par mtshon 'khrugs sde brgyad dmag dpung bzlogaḥ g.yas na za byed 'phro bas dgra dpung bzlog g.yon tu gsod byed 'khyugs pas bgegs dpung bzlogaḥrdo rje la mas zhe sdang rgyal gdon bzlogaḥ rin chen dun mas nga rgyal mtha' dmag bzlogaḥ pad+ma

—8rdo: dbang phyug 'dod chags bse mo bzlog0 las rab kha khas phrag dog dam sri bzlogaḥ rang rang las rdul spros pa'i bdud bgegs bzlogaX rten 'brel bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams bzlogaḥ kun rtog stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs dpung bzlogaḥ rnam rtog mo rtsis rmi ltas ngan pa bzlog a 'thas sems kyis bdud bzhi bzos pa bzlogaX snyems byed ma rig rba 1nga 'thibs pa bzlogaḥ tha snyad mu bzhir bzung ba dbu mar bzlog0 phyi bdud gzung ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog nang bdud 'dzin pa ka dag dgongs klong bzlog gsang ba snang gsum chos zad chen por bzlogaḥ bzlog bsgyur dmod sbyor spros pa mtha' yas pa dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du bzlogaḥ ma chen bde klong bha ga mngon gyur nasaḥ gdod nas bde chen rdo rje'i sku thob 31gaX de ltar rtsang gyer byas pa yis rnam rtog gnyisosnang bdud tshogs 'dulaḥ sa lam bar chad 'phrang grol nas bde mchag rgyal ba'i sku thob poḥ sam shā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lhaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin shes rab phra ba'i cha nas bskul ba don dang ldan phyir bdag 'dra bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa'oḥsarba maṅga la/

gtsasdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i phyi nangasgo dbye zor bskul rim pa bzhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mogu ru pad+ma ka ra ye che rizag gser skyems phud springs sgo rtsang shab bden pa'i tha dzig bsgrags pa ni rkyeX dbus mtha' bral ba chos kyi dbyings nyid laḥ dkyil 'khor phyogs ris mtha' dbus mi dmigs kyang rten 'byung bslu med sgyu ma'i mos ngo sa sprul sku pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nyi shu rtsa bzhi dbyings nas nye bar phyogasaX dam tshig mkha' 'gro bzhi ni sgo mar shar legs nyes so srung sgrub pa'i drod spel zhing lhag ma'i zhal chab len zhing ci bgyis byed0 rlung las mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal rlabs po ches nyin dang mtshan mor rgyu ba'i nyu ma sngon nas gnyer dam blangs ba'i ma sring rnams bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥ las bzhi'i mdzad pas bdud bgegs tshar gcod cing mngon spyod drag po'i las la ma g.yel cigaḥ dzaX hūṃzaḥhoḥ pra we sha yaphaṭaḥ de nasaphyi yi sgo dbye ni gser skyems mchod cing 'di skad do hūṃ hriX sgrub pa chen po'i

phyi yi bcad rgya'i sgo rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rgyaḥ ye shes me chu rlung gi ra gur gtamaḥ dur khrod phra men dbang phyug chung mar bcas gter bdag las kyi byed po bu yug 'tshubs gzhom med bde chen rdo rje'i gur khang las tshad med thugs rje'i 'phrin las dus bab pasaX dbang phyug chen po'i sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon bgegs kyi g.yul ngo laḥ mngon spyod mdzad pa ston pas dus la bab dam tshig thugs rje'i sgo bzhi thabs kyis dbyed0 sgo phyes 'phrang sol brngan chen dgyes par bzhes rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i dpa' shugs bskyedaḥ lha klu gnyan gyis dmag bsdus go mtshon phyor dgra zin ma nor mkhyen pas gzigs mdzod la yo drang thig thob bka' yi chad pas gzir dgra bgegs ming tsam med pa'i 'phrin las mdzod srid pa hu yi phyag rgya bstan nyes pa kun sel sngags kyang brjod gtor lam phyes 11ra lam phyesaḥ yas lam phyes dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams ma sgo ra myur du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig de nas gtor ma zor bskul ni brtul zhugasabaskyed la rol mo bsgrogs hūṃ dza nga ni gang shar rang grol he

—8rdo: ru ga pad+ma drag khros rta khyung rngams pa'i sku snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi srog gi bdagaX 'jigs byed gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i gar che ba'i dbang phyug stobs kyi mnga' bdag mchogaḥ thogs med bsgyur ba'i las la mnga' brnyes pa'iḥ dpal gyi gtor chen mtshon cha'i rnam par bsgyur yung dkar khro bo'i phyag mda'i tsha tsha 'phro rak+ta khrag gi rba klong sha ra ra mtshe mda' dug gi tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugasaX rdo char drag po dpal gtor bu yug 'tshubs spu gri tho ba sdig nag thog ltar 'bebs rno ngar nus mthu stobs ldan dmag zor 'diḥ dam nyams dgra dpung rdul du brlag phyir bskulaḥ bar chad bgegs tshogs ming med gzhom phyir rbad mngon spyod 'phrin las drag po'i brtul zhugs la phyogs skyongs dregs pa yongs kyis dmag dpon mdzodaḥ lha klu gnyan gtod sa bdag dmag la chos drang sgong gza' bdud rgyal pos sna drongs laḥdamigs bya'i gdon bgegs dgra dpung thal bar rlogaX rta khyung drag po'i mthul rtsal ma g.yel zhigaḥ gu rba sta1 ta rā dza phro ka la ru pa sarba du ca hūṃphaṭa rngams yus bskyed la zor las

byaḥs ma māḥde nas che ba bskyed pa niḥ hūṃ hūṃ hū hū snang srid rngams brjed rnga yab dpal gyi ri rakru pho mo mang po che brjid 'jigasaḥ drag sngags hūṃ phaṭa rang sgra 'brug ltar ldiraḥyaku me dbal sdig nag mgo dgu pa klu gnyan srog 'dren pad+ma ga ru ṭaḥ sa bdag gtod 'dul seng chen spro bsdu 'gyed rgyal bsen 'thar mdzad stag mo mgo dgu pa dug gsum 'byung po zil gnon phag nag sogasaḥ rang 'dra'i pho nya nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa 'jigs rngams ltar mi bzod pa'i gzi brjid canaḥ bdag nyid pad+ma drag po'i sku las ni bye ba sa ya nyi rdul 'khrigs ltar 'phroḥ gar dmigs yul snang chos dbyings stong par bsreḥ ming gi lhag mar bsgyur ba'i stobs shugs ldanaḥ mtshon cha thog dang thun gyi zer dngar laḥ 'jig rten srid pa'i dregs can nye nus minaX dgra bgegs 'bog brgyal byed pa lta ci smosaḥ yid kyi lus can kun kyang gzhom byed naX lus sgog dngos po 'joms pa'i 'thar stobs ldan dregs pa kun 'dul rgyal po he ru ka gang shar rang grol pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsalaḥ bdud 'joms rdo rje rta khyung drag po rtsalaḥ ngang nyid ye sangs

—8rdo: rgyas pa'i dal du bzhengasaX khams gsum zil gnon stobs kyi rgyal por shar 'jigs tshogs gang gis mi brdzu rdo rjer dmigasaḥ ye shes rab 'bar lha yi nga rgyal 'dzinaX oṃ gu ru artsig nertsig tri hūṃ khro phaṭaḥ dgra dang bgegs kyi srog snying la thun yaḥ zor yaX mā ra ya rbadaḥ de ltar dpa' bskyed brtul zhugs skyongs dgra dpung rdul rlog bgegasatshogs 'joms nus pa byin rlabs bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥsamawāḥye maḥ rgyal kun thugs kyi yang bcud skor pad+ma rak+ta mtsho gling nas dge bsnyen sha ma'i gos can gyis dus tshigasabastan pa zhal re gro smon lam mthu btsan gtad rgya grol sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu mi bdo thimaḥlhaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang chosakyi bdag po 'gyur med rgya mchosathabs shes mtshon pa'i lha reg rin chen g.yu yi skyes bcas bskul ba dang bla ma yims yang bskul ba don dang ldan phyiras bo bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legasa'aphel/ sarba ma le/

—8rdo: rnal 'byor rgyal dbyangs gyer ba ni e ya be+eḍūr lhun po rdul gsum rkyon bral mkhar snang mtshan rū tra bcom pa'i dpa' bo ngaḥ thog bcas bdud kyis mi tshug gdeng gcig rnyed sor rtogs rdo rje rnon po klong nas mjal lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa'i bro zhig brdungaX gzung 'dzin rū tra'i dpung tshogs ar la gtadaḥ dbang sngon bu mos ster ba'i nor bu laḥ gsol btab re 'dod ka dag ro snyoms ngaḥ thogs med bdud kyis mi brdzu dpa' gdeng rnyed rang bab gnyug ma'i gsang sgo nang nas 'byed bsgom pa nyi ltar gsal ba'i gar zhig bsgyur tshogs yul snang yang mtshan 'dzin dbyings la boraḥ bde 'byung bu mo'i mkha' las rlabs g.yos te chos khams 'ja' shar ltar gzigs ro snyoms nga dga' bro bdud kyis mi rgol gdeng zhig rnyed yul med zang thal rtogs pa rang bab rgyas spyod pa la dor bde stong glu zhig len sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor rang snang rang zhig thalaX ka dag kong chen yangs pa'i mdzod lde mig ma brtsal rig pa gting gsal rnal 'byor ngaḥ lcems byed bdud kyis mi gos gdeng chen thobaḥ snang shes dri ma phra

rag ming med boraX'abras bu sku gsum rang chas rgyal sa 'dzin 'khor 'das ming med spros bral blo re bdeḥdabyings rig mnyam sbyor he ru ka dpal ngas yang dag don rtogs raka sum rim 'ching bdud kyi dpung las rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags yin thal 'byin 'phrin las mthu ldan rked phur brten0 nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal rtags yinaḥ'ajam dpal 'khor lo bzhi ldan rwa bsrung 'chang srid pa gsum las rgyal ba'i che rtags soḥrjes chags rta skad gsum rdzogs sngags zhwa rngams chags sogs rba klong skems pa'i rol rtags ngomasaḥdangos kun bdud rtsir rtogs pa'i me long bcingaḥ'akhor 'das 'ub chub rtogs pa'i brda' rtags lagasaXdregs tshogs dbang sdud li khri'i thig le 'dzin ma sring bran bkol bde stong rol rtags cheX'ajigs tshogs zil gnon ber klubs sag lhum mnabaḥskyes bu ging tshogs las la 'gyed rtags ngomasaḥdrag sngags dmod pa'i rol mo ngag nas gyeraXgasang chen bstan pa srung ba'i che rtags yinaḥkhams gsum dbang du bsgyur ba yab lags te pha cig sngags pa rgyal ba'i don

—8/sde: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro ta ra dza yaḥ —4rna byusgo drag lo zor las ngar ma 'di sdang ba'i dgra la brtsam pa'i tshe pho nya dregs pa sde brgyad la tha tshig bsgrags pa 'di skad doḥ dza bh+yoḥ stong pa nam mkhar rgyu ba'i bang rtsal canaḥ phyogs bcur nges med gnas bcas dregs pa'i tshogs legs nyes shan drang 'byed pa'i dpang la dgongasaX ngas ni mngon spyod drag las mi brtsam par dgra dang bgegs gyis rgol ba'i dbang med gtug dpal gyi thun zor gnam lcags thog mda' lasaḥ dbal ngar tsha zhing bzlog mi gtub pa 'diḥ thad du lang ba'i dgra la 'phen na'angaX zer dbal dregs pa'i sku la phog srid pasaḥ mtho ba zhabs bskum dma' rnams dbu brkungs 'tshalaḥ thad zur 'dug pa g.yas dang g.yon du byolaḥstong pa'i dbyings las zor lam dgra la stonaḥ bdud dmag rnams ni g.yas nas dgra la chos btsan gyi dmag rnams g.yon nas dgra la rgyugasaḥ klu gnyan gtod tshogs 'og nas dgra la chosaX king gang gza' rnams steng nas dgra la rgyugs drag po mngon sbyod las kyi sdong grogs mdzodaḥ yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo nyes pa canaḥ phu nu nye ba mtha'

badz+ra: rtsa skye rgyud bcas bran 'og chung ma nor phyugs longs spyod dkor mar michu dang 'phrad pa'i dpe bzhin du ming tsam med par thal ba rdul du rlog mda' gri thabs rgod khrag bshal sna tshogs thobaḥ ming gi lhag mar bsgyur ba'i dus la bab pad+ma drag 〈snas rta khyung he ru ga'i dam bsgrags gnad gzir gnyer bzhin las 'di mdzodaḥsnyed a ka nini gne+eX a bhi laX maṇ+ḍalaḥ ma hāye swārwa skyems mchodaḥzor mda' bzor la gtor lam phye ba niḥ( (ཿ thabs (degazhu 3 khams gsum dbang sdud lasaX shes rab mda' rnon srid pa rming bshig brten ༷ gnyis med lu gu rgyud du dgugs byas teḥ bstan pa 'jig byed dgra bgegs rnam gnyis gyi tshe dang srog gi 'ben la nges par bzoraḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho grogs la chos drag po'i zor lam nyams pa'i snying la rbad bdud dpung zil gnon rngams yus dgra la mdzod pad+malibaka' bzhin zor gyi lam phye'oḥ badz+ra a we sha ya tsitā shag shag dza rbadaḥ gtor lam phyes zor lam phyesaḥ yas lam phyesaX dgra bgegs gdug pa can de ma shor myur du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod

cig de nas che bskyed niḥ hū hūṃ hūḥ bdag nyid gang shar rang grol he ru ga'iX dbu la dus gsum sangs rgyas pad 'byung bzhugs phyag g.yas me khyung g.yon pa'i dug khyung lding pus mo g.yas g.yon lcags sdig phag nag 'phro sku yi gnas lngar go cha lha lnga bzhugs zer dug mtshon cha'i bu yug 'phro 'du 'gyed dbal ngar srid gsum dregs pa'i bzlog mi btubaḥ me rlung thog zer pho nya lce spyang 'tshubs sku la bkod pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs zhal gyi gdangs rngams bzod dka'i gzi mdang la mi dang mi min gang gis blta mi 'os dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'dud bzhin bka' la nyan thamasacad mngon spyod las la rab bzhengs nasaḥ dgra dang bgegs dpung rtsad gcod rdul rlag dmigs drag yo rtsa sngagasabazla bgo zor la byon de nas gser skyems khrul ba ni re ye khaṃ gser skyems gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur ma ā (ཿ kye rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma gzu dang dpang bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes la nyes med bdag la sngang ba'i dgra dang bgegs mngon smod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzodaX

ga6sdo: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho gzu dang dpang bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes la nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegs mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzod gnas gsum ma dang mkha' 'gro gzu dang dpangaX bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes la nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegasaX mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzod thabs mchog pho rgyud mgon po gzu dang dpang bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes la nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzod shes rab ma mo sngags bdag gzu dang dpangaX bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes laX nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzod rgyug ging gza' dang rgyu skar gzu dang dpang bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes la nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegs mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzod myur ging rdor legs dge bsnyen gzu dang dpang bdud rtsi chang

phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes laX nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzodaḥ rgyal bka' 'dzin pa thams cad gzu dang dpang bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes la nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzodaḥ stod smad bar gsum gzhi bdag gzu dang dpangaḥ bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes laḥ nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegasaX mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzod mgon skyobasasdong grogs byed rnams gzu dang dpang bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes laḥ nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzod yul 'di'i bdag po thams cad gzu dang dpangaX bdud rtsi chang phud brngan gtor 'di bzhes laḥ nyes med bdag la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegasaX mngon spyod drag pos ming med brlag par mdzod kye maḥ dus ngan snyigs ma lnga yi smag rum 'diraḥ yang dag chos la spyod pa'i rnal 'byor bdagaḥ las su lha

—8rdo: bsgrub mgon du dkon mchog brtenaḥgos su sgrub khang spyod pa 'gro don brtsam gnas lugs don rtogs rang byung ye shes mjal bar med snying po nyams su len mod kyangaḥbar chad dgra dang bgegs kyis ma ster bsaḥ'adi la mkhyen ldan rnams kyi gzigs par 'tshal rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi grogs su chosaḥmathu stobs thog 'dra'i nus ngar gzi mdangs phyungasaḥzhing bcu'i dgra la dpal rtsal khyad chos stonaXganod byed bgegs la rno ba'i dbal gyis thobaḥmangon spyod drag pos 'phrin las grub par mdzod thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yāXces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar 'bul lang bskyed ni rang gi mdun du me rlung dug mtshon nad yams 'thibs pa'i khrod du dri dang triḥyongs su gyur pa las bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs de nyams thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur te rkang lag lcags gzer gyis bsdam cing bu ga thams cad rnag khrag 'dzag pa gcer bu mgon skyabs dang bral de 'dar phri li li gnas par bsamaḥyang bdag gi sku yi cha thams cad nas spros pas pho nya lcags zhags sgogs dril thog pa

myur du rgyugasaḥ las kyi zhags pas 'chang la 'chor med mdzodaḥ sa rat+na pa sha hū hūṃ0 sdom las ni baṃX dam tshig thugs dam chen po'i dus la babaX drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon pho nya'i tshogasaḥ dgra la rbad do ma g.yel myur du rgyugasaḥ las kyi sgrogs gis sdom la 'chor med mdzodaX oṃ pad+ma spo ṭa baṃ baṃḥ myos las na rdo dam tshig thugs dam chen po'i dus la babaX drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon pho nya'i tshogs dgra la rbad do ma g.yel myur du rgyugasaḥ las kyi dril bu'i myos chug 'chor med mdzod oṃ garma garnye ho ho dbye las niḥ bh+yoḥ dam tshig thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon pho nya'i tshogasaX dgra la rbad do ma g.yel myur du rgyugasaḥ phra men gnyis kyis 'go ba'i lha dang dbye ma badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ dbab pa'i las niḥ nyu dam tshig thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon pho nya'i tshogs dgra la rbad do ma g.yel myur du rgyugs bstan dgra gar gnas myur khug gzugs la dbob phaṭa1ga we sha yachag aḥ de nas bsgral ba niḥ hā spyoḥ snyigs ma'i las rtsub skal dman na

—'di: rag rgyuḥ lta spyod phyin log bstan par rgyab 'gal ba'iḥ dam sri'i rigs can zhing bcu tshang ba 'diḥ lo zlar bzhag na gsang sngags sgron me sgrubaḥlas kyirnam smin zad mthar mi thug pas 'di la pad 'byung thugs rjes bzod nas samaḥ dus mthar skyes pa'i bu sdug 'dor ram ciX dam bca' zab mo dus la da bab pas yeshes dbyengs las gtum rngams 'jigs pa'i sku0 rta zhal khyung gdong bzhad pa'i gar ngoms laX rū tra 'thar byed dbal ngar gzi mdang gis dgra bo'i lus srog kha phrol rnam shes byung 'khrul b.limatshang stong rgyal ba'i sras su sporaX sbyor sgrol mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzodaX a guru artsigasartseg hrī4 1phaṭaḥ rgyal bsen klu gnyan dgra bgegs 'byung posarba mar ya.a phaṭa zhes bsre spar bya thun gdab ni rtsagasum rgyal ba zhi khro pho nya las mdzad thams cad drag po mngon spyod kyi las la bzhengs nas rngams pa'i nga ro sgogs shing 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha gzing te dpal gyis gtor zor brtegs nas sngang byed dgra dang dam nyams bgegs 'joms kyis bcol zhags chen por gnas

par mos la bzhud pa dang rkang gling gi sgra bskul te gnam lcagasardo rjesathun gdab pa niḥ hū bh+yo dregs pa'i sgog 'asgog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuḥ 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru ga sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyamaḥ dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyalaḥ snyeng rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyur sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'khyugs sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdon skye med dbyingasasu kun rdzob mtshang grol phyir 'jigs bral rdo rje gar gyi thun mtshon 'debs ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rje'i rab bsgral teḥ dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ o hūṃtrig khro bh+yoḥ ma ṇi ma raṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yo rasmo rak+ṣa bh+yo ting ya rak+ta smyo ka la bh+yo ra tsa'isnyeng la bh+yo bse mo'i sgog la bh+yo sabadag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bho sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi sgog la smo dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la smoḥ tshe bla sgog gsum tshal ba dum bur rbad rbad sod cigaḥ sgol zhig ma ra ya

gtsasdo: bzlog bh+yoḥ mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi sgog snying la phob dza phob dzaḥ yi thun gdab pa ni / bh+yo dregs pa'i sgog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i sku 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru gaX sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyamaḥ dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyalaḥ snying rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyur sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'byugasaḥ sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdon skye med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyir khro rgyal stobs 'dus nyung dkar thun mtshon 'debs ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgral teḥ dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreḥ rtsa sngags mthar ma hūṃ trig khro bh+yo ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yo ma ra du na bh+yoḥ rasmo rak+ta bh+yo ting ya rak+ta bh+yo shrī ka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'i snying la bh+yoḥ bse mo'i sgog la smoX sa bdag tsho gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la sboX sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi srog la smoḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la spyoḥ tshe bla

sgog gsum tshal ba dum bur rbad rbadaḥ sod cig sgrol zhigaḥ mar yabazlog bh+yoḥ mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi sgog snying la phob dza phob dza dug thun gdabs pa niḥ /bh+yoX dregasapa'i sgog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuḥ 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru ga sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyamaḥ dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyalaḥ snying rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyur sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'khyugs sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdonaḥ skye med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyiraḥ dug gi dug 'joms ha la'i thun mtshon 'debs ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgral teḥ dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreḥrtsa sngags mthar ma hūṃ trig khro bh+yoḥ ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na smo rasmo rak+ṣabh+yo ting ya rak+ṣa stso dṛ ka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'i snying la bh+yoḥ bse mo'i sgog la bh+yoḥ sa bdag gla gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yoḥ sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi

—8mi: srog la bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yoḥche bla srog gsum tshal ba dumabur rbad rbad sod cigaXsgol zhig ma ra ya bzlog bh+yoḥ mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi srog snying la phobadza phobadzaḥ khrag thun gdab pa naḥ/ bh+yoX dregs pa'i sgog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuX 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru ga sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyamaḥ dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyal snying rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyur sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'khyugs sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdonaḥ skye med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyiraX rten 'brel gnas stong ma mo'i khrag thun 'debasaḥ ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgral teḥ dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ.o hūṃtrig khro bh+yoḥm 〉ma raṇa stso ma ra dun stso rasmo rak+ṣa stso tings rak+ṣa bh+yoX hṝ ka la spyo ra tsa'i snying la stso bse mo'i srog la smo sa

bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yo sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi srog la bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yoḥ tshe bla srog gsum tshal ba dum bur rbad rbad sod cig sgrol zhig ma ra ya bzlog bh+yoḥ mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi sgog snying la phob dza phob dzaX phur thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yoḥdregs pa'i srog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuḥ 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru ga sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyamaḥ dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyal snying rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyur sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'khyugasaX sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'dzabs zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdon skye med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyiraḥ srid pa thal 'byin gnam lcags phur thun 'dabasaX ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgal teḥ dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsre rtsa sngags mthar slo hūṃtrig khro bh+yoḥ marte ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yoḥ raklo raku smo ting ya rak+ṣa

oṃ hūṃ trig khro bh+yoḥ ma ṇi ma ra ṇa spyo ma ra du na spyo rasmo rak+ta 1 ting ya rak+ta bh+yoḥhṝ ka la stso ra tsa'i snying la stso bsemo'i srog la spyo sa bdag klu gnyan dabhe gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yoḥ sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi srog la bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yoḥtshe bla srog gsum tshal ba dumabur rbad rbadaḥsod cigaX sgrol zhigaḥm ra ya bzlog bh+yoḥ mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi sgog snying la phobadza phobangoḥ gri thun gdab pa niḥ( bh+yo dregs palisrog 'asgog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuḥ 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru gaX sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyamaX dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyalaḥsnying dze+erngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyur sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'khyugasaḥ sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubasaḥ zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdonaḥ ste med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyir0 dzul byed sgo mtshon spa gri 'bar ba 'debs ma rig nasal 'khor snying rjes rab bsgal teḥ dbang drag dus me

gtsasdo: 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreX rtsa sngags mtharaḥ o hūṃtrig khro bh+yoḥ ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yoḥ raklo rak+ta bh+yo ting ya rak+ta bh+yoḥ hṝ ka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'i snying la bh+yo bse mo'i srog la bh+yoḥ sa bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yo sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi sgog la bh+yo dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yo tshe bla srog gsum tshal ba dum bur bod rbadaḥ sod cigaX sgrol zhigaḥ ma ra ya bzlog bh+yoḥ mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi sgog snying la phob dza phob dzaḥ mda' thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo: dregs pa'i srog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuḥ 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru ka sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyam dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyal snyeng rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyuraX sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'khyugs sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlang 'tshubs zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen kla gnyan gdon ste med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyir lus sems rgya gtor mda' yi thun

zor 'debs rtsa sngags mthar o hūṃ trig khro bh+yoX ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yoḥ rasmo rak+ta bh+yoX ting ya rak+ṣa bh+yoḥshrī ka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'i snying la bh+yoḥ bse mo'i sgog la bh+yoḥ sa bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yoḥ sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi srog la bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yoḥ tshe bla srog gsum tshal ba dum bur rbad rbad sod cig sgol zhig ma ra ya bzlog bh+yoḥ mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi srog snying la phob dza phob dzaḥ rdo thun gdab pa ni / bh+yoḥdregs pa'i srog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuḥ 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru ga sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyam0 dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyalaX snying rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyur sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'khyugs sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen tsho gnyan gdonaX ste med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyiraḥ thogs bcas brlag byed rdo yi mtshon chen 'debs ma rig

—8rdo: 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgral te dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ o hūṃ cig khro bh+yoX ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yoḥraklo rak+ta bh+yoḥting ya rak+ta stoḥ shrīka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'isnying la bh+yoḥ bse mo'i srog la bh+yoḥ sa bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yoX sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi srog la bh+yo dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yo tshe bla srog gsum tshal ba dum bur rbad rbadaḥ sod cigaḥ sgrol zhigaḥ ma ra ya bzlog bh+yo mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi srog snying la phob dza phob dzaḥ gtor thun gdab pa ni hūṃ bh+yoX dregs pa'i srog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuX 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru gaX sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyam dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyal snying rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyur sgrub sde'i smin gsags las byed gog lcar 'khyags sod sgob 'brag ldir bskal ba'i me rlang 'tshubasaX zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen kla gnyan gdon ste med dbyings su kun

gtsasdo: dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdon skyemed dbyengs su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyiraḥ ra tsa 'bog rgyal gnam lcags sdig thun 'debs ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgral teḥ dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥyo hūṃjig khro bh+yoḥm ṇim ra spyo mar dun bh+yo rasmorak+ta bh+yo tings rak+ta bh+yoX sho ka la spyo ra tsa'i snying la sbyo bsemo'i sgog la bh+yo sa bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yo sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi srog la bh+yoX dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yoḥtshe bla srog gsum tshal ba dumabur rbadabodaḥsod cigaḥsgrol zhigaḥm raya bzlogasbyoḥmatha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi sgog snying laphob dzaphob dza khyung thun gdab pa niḥ / bh+yoḥdregs palisgog 'dza ga 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuX 'khor 'das spyi dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru gaḥ sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyamaḥ dgod gshe rngams sgas dug gsum 'byung po brgyalaḥsnying dze+erngams zhes nasal pa kha lo bskyaraX sgrab sde'i sprin na gas las byed glog

ltar 'khyugs sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubasaḥ zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdon skye med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyir bse mo rlung 'byin khyung thun 'bar ba 'debs ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgral te dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsre rtsa sngagasamatharaḥ o hūṃ trig khro bh+yoḥ ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yoḥ rasmo rasnya bh+yoḥ ting ya rak+ta bh+yoḥ shrī ka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'i snying la bh+yoḥ bse mo'i srog la bh+yoḥ sa bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yoX sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi srog la bh+yo dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yoḥ tshe bla srog gsum tshal ba dum bur rbad rbad sod cig sgrol zhig ma ra ya bzlog bh+yo mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi srog snying la phob dza phob dzaḥ dur phag gi thun gdabs pa niḥ hū bh+yo dregs pa'i sgog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuX 'khor 'das spri dpal gzhir bzhengs he ru ga sgegs dpa' 'jigs rung che ba nam mkhar mnyam dgod gshe rngams smras dug gsum 'byung po brgyalaḥ snying rje rngams zhes

—8rdo: 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyuraX sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'byugs sod rgyob 'brug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdon skye med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyiraX klu gnyan gtod 'dul dur phag thun chen 'debs ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgral teḥ dbang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreḥ rtsa sngags mthar ka hūṃ trig khro spyo0 ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yoḥ rasmo rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ ting ya rak+ta bh+yo shrī ka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'i snying la bh+yoḥbase mo'i srog la sbyoX sa bdag klu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yo sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi sgog la bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yoḥ tshe bla srog gsum tshal ba dum bur rbad rbadaḥ sod cigaX sgrol zhigaḥ ma ra ya bzlog stoḥ mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi sgog snying la phob dza phob dzaḥ srid pa yo log byed pa'i gtor za thogs la hūṃ spyo dregs pa'i srog 'phrog 'jigs med rdo rje'i skuḥ 'khor 'das spri dpal gzhir bzhedas he ru ka sgegs dpa' 'jigs

rung che ba nam mkhar mnyamaX dgod gshe rngams sgras dug gsum 'byung po brgyal0 snying rje rngams zhes 'khrul pa kha lo bsgyuraḥ sgrub sde'i sprin 'khrugs las byed glog ltar 'byugs sod rgyob 'byug ldir bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubasaX zhing bcu'i dgra sde rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdonaḥ skye med dbyings su kun rdzob mtshang grol phyiraḥ srid pa yo log byed pa'i gtor chen po bskal pa 'jig byed me las dbal tsha zhing srid pa gtor byed rlung las ya mtshan 'phagasaḥ khams gsum stong byed chu las rba rlabs btsan grags can gnam lcags thog gis 'gran mi gtub gang gis mi bzlog rdo rje pha lam zor shan pa lag mar bla sgog tshe la rbad ma rig 'khrul 'khor snying rjes rab bsgral teḥdabang drag dus me 'bar ba'i dgongs par bsreX rtsa sngags mtharaḥ o hūṃ trig khro bh+yo ma ṇi ma ra ṇa bh+yoḥ ma ra du na bh+yoḥ rasmo rak+ta bh+yoḥ ting ya rak+ta bh+yoXshrī ka la bh+yoḥ ra tsa'i snying la bh+yoḥ bse mo'i sgog la bh+yoḥ sa bdag glu gnyan dang gtod kyi sha khrag rus pa la bh+yo sde brgyad nag phyogs kyi srog la bh+yo dgra bgegs gdug pa'i don snying la bh+yo0 tshe bla sgog

—'di: gsum tshal ba dumabur rbadabodaXsod cigaḥsgrol zhig ma raya bzlog bh+yoḥmatha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre srin po rgyal bsen klu gnyan rnams kyi sgog snying la phegab dza21ba dzaḥ gtor chen liṅga'i ste du sdebs dmod bcol bya dar chen sprugs rak+ta phyar rol mo rngams brdung su bya de na shog lang gi tshal bu rnams tsher me la sbar te gtad du bcol ba niḥ.a snang ba thabs mchog rgyal po ra hu la king gang thog ser bdag po mched 'khor bcasaḥ gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs shigaX bstan la sdang zhing bdag la rgol ba'i dgra lto zhal misang bstabs so 'chor med rolaḥ stong pa shes rab rang bzhin sha za moX mi srun 'jigs byed rngams gtsug kha mo cheḥ gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas da bzhengs shig bstan la sdang zhing bdag la rgol ba'i dgraḥ gtum mo'i zhal du bstabs so rkan sgras rol0 ma shor dgra sde phung thal brlag las mdzod thabs shes rtsal snang dregs pa sde brgyad po gnad nas bskul ma dbyings nas da bzhengs shigaḥ bstan la sdang zhing bdag la rgol ba'i dgra dregs pa'i dmag tshogs yongs kyi zas skal gtadaḥ lce

spyang sha la rub bzhin hab thob kyis ming med rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod rnal 'byor gtad bcol mi bzhes mi srid na bzung nas 'chor na dregs pa stobs rtsal chung lo zlar las yun 'khyang na zung re zad chos skyong bskal ba'i bar du sgrub na'angaḥ gdung ba'i yus tshig 'bod pa da res tsamaḥ mngag pa'i las de myur bar ma byas na mchod bskang don med bden pa chud re zos pad+ma'i bka' 'gal khyod cag dam re nyams las kyi rnam smin rdo rje'i dmyal bar mnar de ba'i gtad 'di longs la dam 'di bzhesaḥ ma 'khyang myur du bsad rtags thon par gyis mngon spyod drag snyan mthu yi che ba bskyed thugs dam ma g.yel drag po'i las 'di mdzod rak+ka ra hu la yak+ka kha mo che sarba zlo tri kha khā khā hi khā hiX gtor brdung bya zhing bstan ma brngan dam sri mnan zhing rgyal dbyangs len des ni mngon spyod lhun gyis grub mthu yi grags pa rgyas par 'gyuraḥsamagaḥye ma bde mchog gsang ba gsung gi gnas dbang mdzod pad+ma rak+ta'i mtsho dmar mo sgra sgrogasadagyes pa'i zhalaḥsngon dbang lasakyi bskul ba'i tshe sred len bral ba'i brda' mdzod ni rigs ldan bu yis dpal du shar gdul zhing dug gsum gdon 'dul phyir

ba mi: bzlog med dpal gyis zor las 'di rig pa 'dzin pa'i bgo skal ste zhing bcu sgrol ba'i mtho du shogaḥsam shāḥrgya rgya rgya gu brda' nim snyi cesapa 'di'ang lung zinasgormā ku mud gyis nan dan pho pos bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i mdzod khang las zhal bsas te dag par phab pa' ye ge pa ni lung ziname rdzisaming gisabagyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba masgo le/zhus so/
badz+rarnya dam chos thugs ba ter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag po dmar nag me phreng rtsal gyis dgyes bskang drag po me yi las gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i bdud bgegs tshar gcod zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

gtsardo na mogu ru pad+ma krota ra dza yaḥ shā spyo kun khyab bde chen klong yangs nas ye shes gzigs pa'i than las can gdul dka' bdud tshogs tshar gcod pa'i pad+ma drag por phyag bgyi'oḥm 'ong snyigs ma'i dus skabs suḥdug gsum gdon gyi kha dar tshe tshad med snying rjes 'dul mi btubade tshe mngon spyod lasa'adi zabs mag me dkyil steng sazhal shes ltar mdzes par bkod la byin rlabs ni lasachus sbyangs te 'di skad sgrogs rdor dril phyag rgya 'a4 bgo du 63yis/ཿthabs shes zung 'jug sgod kyi nang phyi nang gsang ba'i thugs mthun rdzasaḥzag med ye shes bdud rtsi spelaḥdabang chen drag khros dgyes ston gyuraḥ33/tshwaḥhril hūṃthaḥ tshuḥte pañtsa a phro ta/ 1'iḥ'i ཿ'ib 'i4 'i4 sareg bya go byin ma byade nas me thabs ra ba niḥ( hrīX miyi ngo bo chos kyi dbyingasaḥrang bzhin 'bar zhing bskyed pa steḥlas ni gzung 'dzin mtshan ma bsregs thabs de 'gro ba'i don du bskul ma hā kro ta snyisnan dz+wa la ram̐ de nas bskyod pa bskul ba ni hūṃ rlang gingo bo skye med mkha' rang bzhin mtshan 'dzin gtor ba'i thabs byed las 'gro ba'i don byed ltar bdag gzhan don du las la bskulaḥye

—8rdo: badz+ra tu ra phyo phyo khur sum̐ phyung phyung swā rta de nas thabs khung lha bskyed ni ma sā bha wa sogs sbyangs ye nas mi dmigs chos sku khyab brdal ngang rang bzhin yongs la khyab pa'i snying rje'i rtsalaX rol pa ma 'gags hūṃ dmar hrīḥmatshan shar lhun grub bzhengs bkod ma 'dres gsal bar byedaḥ 3 ཿuhūṃḥ badz+ra sa mā dhi.a0 hrīX yum chen lnga yi mkha' klong yangs pa sa hūṃḥ las dur khrod thod mkhar rab brjid pa brda' don rtags rdzogs shin tu rngams pa'i dal 'bar ba'i me dpung mtshon rtse ltar du 'byil gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin 'byung po bsregs par byed bskal ba'i dug rlung na bun bzhin du 'tshubasaX bar chad gdon bgegs 'khrul rtogs gtor bar byedaX 'bar zhing bskyod pa'i rlabs las chu byung ste gnyis snang bag chags dri ma chos skur sbyangs re yi khaṃ spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃḥ / hrīḥ pho brang 'bar ba e yi dkyil 'khor 1ngaḥganyis snang bdud bzhi spi chings bsnol ba'i khar rig pa'i ngo bo sa bon shar ba lasaX 'khor 'das dpal yon spos bsngas 'phrin las kyi mdun bsted drag po me yi phreng ba

can bskyed rim bdag mdun gang rung ltar du gsal spyan 'dren bzhugasagasol mchod pa phul ba'i rjesaḥsha khrag snying snas bon skyems mchad pa niḥ (ཿtrīḥ mtshan ldan bhan+ta mjes pa'i snod mchog nang dug gsum rnam dag sha sna snying sna khrag 'dod yon lnga yi 'od zer 'phro ba 'di drag khros bla ma'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul rtsa sngags mthar me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā re kha tīḥ nyer gcig brjod la dgyes pa bskang de nas rdzas 'dus 'bul ba ni 31ཿa hūX lcags sam drag po'i snod mchog yangs pa 13 dbang chen drag khros dgyes pa bskang ba'i rdzas thugs mthun bsregs rdzas sna tshogs 'bul gyis bzhes0 mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ rtsa sngags mthar bho dhi dzhai k+ta.a dṛta badz+ra sid+dha se bhaste puṣ+ṭa be gha be+e dza ye ghasma bā la a yu ṣe pra ti ha ta gha gha na rgyal bsen klu gnyan mā ra ya phaṭa brgya rtsa phul la dgyes pa bskangs bar skabs 'dod gsol gdab pa niḥ ho dbang chen drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lnga tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dgyes bsted dam rdzas stsa tshogs bsregs blags su phul ba'i mthusaḥ dug gsum las sbyong ba'i gdon bgegs 'byang po dam sri

btsasdo: thams cad mngon spyod drag po'i sgo nas tshar gcod pa'i brin las mdzod cig drag rol bya zhing dmod pa bor de nas drag po'i yam shing dang sha khrag ling chung 'byu nag sngags bkod la e bskyed bden brjod ni rang mdun e las lcags khaṃ gru gsum nang dṛjiḥlas byung bstan pa'i dgra bgegs rnamasaḥ mngon gsum ltar gsal rkang lag lcags gzer gdabaX dug lnga rang gshed 'beb pa'i btson bzhin gsalaḥ na moḥ mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma drag po rtsalaḥ bdud dpung zil gnon lha tshogs bden mthu yis bstan 'gror 'tshe ba'i dug gsum dgra bgegs rnamasaḥ rang dbang med par gzugs rten 'di la khug bdun nam nyer gcig gang skabs brjod rtsa sngags mthar dṛtshuchomaṅku sha dza dzaḥ āj-i'adzi raka mā ra ya phyes byesaḥ ma ma drag rūhra mā ra ya byes phyes dgra bgegs skyobs byed kyi lha dang phyes shig badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa dgra bgegs ma ra ya thum ru lu lu chings shigaX badz+ra pā sha 〉ཿ dgra bgegs dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa pa ya myos shigaX e khung thu dzaX garma gharnye hoX de nas bsgral las niḥ ྅ dza khams gsum mtshan mar bzung ba'i dgraḥ dug gsum dbang

gyur 'khrul ba'i gdonaḥ ma rig dbang gyur snying rje'i gnas mngon spyod las kyi ma bsgral na ngan song gnas las thar mi srid de phyir tshad med snying rjes zungs mtshon chen bdag med phur dbal thob rnams shes skye med dbyings su bsreḥ'akhrul pa ka dag dbyings su sparaḥ yeḥyetsho ཿram̐zaḥmār yaphaṭaX ā spar ṇaphaṭaḥ bsgral dzos zag med bdud rtsir bsgyur ye shesalha la bstabasapa ni sgo gis/ཿskyemed dbyings )khyon mnyam bhan+ta rtsa log 'khrul du tra bsgral ba'i phung khams bshamasaX ma rig 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phyir drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon lha la 'bulaḥkhams gsum 'khrul gsar dug gsum rnam dag steX gdod ma'i he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shogaX rtsa sngags mthar gargod byed rgyal bsen klu gnyan gri sri gri btsan nye 'gong zhing 'dre za 'dre god sripethe'udam srimā raya phaṭaḥ dz+wa lare khāhiḥ rdzasare sngagasagrangasabadun phul de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa ni hoX drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i mthus gdon bgegs 'byung po rnams med par gyur cig brlag

gtsasdo: par gyur cig gzhom par gyur cig tshar gcod par gyur cig ming tsam yang med par gyur cigaḥ bdud kyi 'khor lo stong par gyur cig drag po mngon (1da kyi 'phrin las rab 'khumams lhun gyis dza/ba par shākyar cigaḥ dzos rnams phul rjes sngar ltar du bsgral bstabs lan gsum bya'oḥ gzhung gi bstod pa rgyas par bya spro na tshogs dang bskang ba phul bsnyen sngags sgrub sngags cung zad dang / rtsa sngags shirnye puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas gto rag mgo pa niḥ hūṃX hrīX skye med chos dbyings dag pa'i ngang nyid las 'gags med lhun grub phyi nang gsang mchod sprin pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol sngags mja rgyas par phul de nasabastod pa niḥ hūṃX hrīḥ rnam rtog 'khrul ba'i rjes 'brang dug gsum gdonaḥ tshar gcod brtul zhugs nus mthu'i phrin las canaḥ drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon lha tshogs la ngo mtshar rang ngo rig pas phyag 'tshal bstod de nasadangos grub blang ba niḥ hūṃ hriḥ mi gnas dag pa chos sna'i klong yangs nas ye shes skya 'phrul mi zad dngos grub gteraḥ dad lngan sgrab mchog rnal 'byor pho mo

la dus las ma g.yel da lta nyid du stsol rtsa sngags mthar kā ya sirnyi oṃ wak+ka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi (༷ sarba sirnyi trī0 de nas gshegs skyems 'bul ba niḥ / hrīḥ dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag snyingaḥ lcags zangs til yungs dri chen bsres pa'i 'tshogasaḥ bka' drin gso phyir gtang rag 'bul gyis bzhesaX mi nub mdzad pa'i 'gro khams dngos sprugs zhu rtsa sngagasamathar me sa rak+ta tsit+ta bā ling ta khā kha khā hi khā tīḥ nyer gcig brjod la phul bar bya spro na bstod pa bsdus tsam bya de nas bzod gsol 'bul ba niḥhoḥ sangs rgyas rang la rdzogs pa ngo ma shesaX sems can rten 'brel yin pa'i don ma rtogaḥ rang rig drag khros yin par zhal ma 'tshom thams cad gzhir bzhengs bla ma'i dgongs klong bshags badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ yig brgya lan gsum brjod la bskang de nas bsdu rim bya ba ni snyedaḥ skye med dbyings las bzhengs ba'i ye shes paḥ drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon gtso 'khor bcasaḥmi gnas nang dbyings de bzhin nyid du bsna gar yang 'gro ba'i don phyir gzigs ska ngomasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya sum̐X ye shes pa nang dbyings ka nas dag pa'i 'khor lo bsnga dam
