—8rdo: tshig pa gnyug ma ye shes kyi ga'ur bsres te 'khor 'das kyi spyi dpal chen por blta'oḥ de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni ho tha snyad mtshan 'jin rū tra kun bsgral nasaX khams gsum yongs sgol rta khyung dgongs klong bstabs ༷ ma rig gnyis snang bsregs cing gzhoms pa'i dgesaḥ nang daphyings he ru ka dpal mngon gyur regagaX lan gsum de nas shis brjod na na moḥ dbang chen bde 1nga pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dalaX thams cad ye mnyam rta zhal khyung gdong gar 'di ni ma rtog 'khrul bar gnas pa kunaḥ ye shes dbyings su sad pa'i shis pa rtsol rmong pa klu 'dul kro hring 'brug ltar sgrogs chags pa'i gnas stong sde brgyad 'dul glu 'gyedaḥ zhe sdang tshar gcod gar dgu'i rnam 'gyur ngoms srid na mtshungs bral dpa' bos shis pa stsolaḥ gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma dbyings su bsregasaḥ ye shes bdud rtsi phyogs med yongs la 'beb 'bar ba me yi dam tshig 'phrin las gyisaḥ mngon sprod lhan gyis tshob pa'i shis pa rtsolaX rten 'brel grong khyer rgyun gcod lta ba'i klong zang thal 'od gsal 'khor yug sgom pa'i babaḥ gnas snang chos

nyid 'khor lo spyod pa'i ngang lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po'i shis pa rtsol ga pang shisab da rgya cher bya dga' ston bya go bsngo smon gdab gnad 'disawaṃn lasalhun gyisakhrub mngon spyod drag po dgra bgegasa'adulasrid na ya mtshan che bar 'gyura'abyung po kun gyi glag mi rnyed yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa'i dngosagrub rgya mtsho'i dpal la 'byor the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥs mapāḥme mabadechen gsang ba gsung gi gnasapad+ma rak+ta 'khyil ba'i klong zlo gam dbang gi da la nasadage bsnyen sha masasprad pa'i brda' rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshesnang bdag rig 'dzin ḍak+ki'i phyir na tshogasalnga yi gsal bar byas gnod sbyin btsan rgod 'bar bsasrungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor cigaḥs mag rgya rgya rgya gu brda':miḥlha cesapa'ang lung zin chosakyi bdag popad+ma chosa'apel rgya mchos nan bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsalagyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda' mdzod lasazhal bdusate dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zinamirdzisamatshan can gyisabagyisapa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba maṅgaye/

—8rdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i las rnams mthar phyin lhun grub zab mo bzhugasaḥ—8rdo na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ ze(1shā na— las bzhi lhun grub thab khung du me tshang dal mjes 'bar rlung sgron gzhung dang mthun pa'i yo byad bshams bdag mdun bzlos pa yongs rdzogs gtong slob dpon he ru'i chas su zhugs de nas bsregs dzos byin brlabs niḥ o u: thabs shes sbyor ba'i rten 'brel las byung ba'i dngos mtshan dag pa phyi nang gsang mchod niḥ dbang po yul drug dgyes bskang mtha' yas pa snang gsal bde rig stong pa'i rang mdangs shar 33ā( 'iḥ'i4ཿtha4 'i4 'i4༷'i4ཿ'i gro rluspa raṇa dzaḥ de nas me sbar ni / hrīḥye shesa'abar ba me yi dkyil 'khor ni 'phrin las lhun gyi grub pa'i tshul du bya rnam rtog dug lnga'i gdon bgegs mtshams bcad doḥ lhag mthong shes rab rlung gis g.yin don bskul hūṃ hūṃ de nas thab bsang sbyangs byas te lha bskyed ni hūṃ trīḥ dngos po mtshan ma'i chos rnams stong par gyuraḥ de yi rang mdangs dag chen ye shes kyi zhing gi bkod pa phun

sum tshogs pa'i dbusaX ye shes gzhal yas mdzes bkod ldan pa'i klong nyi zla zhal sbyor rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i kharaX rig pa'i ngo bo hūḥmathing zer 'bar las spro bsdu'i yongs gyur mdun bskyed me yi lhaḥ zug spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag mja 'bul de nas byon skyems 'di ltar 'bulaḥhrīḥ brdal khyab rat+na'i yangs pa'i gzhong pa ru ro bcud ldan pa rtsi dang 'bru mar bskyilaḥ thabs shes lto sbyor rdo rje lce yis 'bulaḥ ye shes lha yi ljags kyis bzhes su gsolaX rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcig brjod nas skyems phul loḥgazhung gi mchod pa rgyas par 'bul de nas bsregs rdos 'bul ba niḥ hū hriḥ lugs 'byung brtan g.yo'i dpal yon 'byor tshogs noraḥ bdag po ci mchis blos blang bsregs rdzas dang nus pa gcig bsres dngos kun 'dzom pa'i gsos bla ma rta khyung drag po'i dal du 'bul phrin las rab 'byams lhun grub dngos grub rtsol rtsa sngags mthar badz+ra pañtsa.a mṛ ta asne ye bho dhi bhi k+ṣa sarba pa rmā da hā na badz+ra sirnyi saṃ bha dhe puṣ+ṭa be ga bi dza ye gasma bā la a yu ṣe pra ti ha na gha gha na ma la puṣ+ṭa dṛ wa ye dhe wa da dharma khā nyi shidz+nya puṣ+ṭi wa shang mā ra ya phaṭaḥ

—8rdo: ces rgyas pa brgya re 'bul rjes rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba pudza khāhaṃḥXgadz+nya puspyowa shewā raya phaṭaḥ ces bsdus pa stong re 'bul gang la mkho ba'i 'dod gsol niḥ ho bla ma drag po dmar nag me phreng rtsal rta zhal khyung gdong rngams pa'i lha tshogs khyed rnams laX bdud rtsi sreg blugs kyi mchod pa bla na med pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthusaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod bsrung bya rnams kyi nad zhi bar gyur cig gdon bgegs med par gyur cig sdig sgrib dag par gyur cigaḥ longs spyod rgyas par gyur cigaḥ 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par gyur cig dpal 'byor dang ldan par gyur cigaḥ tshe ring bar gyur cigaḥ bde ba mtshog thob par gyur cig shes rab 'phel bar gyur cig nor dang 'bru 'byor bar gyur cig myur ba'i shugs thob par gyur cigaX lus stobs dang ldan par gyur cigaḥ bsrung ba mchog la dbang bar gyur cig rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs par gyur cigaḥ chos rgyud yang dag par gyur cig 'di phyilibadilegs dpal yon bkra shis rgya mtsho la longs spyod par gyur cig cesasbyar ro gzhung bstod phyag rgya lnga dang sbyar tshog

dang gsol kha gtong mang rung de nasagatang rag mchog bsdus phul gtor ma bsang sbyangs spel grub nas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul ba niḥ hū hrīḥ thugs rje che ldan pad+ma drag po'i lhar las rnams lhun sdo/ba dam rdzas sna tshogs kun sbyar ba'i bshos nag khro rgyal dgyes bskyed 'di mchod par 'bul lo thugs rjes bzhes nas kyangaḥ sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe byed pa'i bdud bgegs rgyal bsen zhi zhing stong pa dang rten 'brel legs pa'i yon tan 'phel rgyas shing sde brgyad lha 'dre mi la dbang bsgyur bzhin dgra dpung drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad nas bde skyid lhun gyisagrub par mdzad du gsol rtsa sngags mthar me sa rak+ta tsit+ta ba ling ta sarba pu dza khā hiX brgya rtsa sogs phul loḥ dngosagrub zhu gshegs skyems 'bul ba niḥhrīḥ bde legs dpal sbyin pad+ma drag po yis 'phrin las lhun grub mdzad pa dgyes brtses bskyangs bka' drin gso phyir gshegs skyems 'bul gyis bzhes slar yang thugs kyi thig ler bdag bzung 'tshal rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba pu dza a dṛ ta khā hiḥ nyer gcig phul bstod bsdus bya'o bzod gsol byas la yig brgya lan gsum ba ོda bsdu rim ni hūṃ hrī mi

(6sdo gnas dag pa chos sku'i gsang mdzod las lhun grub snang char ngoms pa'i ye shes paX bdud 'joms rdo rje rta khyung drag po'i dal mtha' grol dbu ma'i dbyings su badz+ra rluḥ zhes ye shes pa rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi skur bsduḥ dam tshig pa rang byung rig pa'i ga'u bskyilaX de nas bsngo smon niḥ hoḥ bde stong spros bral bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du gzung 'dzin thad grol sreg blugs phul ba'i mthusaḥ khams gsum las kyi mdud rgya kun grol nasaX nang dbyings sku gsum dgongs klong byang chub shogaḥ lan gsumaḥde na bkra shisabarjod pa ni na moḥ gdul bya'i zhing snang dpag yas rab 'byams kun sku gsum mdzad phrin rgya mtshos rab mdzes shing bslab gsum rgyan 'chang sa lam mthar phyin nas bcu gsum rgyal sar 'aX da pa'i bkra shis thegagaḥ shis brjod bsngo smon mtha' rgyas bya phrin las lhun grub the tshom medaḥ sam shāḥ gsung mchog bde ba'i mtsho gling nasaḥ pha ror bu ya bgo skal 'ad dge bsnyen sha ma'i thabasakyis sprad rang rkyen rgud pa kun sel phyir pad+ma bde spyod gling pa yis rin chen shog skyar bkod pa'i dges bla ma kun bzang dgyes pa dang rgyal khams dge ba'i rgyur gyur cigaḥ sabo maṅga la/

—8rdo: maṇ+ḍal niḥs ā (ཿ stong gsum bkod mjes rat+na'i maṇ+ḍal dngaḥ rang snang 'od gsal nges pa lnga ldan gter rig pa ye shes kun bzang mchod pa'i sprinaḥbadud rtsi mnyam rol khro 'chol dal du 'bulaḥ bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang 'gro khams rgya mcho dong sprugs nus par shogaX tram̐ rat+namaṇ+ḍal badz+rapū dzite a /༷ zhes pa 'anganusaldan pas so badz+ra: bka' bgo niḥ / hrī chos kun ye mnyam bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin las log par bslad pa'i gnyis 'dzin 'phral byung gdonaḥ 'di na 'dug pa'i gnas med rdo rje'i dal glud gtor khyer la ma gnas phyir dengs shig sarba bisnanagats+tsha phaṭa bsrung 'khor niḥhrīḥmatha' dbus mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nyid las rkyen gyis mi shig ye shes lnga yi guraḥ 'di ru log 'dren rgya bar mi 'os phyir mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor 'byur med lcan gyis tshobaḥdzā nashāstu ragarak+ṣa sbyoḥ nusaldan pas sbyar ba'oḥsarba ma le/

—8/sde: bsregs blugs gi sa chog bsdusapa ni dkar gtor rnam lngas brgyan pa bshams la a ka ros byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad gyeraḥ hrīḥtrīshrīḥ zhes rjes chags bshad pa'i glus gzir tsa na dbang chen sa yi lha mo 'khor sa bdag klu gnyan gyis bskor ba mdun du mngon sum du 'khod par bsamaḥ kyeḥ sngon nas byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs dbang chen sa yi lha mo dang sa bdag klu gnyan gtod 'khor bcasaḥ 'byung ba lnga la brten bcas pa'iḥ sa tshon bdag po thams cad la dkar gtor rnam lngas brgyan pa dngaḥ sa glud mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ ru nga phrag tog ma byed par0 lasarnams sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig mchod pas dgyes nas lha mo des 'dzum pa'i mdangs byung ste khyod ni shākya seng ge'i sras rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob bstan pa 'dzin thugs bzhed ci bzhin sa 'di phul byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs byed doX zhes phyag byas nasas la zim par bsam kye mjes pa'i mtsho sman rgyal mo zhes ra ba bzhi yi gdengs ldan pasaḥ sa la byin rlabs chags chags gdobaḥ 'dzan las thogs med grub mdzod cigaḥ zhes sa gzhi gser gyi rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam moḥ tshon byin

mas ni nyu rin chen mdzes pa'i snod nang du be+eḍūr dngul gser ra ga dngaḥ in+t+ra ni la'i rdul bye laḥ sngo nag hūṃ las mi bskyod paḥdakar po o las rnam snang mdzadaX ser po tram̐ las rin chen 'byungaḥ dmar po hrīḥlas snang mtha' yasaḥ ljang gu ltalas don yod grubaḥ lhag ma rnams ni yum lnga'i dalaX rang bzhin dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nyidaḥ rnal 'byer rtogs pas phun tshogs sgrubasaḥ de dag las spros 'od zer gyis rigs lnga'i lha tshogs spyan drangs bstimasaḥ dam ye gnyis su med par bsreḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaX dzaḥhūṃḥ 31ཿ puṅge dhā pe sogs shabha a maḥ.āḥñtsa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyiḥ gsang ba gcig bsdus ngo bo nyid rigs lnga sras dang bcas pa laḥ gus shing dad pas phyag 'tshal dristod rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba lasaX thig tshon so so'i rnam par gyur 'di yang sgrub pa'i cha lag sanus ldan dpal gyi rdo rjes soḥsarba ma leḥ

gtsasdo rtog sgrib sbyangs ba dang bar ga zhi phyir sreg blugasa'abul ba ni ro badz+ra2 lar midabus giba'i me lha mdzes 'dzum sgegs drang srong chas rdzogs dpa' bo dpa' mos bskoraḥ nyams chags rtog sgrib sbyangs phyir bsregs rdzas bzhes sgrub la bar chad med pa'i phrin las mdzod0 re asnedhe wasarba pūdza khāhaiḥnyams chags rtog sgrib bar chad thams cad dza ku ru ye swā hāḥ lan bdun 'bul 'dod gsol ni bdag gis rtog sgrib bar chad zhi ba dang sgrib po'i gegs gol 'phral rkyen kun bsal nas tshe dang bsod nams ye shes yon tan 'phelaḥ don gnyis 'bad med 'byung bar mdzad du gsolaḥ o badz+rapuṅge dhupe malo kegs niwaṃ te shabha ār+yāḥ zhesamaja de bstod cing tshogs bsdu na trī 'bar ba'idabang phyug zhi ba'i las mdzad paḥ me lha 'khor dang bcas la bdag gis bstod bdag gzhan dbang gyur dri ma mthol lo bshags lha des dgyes bzhes mi dmigs dbyings su yal bdag kyang spros bralanyams len ngang la gnasaḥ.a.ā 'di yang sgrub pa chen po'i cha lag spyodus ldan pas soḥsarba masgolo/

—8rdo: nyes sel me mchod bzhugs ra〉yirdo/ rdzas gtso til mar yam shing sogs sngagasadang phyag rgyas byin rlabs ni tsho sa/ swā hāḥ nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad shirnye ku ru yeswā snya lan bdun gyis spelaḥ ha badz+ra ḍak+ki ni (ཿ asne ye dz+wa la reḥ me sbar me lha bskyed pa niḥ hūṃḥ me dbus dur khrod thod mkhar brjid pa'i klong gza' klu rgyal bsen spyi chings bsnol ba'i khar hrī yig las byung ye shes me yi lhaḥ rta zhal khyung gdong rdo rje phur pa gdengasaḥ dbal zur rngams pas dug gsum 'byung po brgyalaḥ ye shes me yis gnyis snang mtshan ma bsregs dur khrod dpa' chas dpa' ba'i rtags su bgo sku la dam tshig mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis 'dudaX thugs srog las spros 'od zer lcags kyu yis bskul de rtsa gsum dam can spyan drangs bstimaX oṃ badz+ra sa ma mā dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃmaḥho na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ / hrīḥ rtsa gsum 'dus zhal rta khyung drag po la thugs mthun phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes rten 'brel nyes kun sel ba dang legs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong 'phel mdzod ma mahwa pudza sam yahoḥ rdzas sna 'thul la hūṃ trī 'bras bu can

gyi shing dang 'bru yi mar sna tshogs 'bru yi dga' ston bsam mtha' yas rta khyung drag po rtsa gsum sprin la 'bul rten 'brel nyes zhi legs tshogs gong 'phel mdzod rten snying mthar rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing legs tshogs yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cigaḥ brgya stong sogs skabs bstun brjod bstod pa bya yi ge brgya ba bzlas la lhag chad bskang bsngo smon gdab bsdu rim ni lha rnams 'od zhu rang gi thugs shar bsduX rang yang rje sa bral nyams len ngang la gnasaḥ shis brjod bya 'di yang mkha' 'gro snang ba 'od bzang mas bskul bzhin nus ldan rdo rje'i spel ba maṅga lam̐ḥbadz+ra: bzod gsol niḥho mchod rdzas ma tshangs ting 'dzin g.yel ba dngaḥ ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang 'gal ba'i las rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs rnams gang mchis nongasaḥ dam rdzas bsregs blugs la brten bskang zhing bshags sa ma ya yis yig brgya bzlos bsngo smon niḥ ho 'dis mtshon dge kun gcig bsdus 'gro la bsngo phyam

bskyod: gcig kun bzab bla ma'i sa thob shogaX shis brjod ni na moX phan bdeli'abyung gnas bstan pa dar ba dngaX der 'dzin 'dus sde'i tshe sgrub mthar phyin zhingaX sgyu lus dwangs ma'i 'od sku grub pa sogasaḥ don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i shis pa stsolaX 'di yang nus ldan rdo rjes soḥsarba ma yo mi 'dod gsol niḥ ho theg dgur 'grel ba'i brgyud pa'i bla ma da ཿ phyi nang sgrub sde'i lha dang rgyud sde'i dalaX dbyings gsum mkha' 'gror bsregs blugs phul ba'i mthus 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byor ston 'khor chos grwa yis ṭ+wāṃX sa/ ༵ga ༷ ༵'i phyogs su bsgyur ba dngaḥ nyes pa kun gyis nam yangs mi tshug cingaX nyes tshogs ye shes nyid du dag gyur cigaX sa sarbas maya shirnyeku ruye swāhwa
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX sgrub pa chen po'i dus su dngos grub bskul len gter gyi bum bzang bzhugs soḥ

—8/snye: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha ra dza yāḥ rgadza'idza) bsnyen sgrub las gsum mthar phyin dus dngos thub zhu ba'i gsol gdab niḥ rkye hoḥ bzhengs shig rnga yab srin po'i gling nas bzhengasaḥ dgongs shig dpal ri pad+ma 'od nas dgongasaḥ gzigs shig lus med mkha' 'gro'i gling nas gzigs thugs dam chen po'i nyer bzhes mthu ma g.yel bsnyen sgrub las sbyor thams cad chud ma gsanaḥ mos ldan snying nas 'bod bskul 'dir gson laḥ gangs dkar rtse nas dpa' bo'i tshogs dang bcasaḥ bde ba chen po'i dngos grub sprin ltar gtibs rgya mtsho' gling nas dpa' bo'i tshogs dang bcasaḥ ye shes gsal ba'i dngos grub char ltar stsolaḥ nam mkha'i dbyings nas ging chen tshogs dang bcasaḥthun mongs grub brgyad dngos grub chu rgyun stsolaX laṅga'i yul nas rakru'i tshogs dang bcasaX thun min phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsolaḥ 'dug sa gdan thog 'di ru byin gyis rlobasaḥ rtogs grol dus mnyam chen po'i dgongs byin phobaḥ tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin sar bsgrod cingaX 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsolaX zhes bskul rtsa sngags

—'di: mthar kā ya sirnyi oṃ wā k+ka sirnyimasaX tsit+ta sidhi (ཿ sarba sirnyi trīḥ mos gus tshad med pas brgya rtsa sogs brjod la stong tshig gi mchod bstod kyang bya'oḥtho rangs snyan gsan dbab pa na / hrīḥ bde chen phyogs ris mi dmigs o rgyan yulaḥ 'du ba chen po mkha' 'gro 'tshogs pa'i gling liṅga pho mos bskul sti byed pa'i gnas 'phags bod paṇa grub bshad sgrub nyin mo'i 'odaḥ thugs rje'i zer mdangs phyogs ris med pa nasaX rtsa gsum spyi gzugs bla ma rdo rje 'chang ye shes sgyu ma rta khyung drag po'i sku bdud 'joms rdo rje rak+ka thod phreng rtsalaX skye med dbyings las dgongs pa'i rtsal mdangs g.yosaḥ mos ldan sgrub 'bras dus bab chud ma gsanaX deng sang skya rangs dang po shar du nyeX dngos grub stsol dang len pa'i tha tshig dusaX thugs rje ma chung sa rgyan rin po cheX dngos grub ma g.yel lhag lha thod phreng rtsalaḥ snyigs ma'i bu sdug ma dor mtsho rgyal maḥ dug gsum yan par ma shor rta khyang grolaḥ dngos tshob rgyang thags ma ring thugs bsted canaḥ yal yol btang stsom le lo mi mdzad paraḥ snying nas da gzigs rta khyang drag po rtsal mchog thun sidī pha

la stsal du gadregal rtsa sngags mthar dngosagrub bskulasngags btagasal ci nus su bzla'o rdo rje slob dpon gyis dngosagrub kyi rdzasarnams rol la maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol gdab ni rkye srid pa'i 'dams skems srid las dbugs dbyung bsaḥ he ru ka dpal rta zhal khyung gdong bzhad yul dang yul can ar gtad dgongs pa can bdag cag la dgongs srid pa'i gzeb grol ba'i dngos grub mchog gi ya mtshan dam pa stsol lan gsum rjes su bum dbang niḥhū hrīḥ mtha' gting phyogs ris las dben bum pa rba khams gsum stobs rol 'jigs tshogs 'thar mdzad rgyal pad+ma drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i sku yi dbang dang dngos grub nyi ma shar shes rab cher rgyas som nyi'i gzeb grol bas nges don rtogs pa'i bu yi dpal du shar rdo rje sku mchog thob pa skal ba bzang he ru ka dpal bdag dang gnyis med shogaX rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya.a bhi shi yas kwa ya sirnyi tshoḥ gsang dbang niḥhū trīḥbade ba gnas basmil dga' ba bzhi smongs bcudaḥ kun tu ma 'dres sa dbab rung sngod mtshan ldan dum gcig ka pa la yas nangaX gu ru yab yum mnyam par rol ba'i

ga sdo: bcudaḥ dkar dmar dga' ba 'khyil ba'i bcud bzang poḥ su la ma shar sgrub mchog dpal du shar rdo rje'i gsung mchog thob pa skal pa bzang rjes chags bshad mchog bdag dang mnyam med shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā wāk+ka sidhi ā tshig dbang bam thugasadabang niḥhriḥ ye nas ma bcos bcing grol las 'das pa'i sems kyi rdo rje mtshon des tshig bral klong 'khor 'das spros bral phyogs ris mi dmigs zhal brda yi mtshon tsam dwangs ba'i me long bzhinaḥ rang gsal rnyogs bral 'gags med 'od gsal ba dus me 'bar ba'i gsang ba chen po steḥ ye shes 'od mdangs sgrub mchog mos ngor sharaX gting gsal nyag gcig rdzogs pa chen po'i gsang rdo rje'i thugs mchog mjal ba skal pa bzang dbang chen thugs mchog bdag dang gnyis med shogaḥ rtsa sngagasamatharaḥtsit+ta a snyi ṣiñtsa/ཿ cit+ta sirnyi/༷ yon ma gtor ma'i dbang niḥ / hriḥ ste med chos dbyings stong pa'i zusmo rtsa 'gags bral 'khor 'das lcan rdzogs gtor chen bshams tshogs brgyad rang grol bde stong lha mo'i rgyan rta zhal khyang gdong

bzhad pa'i dal du sharaX dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung brda rtags rdzogasaḥ yi dam lhag pa'i lha dang gnyis su medaḥ bdud dpung zil gnon thugs rje'i nyi ma sharaḥ tshogs smon las 'dzoms sgrub mchog skal pa bzangaḥ yon tan zad med gter 'byer skal pa bzangaḥ drag khros yon tan bdag dang gnyis med shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa sgogu ṇa sirnyi tre than las phur sgrom gyi dbang niḥ hū hrī chos nyid nam mkha' mtha' dbus bral mod kyang rnam rtog log par 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi dngaX nyer len 'phral byung bgegs rigs 'byung po rnams 'thar byed gzhen nu drag khros he ru ka rta zhal khyung gdong mtshan ma'i g.yul gcod pa'iX sku gsum don rtags 'ching ba'i dam tshig 'dzinaḥkhams gsum gdon 'joms thal 'byin 'brin las canaḥ rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ma 'dres yongs rdzogs pa tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dam ldan mos ngor sharaḥ nga bdag thad gar gcod pa'i brtul zhugs dbang phrin las yongs rdzogs thob pa skal pa bzangaḥ bdud dpung zil gnon nus mthu yongs thob shogaX rtsa sngags mthar karma a rnyi ྅nyu phaṭaḥ

btsasdo: karma sidhihrī rdo rje tshe yi dbang niḥ ( trīX mtshan ldan bdiskyongs pad+ma'i kā pa laraḥ yid bzhin char 'beb rdo rje tshe yi rdzasaḥ bkres skoms nyon mongs gdung sel bdud rtsi smanaḥ zag med 'di spyod sgo gsum bde stong 'bar sdang 'khrugs ma rig g.yul rgyal rdo rje'i khrabaḥ klong chen shes rab sgo 'byed lde'u mig mchogaḥ ma rig sprin gter rig pa gsal ba'i thabs rtogs pas bdag grol thugs rjes gzhan snang grol ༷ zang thal 'od sku skye shi gnyis med grubaḥ rnam par snang mdzad tshe dang lang tsho 'byoraḥ'aphur ldan gas ga pas bsgyur mjug thogs pa med snang mtha' yas pa'i mdzad phrin gter la dbang rgyal ba'i gsang mdzod 'bras bu'i 1nga chen spyodaX mibaskyod rdo rje'i gsang gsum mngon gyur shogaḥ rtsa sngagasamathar rat+na ayu 〉sirnyi a snyi shi lngas ā& dam rdzas ril bu' dbang ni ྅ hrīX lus la skyerga na 'chi'i rgud sel phyiraX rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub sngal du gsol lnga srin dregs pa'i rbol ba tshar gcod phyir dbang chen pada'i dngos grab sngal du gsol lha 'adz+remimin ngan gtong kun 'joms phyiraḥ nas mthu 5ga rtsal

stobs kyi dngos grub stsol gzhan snang yang dag lam la spyor nus phyir ngag la gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsolaX khams gsum rten 'brel lugs ldog dbyings sbyor phyir sems la ye shes thugs kyis dngos grub stsol 'phrin las thogs pa med pa 'byung ba'i phyiraX drag khros bla ma'i gsang gsum mngon gyur shog rtsa sngags mthar karma a phro ta sarba sirnyi pha lacas uka hrītswa sgrub yig dang sku 'bags las bzhi'i ba lang la spyod te ho smin par gyur cig tha mal sgo gsum smin grol bar gyur cig yid dang chos khams grolaḥ zhi bar gyur cig gzung 'dzin gnyis snang semasaX thob par gyur cig sman dang rigs sngags mthuX rgyas par gyur cig tshe dang ye shes stobasaḥ 'byor bar gyur cig gdul zhing bshad sgrub gter dbang bar gyur cig bla med snying po'i mdzodaX nub par gyur cig bstan pa'i dgra bdud bgegs grub par gyur cig rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa ma lus smrab mchog bdag la phun tshogs thegagaḥ rtsa sngags mthar ma hwasngosaji sam yapas la la hoḥ de ltar sgrub pa lhur len skabs ting 'dzan bzhi bsgrags cho ga las yan lag bzhi'i gzhung mthar phyin tshe dngos

— (: grub dam pa 'di ltar spyod dam tshig gcig lasagazhan mi spel dngosagrub thob nges gsang tshig goḥ samawāḥ ye 4 pad+ma gsung gi mtsho gling nas dge bsnyen sha ma'i sprad brda las dusasu rten 'brel phun tshogs pa'i gab rgya legs par grol ba'i modaḥ brda gsang gdul bya'i dpal du spros samawāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu brda maḥdziḥ zhes pa 'di'ang sba pas rnal 'byor babadud 'jomasardo dze+ekhyung drag rtsal gyisadag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni snying nor mecas spel ba dge sabo masgo le/

—8rdo: dngos grub len khar bro ༅gas ni na mogu ruyaḥ grangs med gong nas chos skur byang chub kyang 'dor med thugs rjes rlabs chen rab g.yos teḥ mi mjed zhing gi skyabs mgon pad+ma 'byung gsang chen nyi ma he ru ka dpal dgongs snyigs ma'i smag rum tha rgod 'khrugs klong 'diraḥ mchog gsum nyi zhur snying la reg pa'i modaḥ pakhro'i 'dab gyes lha grwal phyogs pa bdag thugs rjes yal bar ma dor gu ru rje brgyud gsum chig rdzogs bla ma rdo rje 'changaḥ ye shes gzigs pa bdag mos mtshor bltams teḥthun mong thun min 'od kyi snang ba ngomasaḥ khyad par bskyed rdzogs zer 'khrungs ya mtshan cheḥ che 'di'igadung thags 'jig rten chos btang nasaḥ phun tshogs gzhi bzung bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsreng teḥ kha bskang tshogs bsags bsregs blugs yongs rdzogs pasaḥ dngos grub g.yel bar gyur na don ma mchisaḥ khams gsum dbang bsdud snang ba yab tu bskyangasaX srid gsum ka dag stong pa yum 1nga bzhagaḥ thabs shes gnyis med bsgom la gdengs bskyed paraḥ ye sangs rgyas pa'i dngos grub ces mi stsol 'byung dang 'byung

'gyur thabs shes chos so cogaḥ gsang chen rab dgyes gzung chen shes rab mas mkha' dbyings klong chen pad+mo 'khyil legs pasaḥ rang byung ye shes nyi ma ces mi 'char lta ba 'phang dmas chos nyid mi rtogs modaX klong chen dgongs pa mkha' ltar dag pa nyidaX skyabs mgon thugs rjes don dam gzer chen gdab rdzogs chen 'dzin la pha phob myur bar stsolaḥ bsgom pa yun thung nyams rtogs rtsal bul yang ting 'dzin mi 'gyur rig pa rang bab bskyangasaX gnas snang nyid kyi phyag rgya gsal byas pasaḥ ye shes thugs rje gting nas gsal re ranaX bzlas brjod grangs nyung gra chags zur nyams pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'phrin las mi myur yangaḥ brjod med don la mnyam par bzhag lags pasaḥ dngos grub rgya mtsho nub med stsol re ran dran dang shes bzhin zab mo'i ngang bskyangs teX srid gsum ka dag khams gsum yongs sgrol ngang lta stang bsgom gdengs spyod pa sgyu mar sbyangs dus 'dir byin rlabs chu rgyun 'beb kyang ranaḥ rtse gcig bsgom sgrub snying po lhur blang naḥ liṅga shod kyi srin po pho mo yangaḥ pha las gdung zhing ma las

ba /sdo: brtse gyur na mgon khyod thugs rje che bas ces mi dgongasaḥ slob pa'i dam chag chags nyams rtogs pa'i nongasaḥ bshags dang sbyangs pa sems kyi byed las te bdag ni 'da' nyams srung mtshams las 'das pa'iḥ ye shes chos skur snang shes mtha' bral bshagasaX sgrib bral khyod ni ye sangs rgyas pa dang don dam spros med cir yang 'char gyur bar chos nyid bden pa'i dngos grub mthar thug pa blo 'das zag zad rig stong mngon gyur stsol theg brgyad blo ltar grub 'bras dus smin naX theg chen rtse mo nang rgyud ya mtshan pa'iḥ dngos grub mkha' mnyam nam mkha' mdzod kyi gteraḥ mi 'khyang da lta nyid la stsal du gsolaX rdo rje srin po'i nam lang nyi zla sharaḥ rig 'dzin paṇa grub dgongs don bshad sgrub mdzadaḥ rnal 'byor bskyed rdzogs nyams len mthar phyin te dngos grub stsol len dus la bab lags soḥ mgon khyod thugs rje'i nye ba nyid dgongs nasaḥ bsgrub bya sgrub byed dbyer med gcig 'dres teḥ sku gsum lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i mdzodaḥ ci bzhin mngon gyur dngos grub zhu'o āḥ ces mos gus tshad

med pas badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ ces badz+ra sa twa zasam yaḥ ma ṇi pa la sogs yig brgya ci nusasu bzlas rjesasman mchod phul la dngos thub blang bar bya'o nye lam snying khu spyod pa kun lo'i ngor nye brgyud zab mor dbang ba nu ldanapas nye ba nyid du dngosagrub thob phyir phab nye gnasargan pa smon semasazhes byas bris/ sarba ma la/

bar/: sman mchod ni slo ār+yāḥ ka dag chos sku'i bla ma de mchod dom āhā0 'od lnga lhun rdzogs bla ma de mchod dom āhwaḥ gdang gsal sprul sku'i bla ma de mchod do oṃ ā / 'ja' lus dgyes pa rdo rje de mchod dom āḥ 'jam dpal smra ba'i nyi ma de mchod do.o āhu0 grub mchog dṛ seng ha de mchod do.o āhāX rig 'dzin dri med bshes gnyen de mchod do.oṃ ātu mkhas grub dz+nyā na su tra de mchod do.oṃ āhūṃ rang reg bla ma pad 'byung de mchod dom 'juḥ byin rlabs char 'beb bla ma de mchod do.o āhūṃḥ dngos grub sprin 'khrigs bla ma de mchod docan āhūṃX bde stong dpal 'bar bla ma de mchod dosnyam ā& phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma de mchod dokun āhu bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma de mchod dophan āhūṃ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma de mchod dophan ga(ཿ yi dam rta khyung drag po de mchod dotsan ā&X sku gsum lhun rdzogs dkyil 'khor de mchod do.o ār+yāḥ lhun rdzogs go cha'i dkyil 'khor de mchod dom āmāṃḥ mnyam sbor mkha' 'gro sde bzhi de mchod do.o ārtaḥ las mdzad pho nya sde bzhi de mchod do.o

u hū bka' nyan la ma dun skyes de mchod doyo āḥhū 'khor 'das rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor de mchod dom ātāḥye nas gnyis med mnyam rdzogs de mchod doyo ā&ḥzhes pa'ang dbyings snang lasamachod pas mod la nus ldan pas spel ba maṅga le/

—rten: byin mas ni dngos grub kyi rdzas de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan spros pas 'khor 'das rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dbang byin dngos grub thams cad 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam paraḥ thod pa stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang mer gyis gang nas bdag sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi dbyig chen po thob par dmigs la rtsa sngagasamathar ka ya wāk+ka tsit+ta gu ṇa ba sirnyi m+me pra we sha ya a be sha ya awasaḥ nyer gcig brjod la —8rdo: 'dod gsol ni kye0 dgongs shig brgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma dngaX yi dam pad+ma rta khyung drag po rtsalaX gnas yul rigs sngags zhing skyes mkha' 'gro yisaḥ thun mong grub brgyad mchog gi dngos grub bcas mi 'khyangs myur bar skal ldan rnams la stsol tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin sa zob cing lhag pa'i lha mchog nyid dang dbyer med par bde chen mdzad pas bshesar ba dong sprugs 31ga zhes dngosagrub len par bya ba la sman mchod bcasanas rol bar bya'o/ 'di'ang nus ldan rdo rjes 'byul snang yig gzugs su bkod pa dge legs 'phel/
badz+ra dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥdangos grub dpal gyi 'byung gnas khro bo rol pa'i gnad 'phyang yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs soḥ

—8rdo: na mo pad+ma krota ra dza yaḥ 141 bzla sngon smon las 'phro 'dzom pa yis skal pa bzang po'i rigs can rnams bar pha bdud lasarnam bsal zhing byang chub sgrub la gegs med phyir mi med dben pa'i gnasasu phyin sde brgyad tshogs la sa bslang zhingaḥyon dang rin tu gtor skyems 'bul nag phyogs gdug tshogs dmar gyis brngan bar chad bgegs la chang glud gtong sgrub pa chen po'i khog phub nas phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya bsdams bug ral 'khyar gsum skyon bcos te bskyed ོgas sgrub pa'i gzhung bsreng pa thog mar nyes skyon sbyangasab ni bdag nyid rgyu yi he ru ka gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ze'u 'bru'i kharaḥzla ba nya gang ba'i dal dbus su dam tshig dbang lung man ngag stsol ba'i rdo rje slob dpon nyid gu ru rin po che'i rnam par gsal gdab sgo gsum gyi chagasanyams rtogs sgrib bag chags sbyangs ba'i slad du yid khyed shes kyi dad pa drag pos dri ma la gnong zhing 'gyod sems stobs bzhi tshang ba'i mi gnas par byang zhing dag pa'i dmigs 'dun dang bcas pasaḥyig brgya ci nus su bzla'o mthar bla ma nyid rjes chags kyis 'dzum pa dang bcas te khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag pa yin no zhes lung bstan

—8rdo: gnang nas 'od du zhu ste bdag nyid rgyu yi he ru ka la thim pas thugs yid ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam la smra bsam brjod bral du la bzla'oḥ slar yang sgrub pa la tho 'tshams pa'i 'byung po thams cad tshar gcod pa'i slad du dur khrod me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su hūṃ ljang nag las khro bo bgegs 'thar byed 'bar ba'i khro tshogs kyi rdul sprin 'khrigs shing che ba'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin can du bskyed la ( bisna ta kṛta chin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭaX nyer gcig brjodaḥ hūḥ 'jigs byed dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skuX bgegs 'dul dpa' bo khyod la bdag phyag 'tshalaḥ ma rung bdud kyi dpung tshogs tshar gcod phyir ye shes bdud rtsi nyid la bzhugs su gsol0 gsol ba lan gsum gdab pas lha nyid 'od zhu dam chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyuraX slar bdud rtsi'i chu te gnas khang la gtor bas 'bag rtsogs sbyangs sgrub pa po rnams la 'thor bas chags nyams rtog smib thams cad dag sgrab rdzas yo byad la gtor bas bar chad kyi bgegs bsal mchod rdzas thams cad la phog pas rgyal ba'i dgyes pa bskang

shing sems can kyi tshogs rdzogs pas mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsam moḥ slar spos byung la sgrub pas dam chig rjes su dran te lha mo sbos me ma nam mkha'i klong las byon te kun bzang ye shes lnga yi spos sprin mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor spel te gzung 'dzin gyi spros rtog dag nas ye shes kyi 'khor lor sad par bsam moḥ ma ཿ lha shing sna tshogs dud sprin laḥ tshul khrims bzang po'i dri bsung 'thul dug lnga'i bag chags dag byed cingaX ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub badz+ra dhā pe spra ra ṇa phaṭaḥ se ha ra ṇa hūḥdamigs pa'i spro bsdu bya'oḥ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i khar rtog bral be ro pho mo'i steng du gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal la rgya jed kyi paṇa grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging liṅga dang bcas pa'i sprin 'khrigs nas bzhugs par bsam laX yid khyed shes kyi dad pa drag po'i gsol ba gdab par bya'oḥ de nas rol mo'i tshogs rnams kyang snang ba thabs dang stong pa shes rab grags stong chos sgra gsung rdo rje'i rol mo rgyal ba'i dgyes sprinaḥ 'khor ba'i mtshan ma rang grol du byed pas he ru ka kho nas rol par

—8mi: blta'oḥde nas dus ngan snyigs ma lnga yi smag rum las nyon dug chus myos pa'i sems can bdud kyi 'bangs su gyur pa rnamasaXdapal mgon chen pos thugs rjes zin zhing gdul dka' 'dul ba'i dpa' bo chen pos skyabs 'og tu tshud par bsam laḥskyabs su 'gro bar byaḥnam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad las ngan log pa'i lam las bzlog ste rnam grol he ru ga'i gsang ba gsum du 'god phyir byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed par bya'oḥsems bskyed bya lhag pa'i lha mchog he ru ga'i spyan sngar lta ba 'jal ba'i phyag spro zhing ting nge 'dzin gyis mchod sprin bstabs nas sgo gsum gyi rtog sgrib sbyangs la dag mnyam chen po la yi rang shing dgongs pa'i don las g.yo med du bzhugs shingaX rang grol rol pa chen po'i 'khor lo la longs spyod cing 'khor gsum yongs dag gis srid pa'i rba slong skems par bya'oḥbasam pa dang bcas pa'i yan lag bdun pa phul de nas tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis bskul te bdag nyid gzhi las bzhengs pa'i dbang chen he ru ka rjes chags bzhad pas 'dul smras

bgegs tshogs sdud cing 'byung po'i dpa' skongs shing zil gyis gnon par bskyed laḥ sa rgya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭaḥ /༷ bdag nyid ye nas ma brtsal sangs rgyas phyiraḥ dbang mchog rol ba'i dal du byin gyis rlobasaX kā ya sirnyi maḥ wāk+ka sirnyi ā tsit+ta sirnyi (ཿ slar dbang chen rol byed kyi tshogs spros te bgegs tshogs 'gugs pa dngaX ma mo bde byed kyi sprin dag gis 'byung po rnams brngan zhing tshim par bya ba dang ging 'thar byed rigs kyi mi dbang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad pa dang liṅga bsgyur byed rnams kyis 'byung po'i yid sems dbang du byed cing bran du bkol ba dngaḥ bga' sdod rol byed dag gis 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub du byed par mos soḥ hūṃḥ las rin po che'i sdod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ las glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyuraḥ rlu ā hūṃ ha ho nyi na mo dbang chen khros pa ma mo'i tshogs tshoms kyisaX sa 'og sa sdeng sa gar rgya ba'i bgegasaX smad cig yid tsam gyis ni 'dir bsngas la bdag gi bgo ba'i bka' bsgrab glad gtor

gtsasdo: longasaX ṭa ki ra dza hūṃ dza dzaX〉ཿbaṃ hoḥ o sarba bisne sa pā ri wa ra e de bā ling ta kha khā khā hi khā hiḥ ar+ghaṃ pabye sogs shabha pra tits+tsha ye swā hāX bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen gnas su gyur te drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal che brjid gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa zhig tu gsal gdab laḥ 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ar la gtad par bya'o ༷ ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i steng thams cad phyag mtshan sna lnga'i bla breX 'og thams cad phyag mtshan sna lnga'i sa gzhi0 bar mtshams thams cad phyag mtshan sna lnga'i dra gur dkrug shing khro bo dang khro mo'i sprul pa sdig khyung phag seng gis tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par spros te log 'dren bgegs kyis tshogs rnams nye mi nus pa'i rang bzhin du dmigs la srung gur phub par bya'o gdod nas snang grags lha sngags tshos nyid kyi rol pa ye sangs rgyas pa la de don ma rtog pa'i gol sgrib 'thug po chos nyid kyi dbyings su bsal bar bya ba ni brda' sgo dbye ba'oX thams cad nyams pa'i 'khor lo snang stong sku rdo rje0 grags stong gsung rdo rje dran stong thugs rdo rje gsum du

nges par rtogs shing yid ches te lta ba mjal ba'i phyag kyang phul bar bya'oḥ chos kyi sku la sgrib gol ma mchis pas na chos can gyi snang ba gang la'ang dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i yang dag par 'brel ba'i rdo rje'i gzungs thag la rnam pa kun tu 'jug pa ni dam bca' bzung ba'oḥ gzhi dad pas sna drangs dag snang gis sgo phyes te lha tshogs thugs kyi nyi ma klong nas shar te ma rig pa'i mun khams su rig pa ye shes kyi byin chen dbab par bya'o chos nyid mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rol mtshor shar ba'i dbang po yul lnga rnam par dag pa'i phyi mchodaḥ snang ba 'dod yon lnga rnam par dag pa'i nang mchodaḥ dug lnga cer grol rjen pa gsang mchod rnam par rtog gsum gyi mtshan ma rang sar dag pa sku bā lingaX gsung rak+ta thugs bdud rtsi'i mchod pa chen poXdon dam snang stong zung 'jug tu shar ba thams cad sbyor mchodaX rlung sems dbu ma sgra can gyi khar tshud pa sgrol mchodaX lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa de bzhin nyid mchodaḥ sgom pa'i 'od gsal yangs pa ting nge 'dzin mchod spyod pa'i la dor ba ro mnyam gyi mchod pa chen por ye nas gnas nyid ye shes

—rten: chen pos dang du blang bar bya'o mchod rdzas byin rlabs so ye nas dag chen chos sku'i klong la ma rig pa gzung 'dzin gyi gol sgrib mi dmigs kyang phral byung dug lnga'i sgrib pa chos nyid kyi dbyings su btagags par bya'oḥ de dag ni sngon du 'gro ba'i lta bsgom ting nge 'dzan yang dag par lam du khyer ba'o spyo don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi khog phub pa na sems kyi rang bzhin ye gdod ma nas stong nyid spros mtha' dang bral zhing rnam thar gsum gyis bdag nyid can phyi gzung ba'i yul rnam par dag cingaḥ nang ma rig long ma bstan gyi gol sgrib mtha' dag rtsad nas gcod cing chos sku mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ste 'chi ba 'od gsal dang po'i skur bzhengs ba'o de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin noḥ de don ma rtog pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje ye shes kyi mdangs nyi ma 'bum dus gcig la shar ba lta bu'i 'od gsal mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sbrangs ba ni longs sprod rdzogs pa'i sku dri ma dang bral ba'oX kun tu snang ba' ting nge 'dzin te bar do' snang ba sku gnyis pa ra sbyangs ba'o stong pa nyid dang kun snang ye shes kyi rang

mdangs su rgyu yi ge hūṃ dmar nag hrī yig gis mtshan pa can bkrag mdangs bzod par dka' ba rten med kyi mkha' la shar ba ni gzhan phan 'phrin las chags thog dang bral ba'i sprul sku'oX rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin te skye ba'i snang cha sku gsum pa'i 'dzar lor sad par byed pa'o rgyu'i yi ge de nyid las chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'od mthing nag nam mkha'i 'khor lo shar ba ni dbyings phyug ma'i mkha' 1nga rnam par dag pa'o de'i glong du bya grub ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'od ljang nag rlung gi 'khor lor shar ba ni yum dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha' klong ngo de'i steng me long ye shes rang mdangs 'od dkar gsal rak+ta'i rba klong rgya mtsho chu dang rnams dbyer ma mchis pa'i 'khor lor shar ba ni yum ma ma ga'i gsang ba'o de'i steng du mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'od ser nag zhing chen kyi sa gzhi'i 'khor lor shar ba ni yum sangs rgyas spyan ma'i klong ngoX de'i steng thams cad mnyam par brdal ba'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'od kha tog lnga ldan rus pa'i ri rab zur brgyad pa'i 'khor lor shar ba ni tshogs yul gyi mtshan ma rnam par dag pa'i dpa' bo dang

badz+ra: dpa' mo'i mkha' klong ngo de dag gi gshis su sor rtogs ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'od dmar nag me yi 'khor lor shar ba ni yum gos dkar mo'i mkha' klong mnyam nyid kyi da la ste phyi nang gi 'byung khams kyi zag pa zad cing dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med du brdal bar byed pa'oḥ 'byung ba rim brtsegs su bsgom pa'i bstan g.yos bag chags zad par byed pa'i don no slar yang rgyu yi sems dpa' las 'od lnga spyoḥgyi mtshan pa can rus pa'i ri rab gyi steng du chad pa lasaX rang byung lhun gyi grub pa'i gzhal med khang phyi nang gnyis su shar ba'i nang khang ye shes bzhi ldan dkar ser dmar ljang thog phub chos dbyings ye shes mtshon pa'i mthing rtsalaḥ tshad med rnam bzhi'i sgo rnams la 'phrin las bzhi'i 'jug pa dang ldan pa'i dbyibs dngaḥ thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i nyi zla'i sang skar rgyu brgyad sems kyi kwa gdan rus sbal gyi rnam pa theg pa brgyad mtshon ka ba rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa 'bras bu brgyad mchon gdung ma yid bzhin nor bu'i phras gtams pa chos phung brgya khri'i don rtags gral kheb gser

g.yu mu tig las grub paḥ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i don mtshon rta babaḥ'aphags lam brgyad dang ldan pa'i chos 'khor ji lta ji snyed kyi gzigs pa mnga' ba'i ri dwagasaX skye med kyi don la phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i gdugs chenaḥ nyon mongs pas rdzu mi zhugs pas ru mtshonaXbadud las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshanaḥ gzhan phan gyis skyabs mnga' ba'i rnga yabaḥ dgos 'dod lhun gyis grub pa'i sna tshogs rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed gser gyis pha gu be+eḍūr+ya'i shal buXdung gi mda' yabaX pad+ma rwa ga'i 'dod rnams la bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i mkha' 'gro'i sprin 'khrigs pa gdos mtshan las grol ba phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba ye shes lnga'i zer 'bar baḥ gzung 'dzin gyi rdul rnam par dag pa'oḥ phyi thod pa skam rlon rnyid gsum gyi rtsigs pa ngo rang thugs rje'i mtshon don bde ba 'bar ba'i rak+ta'i chag chag gdab paḥ gsal stong snyoms pas klad zhag gis zha la dang sprin thabs su sprar baḥ rtogs pa mi 'byur ba'i mtshon don 'ur mos gzer gdab paḥ mi g.yo dpa' ba'i khyung tshang gzhan snang 'dul ba'i chu srin gyi ya themaḥ bdag

—8rdo: snang gzhom pas sbrul nag gis ma themaḥ gti mug 'joms pa'i klu brgyad kyis ka gdanaḥ nga rgyal 'dul ba'i lha brgyad kyi ka ba phrag dog gcod pas gza' brgyad kyi ka zhu ma rig pa gzhom pa'i rgyu skar gyi grwal khebaḥ bde bar rol ba'i rgyu ma'i lda ldi rmongs pa dwang bral ba'i mig gi sbrul 'phyang0 gzigs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i tsit+ta'i pho toḥ thugs rje kun la snyoms pas zhing gi bla bre 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrul ba'oḥ de dag gnas khang gi mngon zhen ldog cang ye shes kyi klong la spyod pa'i skal pa bzang po 'jog pa'o gzhal med khang de'i dbus su srid pa las 'phags pa'i rin po che'i khriX chags pa dang bral ba'i pad+ma bde stong kha sbyor ba'i zla nyi zung du 'jug pa'i stengaḥ thogs bcas thogs med dga' brod snyems byed kyi mtshan ma dbyings su gzhig phyir bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i khar rgyu yi yi ge de nyid khra thabs su bab pa las rang byung chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs pa la gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig tu gyuraḥ de las 'od zer spro bsdus ma rig pa sbyangasaḥ ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'bar ba las

bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su dpal chen po gu ru drag po dmar nag me yi phreng ba can bde ba sbyin pa'i sku mdog dmar gsal mngon spyod ston pas cung zad gnags mdangs chags pa thugs rje khro la rngams pa'i zhal 'bar ba rjes chags dpa' ba'i rol rtags rta zhal ljang sngon mtsher ba rmong pa klu 'dul gyis khyung zhal sgrug nag 'bar ba gdug pa'i klu chen lnga sbrul gyi rnam par bza' zhing phyag gi gnas su son pa zhal nas rka ke dang kring kring hring hring sgrogs pa sa 'og 'byung po'i sma phab par byed paX sku gsum lhun gyi grub pas spyan gsum dmar la zlum paḥ bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i snyan dngaX don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i shang bug har baX tshad med rnam bzhi'i mche ba gtsig shing mnyam par rol pa'i ljags 'dril ba mtshan ma bsregs phyir smra smin las me yi tshwa tshwa spro ba dmar ser ral pa gyen du 'khyil zhing rdo rje phra mo 'khrigs pa sku lnga lhun grub du thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan la ye shes lnga ldan dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur baḥ nyi ma dang zla ba'i snyan cha bkra zhing gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa phyag g.yas dang po

—8rdo: na rdo rje rtse lnga pa gdeng zhing 'jigs tshogs lta dman zil gyis gnon paX g.yon phyag dang po'i lcags phur gzir bas dam sri pho mo'i snying khrag 'byin paḥgayas phyag gnyis pas dur phag bsdam pas sa 'og 'byung po'i tshogs zil gyis gnon pa phyag g.yon 'og mas sdig nag gtser bus rgyal bsen 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed paX sku rgyan nga rgyal rang grol glang gos stod g.yog dang mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i sked chings bde bar rol pa'i don rtags bya ba mthar phyin dar gyis dpyang pa ljang sngon 'phur ba phar phyin drug rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan cha spras pa lte bar chu srin gyi zhal ni thugs rjes 'gro ba rnams yar bar mi 'dor bar 'dzin cing sgrol stobs che ba dang mdzad pa'i 'phrin las chags thog dang bral bas 'brug stong ldir zhing glog stong 'khyugs pas sa gsum gyi srid pa g.yo mgul du byed pa sku smad dbal phur zur gsum me yi tsha tshwa 'phro bas 'byung po dam sri'i snying 'dar zhing sgog dbugs lhud paḥye shes kyi me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi mtshan ma bsregs par byed paX dwangs ma ye

shes kyi sku mtshan ma'i rdul rnam par dag pa 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin can noḥ lha de'i sku dbyings dwangs gsal rgya mtsho lta bu'i klong du rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang ldan pas chos kyi dal dbus su srung ba'i ra gur thugs rten gser gyi mchod rten tshon gang ba seng khri tshad med bum pa bre mgul chos 'khor gdug tog dang bcas pa rdzogs pa'i bum lter gnam lcags las grub pa'i rdo rje rwa gdeng me'i tsha tshwa 'phro baḥ de'i lte ba zlum po'i 1nga pad nyi'i khar khro chen gtsugs tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba ser nag g.yas gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo dngaḥ g.yon me rlung gi zhags pa bsdam pa dur khrod dpal chas kyi mdzes par spras shing shadas gnyis gyad kyis 'dor stabs su bsgrad paX de'i thugs klong gser gyi tsakra rtsib bcu pa la khro bo bcu rtag tu gnas shing mi g.yo bar srung skyobs mdzad pa kun gyi phyag mtshan phur pa 'dril zhing sku smad lcags phur zur gsum pa re phyogs skyong pho mo'i snying khar gzir baḥ de dag gi dbus su dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor ba'i dbus su dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi klong du phra mo'i sems dpa' hūṃ yig dmar

btsasdo: nag me 'bar baḥ khyad 'khor kyi ga le rtsa ba'i bla ma de rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par gsal gdabaḥ zla tshes kyi ga'ur yi dam rtsis gang cheḥ mgo tshag gi 1nga du dpa' bo dang mkha' 'groX ha khog nang du rtsa ba'i snying pot+t+waṃ ༷yig gi dbus bsrung bya de'i ming yig dang po rak+taḥrak+taḥganyis kyis brten paḥ g.yas ngos su bsrung bya pho rigasaX g.yon du mo rigasaḥ mdun du bu slobaḥ rgyab tu rta phyug 'khor g.yog nor longs spyod dang bcas pa gsal gdab ༷ phyirim za ra tshag las spros pas lcags kyi drwa ba mig mang ris su bkram pa sa 'dzin dang 'brel ba de dag thams cad kyang lcags kyi sdig phag dug khyung phra mo grangs med pas gtams pa dug gsum rang mtshan du gol ba'i gdon bgegs 'byung po nye mi nus pas rang bzhin can du dmigs thugs sa ga hūṃ dmar po'i mthar gsang sngags snying po 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar g.yas su dmar kyi li li 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis dreg pa can thams cad dbang du bsngas rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las gang bsam pa thams cad thogs med yid bzhin du 'grab par dmigasaḥ snying

po'i 'a chung gi nang du chos skyong rnams gsal la bran du bkol ༷ zhabs kyu'i nang du sde brgyad kyi snying po ar la gtad cing gnad la dbabaḥ dmigs pa'i gnad 'od zer gang la gzir yang thogs med du 'grub pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang 'dra'oḥ yang srung dmigs mi 'dra bas khyab parabum lter pad zla'i khar khro bo gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur dang de'i thugs gar gser gyi tsakra rtsibs bcu pa'i lte bar gnam lcags kyi rdo rje dang dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i ga'u thugs srog sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gong ltar gsal gdab rtsib la khro bcu dang bcas pa gsal ba'oḥshar gyi rtsa 'dab kyi sgo srung dpal gsang ba'i bdag po mthing nag khro chas can rdo rje dang sdig pa 'dzin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor dbang chen dmar nag thod dbyug dang sbrul zhags bsdam paḥ bde chen gyi 'khor lor 'jam dpal ser nag ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa kun kyang khro gtum rngams pa dur khrod kyis chas rdzogs shing zhabs gnyis gyad kyi stabs su rol zhing pad zlar brjes pa me rlung dud sprin 'tshubs ma'i dbus su gsal gdab sprul pa'i 'khor lor

gshā : mkha' 'gro sde lnga mthing dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i bkrag mdangs can gri thod 'dzin pa zhi ma khro 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan zhing rus rgyan dar dpyangs phag zhal bye mtshan pa dang bcas te zhabs gnyis kyi gar bsgyur gyis pad zlar rol zhing 'od lnga'i gur khang 'khrigs pa'oḥ chu srin gyis zhal dbus bde skyong 'khor lor khro bo yak+ka me dbal ljang nag tho ba dang zhags pa bsdam pa 'jigs rngams dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs shing zhabs gyad thabs kyis pad nyir rol pa'o gdul bya'i mos mtshor gzugs sku ru ngoms kyang don dam par sku lnga 'du 'bral ma mchis pas brda rtags bde ba'i rang bzhin ro ma dmar mor dbang chen gyi khro rdul 'khrigs pas chags pa dbang du sdud cing 'od gsal snyoms par byed doḥ stong pa'i bdag nyid rkyang mu dkar mor ye shes kyi phag mo'i dal sprin ltar 'khrigs pas stong pa mngon du byed cing rlung sems la dbang za baḥspyi gtsug ral pa'i gseb tu pad+ma thod 'phreng nam mkha'i mdog can kha ṭaṃ dang bhan+ta 'dzin pa gru mor thod pa'i rnga bkal ba'i sgras dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i spro bsdu 'gyed pa

gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug can pad zla'i gdan la zhabs mnyam par bzhengs pa'o de'i steng du ye shes me khyung dmar po rlung gi gshog pa can rngams brjid 'bar ba'i sku ru gsal laḥ rwa bar pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ze'u 'brur bla ma tshe dpag med dmar gsal longs sku'i rgyan chas can tshe mda' dang bum pa 'dzin pa 'dab ma stong la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong sprul sku'i cha byad can du gsal bar bya'o0 de dag ni sku gsum la 'du 'bral ma mchis kyang ye shes kyi gzigs pa gang yang nub med yin pas so phyi rim phyogs bzhir pad nyi ro gdan gyi khar shar du dus mtshan dmar mos chags pa dbang du sdud cing thogs bcas rang grol du byed pa lho ru dus sbyor sngon mos srid pa kha lo bsgyur zhing thogs med zil gyi gnon paX nub tu chags spyor smug nag 'khrul pa rmings nas bshigs shing dga' brod stong par byed pa byang du shug sgrol ser nag rlung sems dbu mar bsre zhing snyems byed thad gar sangs ba dur khrod kyi gnas la rgyu ba'i khro zhing gtum pa mkha' spyod kyi yul la dbang ba'i bde ba'i rnam 'gyur ngoms pa

06rdo cha gdul dka' 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags mi srun srin mo 'gres pa'i cha lugs can noḥ de rgyab sgo bzhir pad nyi rū tra pho mo'i khar shar du dbang phyug nag pos mtha' ma'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa lho ru tshe bdag 'bar bas bdud sde'i snying sgog 'dren paḥ nub tu badz+ra gī lis dam sri'i snying khrag 'khrun paḥ byang du bdud 'dul drag mos byad phur rbod gtong bzlog paḥ gdug pa 'dul ba'i cha nas khro zhing gtum paX skal ldan skyongs ba'i cha nas zur mig g.yo baḥ tshad med rang gdangs yin pas sgo bzhi skyongs baX 'khor 'das ro mnyam yin pas dam ye sna tshogasaḥ thams cad kyang sku snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal la der 'dzin dang bral ba snang stong me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur shes par bya'o khra gdan da phu po' mngon zhen bzlog phyi ra lha'i gsal snang 'dzin pa'oḥ dbang bskur ba'i lha rgyal ba rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas phyag na bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bkang ba 'dzin paḥ skal ldan gyi rgyad la gnas pas ye gnas ye shes la 'byer bas dbang basmar stsol bar bsam laḥ e mastoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang ba

mchog 'dzin pa0 mi phyed ye shes pad+ma he ru ga'i dbang bskur mchog de skal ldan rnams la stsol snying la zhugs nas ye shes rjen mthong mdzodaḥ ma sarbata thāg ta ma hās nu rā ga ṇa brnya badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma a bhi ṣiñtsa /༷a bhi ṣiñtsa saḥ zhes dbang bskuraḥ nye bar gnas pa'i lus dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la sku mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rjer rgyas gdabaḥ ngag sngags kyi dkyil 'khor la gsung mi 'gags pa'i rdo rjer rgyas gdabaḥ yid mnyam par gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thugs mi 'khrul ba'i rdo rjer rgyas gdab par bsam mo oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ha a nu rā ga na ka ya badz+racasaḥ wāk+ka badz+ra.āḥ cit+ta badz+ra hūṃX zhesargyas gdab ye shes kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' dang mnyam par sad de dam tshig pa la ro gcig tu gyur bar bsamaḥ dbyings rang bzhin gyi gdod nas rnam par dag pa las ye shes lhun gyi grub pa'i dal pad+ma he ru ga'i gsang ba gsum gyi phyag rgyar bzhengs nas dam tshig 'khor lo la sib sib bsdim moḥ spyan 'dren dmigs pa'oḥ smar yang bdag dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor snang stong zung 'jug gi rang bzhin la lha ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rig stong

—8rdo: thig le nyag gcig gi dal dang gnyis med ro gcig tu gyuraḥ bzhugasagasol gdab po yang lhag pa ting nge'adzin gyis dkyil 'khor la bdag bskyed las spros pas lha mo grangs med pas phyag mchod phul nas chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i lta ba mjal bar bsam moḥ gzhung ltar phyag mchod phul bdag bskyed las spros pa'i dbang po yul drug gi lha mo rnams kyis phyi mchod phul bas 'khor ba'i gnas stong par bsam mo yang 'dod yon lnga'ilha mo rnams kyis nang mchod phul ba'i 'khor ba'i yul stong par bsam mo yang dug lnga cer grol gyi lha mo lnga'i gsang mchod phul ba'i 'khor ba'i rgyu ka nas dag par bsam moX yang ma rig rtog gsum dang bral ba'i thugs kyilha mo matram̐ng ga'i dngos kun bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i mchod pa phul bas mthu dbang ye shes kyi dngos grub rtsol bar bsamaX gsung gis lha mo dmar mos chags pa dbyings grol gyi rak+ta tshar gsum phul bas dang pos nyon 'byul gyi rū tra bsgral gnyis pas bka' sdod dam can pho nya las la bskulaḥ gsum pas he ru ga'i dgyes pa bskang zhing srid gsum ka nas dag par

bsam moḥ sku'i lha mo dkar mo'i ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan pas dpal gyi mchod sdong bā lirnyi phul bas 'dod yon gyi zhen 'dzin rnam par dag cing lhan skyes bde ba chen pos ye shes mngon du gyur bar bsam moḥ ma dag pa'i rlung sems dhu tir chub cing kun rtog gi rang mdangs su shar ba'i chos thams cad 'dzad med nā da'i dbyings su bcing bas sgrol mchod dngaḥ me rlung gi thabs kyis bskul te nam mkha'i ba bzhus nas 'khor lo lnga yis gzhen nu thams cad la mnyam par spyor bas mchod pa phul te bcu drug gsum ldan gyis ye shes zag dang zag med kun mngon du gyur bar bsam la phul loḥ rab gsal ting nge 'dzin gyi rol mtshor shar bas rnam mang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas par spros te ting nge 'dzin mchod phulaḥ chos can gyi snang ba chos nyid kyi dbyings su cham kyi bzhag ste smra bsam brjod bral du gnas shing 'bul bzhes gnyis med kyi ngang skrongs ba de bzhin nyid mchod doḥ gzhung ltar mchod pa rgya chen por phul gzhan yang sku dam tshig gi phyag rgya rgyal ba rigs lnga so sor shes pa dang gsung

ga6she: chos kyi phyag rgya maḥhūṃḥswā eX ha rnams phyag rgya lnga'i phyag mthil du bkod pa dngaX thugs ye shes kyi phyag rgya chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid sor rtogs bya grub la blta ba'oX bca' ba las kyi phyag rgya rdo rje thugs bsten 'khor ba'i sa gnon sa lam mchog sbyin dgongs par mnyam bzhag mi 'jigs skyabs sbyin rdo rje gar bskor pad+ma 'bul skor mdud pa'i thar sbyar mun sel dril dkrol don gyi ye shes la yid ches glo thub ngo mtshar dang bcas pas bstod par bya'o gzhung ltar bstod pa byaḥ ting nge 'dzin gyis gzer ni lha'i gsal snang la gnad du bsnun par bya ba dang dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer ni thugs ye shes kyi lta ba la gnas par bya ba dang snyang po sngags kyis gzer ni bdag dam tshig sems dpa' la dmigs nas sngags gyer ba dang lha ye shes sems dpa' la dmigs te sngags bzla ba dang ting nge 'dzan sems dpa' la rtse gcig tu gtad te sngags bzla ba dang phra mos sems dpa' la dmigs nas sngags bzla ba dang sngagasaphreng lasa'od zer zla ba dkar 'phreng lta bus sgo gsum gyi rgyud sbyangs te sgrib pa dag par dmigs la bzla ba dang 'gal me'i 'khor 'o lngar bdag mdun gyi 'khor lo bzhir brgyad de mchod pas zer gyis 'khor

'das kyi dpal yon dwangs ma thams cad gcig tu dril la sngags bzla ba'o lus phyi nang gi khro bo khro mo rnams dang snod bcud 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi khro bo khro mo rnams kyis gsang sngags snying po'i rang sgra bung ba tshangs zhugs pa ltar bzlas pas 'dzadar 'das gasku mgul byed cing bstan gasku sa spyi dpal du gyur par dmigs laḥ sngags bzla'o spro bsdu phrin las kyi gzer ni snga dro 'od zer dkar po'i spro bsdu'i bdag gzhan gyi sgrib pa sbyangs shing 'jigs pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi bar dmigs laX nyin gong 'od zer ser po'i spro bsdu'i sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i rig 'dzin nyan rang dgra bcom pa rnams kyi mkhyen nus brtse ba'i yon tan phra rag thams cad bsdus te bstim pa dang lha dang drang srong 'khor los bsgyur rgyal mi dbang 'jig rten khams kyi dregs pa can klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal yon bkrag mdangs dngas bcud thams cad bstim pa dang nyi zla sa chu me rlung rtsi shing nags tshal sogs 'byung ba'i bcud thams cad gser mdog 'od kyi rnam par bsdus te bstim pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor

—snyed: nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan thams cad rgyas par bsam laXsngags bzla'oḥdagong mo 'od zer dmar po'i spro bsdu'i lha 'dre mi gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang stobs 'byor thams cad 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pas bskul te dbang du bsdu bar bsam pa dang khyad par zhi bas mi thul zhing mi srun drag po'i rigs can thams cad dbang du bsdus bran du bkol sgog snying 'phrog te bdag gis ci bcol ba'i bka' nyan par bsam la bzlas pa bya'o srod dus 'od zer ljang nag dang mthing ga'i spro bsdus 'gro drug gi g.yang sa chen po drug bcom par bsam pa dang nyon mongs pa'i bdud bzhi sdang med du ar la gtad pa dang ma rig pa'i dgra gsum mngon spyod drags po sgo nas tshar bcad de rlung sems dbu ma sgra gcan gyi dbyings su nub par byas la sngags bzla dus la bab tshe rgyal po'i pho nya lta bu'i 'dzab rgyun gyis lhag pa'i lha'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i dbang byin dngos grub thams cad bsdu ba dang bskul dmigs la nan du brtson zhing 'dzab dbyangs dal la ring bar bzlas la stong tshig gis mchod

bstod sogs byas mthar hūṃX pad+ma drag po rig 'dzin rnamasaḥ yal yol btang snyom mi mdzad paraḥ thugs mchog dpal gyi be'u nasaX ye shes gsang ba'i nyi ma sboraX deng seng skya rangs dang po shar dngos grub stsol len dus la babaḥ mi zad sku dang 'gags med gsungaḥ 'khrul pa bral ba ye shes thugs re bskong yon tan 'phrin las dpalaḥ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang dngos grubaX ma lus dus 'dir sirnyi s+t+waṃ thun mong sngagasakyi grub pa brgyad khyad par mchog gi dngos grub kun skal ldan sgrub mchog pho mo la nye ba nyid du stsol bar mdzodaḥ sirnyi pha la a la la hoX de dag ni dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi rol par la bzla zhing lam du khyer ba'o phyi don gsum pa rjes kyi ram pa laḥ ma da na da me sa gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams dum gcig ga snod du bsags te brda dang brda len sogs spros la byin gyis brlabs pa ni bdag he ru ga'i banyam bzhag gi ting nge 'dzin las byin rlabs kyi chu byung bas tshogs kyi bag chags bgrus ye shes kyi me byung bas tshogs kyi mtshan ma bsregasaḥ shes rab las rjang byung bas tshogs kyi dngos po gtoraḥ lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin las

badz+ra: sku'i bdud rtsi dkar por bsgyur gsung gi bdud rtsi dmar por spelaḥthugs kyi bdud rtsi mthing dkar spros te rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang shing rnal 'byor bas chags nyams dag ste sems can gyi tshogs chen po rdzogs par bsam mo nam mkha' mdzod sngags brjod chos nyid gdod nas dag pa'i klong las chos can cir yang 'char ba'i dga' ston tshogs la rnam mang ye shes kyi gzigs pa mnga' ba'i rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dga' ston 'bul ba'i zhing du byon par bsam laXtshogs zhing spyan 'dren bya 'dod yon gyi lha mo lnga'i phyag na gser dngul zangs lcags rin po che'i gzhong par tshogs ston nam mkha'i mtha' klas par spros te tshogs zhing gi dal du phul bas rnal 'byor bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bsam laḥdang po phud 'bul bdag mtshan du rtog pa'i dbang gis phyi so thar gyi sdom paḥbar byang sems kyi bslab bya nang gsang sngags kyi dam tshig las 'gal 'das nyams chags zhig ral ci song ba thams cadapa shes dza(gas kyi 'khor ma la brten nas bshags sbyangs byas pas sgrib tshogs mtha' dag

dang bral bar bsam laḥ bar bgags phul snod nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong du bcud khams gsum gling bzhi srid pa'i dpal yon thams cad tshogs ye shes kyi rol bar dmigs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul bas dgyes pa bskyed par bsam laḥ bskang ba bya sngags kyi masga go kur pa thogs te sgrol ba po bdag pad+ma drag po rta khyung zil gnon rtsal du gsal gdab bsgral rdzas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra sde dngos su gsalaX sgrol byed sras mchog badz+ra kai la ya dngos su gsal gdab laḥ 'gugs gzhugs nan du bya tshad med rnam pa bzhi'i rang mdangs lha mo lcags zhags sgogs dril mas dgra bgegs 'gugs 'ching sdom phyos kyi las byed par bsam laḥ zlokhribadz+ra aṅku sha dzaX dzaḥhūṃḥbaṃḥ༄steḥ zhes brjodaḥ'akhor 'das bdag he ru ka la bstim pas byed pa po gso bstan g.yo 'byung ba'i dngas bcud srasaphur la bstim pas gdab pa'i mtshon gsoḥkhams gsum gyi dgra bgegs thams cad dmigs pa'i yul de la bstim pas bsgral ba'i yul gso ba'oḥ gzhung gi bsgral ba bya phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying khar gdab pas bla rten skyal ba 'dra ba la theb te dngas bcud dkar mer gyis phur pa la

—8rdo: thim pas bkrag mdangs bskyed par bsamaḥyang phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying khar gdab pas khrag gi dngas ma rgya sran gyi gong bu 'dra ba de bsregs shing bskamaḥrlung gi dang ma bye'u leb ma'i mgo tsam lta bur gnas pa de sku dbyings su bsdusaX tshe rten ba spra 'dra ba'i dbus su rnam par shes pa mar me rlung gi ma bskyod pa lta bu'i bkrag mdangs can zloḥljang gis rnam par gnas pa de tsen gyis blang nas bdag he ru ga'i thugs gar thim pas tshe bsod rgyas par bsamaXslar rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo ā dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam par 'ub kyis bsdus te khong seng nas sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma sbyangasaḥgatsug tor gyi 'khor lo nas thon te 'og min gyi dbyings la mnga' dbang mdzad pa'i he ru ka yab yum gyi sbyor 'tshams su thim pas sras bde ba chen por sangs rgyas par bsam laḥ.a phaṭaX a phaṭaḥ.a phaṭaḥ gdab sngags bshe da dril bu shes rab yum gyi mkha' la rdo rje thabs mchog yab kyis gtun bus dgra bgegs kyi phung po brdung te sha khrag rus gsum dmar nyog gi 'thag nas khams gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags

stong par bsam mo drag sngagasaso lnga brjod la rngams rol du bya'o phyi ltar zhal stong pa nyid kyi to khung du bcud khams gsum yongs bsgral du byas la bstabs so nang ltar shesarab chen po'i zhal ho du sgo gsum rnam dag du bsgral la bstabs so gsang ba klong chen ye shesagyi zhal hodu dug gsum cer grol du bsgral nas 'bul bar bya'oḥ gzhung ltar bstabs pa bya bye da stong gsum dang mnyam par bcud dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sman zas nor 'dod lnga'i phung por dmigs nas gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang rdo rje chos skyongs ba'i srung ma rnams kyis dgyes pa bskang bar bsam laḥ gnam phud bya bdag dam tshig sems dpas tshogs ye shes kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod pas nyon 'khrul gtan nas dag cing nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam la drang ba 'bul bzhes bdo dang brda len grub phral smon lam rnam dag tu gdab po bdag he ru ga'i ya rkan trīḥlas rta mgrin ma rkan baṃ las phag mo yas kyi so rnams dpa' bo mas kyi so rnams dpa' mo ljags bde ba chen po'i dal zhal chab dga' bzhi'i bcud dngas ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma mā stoḥ dza hā baṃḥhoḥ

—8rdo: lha rnams mnyam par sbyor bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun lhag gtor la reg pas dug gsum rnam par dag pa sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtshoḥ rus pa'i gram khrod tshil zhun mar khus rgya mtsho ru 'khyil par bsam moX 3 āmāṃ ha ho trī lan gsum gyis spel loḥdapa' bo 'bod pa'i rkang gling dang dpa' mo bskul bas bshud glu'i sgras rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas lhag sdud kyi pho nya rnams dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs shig byon shig e a ra li hring hring pho phe ཿ gzhung ltar lhag ma gtong gtor snod bhan+ta lcang lo can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dgra bgegs gang yin pa de dngos su gsal laḥ na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dngaḥ yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtshoḥ ma gnas gsum gyidapa' bo mkha' 'groḥ rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus thad du lang ba'i dgra bo de mtha' rtsa ste rgyad dang bcas pa rnams sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig lan gsumaḥdzaḥhūṃmaXhoḥ dbyings nas mtshon thun gyi char phab pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus

gsum nam mkhar mnyam pa'i sprin du gyuraḥ 34 ādza : ha ho hrīḥ chos skyong gi gtor ma dang bskul gtor rnamasal de ltar 'gug bstim byas la gsolas dang bskul ba gang 'dod ltar gtong ngo bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen gyi ting nge 'dzin du gnas te dgongs pas gzir tsa na rgya bal bod yul kyi dregs pa can thams cad sngon gyi tha tshig dran nas 'dar yed yed du 'dus la rdo rje'i dam bsgrags kyi bka' nyan zhing gsung sdod par bsam la dam bsgrags 'don g.yar dam gyi pho nya rnams kyis rin po che'i sgod sna tshogs thog te bdag nyid dpal chen pos brngan du 'bul bas gtor ma blang zhing ci bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub po zhes snying nye bar bsamaḥ chad tho gtong pad+ma he ru ga'i 'khor na gnas pa'i bdag nyid chen mo la sogs pa'i bdud mo bzhi dang gang dkar sha med la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin bzhi dngaX kong btsun de mo la sogs pa'i sman mo bzhi rnams la rang rang gi sprul pa sman bran 'bum phrag dang bcas te da la'i rgyab dar gyi yol ba bkram pa'i phag tu 'dus te dril rta mang po khal sdang du btags dpon g.yog mang pos pus btsug tu gnas mang po rnams kyis

—8rdo: bzhes lhag bshal chab rgya mtsho 'jing nam bas kyang rgya che ba zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsgyur ba de kun gyis spyi nor du bzhes la sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bsal ba dngaX sdom pa dam tshig srung ba dang / lta log gi bstan pa bsgrub pa dngaḥ rnal 'byor pas bzhed don sgrub par zhal gyi bzhes te gus 'dud kyi rnam 'gyur dang bcas te 'khod par bsam laḥ bstan ma 'bul rang gnas su gshegs par bsamaX don dam stong nyid kyi sgrom rgyar rlo'am tri las dam sri 'gab 'dre thams cad mngon sum du rkang lag lcags gzer gyi btab bzhin gnas par bsamaḥ bro 'gugs bya rim dgu sa yi 'og rol gru gsum gshin rje'i lto ba thar med btson khang nag poraḥ las ngan dam sri thams cad 'dus par bsam laX rta bro bya 'phar ldang g.yo mgul bros thar gab yul thams cad dang bral bar bsamaḥ bro sngags brjod bstan pa'i sbyin bdag thams cad mnga' thang dar ba dngaḥ bshad sgrub kyi sgo phyogs kun nas rab tu rgyas pa dngaḥ rnal 'byor ba'i sku tshe ring zhing chab srid 'phel ba dngaḥ gsang sngags snying po phyogs dus kun tu dar

zhing rgyas la bkra shis par gyur cigaḥgator sgod btags la smon lam brjod don dam par skye med dbyings kyi ho khung chos kyi dbyings mthing gsal zlum po me long ye shes dkar gsal zlum po mnyam nyid ye shes ser gsal gru bzhi sor rtogs ye shes dmar gsal zla gamaX bya grub ye shes ljang gsal gru gsumaḥnyon mongs gti mug gi 'khrul snang bsregs pas rang byung ye shes lhun grub nyon mongs zhe sdang gi rtogs tshogs bsregs pas zhi ba chags bral nyon mongs nga rgyal gyi 'khrul snang bsregs pas mnyam nyid lhun 'thug nyon mongs 'dod chags kyi kun rtog bsregs pas dbang chen bde mnyamaX nyon mongs phrag dog gi rba klong bsregs pas bya grub rtsal rdzogasaXrmongs sgrib bral ba'i 'od zer mthing gaḥsnying stobs dag pas 'od zer dkar poḥrgyag sems dben pas 'od zer ser boXrdul dang bral ba'i 'od zer dmar po rlung min sangs ba'i 'od zer ljang ku gzugs phung grol ba'i bsregs rdzas yam shing tshor phung dben pas bsregs rdzas mar khu 'du shes 'joms pas bsregs rdzas shing togaḥ'adu byed bzlog

—8rdo: pas bsregs rdzas yungs dkar rnams shes phung grol bsregs rdzas rnam brgyad doḥ zhi bas me lha snying rje chen po rgyas pa'i me lha byams pa'i 'od zeraḥdabang gi me lha dga' ba'i 'dzum 'baraḥ drag po'i me lha btang snyoms tshad med lhun grub me lha stong pa'i dbang phyug zhi bas 'dod gsol thogs bcas rang grolaḥ rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol thog med klong grol dbang gi 'dod gsol dga' brod shar grol drag po'i 'dod gsol snyems byed rang grol lhun grub 'dod gsol kun gzhi ye grolaḥ de lta bu'i don dang ldan pas thabs kyi bsregs blugs la mkhas na don gyi ye shes 'bar ba'i klong chen po mngon du gyur nas mtshan ma'i bud shing thams cad bsregs nus shing gzung 'dzin gyis brdzi mi zhugs pa'i dgos pa yod doḥ thabs la mkhas pas las bzhi'i sregs blugs kyang 'bul bar bya'o don dam par gzhi la 'khrul pa med pas 'khrul snang gzhi ru bzlog sna tshogs skye ba'i snang ba skye med klong du bzlog 'chi 'phos 'gags pas snang ba 'gags med klong du bzlog sna tshogs gdos pos snang ba yod mtha' bral bar

bzlogaX stong lta had por blta ba med mtha' bral ba bzlog chos khams rgya mtsho'i snang ba chos nyid chen por bzlog chos sku gcig tu blta ba phyogs las rgyal bar bzlogaḥ'apho bsgrod 'gro ba'i snang ba ma skyes dmigs bral klong du bzlogaḥ gcig nas gcig tu 'ong ba kun rtog rmongs bral bzlogaḥ lta ba phyogs las rnam rgyal don gyi zhi bzlog cheḥbasgom pa 'od gsal ris med khro rgyal stobs bzlog dngos spyod pa ro snyoms dam pa sna tshogs than bzlog steḥ bzlog pas dgos don go ba chen pa'oḥ don de rtogs pas gas bzlog rnams bya'oḥ srid pa gzhir bzhengs kyi rgyal po snang srid ye mnyam du sad nas 'gyu snang la grol cha 'dzoms pa sprul skuḥ 'od gsal la sangs cha 'dzoms pa'i longs skuX gnas pa la dngas cha ldan pas chos skuḥ dang po snang stong zung 'jug bum dbangaḥ gnyis pa gsal stong zung 'jug gsang dbang gsum pa rig stong zung 'jug tshig dbang sku mi 'gyur ba oṃ kyi mtshan pa lta ba'i rdzong gsung mi 'gags pa ā'i mtshan pa bsgom pas 'phrang thugs mi 'khrul pa hūṃ gi mtshan pa spyod pa'i stong srog 'phrog pa'oX de don rtogs

—8rdo: pa'i dngos grub rang gzhung ltar du blang ngo ho dpal ldan bla ma rta khyung drag po rtsal thugs mkhyen gzigs kyi ye shes can bdag la dgongs su gsol bdag mtshan bzung ba'i 'dod chags kyi dbang gis so thar dang 'galaḥ gzhan snang bltas pas zhe sdang gi byang sems dang 'gal gnyes snang 'thas pas gti mug dang dug gsum cha mnyam gyi dbang gis sngags kyi dgongs spyod zab mo dang 'gal bas las thams cad la gnong ngoX 'gyod doḥ mi 'chab mi zed par bshags sbyangs bgyid lags na 'didang phyima'i sgrib par mi 'gyur bar tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsolaḥ bzod gsol phul don dam par skye med kyi dbyings la chags nyams rtog sgrib ma byung ma skyes pas na rang byung ye shes mtha' bral chen por la zlos par bgyid naḥ bshags bya bshags byed gnyis su med pa'i 'od gsal chen po la gdengs thob par bya'oX sku gsum yeshesi kyi lhar snang dang mnyam rjes nyin mtshan kun tu bsre ba'i dran pa ye bab chen po laḥ bzhugs gsol gdab zhes pa'oḥ bdogashadags snying po'i nyag bran du gyur pa'i zag dang zag med

mi g.yo ba'i dge sogs bzang ngan bar gsum chos nyid mnyam pa'i 'khor lor bsre zhing chos can rang byung ye shes su sad par bya ba ni bsngo ba dang smon lam mo lugs 'byung gi chosathams cad lugs sdog de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su kun gzhi'i rmongs sgrib dang bral bar chos sku mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lo'i nang dbyings bzung ba ni rtags mtha' bsal ba'oḥslar rjes thob kyi spyod pa thams cad rig gdangs ye shes su blta zhing bden med sgyu ma'i rtsal sbyangs la mkhas shing gzugs sku'i gzhan don ro mnyam chen por dngas du blang ba ni chad mtha' bsal ba'o chos nyid lta ba'i ye gdangs chos skur khyer ba dngaḥ rang bab rgyun gyi 'od gsal longs skur bsre ba dang gnas snang shar grol rjen pa sprul skur gzigs pa ste thams cad dag mnyam chen rnge ra mjal ba'i shis brjod rgya chen po bya chags pa dang bral ba'i me tog gi sil ma bkram 'bras bu la yid smon med pa'i don gyi smon lam gdab shar grol ris med du 'char ba'i bden tshig brjod par bya'oḥ yemaḥ rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje che chags bral snang ba mtha' yas gar bde sbyin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal ye shes gzigs ldan he ru ga'i rang las mi gzhan rgyal tshab laḥ rang rig

—8mi: don gyi pha phog gtadaḥ gang snang brda dang gdamasapar bstan khyad par pad+ma rak+ta'i klong mnyam nyid dbang gisad la nas gdul byas bskul ba'i thug rje skye lasa'aphrosadabang gi zab gter 'phrad gang gi gshed du gang snang ba pad+ma drag 'khros zil gnon rtsal yang snying thugs gter 'du pa 'di mkha' 'gro'i snying thig min re gan skal ba dman la mi 'chor bar rig 'dzin yongasakyi dpal du shog dge bsnyen thang lha yar bzhud dang phrin las dung gi phreng ba can dam tshig ldan pasapho nya la bka' rtsa'i phyag rgya'i gdab ste gtadaḥ bya ra mel che'i so kha srung dbang chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangasagyi gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin mdzad pas khyung drag rtsal dang 'phrad par shogaḥsamashāḥrgya rgyargyaḥgaltar rgya gtadargya sbas rgya zabargya gsang rgya gurgya brda thimaḥlhaḥ ces pa 'di'ang lung zinamishisamatshan can gyis bkra shis lha reg rin chen gnyis pa phun tshogasakyi grangs ldan bcas te bskul ba dang nye gnasabla ma mthar phyin rdo rjes dbang gi lha dar rin chen g.yu byur du mas skyes dang bri gzhi shog dkar bcas bskul ba dang dge rganamyan sel nas kyang sku gsung thugs mtshon gyi gos dar ras yug gi skyesabacas yang yang bskul ngor kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byer klong yangasardzogs pa chen po' nye lam la spyod pasakhrag 'thung nusaldan rdo rjebadud 'dul khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda mdzod las zhal bzhus te dag
par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni snying slob byumasachosanas bgyi pa thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu dge zhing sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rgyur gyur cigaḥ sarba ma la/

—8rdo: dgos gnad kyimachod byang niḥ bshos bu nor bu mig dgu la mda' dar dang shing rtsi bal tshon brgyan 'o phud dang shel tshig bshams phralaḥ a ka ros spel te snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do kye chos dbyings nam mkha' stong pa'i klong dkyil nas mtha' bral 'ja' tshon mig mang ris su bkrams chags pa'i rdul bden sna tshogs padre'i tshalaḥsna bdun rat+na'i gzhal med khang mdzes nangaX dga' bdeli'od gsal 'khyil ba'i da la nasaḥ lha dbang bu mo mdzes pas gzugs legs maḥ sngon gyi tha tshig dran mdzod da tshur byon sna tshogs dar dpyangs pad 'phreng rgyan bzang klubasaḥrdzu 'phrul thog med rlung gi rta la bcibs dbyar gyi rgyal mos chibs sna drangs byas teX 'ja' sprin sbrang char rol mo'i sgra dang bcas ra sa ya na'i grogs su da pheb bzhugasaX yid sprul taing 'jin dpa' mkhar 'dir gzigs la drug ldan sgyu lus zag pa mi mnga' yang brtse ba'i zur mig g.yos pa'i mod la ni bde stong spros bral 'od gsal rtogs pa 'baraḥbadag gis sgyu lus zag zad ngo mtshar gnas lha yi a mṛ rgyas gdab sku drin che dam pa'i

chos gter mi nub sgon me'i 'od lha sman 'bum bcas dpal rir 'god nus na bdag grogs mched kyi gdul zhing e ma ho dam tshig 'di la dgong mdzod drin ldan maḥces ma hā de wi garma mu tra e rda rat+na bā ling ta khā hiḥ lan bdun gyis phul tshe 'dzum mdangs bstan na brten pa'i dal la bzhugs par mosaḥ sam māḥ a ka ros gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te kye grangs med gong nas smon lam sems bskyed dag 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel la zhal bzhes pasaḥ gsang srog dag pa chos nyid byin thob cingaḥ o rgyan rgyal tshab spyi bor len mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod bde sbyin lha mo bcu drug lasaḥ gcig ni dgongs sngon nam mkha'i klong na bzhugasaḥ gsang ba'i mtshan gsol me tog man+ta raḥ gcig ni laji can gyi yul du bzhugs gsang ba'i mtshan gsol rma bya'i gtsug phud bcing0 gcig ni mdangs ldan rgya mtsho'i dkyil du bzhugasaḥ gtsug na'i bu mo a lcam bzhin bzang maḥ gcig ni rma g.yang nor bu'i brag la bzhugs pad+ma'i thod can gter gyi bdag mor grags gcig ni gnyan mo'i khyung tshang brag na bzhugasaX rlung gis gshog ldan dung khri dkar mor

—8rdo: gragasaX gcig ni tsha ba rung gi mthil na bzhugasaḥbade ba'i gar 'byugs g.yu yi sgron ner gragasaḥgacig ni lto brag pad+ma'i mtsho la bzhugasaḥrdo rje'i spyan gcig g.yu yi sgron mer gragasaḥgacig ni tsa ri gsang ba'i sdong na bzhugasaḥrta gdong sman gyi gol gol zhes su gragasaḥgacig ni lho mon 'bras mo ldongs na bzhugasaX gzigs pa stong ldan g.yu ring zhes su gragasaX gcig ni sbas yul spa gro stag tshang bzhugasaX lde mig stong 'dzin pad+ma'i mig ring gragasaḥgacig ni sbas yul grib btsan lung du bzhugasaḥgri rgod btul ba'i ha lcam dbang mor grags gcig ni sbas yul longs gsum tshal du bzhugs gsang ba'i mtshan gsol khams gsum stong sgrol btags0 gcig ni sbas yul spa ma me rung bzhugasaḥmakha' spyod bde sbyin pad+ma klong stobs grags gcig ni yar lung shel gyi brag tu bzhugasaḥgasang ba'i mtshan gsol lha dga' lcam mor grags gcig ni ngan sngags grub pa'i yul du bzhugasaḥgang la'ang thogs med rdo rje dbang bsgyur grags gcig ni sidhi ya na'i drung na bzhugs 'phur ldan bdud

rtsi'i dbang mo zhes su gragasaX khyed cag dbyar dam can gyi spun sring steḥ bdag ni pad+ma rgyal po'i gdung tshob yinaḥ brda tshig pho gyi 'bod la mi gsan namaḥ bcu drug ltag bskrod sgra la mi dgyes samaḥ bshud pa rdo rje'i glu la ces mi pheb ༷ ra sa ya na'i grogs la g.yel mi 'tshalaḥrtog bcas sgyu ma'i lus kyi mi mthong yang sa thob sngags kyi dbang po'i spyan snga rtsa glu tshig 'ja' 'gyus rol mo dri bzang bcas gsang chen da la lan gsum bskor bzhin duḥ khams drug sgyu lus dngos po med mod kyangaX yid rig nyams kyi phyag rgya bde ba'i gzugasaḥ dkyus ring spyan zur 'dzum pa'i dpal tsam gyisaḥ bdag lus bde ba'i mes zhu dwangs mar sad gzhan phan pañtsa a pra grub mthar phyinaX rang rang sprul pa lha sman 'bum 'bum bcas nged tsho mkha' spyod gling du 'tshogs so zhesaX pad+ma'i lung gis bsngags so skal ldan tshogasaḥ thugs mthun dam rdzas phud gtor 'di bzhes la bde nas bde bas rtser son mthar phyin mdzodaḥ shā panya ma hā o ṣa dhi sarba cit+ta hrīng trīng dzaḥ e rda bā ling ta khā tweX eḥ chos dbyings nam mkha' bsam gyis mi khyab bde

—8rdo: ba chen pos klong yangs su ye shes gzigs ldan rlung gis rta byas 'khor 'das snang bar mnga' dbang bsgyur chags thogs bral bzhin dngos kun dngas ma bdud rtsi ye shes bcud du dril 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub bdag la stsolaḥ bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid nyi ma phyogs dang ris med yongs khyab brdalaḥ dge mtshan dam pa des kyang bdag cag dpon slob dge ba'i bkra shis regagaḥ zhes spro na lan gsum brjod 'di'ang rdzun rkyal nus ldan pas 'byul nyams la shar ba yig gzugs su bkod pa 'i mthun rkyen snying nor rmāshāsabagyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥsabo masgom/

—8rdo: smosgomidz+nyā/r+sha bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i khang 'phang la brda sgo dbye ba niḥ eḥ ye nas rdul bral chos sku mkha' khyab 1nga 'khor 'das ris med mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang blo yi dbang gis ji bzhin klong ma gyur gting gsal ye shes rjen pas brda' sgo dbye ma dz+nyā na tsakyu pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ brda phyag 'tshal ba niḥhoḥ nye ring mi dmigs chos sku thugs rje can phyogs dang ris bral rta khyung drag po'i zhalaḥ kun mkhyen kun gzigs ga ga ma'i ye shes laḥ rang rig lta ba mjal bas phyag bgyi'oḥ sa ma ya na mo (ཿ dam 4'a bzung ba ni nyi gdod nas dag pa'i chos nyid ris med kyang rjes su chags pas 'khor ba dbyings su bsre don dam rig stong zung 'jug lhag pa'i lhaḥ srog gi gta' ru mi gtong 'dzin bgyi'o sa ma ya tsit+ta badz+ra (ཿ skyab 'gro ni na moḥ 'dus ma byas pa chos sku 'od mtha' yas rang gsal 'od lnga longs sku nam mkha' rgyalaX thugs rje chags bral sprul stu pad+ma 'byung dbyer med rta khyung lha la skyabs su mchi sems bskyed niḥ ho sems kyi 'ching rgya gzung 'dzin lam byed cingaX mu bzhir gol ba'i mkha' khyab yid can kun nang

dbyings sku gsum sa la 'god bya'i phyiraḥ yi dam pad+ma drag khros bsgrub par bya tshogasabasags ni na mo chos kun ye mnyam dag pa rab 'byams laX rang gsal rtogs pa 'bar bas phyag bgyi'oḥ kun bzang rang grol rgyan rdzogs mchod pa 'bulaḥ a 'thas sems kyi dri ma phyag bgyi'oḥ sang chen nam mkha' mdzod la rjes yi rangaḥ gang 'dul mdzad pa nub med chos 'khor bskul zang thal dbyings su 'pho med gnyug mar bzhugs dge tshogs 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngoX 'gro kun rang rig mngon gyur byang chub shogaX byin 'beb niḥ hū hūṃ hū mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nasaX rtsa gsum spyi gzugs bla ma rdo rje 'changaX ye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bzang mngon bstan nas dngos kun bdud rtsi grub pa'i gzi byin phobaX zla gam dgu rdzogs me ri 'bar 1nga nasaX yi dam sgrub rgyud dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho kun rjes chags rol gar bde ba'i mdangs ngoms la dngos kun bdud rtsi grub pa'i gzi byin phob bde ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma brtsegs sang nasaḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro rigs sngags zhing skyes bcas

—8rdo: dga' bde'i 'dzum ngoms brtse ba'i mig g.yo bzhinaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsi grub pa'i gzi byin phobaX dam tshig zab srung bka' gsang pho brang nasaḥ ma mgon lcam dral dregs pa sde lnga dngaḥ ye shes las la grub pa thams cad kun bdud rtsi grub pa'i 'phrin las gzi byin phobaḥ lha ma 'jig rten yongs la dbang bsgyur bsaX tshangs dbang rtsi bcud 'byung ba'i lha mo sogs sman gyi pho nyar zhal bzhes thams cad kyisaḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir grub pa'i gzi byin phobaX rtag dang mtshan ma bzang po bstan pa dngaḥ lha 'dre mi gsum sde brgyad dbang du bsdusaḥ ra sa ya nas rang 'bras mngon gyur teḥ rig 'dzin zhing la spyod pa'i gzi byin phobaḥ ( he ru gam hā.a dṛta pañtsa kro dhas pā ri wa ra badz+ra a be sha ya a sa mchod dzos byin masaniḥ hrīḥ gzhong pa rin chen pad+ma'i yol ko dang mtshan ldan bhastor bkod pa'i rdzas rnams lasaḥ ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rol ston bsam yas sprosaX mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bskang phyir 'bulaḥ 37 āḥhūṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a phro ta hūṃ trītha snyen āḥ/ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hrī4tshan āX/ ma hā ba

ling ta te dz+wa bā ling ta bā la bā te gu rgya hrī shā sa ma ya hūṃ hrī khyuḥ o ā hūṃ ma hā sto dhi tsit+ta sta na ga na gu h+ya sa ma ya swā hāḥ tsheḥsaXswā eḥnya rluḥleḥme spyo rtaḥ badz+ra byu dza spa ra ṇa khe gagasapa niḥ hoḥ ma rig sgrib gol sdug po'i dbang gyur te bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gsal la 'gal byed pa'i byang rgod 'thor 'byams rtog pa'i dri ma kun sgrib bral rig pa zang thal rjen par bshagasaX badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ de ltar sngon 'gro legs grub nasaḥdangosagazhi rjes rim tshangasab yis bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor nyamasasu len grub pa mthar phyin chud mi zaḥsamag rgya rgya rgya nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nu ldan ga ma drag gling pa'i mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda' mdzod la bsgyur ba dge legasa'aphelaḥsarba ma le/

—8rdo: sgrub pa go po'i dugasu zhi dmigs niḥ rang pad+ma drag por gsal ba'i thugs srog 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed bskulaḥ lha tshogs de dag las spros pa'i 'od zer gyi phyi nang gi 'byung ba'i rgud pa dus kyi ru 'dzing 'khrugs rtsod nad mug rnal 'byor ba'i chags nyams rtog sgrib rten 'brel nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi nas legs pa'i yon tan du 'byor ba'i phrin las grub par dmigs la rtsa sngags mthar ra sa ya na a dṛ ta sidhi hriX dmigs bsal dang rten 'brel nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad shin+ta ku ru ye swā ྅ dbang gi dmigs pa ni rang pad+ma drag por gsal ba'i thugs sgog 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed bskul lha tshogs de dag las dbang gi 'od zer tsha la rtsubs pa rno la myur ba 'phros khams gsum gyi phywa g.yang stong gsum gyi mnga' thang thams cad me re re bsdus nas bdag gi dbang du 'gyur ba dang mi min lha srin dregs pa can thams cad bran du khol teḥ mthong khol mngon gsum du 'byung gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dngaḥ rigs sngags zhing stes kyi rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kun kyang zhal nye zhingaX

—8rdo: gol ba'i gdon tshogs thams cad ar la gtadaX 'khrul snang dbyings su bor ༷ bag chags kyi sbubs las grol grol gzhi'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs reg pas phan bde byams sems la 'byor drag sngags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo grogs su snang zhing 'khru ldog gdug sems ldang med du byas nas 'gro drug gi g.yang sa stong ste bdud bzhi thad gar chod nas dgra gsum g.yo med kyi dgongs pas mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par bsam la rtsa sngags mthar dmags bsamaḥ ra saya na.a dṛ ṭ+wāṃ sirnyihrīḥ sarba bisnem raya phaṭaswā hāX sgrub pa chen pos dus su nye bar mkho ba'i las bzhi'i dmigasarim khyad par myong grol gyi dus su kha 'phang la nye bar mkho phyiranu ldan pas smras te me shis brisapa dgeḥsarba ma
