ra mi: bdun dang maṇ+ḍal phyag mchod phul gus 'dud zhe sa bcas te gsol gdab ni kye hoX ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs rgol 'joms bdud 'dul dpa' bo dgongasaḥ bdag gzhan don du he ru ga'iḥ sa yi cho ga gnang bar zhu lan gsumaḥbla mas bka' gnang niḥ e maḥ skye ba tshe rabs sngon rol nasaḥ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i las 'phro can gsang ba las kyang chas gsang bsaḥ dal zhal phye ba ngo mtshar cheḥ khyed kyi bzhed don bdag sgrub na tshogs dang mchod pa rgya cher sprosaḥ sgo gsum bag phob gzu bor gnas 'jig rten //da ngan 11ngas shig buX zhes gdams la sa lha'i gtor ma skyems bcas rnam lnga'i bskor te bshams thog mar yul gzhi'i bdag po la gtor skyems phul zhang sa bslang ba ni hūṃ dza bkra ༷/sa sa gzhi byin chags 'dir gnas pa'i yul skyong zo dor dregs pa pho mo rnamasaḥ pad+ma'i dam bsgrags tha tshig 'dir 'dus la rta khyung drags pos dam tshig mnos par gyis sgrub pa zab mo dbu nas mthar phyin bar phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang bsnen zhing smrab la 'bras bu 'byung ba dngaX sbin bdag bkra shis dpon smob ska tshe bsrings mdzad pa

phula'adod gsol niḥ ho sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes laḥ sgrub pa zab mo nyid dbu 'dzug nas mthar ma phyin gyi bar du phyi yi bar chad nang du mi gtong zhing nang gi dngos grub phyi ru mi yal ba'i srungs mtshams kyi brin las dam pa mdzod cig dkar po lha'i rigs me lha 'am ni btsanaX srog bdag rā tsa bdud srin gnod sbyin klu ma mo rang rang sprul pa g.yog bcas laX yid mthun dam rdzas mchod gtor 'bul gyis bzhesaḥ bstan pa srungs byir bdag gis bstod par bgyiḥ bshad sgrub bsgom la bar chad med pa dngaX sems can bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod sarba lo ka pa la gtsā rang gnas su gshegs pa ra bsam dug gsum gdon la chang glud dang gtor ma bshams la sngags dang phyag rgyas spel te kyeḥ 'byung po gang dag sa steng rgyu ba dang sa 'og sa blar gnas pa'i dug gsum gdonaḥ rang rang rigs dang 'khor du gtogs pa kunaḥ lan chags sbyangs ba'i slad du 'dir 'dus shigaḥ yo sarba bhigan sa pā ri wā ra e h+ya hiḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya stoḥ ma kusko ri rku ka ri swā hāḥ ma pu tsi pu

rigs lnga yab yum laX gus 'dud bde stong 'bar ba'i bstodaḥ hū0 oṃ treḥhrīḥ.u rat+na spa ra ṇa phaṭa saṃ ha ra ṇa hūḥ nyer gcig brjod mthar rigs lnga 'od zhu rdul tshon rnam par gyur de nas thig rkud byin rlabs niḥtrīḥ dam tshig 'gyur ba med pa'i dalaḥ ye shes gzung thag lug gu rgyudaḥ mthing gsal chos dbyings ye shes ngang dkar po me long ye shes soḥ ser po mnyam nyid ye shes gsangaX dmar po so sor rtogs pa laḥ ljang ku bya grub ye shes kyi rang bzhin nyid du lhun gyis grub rluX līthaḥbyetshu sa ma mā rat+na ma snye spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa shā nyer gcig brjodaḥhrī 'gyur ba med pa sku yi gsang sna tshogs 'gags med gsung gi ngang ye shes thugs ni mkha' ltar dag de bzhin nyid du gzi byin phobaḥ dam tshig dal dang ro gcig gyuraḥ 'phrin las 'gro 'dul mthu ldan shog ma āḥhū spa ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūḥ nyer gcig brjod rnam bzhi'i mchod cingaḥtrīḥ ma skyes 'gags med zang thal klong ye shes lnga yi gsang ba cheX sna tshogs 'byung gyur chos so cogaḥ gnyis med mnyam sbor mdzad la bstodaḥ ye shes lnga gsang 'od kyi rnam par spo bsna byas

—8rdo: te thig rkud la thim par bsam dri bzang dang ba byung gi ga chags gdab pa niḥ hrīḥ thugs bskyed dag pa'i smon lam las 'khrungs bas ba byung rnam pa lnga yi gzhi bting ngo nyon mongs ma rig rdul dang bral ba'i phyir bzang po'i dri mchog sbyar bas chags chag gdabaX o ru ru sbu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba ar+sha sarnya ni swā hāḥ rol mo dang bcasate zig dkyil la chag chags gdab slob dpon chur gnas gzung ma ni dri za'i yul 'dzin dam tshig brten rdo rje yab kyi dril bu yumaḥye zig rkud pa sbrel te bzung dpral bar gtug cing snyoms zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi spro bsdu bya smon lam bden tshig brjod pa niḥ o sgyu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor du thabs shes chags 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum kun byang chub sems kyi sgrub par rtag zhugs nas thams cad bde ba chen po'i dal du bsgyur sto dhi tsit+ta spra ra ṇa phaṭaX se ha ra ṇa hū 'tshogs pa kun byang sa sems kyi dzi nge 'dzin la gnas he ru gas zhal nasadam tshig bskul ba'i sgra badz+ra suhra sa ma yā ma ti pra ma hūṃḥ de nyid gsum dang rgyab 'gro'i bzhi'iḥ ye thig dbyings phyug mkha' la gdab thig rkud chad na yab yum 'chiḥ thig sna shor na gnyis ka nyams chad na

—8rdo: bkod la rnam bzhis mchod rol mo bya zhing bstod pa niḥ hrīḥ 'bar ba'i rang bzhin kun nas bzod dka'i gzi 'jig byed dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong bdud dang dam sri skad cig nyid la 'dulaḥ 'thar byed gzhon nu rta khyung drag por bstodaX de nas bum pa lta gon ni bshal bdug brab gsum thub nas slar bla med so lnga'i rdzas chen gyis bum pa'i sum cha dgang ba na skye med kyi dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar ngoms te sgrub pa las kyi dam tshig gi dal du bzhugs par 31sa la lha sngags yongs la snyen āXshāX ཿbtags nas ku sha bkrugs bkram ste dgod cing rnam lnga bkram byas te tsūḥ pho brang 'bar ba e yi klongaḥ dur khrod thod mkhar rngams pa'i dbusaX chos 'byung pad zla bdud bzhi'i kharaḥ drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon skuX dmar nag me yi phung po canaX bde stong sha za mkha' 'gro bzhi sgo bzhi'i bstan srung dang bcas paḥ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsal srog gis basmal rte dpal ri nasaḥ ye shes lha tshogs smran drangs bsdimasaḥ snyen padwa kro tasabo sapā riwa rabadz+ra sam yadza dzaX snyen pad+ma krota rwadza sapa riwa ras mayā t+tamilhanaḥ a rti

pu hoX pra tiṣ+ṭha ho na mo hū oṃ badz+ra aste shabha pañtsa rak+ta bā ling ta khā nyi hū trī bde ba'i rang bzhin kun nas 'bar ba'i skuX rmongs pa klu 'dul rjes chags bzhad glu can nyon mongs rang mtshan gol ba'i bdud sde bcom drag khros 'bar ba'i sku mchog khyod la bstod bum pa'i thugs shar hrīḥdamar po la sngags phreng gi bskor ba las 'od zer 'phrosaḥ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas gdug pa btulaḥ dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ru 'khyel bar dmigasaX bsnyen sgrub lasagasum gyi sngagasabazla mthar sngagasakyisamachod cing bstod mthar tshog āḥhū bum chu yas kyi bdud rtsi 'khyel ba'i klong lha rnams 'od kyi skur bzhugs par bsam moḥ phur bu byug bdug brab gsum bya lha sngags mjug tu hū sgrub ltar sham 'dogs lding khrir 'god byas te sngagasadang rol mo'i mchod cing bstod thod dzos rta gon byed kyang rung thabs shes dar gyi kha bkab teḥ dza gad chos sman snying por bzhugs me long rdo phag zung gis mtshanaḥ bzang drug li khri mnyam par sbyar dpa' bo yab lum dal du dmigs bde stong sbyor ba'i chu rgyun gyis snyarnya mer gyisagang bar dmigs de nas slob ma rta gon ni las chus ོ gsum dri ma sbyangasaḥ tho mtshams bgegs bsgrad bsrung

bzhi mtshon rat+na'i me long dang sku gsum lhun rdzogs dar gyi 'phur ma dang ye shes lnga mtshon tshon skud drwa ba bkramaḥ pha rol phyin rdzogs rus rgyan 'phreng bas mdzes bdud bzhi rtsad gcod mchog phur rnam pa bzhi nyon mongs rgol 'joms shes rab ral gri'i mtshon 'dod yon ro mnyam stag gzig smad shams bcas phyogs bcu'i g.yul bzlog khro rgyal srung gur rnamasaḥ rang byung rang shar ngo mtshar phun sum tshogasaḥ sbyo maṇ+ḍal spa rat+na phaṭaḥ se ha ra ṇa (ཿ mchod sa yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa ni dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas yo byad thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las rang snang dag pa 'od gsal gyi zhing rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang dang ston 'khor o rgyan chen po rje 'bangs lo paṇa gyi tshom bu rigs lnga'i rtags 'chang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ging liṅga'i tshogs rnams kyi mchod sprin mtha' yas pa thogs shing glu gar bro yis lta spyod dang ting nge 'dzin bsam mtha' yas pas spo ba 'gyed pa rab mdzes sa gsum lhan tshob gyi da la chos smo mtshan ma smib g.yog dang bral mod kyang longs spod rdzogs sku nges pa

—rten: lnga ldan gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs shing sprul sku gzhan phan thugs rje'i brin las chags thogs dang bral zhing dngos kun bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du dag smin rdzogs pa'i a dṛta dang dga' ston phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs rdo rje'i rig ma nyer spyod bdun sprin 'dod yon lnga ldan sman raka gtor mchod bkod mdzes yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa sgyu ma lta bur mang zhing 'phrul yangs pa ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi myong grol zag pa med pa'i gter chen po dpe 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur cig snyen sarba bid su ra su ra a pat+ta ya a pat+ta ya spra ra ṇa kheḥ sa badz+ra arnya shabha ru pa dharma pañtsa rak+ta bā ling ta sta na gha na bho dhi tsit+ta spra ra ṇa kheX saṃ ha ra ṇa (ཿ de nas byin chen dbab pa niḥ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mu mtha' yas pa'i thugs rgyad bsalaḥ kun kyang sku phyag rgya gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan yon tan phrin

las thams cad 'ja' dang 'od phung gi rnam par byung nas bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la phog pa'i byin chen phab cing dbang chen bskul bar bsam laḥ hū dzaḥrnga yab gling dbus zangs mdog dpal gyi riḥ bde chen pad+ma 'od 'bar pho brang nasaḥ bzhengs shigs bzhengs shig rdo rje thod phreng rtsalaḥ rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging liṅga 'phags bod lo paṇa sprul pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad bka' bab rje 'bangs dngas ma bu dgu sogs sprul pa'i gter ston grub brnyes thams cad kunaḥ skye med dbyings las dgongs pa'i rtsal g.yos laḥ dad ldan bu yi mos ngor mngon snang teX bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas dang yo byad rnamasaḥ lha dang zhing khams dag mnyam myong grol gteraḥzag med ye shes rol par byin chen phobaḥ 'ja' sprin khu sbrang 'od gsal klong yangs nasaX rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyi byin chen phobaḥ rab 'bar me rlung bde stong 1nga yangs nasaḥ drag khros me 'phreng rtsal gyi byin chen phobaḥ dga' bzhi'i zer 'bar byang chub sems klong nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi byin chen phob gangs dkar rtse mo rdo

—8rdo: rje'i brag steng nasaḥ nam mkha' shugs can phyogs ma'i rgya mtsho'i gling dbus pad sdong ze'u 'bru las thugs pyon ḍak+ki'i tshogs kyi byin chen phob mi 'gyur rig pa shar ba'i 'od 1nga nasaḥ dus mtshan rdo rje la ma'i nyams rtogs ye shes rgyas pa'i gter mdzod nas dus sbyor rin chen dun skyes khams gsum 'ub chub pad+ma 'bum 1nga nasaḥ chags sbyor rab 'bar dbang mos byin chen phob rlung sems dbyings rol dhu ti'i klong yangs nasaḥ shugs sgrol garma kha khas legs nyes ltong 'dzin ye shes rjes 'gro baḥ bka' sdod pho nya rgya mtsho'i dug gsum ar gtad bdud bzhi rang grol ba'i rta zhal khyung gdong 'bar bas rtag mtshan bzang po dus las mi g.yel b.raḥ da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsolaḥ slo pad+ma krota rā dza sapā ri wa rabadz+ra sam yādza dzaḥ a we sha yas āḥ sta gon gyilha chogs rnams 'od du mer gyi zhu nas rdul tshon gyi lha rnams dang tha mi dad par ro gcig tu bzhugs par bsam moX badz+ra sam yādza dzatsāḥ grwal bsgrigs pa ni hūṃ hriḥ rtsa gsum kun dngos rdo rje slob dpon nyid mi g.yo

bde chen khri la bzhugs su gsolaX lta dgongs gdengs rnyed rdo rje rgyal theb yang chags bral pad+ma'i khri la bzhugs su gsolaX bde chen thabs mkhas dga' bzhi'i mdza' na mo sna tshogs dar gyi gdan la bzhugs su gsol rdo rje'i 'gyur gdang las kyi sgra rdeb paḥ tshangs ma 'gyur ma ldem ma bskul ma zung g.yos 'dzin drod 'dzin bya rog brda sbyor ba rdo rje gdong 'khrigs 'dab brten sna tshogs pa thams cad lta spyod dam tshig dag pa yisaḥ bstan ma bden pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol dam tshog gcig 'dris skyes mchog dgyes par bzhesaḥ thang lhod bral ba'i sdom dam ting 'dzin zungasaḥ bde mchog chos kyi rgyal poye maho rdo rje slob dpon la mnga' dbul ni kye hoḥston pa mdzod ldan rdo rje rgyal po nyid theg mchog 'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal zhabs pad brten ༷ sku mchog 'gyur med rgyal mtshan gsung chos dungaḥ gzigs pa'i spyan bzang gser nya mgul bum bzang thugs mchog mi g.yo dpal gyi be'u'i dbyings gdul bya'i skyabs mchog thugs rje'i bsil khang gdugs 'dod 'byung nor bu chos kyi 'khor lo'i dpal ting

bsnyed: 'dzin khyim bdag shes rab btsun mo'i gzugs lta ba'i glang po dgongs spyod rta mchog dang nyon mongs g.yul 'joms dmag dpon rin chen duḥ mnga' dbul 'bul lo thugs rje'i nyer bzhes nasaḥ sems can don phyir brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur ngoms bdag sogs slad du sgrub chen gnang bar zhu sku la na bza' gsol zhal du skyems drangs thugs byon rig ma phul de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis zhal bkod gdams pa ni e ma hoX tshogs smon las 'dza bzang po'i bskul ba'i 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byer pho mo rnams gson cigaḥ deng gi gnas 'di yang bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su blta ba dngaX ston pa bdag nyid kyang gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi gsang ba gsum dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa dang khyed cag 'khor gyi tshom bu yang rje 'bangs lo paṇa dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhin du shes pa 'gran tshol rgyag sems spangs ba dngaḥ dam chos mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod 'brel tshad don ldan gyi sgrub pa chen po mdo sngags chos kyi snying khur shes pa dang dus phun sum tshogs pa gsang chen gyi spyod pa byed cing ting 'dzin mi 'gyur ba'i gzhi

bting bas dge mtshan bkra shis pas rang bzhin nyid dngaḥ kun rdzob rgyu ru sbas pa de snang ba lha sgra grags sngags dranartogs thugasaX ro mnyam rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dag pa rab 'byams su bzhugs pa nyid nges par rtogs shing yang dag par gzigs dgos pa dang 'dod chags chos sbas kyi gab don ni dbyings don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor sras bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khoraḥ kun+dha byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad bde chen ye shes kyi rang mdangs su shes shing byed pa bcing la 'gyur med ye shes su la bzla ba'oḥ snang ba sems sbas pa ste sna tshogs kyi chos thams cad sems kyi rol ba rtog tshogs gang 'gyu gang shar thams cad sems kyi rtsal du shes shing sems kyi rang bzhin ni gdod nas ma byung ma skyes pa ste ye grol nam mkha' ltar dag pas yi shes nyag gcig gi gsang bar sgog tshud pas dag chen chos du blta ba dang stong nyid rtag sbas kyi don ni rig pa gang las ma byung ma skyes pa ste snang ba chos nyid kyi yo lang stong pa ye shes kyi gsang ba thams cad rig pa nyag gcig gi gsang sgog tu dag mnyam pa'i don blo

gtsasdornya bral chos nyid chen por yid ches shing phu thag chod pa de'oḥsku yi dam tshig thams cad sprul pa sku'i dkyil 'khor nyid du spyod gsung gi dam tshig gi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bde ba chen por lam du khyer thugs kyi dam tshig chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes mkha' ltar rnam par dag cing 'od gsal ba nyid la 'jugaḥsku dam tshig gi phyag rgya lha'i dkyil 'khoraḥgasung chos kyi phyag rgya sngags kyi rol mo thugs yeshes kyi phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi rol mtshoḥbaca' ba las kyi phyag rgya dam tshig lnga ldan rdo rje'i gar bsgyur ba'oḥbaskyed pa'i sngags bskul byed kyi rkyen du shes pa dngaḥbazlas pa'i sngags skar phreng to lo 'gal me lta bu'i phrin las dngaḥsnying po ye shes kyi sngags sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang mi 'gyur srung ba'i ra gur la rtag tu blta zhing phrin las bzhi'i gzer gdab pa'oḥbaza' b.lidam tshog gi dga' ston tshogs su shes pa'am sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar lam du khyer ba dang yang na chos nyid ro mnyam chen po mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'oḥbacing ba'i dam tshig rdo rje sems dpa'i me long

snying la brten yid rig ye shes kyi phyag rgya gzungs rig chos kyi phyag rgyaḥ dngos rig bde ba'i phyag rgya gang rung lus la brten dri bral ras gos dkar po mjes pa'i mthing shams sngon po sna tshogs dar gyi phu dung ma bcos don rtags ral pa sogs sngags kyi rgyan rnams chas su 'chang bar bya'o khyad par du lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong zin par bya ba la bsgom pa yeng med kyi 'phrang bsgal te spyod pa'i stong sgog 'phrog pa zhig dgos so chos thams cad bdag med de bzhin nyid du blta zhing chos nyid ma bu spros mtha' dang bral ba'i dbyings su rim bsdu byas pas 'chi ba chos skur sbyangasaḥ kha sbyor 'od gsal ye shes lnga'i ra ba las mi 'da' zhing gsal dag stong pa'i gnad dang ldan pas bar dor longs spyod rdzogs skur bsreḥ gang 'dul gzugs kyi sku mtshan ma gdos bral bde chen ye shes kyi sku la ting 'dzin rtse gcig tu dril bas skye ba sprul skur sad par byed doḥ de bas khe nyen che ba gsang sngags kyi sgo 'dir zhugs nas smin byed kyi dbang zhus bla ma la mos gus thob mched la gdung sems cheḥ dad pa dag snang mos gus 'byoraḥ ma ga

badz+ra: lta yid gnyis the tshom dang bral na bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin med kyang dkyil 'khor 'di nyid mthong nas sgrub pa'i sgor 'jug pa tsam gyis yang srid phyi ma'am skye ba bdun tshun chad sangs rgyas bar 'gyur ba ni khyad chos yin pas the tshom tsam yang mi dgos soḥkhyad par yang zab drag po thugs kyi sgrub pa 'di las zab pa'i gdams pa ni rta rmig lcags kyis btum nas stong gsum gling bzhi bskor na'ang rnyed par mi 'gyur ba ni gtan tshig goḥ brgya la lan gcig rnyed pa'i dus tshod 'dir dran shes bag yod dang ldan pas gzi bor byos la phung khrol nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa rang zhig rang grol la gtong ba las rjes gcod 'phro mthud mi bya'oḥltem rkyang mod pa'i mos gus gnad cheḥgayo zol dang brarme ba'i mchod bshags tshogs ston re spro dgos shin tu dngas shing bag pheb pas sgo gsum lha sngags chos nyid du blta nus pa rab dag snang la rtsal sbyangs pa 'bringaḥ tha nanga'ang mos gus rtse gcig 'di gal che bas thugs la zungs shigaḥ ji skad duḥ rdo dzorgyal bo he ru ga'i bka' las 'das na dmyal bar lhung dam tshig

bzhin du mi nyan naX snying bsregs tshe thung nad mang zhingaḥ mkha' 'a14re bka' chad thog ltar 'bebasaḥ dam can srung mas 'khu zhing btagaX zhes gsungs pasaḥ pha yi ji ltar bsgo bzhin du0 khyed cag mched dang lcam dral spun sring rnams kyis rtse gcig tu brten zhing dbyer ba med par mdzod cig ces gdams par bya'oḥde nasardo rje'i bstod ringasanaḥ hū trīXrdo rje mi shig bde ba chen po'i dbyingasaḥrdo rje chags pa'i rdul bral pad+ma'i zhalaX rdo rje tshe dang ye shes dpag med paḥrdo rje 'od mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal bstod rdo rje'i sku la phyogs ris mi dmigs kyangaḥ rdo rje'i ye shes gzigs tshul mtha' yas pa rdo rje'i gdul zhing bskal bzang 'dir byon pa'i rdo rje'i sku can sangs rgyas stong la bstod rdo rje'i mchog grub nus mthu phun tshogs shingaḥrdo rje'i mchu yis sa gsum gdon tshogs 'thar rdo rje'i khro tshogs rnams kyang zhal nye ba'i rdo rje'i rigs kyi ga ru ṇa la bstodaḥrdo rje'i bde ba'i dbang phyug he ru ga rdo rje sngags kyi dngos grub mchog stsal zhingaXrdo rje'i rigs can bskal bzang yongs smin pasaḥ rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod

—8rdo: rdo dze+edon dam chos dbyings ye shes zhalaX rdo rjes rjes chags dbang chen bshad pa'i gar rdo rje gar dgu'i dpal 'khyud rta khyung rgyalaXrdo rje 'jig byed zhal la phyag 'tshal bstod rdo rjeligadong mo dus mtshan chags pa'i skuḥrdo rje'i dbyings spyod dus sbyor rngams gcig can rdo rje'i gar mdzad chags sbyor mkha' la spyod rdo rje'i lcam mo shugs sgrol bcas la bstodaḥrdo rjes bka' nyan 'char byed nag po dngaḥrdo rje'i las mdzad tshe bdag 'bar ba rtsalaXrdo rje'i mthu grub badz+ra kai la yaḥrdo rje bdud 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥrdo rje'i mkha' la thogs med bsgrod stobs canaḥrdo rje phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrubaḥrdo rje gsang ba'i bka' nyan dam tshig canaḥrdo rjes bka' skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥbadud rtsi sgrub tshe rdo rjeligaze yis dngos kun bdud rtsir bsgyur rdo rje byin rlabs dbang bskur mthu thob pas rdo rjes rdzas mchog mthong thos dran reg kunaḥrdo rjes sa mchog grub la phyag 'tshal bstod ya na rdo rjes lta dgashengs zab mo dngas blang nasaḥrdo rje ye shes grub pa'i ting 'dzin laXrdo rje khrag

'thung mngon snang mdzad pa sgrub rdo rje'i phrin las rmad byung 'byung la bstod rdo dze+e'agyur med dgongs pa'i gzer chen gdab rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gzhi bzungs teḥ rdo rje'i smon lam grub pa'i mtha' brgyan nasaḥrdo rje'i mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprugs thegag de ltar phyag rgya bzhi ldan pas dkyil 'khor lha tshogasadagyes pa bskyed de nas ting 'dzin bzung ba ni mched lcam lu gu rgyud tu sgrel de ( hrīḥ ye nas gnyis med chos sku dag pa laḥ ma rig dbang gis phyogs ris so sor bzungasaḥ rtag chad mu bzhir gol ba'i nyes sgrib kunaḥ chos dbyings mkha' ltar dag pa'i 1nga du bshagasaḥ dri med gdod nas dag pa'i rig pa bsnyen dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer chen rtag tu gdab rdzong 'phrang srog gsum he ru'i dgongs nyams skyongasaḥ mi 'da' rdo rje'i ting 'dzin mchog la gnasaḥ hrīḥ gdod nas dribral sku gsum ye shes klong snang grags dran rig lha sngags phyag rgya che ma brtsal rdzogs ldan rang byung lhun grub mdzod gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po mngon du byaX a chos nyid lta ba'i rdzong chen mkha' ltar yangasaḥ 'od gsal bsgom pa'i 'phrang chen 'jug ngog bde

badz+ra: la dor spyod pa'i stong sgog mngon sum 'phrog lhun grub 'bras bu rgyal srid bde blag rtedaX a a ༷ sa mchog 'od gsal rdo rje'i rtse mo stse bdag cag dam ldan rnal 'byor mched dang lcam dka' ba med par bde legs nyid spyod nas don gnyis lhun grub 'byung bar mdzad du gsolaX ma ni sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shesaXgu ru ni yon tan dang byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnasaḥ artsig zhes pa me yi phreng ba canaḥ nertsig 'bar ba'i sku can 'thar byed dang 'joms byed me rlung 'tshubs ma'i 'khor lor la'ang 'jug trīX bde chen ye shes sbyin pa'i pad+ma gsung gi srogaḥ shā rjes chags bzhad pa'i glu can pad+ma gar dbang nyid kyi dngaX khroḥchos kyi dbyings las gti mug 'dul byed ye shes kyi bskul tshig dngaḥ pha 'khor 'das kyi spyi dpal du spro zhing dregs pa tshar bcad 'jig rten pa dam la btags 'byung ba'i dpal yon thams cad gcig tu drilaX ṭa zhes pas nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bsted cing dug gsum gdon gyi gtsug na spa zhing rnam par rgyal ba'i don rdogs so kai lapa thal 'byin gyi

dgongs pas gdul dka' 'dul bar zhal gyis bzhes pa dngaḥ gnod byed sarba —sno ta kṛta re re snga mas tshig 'bru bzhi'i gdul bya ngos bzung ba dang de 'og gnyis kyi 'dul byed pho nya'i tshogs las la rbad pa dngaḥ 'og gi 'bru bzhi'i he ru ka la gsol ba btab cing gnyer gtad pa'oX dngos grub kyi snod du rung bar bya bas bzlas pa 'di nyid 'bru 'bum re bzlas na 'grub pa'i rtags 'ja' yi gur phub paḥ dri bzang 'thul baX nyams dga' dang spro skyo ba medaḥ shes rab 'bar ye shes dang yon tan skye rmi lam du bdud rtsi'i khrus la zhugs: gos dkar po bgoḥ rtsi bcud la longs spyod pa rnams ni bsnyen pa 'byung ba'i rtags tshad thems pa'oḥ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i sngags don ni rtsa ba sngags ltar dngaḥ sham gyi khyad par niḥ rgyal bsen klu gnyan zhes pas gdul bya'i zhing dngos bstan de dag dngaX gzhan yang dregs pa ma rung ba'i rigs thams cad kun kyang dmigs pa'i gcun dre ga la zhes pas shi sa bstan pa gnang la dbab pa las la rbad pa mtshon 'khor bskor ba spu gri'i gtub pa kun la 'jug shī la

—8rdo: ya rbadaḥzhes pas khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs 'thar byed sdig pa brlag byed phagaḥgatub byed khyung za byed seng ge'i tshogs bsam yas pa spros nas rang rang gi gdul bya'i zhing thams cad rjes su bzung zhing thabs du mas sgo nas bsgral 'dren las la gcun pa sogs mdzad pa sna tshogs ston pa'i don noḥ'adi ni dngos grub bsdu ba'i 'dzab ste snod kyi zhing me ru 'bar bar byin gyis brlabasaḥbacud rnams he ru ka yab yum kyi rol bar gzi byin bskyedaḥsngags phreng 'gal me'i 'khor lo lta bu'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras bcas mchodaXmakhyen nus brtse ba'i dbang byin bkug dregs pa can thams cad bran du bkolaḥsgog snying 'phrog nas dbang du bsgyuraX 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud bkug la gzi byin bskyedaḥdangos grub bskul zhing bdag gi dbang du byed de rdzas kyi nus mthu bskyed pa'o grub pa'i rtags me mar rang 'bar du 'byung bum chu khol bhan+ta lud gtor ma bdud rtsir saḥnyams dga' dngas spro dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bzang po 'char rmi lam du mkha' la 'phur ri rtser sdodaḥnyi zla gsar du 'charaḥ'abyug

seng stag dred sogs gdul dka' ba rnams zhon zhing bkol gtub pa rgyal po dang bla rje mnga' thang can mang po 'tshogs shing dbang zhuX bdog pa 'bul mna' tho bya ba sogs 'byung bzlas pas grangs tshad kyang bye ba gcig gra zur ma nyams par lhag chad dang bral bar smra ba bcad de bzla'oḥ bsten du rung ba'i bgrang phreng ni rak+ka gdong drug dngaX bho dhi cit+ta dang tsan+dan gyi phreng ba rnams brten nas bla ma la byin rlabs zhu mi lag mi 'grimasaX lus kyi drod dang mi 'bral bar bcingaX ra dang rus pa'i phreng ba 'chang na byin rlabs mi 'byung zhing dngos grub yal bar 'gyur ro phrin las bzhi'i thabs mkhas la 'jug phyir las sbyor yang bsnyen pa'i don gong ltar laḥ rā tsa 'khu na dum bur bshigs thabs la 'badaḥ rā tsa 'da' na tsit+ta phyung thabs su rbadaḥ rā tsa sdog na bzlog cing gtub thabs su brtsonaX rā tsa dang bse mo sogs dus kyi log sbyor mkhan klu gnyan dang bcas pa gnad kyi gcun te bse mo na ga tsig tsig ces gzir roX a hab hab ces yakru me dbal las la rbad cing gdon gsum zhal du bstabs 'phros don gnam the

gtsasdo: bar the sa the'u be+e the'u thams cad dur phag gi sod sod gnod byed 'byung po'i kha 'dar 'dar zhes ring du sprad snying 'dar 'dar zhes phrol du bzlog sgog 'dar 'dar zhes 'khu mi nus par gzhigasaḥ zheng sdang snying la ram̐ ram̐ zhes rgyal gdon rnams ye shes me yi bsregs ༷ 'dod chags khrag la zud zud zhes mo gdon bse mo thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi chu ru bsgyur guti mug shā la rbad rbad zhes klu gnyan sa bdag gtod 'khor dang bcas pa shes rab rlung gis tshal bar dengasaḥ phrag dog danyigs la ye ye zhes dus kyi gdon rgod nad rims yams bdag god sri god 'dre thams cad 'jigs byed 'thor rlung rdo rje'i thog ser gyi gzir ba dang nga rgyal ru sa la dza dzaḥzhes lha min gyi grong khyer dbul sri 'gab 'dre thams cad tshar bcad cing nus mthu gtan nas brlag pa dngaX rtswa dbyug sgog la ye shudwa dzaḥzhes pas ging gi tshogs dang dbug len phra min gyi tshogs dang srog bdag gi sde tshogs dang shu bo lag ring gi tshogs dang ye shud btsan gyi tshogs rnams gnad la dbab cing sgog 'phrog pa dngaḥ tsit+ta

—8rdo: gnod byed 'gab 'dre khug dam sri'i snying la ma ra ya dza dza hūṃ (ཿ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten kunaḥ ye shes khro bo khro mos gtamaḥ kun kyang rdo rje'i bro la dgongasaḥ dgra rnams ma lus rdul du brlag bgegs dang sri kun 'thar bar byedaḥ 'gab 'dre bse rag dbul sri bcomaḥ phung 'dre chos kyi dbyings su bshigasaḥ snyed sum bha ni sogs ya ma dam sri rakru s+t+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ de ltar bya pasasri bdud 'joms sgrub la bar chad med par 'gyuraḥ sa ma mā mthar dngos grub bskul len gter gyi bum bzang ltar du bya ba dang thod rdzas rigs lnga sogs dngos grub gyi rdzas gzhan rnams rol phyar smon lam 'di ltar gdab poḥ / trīX sku shes thugs mchog gsang ba'i nyi ma cheḥ drag khros rta zhal khyung gdong he ru gaḥ yang yang bsnyen zhing sgom sgrub mthar phyin pasaX dngos grub mchog stsol dus las ma g.yel zhig 'amib mid pa rdo rje tshe yi dbangaḥ nub pa mi mnga' dpal 'byor yon tan stobasaḥ chags thog bral bar kong rngol shes rab sa sde brgyad ar gtad dregs pa zil gnon mthuX gangagis mi 'jigs gzhom med rdo rje'i gteraḥ tshe 'dir 'og min bsgod pa'i smon lam

—8mi dṛ ta kusnyo li sa pa ri wa ra e rda bā ling ta khā hiḥ lan gsumaḥho ye shes khro bo chen po yiḥ thugs la phyogs ris mi mnga' yang bdag rmong ma rig dbang gyur nongs khyed la mthol bshags bzod par bzhesaḥ yig brgya bzla hoḥ las mdzad khro bo chen po khyodaḥ hoX ye shes khro bo chen po khyod sku drin bla na ma mchis soḥ bdag gis sgrub pa mthar phyin pas da ni skye med dbyings su gshegs badz+ra sum̐ḥ nang gi tho bsdu na rin po che'i sgod dutsan las gtor ma bdud rtsir gyuraḥ o āmāṃḥ bhan+ta yangs pa'i snod nang du sha khrag gtor ma ri ltar spungasaḥ khro bo chen po dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bdag gi tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cigaḥ sa badz+ra krota ya man+ta gas pā ri sogs khā hiḥ lan gsumaḥhoḥ ye shes khro bo chen po khyodaḥ sku drin bla na ma mchis soḥ bdag gis sgrub pa mthar phyin pasaḥ da ni skye med dbyings su gshegasaḥbadz+ra hūṃḥ phyi'i tho bsdu rin po che'i stod du phyi'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang gtor ma 'dod yon gyis phung por gyuraḥ o āX hūṃḥ ho mchod yon zhabs sil me tog spos mar me dri chab zhal zas

—8mi: pa bzod par gsolaḥ yag brgya brjodaḥ hoX rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas rnams dgongasaḥ bdag gis sgrub pa mthar phyin pasaḥ rang bzhin gnas su gshegs su gsolaḥ 'dod don zhu tshe phrin las stsalaX badz+ra hūṃX lho yi tho bsdu rin po che'i snod du phyi'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang gtor ma 'dod yon gyis phung por gyuraḥ o ā (ཿ hoḥmatshod yon zhabs sil me tog sposaḥ mar me dri chab zhal zas dang0 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma rnams rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bulaX oṃ badz+ra pukhye dhape a lo ke ghasnye rne wigye āX hūṃḥ be+e ru bak+ta sde sa pā wa ra e rda bā ling ta khā hiX lan gsumaḥ hoḥ thub dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyiḥ spyan sngar khas blang dam mnos pasaḥ rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas rnams kyiX thugs 'gal nongs pa bzod par gsolaX yag brgya brjod hoX rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas rnams dgongasaX bdag gis sgrub pa mthar phyin pasaX rang bzhin gnas su gshegs su gsolaX 'dod don zhu tshe grin las stsolaḥ badz+ra hūṃḥ nub kyi tho bsdu rin po che'i snod du phyi'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang gtor ma 'dod yon gyis

phungapor gyur mo ā nyu hoḥ mchodayon zhabs sil me tog sposaX mar me dri chab zhal zas dang 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma rnams rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul chabadz+ra pur+shadhāpesaloke rnye nainibyeyaXtso mabe+e ཿmaṇayisam war e dobāying ta' hiḥ lanagasumaḥhoḥ thub dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar khas blang dam mnos pas/rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas rnams kyiX thugs 'gal nongs pa bzod par gsol yig brgya brjodaḥhoḥ rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas rnams dgongs bdag gis sgrub pa mthar phyin pas rang bzhin gnas su gshegs su gsolaḥ 'dod don zhu tshe phrin las stsolaḥ badz+rahūṃ byang gi tho bsdu'o de nas bsngo smon niḥhoḥ rang snang rnam dag dpal gyi ri bo'i zhing khams yongs bkod nasaḥ khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po'i gsang ba gsum klong mngon gyur phyir bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa zab mo nyams su blang ba'i dge rtsa 'dis rab brtson rnam dkar ci mchis mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs la bsngo0 kun kyang gnyis 'dzin rnam dag 'og min me ru 'bar ba'i zhing dpal chen he ru ka dpal nyid dang dbyer

—8/sde: med lhun rdzogs shog lan gsum gdab de nas sku drin gso ba niḥ.e ma hoḥgang zhig dran pas thar ba'i lam sna zin gcig chog sgrub pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang thams cad gu ru nyid 'char bskyed rim bcasaX mos gus dad pas phyag bcas nyid la 'bulaḥsku na tan rgyal ba sras bcas kun mnyam yangs bka' drin thams cad gcig bsdus dper mi 'osaḥmatshungs med sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma laḥsgo gsum ltos med 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol dang po dge ba'i lam la kun slong bcosaX bar du thun mong thun min rim pas bskyangasaXtha ma sor byang nas bzung sngags la zhugasaX smin byed dbang bskur bcal ba sku drin che dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa la gnas shing bar du rdzogs rim bde stong ting 'dzin bsgom tha ma rang sems stong gsal ngo bo bstanaḥsrid las rnam grol mdzad pa bka' drin cheX gnyis 'jin rgya grol snang stong zung 'jug mthong chos nyid lhun mnyam yangs pa'i gdan sa rted kun yin min pa med pa'i 'od gsal mjal0 blo bral rnal 'byor mthong ba sku drin cheḥganas

snang dbyings zig rig gdang rjen par sharaX dang po cher smin mngon gsum gong 'phel nasaX bar du tshad pheb stsal rdzogs bstan pa thobaX tha ma chos zad gdeng thob sku drin che ༷ stong gsum gser gyi phyur bur dgang byas te rin chen sna bdun nye ba'i 'dod yon lnga rnam mang mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul na'angaḥ sku drin yon tan gzo bar ga la nusaḥdri bral dar gyi na bza' sku la 'bulaX dza gad sngags kyi dga' ston ljags la bstabasaX thugs byon mtshan ldan rig ma skyon bral 'bul thugs rje brtse bar dgongs te bzhes su ga〈snalaX dzamam bu gcig tu rig 'dzin sar 'bo/da phyiraḥ thugs bskyed spyo na lam yang dag gnang bar zhu mched lcam thams cad gzungs thags kya lu gu rgyud du 'brel g.yas su ring bu dang g.yon mar me thog la smon lam gdab pa niḥhoḥ bde mchog gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor duḥ rtsa gsum spyi gzugs rdo rje slob dpon dang mched dang lcam dral rdo rje'i gzungs ma bcasaḥ mi 'bral tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas re gaḥ tshogs dang sbyo ra ba'i lam gyi rtsal rdzogs teḥ chos nyid bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes zhal dpe tshig mtshan ma'i yul

—8rdo: las rab 'das paraḥmathong lam don dam bden pa'i nge sa gsang rnyedaḥdang po rab dga'i sa la byin par shog rnam smin bag chags las rgya me yis bsregasaḥtshe la dbang ba'i yon tan rtsal chen rdzogasaḥnyams kyi snang ba gong nas go du 'phelaḥsbyangs dkalirtsal dzogs sa la phyin par shogaḥrig pa tshad pheb nyon mo sa sgrib bral zhingaḥphyag rgya chen po' yon tan rab smin rdzogasaḥlam dang rim pa rnam gsum mngon gyur teḥs brgyad legs pa'i blo gros zob par shogaḥm rig shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bral zhingaḥchos nyid zad pa'i yon tan mngon du gyuraḥlam gyi rim pa sna tshogs rtsal rdzogs te kun tu 'od kyi sa la phyin par shogaḥbag chags phra ba'i dri ma dang bral zhingaḥmi slob yon tan 'bras bu'i dbang rdzogs teḥphyi gsal snang ba nang dbyings la bsdus nasaḥrdo dze+e' na pa'i sa la phyin par shogaḥchos sku skye med lhum su byang chub ste 'khor ba dong sprugs rgyal kun dgongs pa gcagaX gzugs sku rnam gnyis bya brtsal 'bad med 'byungaXskugashes bla ma'i sa la phyin par 31ga dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i

gzungs thags dang ye shes snang ba rgyas pa'i mar me dang0 lta spyod dgongs pa gcig bsres smon lam gyisaḥtshom bu gcig tu rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cigaḥ thos pa tsam gyis nges par grol 'gyur bas rdo rje 'chang gi bsngags pa'i lam mchog dang 'brel ba thob pa'i mchog dman thams cad kunaḥ chos nyid bden pa'i myur du byang chub shogaX de nasardul pho chur bsdu ba niḥ eḥ 'byung ba chen mo ma mā kiX rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i dbyings 'gro ba ma lus 'tsho byed smanaḥ bde ba 'byung ba'i mkha' dbyings suḥ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon bsdu byin rlab chen po'i bden stobs kyisaḥ sa 'og 'gro ba yongs smin zhing / mthong reg sgra thos nyams myong kunaḥ rig 'dzin sa la 'god par shog nyon shes sgrib pa dang bral zhingaḥ sa bcu lam lnga'i rtsal rdzogs teXrdo rje 'chang dbang mngon gyur nas 'gro don 'bad med 'byung gyur cigaX.e ma ho e ma ka ri ka riḥms dha bha li bha liX sa mi ta su ru su na kun+da li ma su ma su e ka ri su li bha ta ye tsa ki ra bha li ta lce ye sa murnyaḥtsar+ya su ga zheX bhi ti la pa bh+yaX gu li yī pa ki ri dhu ka niḥ ma

—8rdo: ta ri bh+ya tanaḥ pa ra li he pa na ma khar te ke la na si bhu ra ta me ka tsa ra ti pa sur+ya ghata ra.e shapa na ra na snyi tipa ghute pa yaḥ gyu ralhu rapag khard lamaḥ na ra na ra i tha pa ṭa lamaḥ si ran si ran bhi pa bhe sa ras pa lamaḥ brnya burnya0 bhud tshiṣi pa gye le sa saX ri riḥ khekheḥ igiḥm māḥ ri riX la )skuḥkun tu bzang po yab kyi dgongs pa'i chos nyid kyi rang sgra bsgrags pas sa gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad ma rig pa'i mal nas gzhi thog tu sad par byed doḥ yi ma hoḥ mas dha bha pa liX sa mi ta su ru su rtsa kun dha li ma suḥ yi ke ri li bha ta yi tsa ka bhu li ta lce yi sa man+ta tsar+ya pu gha yeḥ bhihaṃ sa na bha ghu yeḥ ka ri ṭa ke ni dha ka ma hā sto re ta na pa ra ba li dhiX sa kha ra ta ke lan se bhud ra taḥ a ka tsa ra sa bas tanaX ta pa sur+ya ghata ra a ma na pa ra bi ho/ ting lhu ra laX ma smin pa ghuhaṃ laḥ ta ya ghu ra ghu raḥrlangs gakha pa ra nalamaḥ na ra nar lamaX e tha rapa talamaḥ sirna sirna bhe sa ras pa lamaX sa ke lamaḥ sa swā ri shāḥ li liḥ i zhiḥ ma māḥ rā rāḥ kun tu bzang mo yum gyi dgongs

pas chos nyid kyi rang sgra bsgrags pas ma rig pa'i mal nas sad pa'i 'gro ba thams cad nang dbyings chos kyi sku ru sangs rgyas par bsam mo rgyun 'bab gyi chu dang rdul tshon cung zad bcas bum par blugs te dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi steng chags chags gdab nas skyes ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi mas tsa ni sarba ar+sha sirnyi ni swā snya lan bzhi brjod la byin gyis brlabs par bya'oḥ de nas las kyi shul mi mngon par bya ba dang rdul phyags me tog sna tshogs kyi gcal bkram moḥ de lta bu'i sgrub pa chen po byasan 'bagasabasnyen dung phyur bcu phrag bsgrengs ba las 'gyur khyad che'oḥ gnas la byin chags sgrub po 'a tshe chos mdzad phran mtha' ru phyin pa la sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyi mi la ngoḥ e maḥ yang zab thugs kyi sgrub pa mchog mkha' 'gro'i gsang srog zab pa'i bcud dug gsum gdon gyi gshed du che dregs pa yongs kya srog snying 'phrog 'brel tshad rag 'dzin zhing la 'godaḥ byin rlabs rno nus bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal bka' 'di srog bdag sde bzhis srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor cigaḥ sa ma māḥrgya rgyargya gter rgya gtadargya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brdathamaḥ3) cesapa 'di'ang rig sras shes rab sgogasamed nas yang yang bskul ba dang thab grogs rat+na saras nanabaskul dang bla ma mthar 3na nas ran chen g.yu

— re/: byur thabs shes mtshon pa 'i la gos dge mtshan snag gi skyes bcas bskul ba dang nye gnas snyan sel nas rgyas mdog la regs sna tshogs bcas bri gzhi'i mthun rkyen byas te bskul ba dang chos kya bdag po me tās mtshan can gyis bzhed pa don ldan phyi ra kho bo sbas pa 'i rnal 'byor bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa ni me tra dharma dhā ra bgyis pa thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu dge zhing bkra shis pa ra gyur cig sarba mge lo/
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las: rigs bdag 'chi med mgon po'i rgyun khyer grub pa'i rdo rje bzhugs so:

'am/: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: ñtsa/she47 skyabs sems ni hrīḥ 'chi med grub pa'i rdo rje snang mtha' yas tshe dang ye shes dpal la skyabs su mchi ma rtogs 'gro ba skye rga na 'chis gzir: 'khrul pa rmangs nas sangs phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum dngos gzha ni hrīX snang ba rnam dag bde chen pad+ma brtsegs 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul zhing bkod phun tshogs dbus: dag chen lhun grub rang byung gzhal med 1nga: ma chags pad+ma rma byas btegs pa'i khar rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje snang mtha' yas: tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das: dmar gsal longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum spres: phyag g.yas tshe mda' g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin: 'ja' 'od 'khrigs dbus rdo rje dkyil krung bzhugs: snang stong zung 'jug dwangs ma'i 'khor lor shar: 'od zer rtse la bskal bzang sangs rgyas 'gyed mkhyen nus brtse bas rtag tu gdul bya skyobs tshe lha rig 'dzin pho nya mgyogs ma rnams: ma 'dres 'ub chub sku yi dbyings su rdzogs: rang 'dra'i pho nya 'od lnga'i lcags kyu yis: 'byung ba'i dwangs ma 'khor 'das dpal yon

—8rdo: dang: 'gro ba'i tsho gzugs yi ge'i rnam pa ru sgog gsum bkrag 'byud dpal yon dang bcas pa: bdag la bstims pas 'chi med rig 'dzin gyi sku mchog thob pa'i skal bzang brnyes par dmigs: slo a mi dhewa ayu rnyi /sdiḥ brgya stong sogs brjod la trīḥ yeshes tshe yi lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: 'dzab dgongs ting 'dzin 'od gsal mchod pa 'bul: 'pho med grub pa'i rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: byang rmugs chags sdang sems kyi 'khrul bun bshags: 'amimed yeshes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: rlu ma hā panyu 4 dza hoḥ rjes rim ni rang bla ma tshe dpag med gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mu med pa 'phros: rang dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe yal ba 'khyams pa 'thor zhig ral ba thams cad dang: khyad par du gdon chen gyis 'phrog pa: gdon phran gyis brkus pa: byad ma lha srung gis bkug pa'i bla tshe thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par 'ab se 'ub se sib sib rug rug bsngas te tshe dpag med kyi bum par bstims: bdag dang bsrung bya la yang yang bstems pas bla tshe nyams pa sor chud nas lus bkrag

mdangs ldanaḥ 'byung ba khod snyoms nad med lang tsho rab tu dar: sems skye med rang mdangs lus la shar te rdo rje'i tshe sgog dam pa thob par dmigs la: hū hrīḥ ma skyes ye grol 'dus ma byas pa'i sku: bde stong zung 'jug bla ma tshe dpag med chags pa'i rkyon bral pad+ma ra ga'i mdangs gdul bya'i re skongs dbang gi 'od chen 'khrugs: phyag g.yas tshe mda' rgyal ba rigs lnga'i gsang phung khams 'byung ba'i gsang srog gcig tu bsre: g.yon pa 'chi med dpal sbyin tshe bum 'dzin 'khor 'das yongs kyi dpal yon 'ub tu chub: mi g.yo bde rol rdo rje dkyil krung mdzad: thugs rje 'od zer bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong bye ba phrag brgya'i mgon por spro bsdu 'gyed: las byed pho nya nyi ma'i zer ltar g.yo: stobs ldan dregs pa'i srog bcud yi ge bcu: 'byung ba'i sa bon khams kyang de lta bu 'gro ba'i tshe gzugs yi ge'i rnams 'gyur can: thams cad skye med snying po āḥgacig ma: ma 'gag mi 'gag 'gag med brda yig hā: bsod nams nus mthu stobs rdzogs rje0 ljang tshul: lha klu mi yi bla srog tshe rten du: bkugs la bdag

ga'adi: dang bsrung bya'i stobs su shar bla 'di 'khyar ba yod kyang da khug cig: tshe bcud nyams pa yod kyang sor chud mdzod: srog la chad gas byung kyang g.yo med bsrengs: lus 'byung rgud pa shar yang dar rgyas shog don gnyis grub par tshe yi rgyal srid la: gnas skabs mthar thugs 'byer ba rab ldan te: nang dbyings bde chen rdo rje'i dpal thob shog tshe gzungs brjod ༷ bde stong zung 'jug nyi zla'i ga'u rtsa phun tshogs tshe rten yi ge ā rtsi hūṃX 'pho 'gyur mi dmigs rdo rje'i sbubs su tshud: dwangs ma gcig dril rdo rje'i srog thob regag hūṃ tra tra thagag: mu tra ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rba bstam bya:shas brjod smon lam mtha' rgyas bya des ni tshe yi dngos grub thob sa ma mā e ma bde chen gsang ba gsung ga mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong rin chen snying po phyur ba las phun tshogs dge bsnyen sha mas sprad sngon smon dag pa'i gsang rgya khrol 'dod sred can gyi ched ma yin gzhan phan thugasabaskyed ldan pa la dpa' bo bdag gis sbyin bgya'o sa ma yu rgya rgya ma gu h+ye brda thim 3ba zhes pa 'di 'ang sngags skyes gzhen tshul 'dzin pa kun bzang ga bzhed ngor kho bo bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma le/

—'di: tshogs smon dag pa 'i spro glu ni a ho: lus dag pa rdo rje phung po yi grong khyer: sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad raka yi gling dbus: dbyings a wa dhu ti mkha' 'gro ma'i nye zhing: klong nam mkha' rnam dag ko ṣa ya dwangs mtshor: mdangs stong sgron 'ja' zer lnga ldan gyi pad sdong: gdangs rdo rje lug brgyud 'od gsal gyi rwa gur: thugs shes rab rang byung nang dbyings kyi dpal ri gting kun gsal rang rig bla ma de pad 'byung: dpal yeshes sgo brgyad bka' bab kyi rig 'dzin: nang rtog tshogs sgyu drwa rgya bod kyi lo paṇa: chos ma rig mun sel rig pa yi sgron me: don ka dag lhun 'grub zung 'jug gi dgongs pa: da thog malisangs rgyas rang rtsal nas rted de: yul dngos kun bdud rtsi grub pa yi nye lam 'dir smon gyis bskul ba dpa' bo dang dpa' mo: sgog dam tshig gyis bsdus lha dang klu'i bu mo: sman ra sa ya nar gnyer gzhes pa'i tshom bu: sgra grags stong bdud rtsi'i ched brjod ni nub med gang 'brel tshad don ldan bla ma yi zhabs drung: da mi'abral 'chogs pa'i rten 'brel zhig zhu'o: zhes pa'angabla ma mun sel nas ka ma la'i skyes
bcasabaskul ba dang grogs rat+na sarasaspro bzhin bskur ngor kho bo sbas pa'i la 'gror nusaldan rdo rje spel ba dge legs 'phel sarbam la/

bam: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las:man ngag dug lce ngaram god kha rgyun gcod rdo rje'i gdong gtad bzhugs so:༄༅ / na mo gu ru kro ta shrī ya (༷ mo/sgo rdo rje gdong 'byugs pad+ma drag po rtsal thal 'byin dbal par ldan la phyag 'tshal lo dug gsum rang mdangasami srin nga po yas skye 'gro'i bde skyid bcom tshe gtad du bcol sa ma yu lcags rkya snod du ling dum brgyad rtsa brgyad drag po' shing dum 'bru nag sha dum brgya tshogs par bsags shang me hom sbar ba ni ram bisnye dz+wa la re:shā:drag po'i gdong zur dmar nag e yi klong bdud bzhi rgyal bsen spyi chings bsnol ba'i khar:hūṃḥdamar las byung dmar nag me phreng sku:khro gtum rngams 'khrugs sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs:rta zhal khyung gdong mtshan ma'i gdon 'dul bshad:'bar ba'i dbal ngar gdon gsum snying la gzir khyung gshog sdeb cing klu rigs zas su za:ngad ldan dri yis 'byung po 'bog brgyal byed bskal pa'i me dpung srid pa'i dug rlang 'byil ma rig gdon 'thar pho nya glog ltar 'byugs mi srin srin mo bzhi yis sbor sgol 'gyed:ma rig gdon bzhi'i

gshed ma pho nya bzhi: kun kyang rngams brjid srin po khros pa'i gzigs: 'jigs pa'i hūḥsgrogs bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar rdo rje'i 'od zer khro rdul 'khrigs par shar: srog gis bskul te rngams brjed dpal ri nas pad+ma drag po gtso 'khor sprul dang bcas: ye shes sgyu ma rta khyung drag por bzhengs: 'bar ba las kyi da lar gzi byin bskyed: ma rig gdon rgod snying la dbal ston cig: mngon spyod lhun gyis grub phyir phyag kyang 'tshal mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gdon gsum phung khams stobs: rngams pa'i ljags kyis skan sgra bcas te gsol: ma ga 'khrul snang ba skye med ar la gtod: rtog gnyis gdon tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas 'gugs bstim bsgral las ni e bh+yoḥmadun du lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du: gzugs rten mtshan ma bkod pa 'di rnams: bdag dang bsrung bya la mkhon 'gres rgol ba'i gdon gsum gang yin pa de mngon sum du gsal la: na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: dkon mchog gsum kyi bka' che mchog pad+ma rta khyung drag po rtsal gyi

—8rdo: lha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin zab mo'i bden pa dang:bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden mthu phun sum tshogs pa la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i rgyal 'gong dam sri mo gdon bsen mo klu gnyan sa bdag gri bo 'gong 'dre yams kyi bdag po bdag mo thams cad gzugs rten ling ga 'di la khug cig:bla rten sha dum 'di la khug cig sgog rten shing byang 'di la khug cig:tri sne dza/ baṃ'oto:grangs gang skabs dang bstun na momachog gsum kun 'dus rta khyung drag po rtsal:bdud 'dul gzhan snang zil gnon nus mthu yis:gnod cing sgol ba'i dug gsum 'byung po rnams:gzugs rten mtshan ma rdzas bkod 'di la khug:ci mang brjod rā tsabase monā gabe the'u.a tri shu bosarba aṅku sha dzadza:mā raya prayi shas phaṭaskyobs byed kyilha srung dam log rnams dang phyes shig:khrol shig:thum ri li ri li lus chings ngag chings yid kyi dran pa rmag par gyis shig dz+wa lapa yakhrag du skyags shig:myog spyo rbad:dza:phung sabyed pa'i dug gsum gdon khyod

las ngan log par sbyor dbang gis: bdag nyid chen po'i thugs rje 'dzin: sbyor sgrol rngams stabs las la drangs dza: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: zhabrul snang lam gyi ru tra khyod: skye med dbyings su bsgral bar bya: 2j-i rutra ma ra ya rbad sod phaṭa: ces bsgral la bstab pa ni hūṃ hrī rab 'bar me dpung 'tshubs ma'i 1nga dkyil nas: che btsan dug gsum gdon 'dul he ru ga: rta khyung drag po'i zhal gyi hom khung du: dug gsum gdon gyi phung khams skye mched bstabs gtad 'di longs la ma shor dam du zungs: byang chub bar du 'gro la 'tshe ma byed: skye med sgrom rgyar rdo rje'i btson du zungs: ma gu ru artsiganertsig nyihūṃ khro phaṭa: rā tsa bse mo klu gnyan be the'u gri bo 'gong 'dre'i phung khams skye mched kha ram̐ khā 3 bisne ta krita dz+wa la re ram̐ brgya rtsa brjod la bsregs rdzas rnams drag po' zhal gyi hom du bstabs skabs su 'dod gsol gdab pa ni hoX rta khyang drag po bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: ma rig dug gsum gdon tshogs ste 'gro sngag la sbor ba rnams kyi phung khams

ga6rdo: skye mched sha khrag rus gsum la chub kyis rngub cing grum gyis rol terngams paliskan sgra dang bcas nas gdug pa dam sri'i 'khor lo rnams med par mdzod cig stong par mdzod cig: bskrad par mdzod cig: gzer bar mdzod cig: dbye bar mdzod cig: 'chings bar mdzod cig: rmug par mdzod cig: myos par mdzod cig:mnan par mdzod cig: bsad par mdzod cig: ming tsam yang mi gnas pa'i drag po'i phrin las mdzod cig: yid la brnag pa'i dam spa rnams ming med rdul du brlag par bsam de nas me zhags gcod pa ni hūṃ hrī drag blo'izhal gyis zhe sdang gdon tshogs 'thar: dbang chen rta glus sde brgyad dbyings su bcom: rngams pa'i khyung skad klu gnyan gtod la gshe: sku las spros pa'i me zhags 'bar ba'i gzis: nad rnams thams cad dbyings su dz+wa la ram̐: gdon rnams thams cad dbyings su dz+wa la ram̐ bgegs rnams thams cad dbyings su sri tshoms thams cad dbyings su mosnyedagazugs mod dbyings su kyi li li: garti mug las rgyang 'khyal 'khor dz+wa la ram̐ me kong gzugs khams gnas su da la la: zhe sngang las

byung zhabrul 'khor dz+wa la ram: me 'dabs 'dod pa'i khams su 'u ru rtsa 'dod ldan rig drug 'khor ba'i gnas stong mdzod me yi tsha tshwa phyogs bcur kun tu 'phro: phyogs skyongs sde brgyad lha 'dre tshar chod cig: me dbal mtshon cha 'bar ba'i rno ngar gyis rgya 'dre dam sri 'byung po dum bur gtubs: me yi 'od zer stong gsum kun tu 'khyil 'bar ba bdud kyi 'khor lo stong par mdzod: trig shwa trig shwa ra tsa dun dza bse mo trig shag: na ga tshal rbad 'gong po hurathum: be'u the'u larbad: gri 'gong 'byung po'i snying tshal: tri hur jesde ta krita ram̐ re gawa yang drags sngags sna tshogs brjod la me zhags dang thun gshar brab po de nas bsdu rim na hūṃ trī rngams brjed me ri 'bar ba'i zhing bkod pa: khrag 'thung drag khre'i dal du shar ba rnams: rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings su sum̐: 'khrul 'khor rba klong ka dag dbyings su bsdu: a a ā de nas bsngo smon ni hoḥ snang srid rnam dag rnga yab dpal rir shar gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rig stong khro bo 'thar: dug lnga'i gdon tshogs ye shes dbyings su bsgral: me 'bar me yi mdzad pa mthar phyin shog:

—8/sdernya lan gsum de nas shis brjod na na mo yul med mthong bas thogs bcas bdud rnams bcom: yul can grol bas thogs med bdud las rgyal: re togs mtshang grol snyems byed dga' brod stong: bdud 'dul 'bar ba chen po'i bkra shis regag: gzhan ya shis brjod rgya cher bya bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab des ni 'phral snang g.yul las rgyal the tshom med dosomag ye ma bdemadzod gas ba gsu ga mdzod pa d+ma rak+ta 'byil klo— nas dge bsnyen sha mas sprad brda las dus bab gsang ba'i rgya bkrol nas rin chen shog skya pheb pa'o samag rgya rgyargya gu phya brdanim snyi zhes pa 'di' sngags skyes lung zinasamarnya bha dra bskul ba da grogasarat+na'i ming can gyis bskul ba don dang ldan phyir kho bobadud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gas mdzod las bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lu zinatham gi sa bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgotha

—8rdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las drag sgrub 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'igand yig sngags kyi don bsdus bzhugs so:—'di: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 11be+et+ta/11 'bar dang g.yo ba'i 'od zer can drag khros bde go rdo rjer 'dud gnad yig sngags kyi don bsdus 'di lkog yig tshul du nyams su len sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya zuche/ 0 trī: brtan g.yo rnam dag me ri 'bar ba'i klong: dbang chen bde ba'i gzi 'od rab 'bar dbus dug gsum las skyes rgyal bsen klu gnyan khar:rang rig ngo bo hūṃḥmathing 'phro 'du las: gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga rwa gdeng ba: me rlung dug gi tshwa tsha glog ltar 'byugs: lte ba zlum por nyi zla'i ga'u'i nang 'khor lo rtsibs bcur khro rdul 'khrigs pa'i dbus: chos 'byung e klong gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur sgog dmar nag me 'phreng rta zhal khyung gdong spud: bzhad pa hi hi kring kring 'brug ltar smogs: ma rig slongs pa'i gdon tshogs 'dar sngangs brgyal: ngan sngags spa gri reg gcod zer 'phros pas: gags lcog 'bras srin mdze rigs gnyan nad dang nag po

sum sbrel grum bu chu ser sogs:thams cad mi gnas stong pa'i 'khor lor bsre:rdo rje phur pa sdig phag phyag char 'gyed:phra men mu stegs rbod gtong bzlog par byed:sde brgyad ar gtad gnam lcags dbal phur ldan:dpa' ba'i rtags su zhing gling thod sbrul brgyan thogs med las myur khyung gaXg g.yas g.yon gdengs:klu rig za zhing sprul ba rdul ltar 'tshubs yas kyi rwa la 'jam dpal dbang chen dang:gtum pa me dbal mkha' 'gro sde lnga shar:mar gyi rwa la dus 'byor dus mtshan dang:chags stobs shugs sgrol dbang phyugs nag po gsal:pad 'dabs yas mas hūḥyig phra mo'i gtams:thabs kyi cha 'dzin g.yas nas lcags sdig 'phro:shes rab rang bzhin g.yon nas dur phag rgyu:za byed khyung nag me gshog mdun ngos 'gyings:gsod byed stag seng rgyab nas bran ltar 'dud:thams cad ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyis bskul rab 'bar gsang ba'i snying po'i sgog gcig 'gyur:nus mthu stobs kyis gang la gzes pa de:bsregs bcom bskam la stong chen dgongs nyams skyongs:sde brgyad ar gtad rta yis

badz+ra: 'dul glu sgrogs: don dam nyag gcig rang rig drag po rtsal: mngon gyur ye bab dag chen chos sku'i ngang oṃ gu ru artsig nertsig trī hūṃ khrom ru ru bha sha du ye ka la du pa e dza je phaṭa: drag sngags thog rgod 'bar ba 'dis gza' klu sde brgyad gdug tshub dang 'byung po pongs kyis nad gdon rkyen byad phur rbod gdong cho 'phrul dang mo ngan rmi lam 'khrugasapa dang rgyal bsen ze 'gong gri bo' rkyen thog ser bu yug 'tshubs pa sogs thams cad 'di yis bzlog cang gzhesas nus pa nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyams rdzu 'phrul thog las rno ngar che gags 'bras srin rigs dran pas 'joms lhog pa spun dgu rdul du rlog mdze rags bco brgyad rming nas skems glog dang skar mda' lce 'bab gzhoms sgrang dang sgran dang gzer nad zhi mthu ldan sngags kya gnad yig 'di gong bsnyen bye ba tshad du 'khyol de nas las la sbyor ba' tshe gang la btab kyang rkyen snang grol bar chad g.yupa las rgyal bar 'gyur samawā yang gcig sngags kyi bsgyur kha ni ram ram tsig tsig2nags 'bras srin la lnga ga lnga ga dza thud pāṭa: de ya nusamathus gang 'bras srin nad thub sa ma shā dram rdor ye rdzar sha rdzar khrag rdzar garkata la la swā hwa gre gzer khrag dang sha 'bras tsha dzer thub sam khreg hrig ya ma 'gong po'ikha the: ri 'go mchis 'gong dkar

'gong thamasacad sel sam mā kha ram̐ hu le bha tsa la swā shā shig dang ldi ba za phrug kun la phan samaku reta khrag chu rtsa rak+ta che/ma: sna khrag khrag ngan rma khrag thams cad gcod sa ma mā 'ug sha dzar rkang thab sprin khrag shes yig sha grib ling thab ling rkyer ling kun kyang thub sa ma mā a mi ta tsha thab rba ru gzhob swā shā thab gnad gnyan gas sgrang gzer kun la phan sam mā ma sa ka rtsa chu'i sgo la sol yi ye chil chil swā hwa rtsa chu bsdamasagrol bu dang sha ma thon sam shā zlo a hril hril stog pa sprun dgu til zhi zhi mal mal swā hā: sa lhog 'bu lhog tsher stog gzhoms sam mā sa na ga khrom rbad chi le su rwa gla nag rtsi byug klu nad kun la phanaḥ sam mā kring hrīng ra hu la ram̐ khaṃ: mgo dgu byugs btab gza' nad kun la phan sa ma shā yakru ram dun dza phag thun sngagasasbyar gnod bzhin nad kun thub sam shā bi the sa tsi ze the rgog thal sngagasasbyar 'gong the rming nas skems sam mā dha dhu tha tram̐ nang bha ya swā hā: ya ma la sogs mgo 'khor 'bu rigasathub sa ma mā snyeX k+ṣe ga du ste/ swā hā: mi la bse rag thab las 'dri ba gzhesas sam shā khrom lhang tser krig shag shel thum gas pur badz+ra bi sha tse hūṃ pāṭa: nad gdon gzer sgrang kun la rab tu bsngags sam pā thim tha ra ti sa turnye dz+wa la re bha

ra mi: ye swāhwa:yung ser shu dag bong nag bsngags la 'amang nad yam 'gos rim kun las rgyal bar 'gyur sa mag ya leya lespyang rikhye yale swārwa:'di yisanus pas gcan spyang mchu chings so sa mawā ha hrīha dṛ sdom re dzardo nag la bawa btson bzung dgra rnams 'ching sa mawā dha shalcags rnonangar zhu zhi malamal bsgyurabasgyur dza dzago:rgya kri la bawa 'chang bas mtshon bsrung ngo sa ma shā na nag dzamun+d+ra thog zhun baṃswā snyabargya rtsa bzlos pas thog gi 'jigs pa sel sa mawā a cigatseg ratsa 'da' 'khru ldogan tsit+ta phyung bzlogabod:sngags 'ad bzlas pas rgyal gdon nad las grol samashā ra moyakru mobase gsonag na 'dremo'i gesdom mchutshongs bhastore ram̐kha tha sngags 'di gzir ba mo 'dre mchu chings ngoḥs mamā ka lahu nyudu nasaḥphra 'a gdug pa'i byad zor rbod gtong thub sa mawā zhal mtshalatswa rak+taswā snyasngags 'dis mkha' 'gros bka' pha khrag rimasabazlog sa mawā nyal nyala'adi soganyaganyag sogasole bhidachil tshilaswā hāsngags 'disazho chang lad dang dkar rkun gzhoms samawā rtsetigawaka nanas phyungaphyungs khrolaste(la swāhwa:sngags 'dis ngag mnan grol bar 'gyur sa mamā a g.ya mdu ༄khyad phurabacesag:he

ka ya ma du ru byad phur bzlog: sarba tsit+ta snyi ma ya du ru byad phur bzlog sarba cit+ta gzer thum bisne trig dza rbad ya bzlog: 'di yi nus pas ban bon kun rgyu'i byad thams cad nyi mas ba mo ji bgo 'byur sam shā tsa tur he le btsan tri shu bo khrol bur gtor re sngag kyi nus pa btsan gyisargol ba thub sam mā kha tur ma ma ram gri bo'i tsit+ta gtub dza re rbad: ram̐ rak+ṣe tresngagasa'adis nye 'gong zhing 'dre btsan gshed thub sam mā triḥr tsa rgyal po'i cit+ta zung zung: mo 'dre'i snying la shag shag gnyan gtor klu la ram̐ re: ma sha rbad rbad 'da' na dug gsum gdon snying phyung phyung: lhog na dug gsum gdon snying gtub gtub: 'khu na dug gsum gdon snying phrol phrol: ya ya ya dri ya ma zhus triya:ma zhungatre+e pa dug gsum gdon la dri dza: e khur thum dza: ti phur nag po'i snying la ram̐ re: ti phur nag mo'i srog la shag shag: ti phur nag mo'i thod khrag la yeyo rtsa dbugs sgog layam shudar:cit+ta phyung phyung thun thun: dza dza: trag rakru sgog chod: zhe sdang rus la rngams rngams: gti mug sha la dza dza 'dod chags khrag la rbad rbad: phrag dogadabugs layo yo nga rgyal snying la

—8rdo: —tre:na gar tsabase motsasnen takretaram r+shadrag sngags spu gri'i 'khor lo 'dis dug gsum 'byung po gas cang bsregs gdugs pa gajon gyi snying khrag lud steng 'og bar gdon ar la gtad nus pa me lte'i 'khor lo 'dra ga la gzes pa de bsregasa'abyur stobs ni gnam lcags thog da 'dra mi mthun phyogs la gtad nas brlag yon tan sman gcig dang 'dra bas nad rnams kun la sleb pas chog gnad yag sngags kyi don bsdus 'di'i byin rlabs mthu stob bsam mtha' yas sa mayu rgya rgyargya sngags kya mchod cing bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī:sku yitsheb nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyams:gsung gi nga ros sde brgyad 'byung po 'dar:ye shes thugs kyis 'khrul 'khor rmang nas bshigs:gar dgu'i dbang phyugs rta khyung drag por bstod:dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab shis pa brjod cing ོgas rims skyongs des ni bdud 'dul dpal chen thob pad+ma he ru'i gsang gsum mthong sa masru ste tshodabang chen gsang ba gsung gi gnas pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong ran chen brda mdzod snyang po' bcud dge bsnyen sha yis sprad pa las smon lam dag pa'i gsang rgya grol ye shes thugs kyi gtad rgya sad mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod ma 'dres 'jal sa mas rgya rgyargya gu rgyabarda/mi snyi zhes pa 'di'ang chos bdaga'agyur med rgya mtshosarin chen sbos

shel bcasabaskul ba dang chos bdag thub bstan dbang posabakra shis lha regs dang nor mchog snag gis skyesabacas dge rganani ma la phrin ba ga nas zung gis bskul ba dang chos bdag dam papad+ma kun bzang gnyis la yang dgyes byed kyisargyur ye 'gro snyams nas kho bobadud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las zhal bdus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅgal
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las: drag po dmar nag me 'phreng rtsal gyidabang rdzongs dregs pa'i sgog tig dmar nag zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

༄༅// na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye:tshog /(bamis can gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi'i gshed po che nga bdag 'thar mdzad he ru ka rta zhal khyung gdong me phreng rtsal snying dbusami shig thig ler rol ma 'ongasal ldan pho mo rnams smin zhing grol bar bya ba'i phyir drag po dmar nag me phreng ga dbang gengasadregs pa'i srog tig bstan sam mā dkyil 'khor dbang dzos gzhung bzhin bshams bdag mdun bum bzlas tshad du'akhyol rang nyid 'jug cing rig me tor slob ma gral bsdu khrus bgegs bsal srung 'khor sgom la bden don bshad mkhrophul la gsol gdab ni kya:ma rig dza the 'thar mdzad he ru ka rab 'jigs dus me 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dang:tha mi dad pa'i rdo rje sgobs dpon dgongs:dbang rdzongs dregs pa'i srog tig bdag la stsol:lan gsum zhu lan gnang ni ho:dpa' bo chen po mthong thos dran dang reg:ma rung ru tra bdud dpung g.yul ngo las:rgyal byed gzhom med rdo rje'i go cha sbyin:dam tshig de stsol dmar nag me phreng zungs de nas skyabs 'gro ni ho:nga bdag du tra'i snying 'byin he ru ga:dug gsum gdon tshogs bdag med rnon pos 'bigs:'jigs byed gar dgu'i dpal 'khyud me phreng rtsal skyabs kyi mchog brten rig

༄༅// pa'i snying por 'dzin: de nas sems bskyed ni ho brgal dka' srid pa'i rba 1nga stug po las nga bdag mtshan mar bzung ba'i 'gro ba rnams: don dam he ru'i gsang gsum mngon gyur phyir: lhag mthong rig stong mngon gyur sems bskyed do de nas tshogs bsags ni na mo: khro rgyal stobs 'dus 'jigs tshogs 'thar mdzad la: he ru bde sbyor dgongs pa'i phyag bgyi'o: khams gsum rol rtsed sku gsum thugs su 'bul: rtag chad mu bzhir gol ba mthol lo bshags: gar dgu'i nyams dzogs mdzad par rjes yi rangs: sbyor sgrol thabs mkhas 'gro ba'i don slad bskul: gdul bya rgya mtshor phan bde'i gsos su bzhugs dge kun mi dmigs spros mtha' bral bar bsngo phyams gcig gdod ma'i grol gzhi mngon gyur shog de nas bka' gnang ni ho gtsang dang sme bar 'dzin pa nyon re mongs sbyor grol thabs su ma spyad blo re dman: 'khor ba'i srog rlung dbu ma chen por gcod: ma byin len pa bde ba kun gyi gsang mi tshangs spyod pa rgyal kun dgyes pa'i sprin: mi dge dang blang dge ba dmigs su med dam tshog kun gyi rgyal po

spyod shes na:rnam pa 'jig rten 'dra yang don sangs rgyas:he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i sras su bsngags:de ltar spyod na dbang gi skal ba sbyin:mi nus pa rnams bde ba chen por dengs:bde rtsol bde 'dod bde ba ngas mi sbyin:'khor 'das ldog pa'i brji la dngos grub ster: yako nyide nas dam tshag khas len ni rdo srid pa mthar mdzadardo rje rgyal pos dgongs:'gro ba'i don du nyon mongs mi sbong spyod:sems can yongs sgrol mi dge thabs kyis len:lha klu mi mor bdeba'i dga' ston ster:sngags kyi bya spyod dka' ba thams cad spyod:'da' ka ye shes sgog gi slad du 'dzin:gzhi med rtsal sbyangs kun rdzob rdzun mtshang rdol: nyag gcig rig pa'i 'das par yid smin grol:byul brdal dgongs pas 'khor 'das ka nas dag:lhun rdzogs kun bzang dgongs klong btsan sa 'dzin:de lta bu la dngos grub dbang mchog stsol:lan gsum de nas mna' chu ni rdo 'da' dka' rdo rje rgyal po las kyi chu: rdo rje lce yi dam tshig pad+mo reg: dam bsrung bde mchog ye shes dngos grub sbyin: nyams na bka' yi chad pa thog ltar 'bebs: phung

༄༅// 'tshengs nus pa'i mna' chu gzu bor zungs: badz+ra sam yan rakan: mig dar bkab cing me tog gtad slob ma lhar gsal ye shes dbabs bstan par bzhugs gsol me tog to shis pa brjod la rab tu gnas de nas me tog dor ba ni hoḥ he ru ka dpal pad+ma 'dzum pa'i zhal: bde mchog rig 'dus gsung gi da la phu rig pa'i me tog dad brgya'i 'dab ma can gus pas 'bul 61 lhag pa'i lha der phob: badz+ra pur+shapu dza41: gsang mtshan 'thar byed rgyal po shes rab ma la hu lu bde stobs zhes gdags par bya'o tshom bu'i dbang bskul du brtsal la yis pratai skṛ sto eme tiṣ+ṭhabadz+ra: de nas gdo g.yog bkrol ba na ho: sangs rgyas dngos grub 'khor 'das mnyam par bzhugs: ye nas sku gsum rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la: ma rig gsum gyis sgrib pa'i gdos por bzung: da ni ye shes rig pas dri ma bsal: dz+nyā na tsaklu pratswa shaya phaṭa ngo yang sprad do de nas nus pa'i dbang lnga ni rdo rje'i khri gdan gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ zhibar gzegs pas zhi ba chos skur brdal: lhag ger mtho bas srid rtsa zil gyis gnon zung 'jug dgongs pa mngon du gyur ba'i phyir 'pho med rdo rje'i khri ru mnga' gsol lo:

tho badz+rarat+na maṇ+ḍala.a snyi ṣiñtsa 4 nyi zla pad+ma gto la hū hrīḥ bde ba'i 'byung gnas pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dal: 'bar ba'i rang bzhin mtshan ma kun bsreg gzi: bsil ldan dngas ma byang chub sems kyi bcud: bde stong spros bral spyod phyir bdag dbang phul: o pad+ma sur+ya tsan+d+ra ma hā su kha.a bhiḍiñtsa tshi gser gyi yor lo gto la hū hrī 'khor ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs ma rten 'brel dgu: chos kyi 'khor lo zeg pa rim dgus skyongs: ye shes klong dgu'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes phyir: rten 'brel phun tshogs rtags kyi mnga' gsol lo:oṃ badz+ra tsakra dharma dhartu e haṃ a snyi ྅sdoms: de nas dung dang glegs bam 'bras snye rnams gam la o hrī mi nub chos kyi sgra dbyangs skad po che: rgyud sde kun gyi yang bcud glegs bam dang nus mthu smon lam mtha' yas 'bras snye bcas: stobs mchog 'dzom pa chos rgyal rtags dbang bskur: o ka rum shabha dharma sum bhu rā dza a bhi ྅2lon de nas rdor dril gam la hū hrī thabs kyi rang bzhin kun 'byung theg pa 'dzin: shes rab rang bzhin dka' thub bslab bya ston: gnyis med dbang bsgyur rdo rje'i mdzad pa skyongs: dam tshig gsum ldan

༄༅// ston par mnga' gsol lo: snyed ma hā badz+ratsan: dz+nyā nadhardu ni (tsu tsit+tas mas ni dga' ston bya zhing rol mo sgrogs sa mayu de nas phan pa'i dbang bcu yang maṇ+ḍalaphul la gsol gdab ni kye bdag mtshan rtogs pa'i dra ༅ 'dul ba'i phyir: rta khyung drag po'i phyi yi dbang gsum kyang: he ru ka dpal rdo rje rgyal po yis: skal ldan bdag cag rnams la rtsal du gsol: lan gsum zhu gnang ba ni hoḥ sna chogs ma rung gzugs snang spyod pa kun: sems kyis bzos te sems can snang ngor ston: don la mi dmigs pad+ma nga yis rtogs brtul zhugs rta khyung drag pos tshar gcod do: de nas phyi sgrub dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad can rgya sku gto la hūṃ hrīḥ dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes chos kyi sku 'jigs rung srin rgyal dbu dgu rngams gshe sgegs: rta skad khyung glus sa gsum 'byung po brgyal: he ru ka dpal khro rgyal stobs 'dus dbang: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: bar chad bdud las rgyal ba'i dpal thob shog rtsa sngags mthar ka yas snyiṣiñtsa tsho de nas sngags 'khor gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ bzlas pa tsam gyis gdug pa'i dpa' rkong shing phrin las rnams

bzhi'i gzi byin drod dang ldan: dug gsum 'byung po 'bog brgyal 'thar bar byed: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i gsung gi dbang thob shog mo guru artsig nertsig hrīḥhūṃ41 phaṭa: sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gyi sgog la mā ra ya rbad ram̐ ram̐: wak+ka abhi ṣiñtsa āX bzlasalung 'bog cing rtags dbang bskur de nasardo rje ra gdengasadang sdig pa gawa la hū trīḥ phe shesamatshon chen gnam lcags rdo rje 'dis: nga bdag tu tra'i snyigs khrag khol bar byed las byed yaka me dbal rngams pa'i sku: mthong ba tsam gyis dug gsum 'byung po brgyal: nus mthu phun tshogs khro rgyal thugs kyi dbang skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin rtsa sngagasamathar tsit+ta a nyi ྅do shā 'dod gsol gdab bzhin shis pa brjod maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni byeXm rig rmongs pa'i 'gro ba tshar gcod cing 'jig lta rdul brlag drag po'i nang dbang gsum: he ru ka dpal rdo rje rgyal po yis: 'dir tshogs mos ldan rnams la gnang bar zhu: lan gsum zhu bka' gnang ni ༄ste med la thod parabazung ba rtog pas bdud: dug gsum 'byung po'i rang mdangs 'khor bcas g.yo: gang yang pad+ma drag po rta khyung gis skye

༄༅// med dbyings su ar la gtad par bya: de nas nang bsgrub zhal gsum phyag drug can gyi sku gto la hūṃ trī: rta khyung drag po he ru rngams pa'i gar: bdud dpung zil gnoca dbang chen 'dul glu sgrogs: dregs pa'i dpa' skong nus mthu rdzogs pa'i dbang dug gsum gdon 'dul dam pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar ka ya.a bhiṣiñtsa tsho de nas phreng ba gtad la hūṃ trīḥ kun btags ma rig gzhan dbang gdon gyi tshogs: pongs grub 'khor ba chos sku rgyas 'debs phyir brjod med snying po bcud 'dus rigs brgya'i dbang skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar wak+ka a snyi ṣiñtsa.āḥ de nas ral gri dang khyung dmar gtad la hūṃ hrī bdag 'ardzan mtshan ma chos kyi dbyings su gcod shes rab mtshon chen rdo rje rno ngar ldan: ma rig sa bdag klu 'dul ye shes khyung mdze rigs bco brgyad gegs sdog gzer 'bras sgran nag po sum spril dus kyi gdon nad kun: dran pas stong byed drag po mthu yi dbang: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sbyin par byed: rtsa sngags mthar rtsat+ta a snyi ྅༷ rgyu: smon lam btab la shas pa brjod maṇ+ḍal phul rjes gsol gdab ni kye

bdag 'dzin mtshan ma'i yul chos kun tu btags: sna tshogs bkod pa chu zla'i rdzun ris ngoms: 'khrul pa rtsad gcod drag po'i gsang dbang gsum: he ru ka dpal mchog gi bdag la stsol lan gsum zhu bga' gnang ni hoX snang tsam stong pa rten 'brel kun rdzob chos: legs nyes sems kyis byed grub ya nga'i 'phrang: rang rig 'od gsal klong du tshar gas da phyir: pad+ma drag po bdag gis rjes su 'dzin de nas gsang sgrub zhal rta dbu thung gdong yod mapha gcig phyag bzhi can gyi sku gtad la hū hrīX drag po khyung klus sa bdag klu gnyan 'dar dbang chen hi yas dreg pa sde brgyad 'dul dus me 'bar bas srid gsum gdug pa 'thar: dmar nag me phreng rtsal gyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya.a bhi ṇiñtsa.oṃ de nasahrīḥ/ zloligagamal hū hrī dran pas thugs dam rgyud bskul snying po trīḥ nus pas bdud dpung zil gnon hū: yig 'bar: mdzad pas dug gsum 'thar byed yi ge zlo dpal chen khro rgyal stobs mchog dbang thob shog: rtsa sngagasamathar wak+ka a rnyi ṣiñtsa a de nas phur bu dang dur phag mgo dgu gto la hū hrīḥ srid gsum rba klong 'khrul 'khor mtshan ma

cu // 'big: log pa'i rgol ba gnyis chos mtshan ma bsreg: sa 'og gnyan gyi sma phab brdul mdzad 'phro: dbang bskur ma rung 'byung po 'thar byed shog: rtsa sngags mthar: tsit+ta.a snyi ṣiñtsa gyi smon lam bawa la shis pa brjod maṇ+ḍal phul rjes gsol gdab ri: kyi nyon mongs las lasaskyes pa'i rang rgyud pa 'byung po dam sri'i rgor ba tshar gcod phyir: gnyis med ye shes gsang ba'i dbang mchog sgo: rigaldanaskal pa bzang po bdag la stsol: lan gsum zhu bka' gnang ni ta ma rig dug gsum 'khrul ba'i rang mdangs su: a 'thas rgyal bsen 'byung po tha dad shar: 'khrul pa rnam dag chos sku sangs ba'i phyir bdag nyid pad+ma drag pos rjes su 'dzin: de nas gtor ma la gsang sgrub zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku'i brgyan pa gto la hūṃhrī gdul dka' 'dul mdzad dbang drag pad+ma'i sku: che ba'i stobs rdzogs rta khyung gtsug na spa: 'khor 'das dpal bkod dam rdzas bha ling ta: khrag 'thung rgyal po bde stsor don gyi dbang: skal lngan rig 'dzin las lngan pho mor smin: nyiruka dpal gsang gsum mngon gyar shog: rtsa sngags mthar bālijo guṇa

ma bhiṣiñtsa trīḥ smon lam gtab la shisapa brjod dga' ston tshogs dang ston mo bya sam mā de nasago cha'i dbang lnga ni maṇ+ḍal phul la 'di skad do slob ma gu ru drag po gsal ba'i spyi bor sku yi go cha bgo ba ni 'jam dpal gyi sku gam la ཿtrī ༷ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi gsang rdzogs gar: smra ba'i nyi ma 'jam dpal ye shes sems: khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal yon tan go cha rigs ldan bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar ya man+taka badz+rarak+ta dṛhū: slob ma gu ru drag po gsal ba'i mgrin par gsung gi go cha bgo ba ni: rta mgrin gam la ཿhrīḥ bde stong zung 'jug glu bro gar gyi bdag 'gags med bde sbyor he hi bshad sgra ston pad+ma gar dbang rta mgrin gtum mo yum: gsung gi go cha rigs ldan bu la bgo rkyen pad+marta kṛta h+ya ṣ+ṭṛwa badz+ra rak+ta shrī hū: slob ma gu ru drag po gsal ba'i slob snying khar thugs kyi go cha bgo ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ yi shes thugs klong chos nyid mkha' ltar dag: bsam mi khyab bzhin 'gro 'dul gzigs pa can: gsang bdag rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug dpal thugs mchog go cha rigs ldan bu la bgo: oṃ badz+rapa ṇi ma hādṛbadz+rarak+ṣamatru: slob ma gu ru drag po

༄༅// gsal ba'i lte bar yon tan gyi go cha bgo ba ni:nyu hrīḥ'abyung ba rnam dag yum chen lnga yi gsang phung po rang grol bder gshegs rgyal ba'i gdung spro bsdumi byed po phag mo rigs lnga yi: ye shes gsang ba'i go cha bu la bgo ma badz+ra bhirnyarat+na pad+ma rma wang nyimesarba rak+ta sho hūṃ slob ma gu ru drag po gsal ba'i gsang bar phrin las kyi go cha bgo ba ni: / hrīḥ khro rgyal stobs 'dus 'khor ba'i dpung tshogs gnon rngams pa'i gad rgyang dam sri'i snying la 'debs: gang 'dul phrin las glog 'khyug he ru ga'i:bsrung byed go cha rig ldan bu la bgo snyed badz+ra/yak+ka sno ra / darma mul badz+ratsakra etsū ran shis pa brjod brjod cing dga' ston bya me tog 'thor bzhin rab tu gnas de na rgyasagadab kyi dbang bzhi ni 'dor lo bsgyur ba gto la hūṃ hrīḥ khams gsum rba slong chos kyi dbyings su bsgyur: dug gsum gdon tshogs skye med dbyings su bcar: nga bdag ru tra'i gdug rtsub smor ngan bgrang: gtsug tor 'khor basbyar basmang dbang bu la sgrin badz+ra tsakralu lakarma byusmorna mam rakru rak+ṣa de nas khro bcu phur mjug can rdo rje dang phur ba 'dzin pa gam la hūṃ hriḥ

phyogs bcu'i gden 'dul phyong skyongs snying la 'bigs: bar chad g.yul bzlog bsrung skyobs 'phrin las myur 'jig byed khro rgyal chen po sprul pa bcas skal ldan bsrung ba'i gnyer gtad dbang bskur bya:hū /hū (hū: hū /hū (hū ma ma tset+ta rak+ṣatshwa spyo de nas rdo rje sngon po sgog hūṃ dmar marga pa can gam la hū hrīXchos nyid mi 'gyur don dam rdo rje las: 'khor 'das snying po rgyu yi sems dpa' ni: rkyen gyis mi shig de bzhin nyid du bzhugs: skal ldan bu la bde stong snying po sbyin rtsa sngags mthar hū trig shag aphaṭa tsit+ta rak+ta rak+ṣa de nas me tog 'thor la hū hrīḥ sems kyis bzos pa'i dug gsum gdon las rgyal: rnam rtog las byung nad rnams kun las grol: 'dus byas skye dga' na 'chi'i g.yul las rgyal pad+ma drag po'i gsang gsum mngon gyur 3snag maṅga lamarmā stitaiṣ+ṭha badz+ratsos tsho dga' ston bya zhing rol mo sgrogs de nas bde mchog bde bar rol ba'i dbang gsum ni snang ba mtha' pasagato la hū trī bde ste nga spre sa bral smra bsam brjod las 'das dri med ye shes gzigs pa mtha' yas ngoms gsung mchog rigs 'dus snang ba mtha' yas sku

༄༅// 'chi med tshe dbang skal ldan bu la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar ā yu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas rakru thod phreng rtsal gto la hūṃ hrī mkha' gting mi dmigs ye shes thugs kyi klong bzod dka' srid pa'i du ṣa skyobs byed cing: 'khrul ba rmings 'gyel bde mchog thabs kyi dbang: skal ldan las smon phun tshogs rnams la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar rakru he ru ka sarba sirnyi a bhi stethu ྅: de na pad+ma mthang nag bzhing tso can 'byung gnas kyi sku gto la hūṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings klong nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa ngoms: 'gro 'dul phrin las bsam dang brjod las 'das dbang byin dngos grub ye shes yon tan mdzod: pad+ma 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar pad+ma ka ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa trīḥ de nas nus pa smon pa'i dbang ni bum pa thogs la bum pa tshos dbyings khyab brdal spros bral klong: 'od gsal ye shes lha sku'i bkod pa ngoms: zag med bde sbyor byang chub sems bcud 'khyil: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: lus dang rtsa yi sgrib pa kun dag nas: snang stong gnyis med ye shes mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar kum bhahaṃ badz+ras bhiṣiñtsa tsho: de nas

bcud bde stong ye shes su bskyil ba'i dbang ni hū trīḥ mtshan ldan bde stong ka pā la yi nang gu ru ḍak+ki bde sbyor bcud kyis gtams dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i sprin chen 'phro ba yis:skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa kun dag nas: gsal stong gnyis med ye shes mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar ba bho bo la kache hrī po a dzhai ṣiñtsa ā de nas thabs la mkhas pas khams gsum rol rtsed bsgyur ba' dbang ni hū hrīX rigs lnga'i rtags 'chang bde stong zhal bzang ngoms: mdzes pa'i dpal 'khyud 'dzum bzang yid 'ong ma: 'du shes gsum gyis rol rtsed gyis brten na: mi rtog ye shes bde ba sbyin mdzad cing: yid dang thig le'i 'dzin stangs rnam dag nas bcu drag gsum dag dga' stong mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar mū tra pradz+nyā a snyi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas don dam mtha' bral 'bras bu nyag gcig gi dbang ni hū hrīX tshig dang dpe yis mi mtshon don rdom pa dri med 'od gsal thig le'i spro bsdu 'gyed kun khyab rang byung ye shes brda yi dbang: dgongs pa dbyer med ngang nas bu la sbyin: cha mnyam sgrib dag rig stong mngon gyur nas: spros bral ka

dbyubyu// dag tshig dbang rtogs par regag a a.uḥ phaṭa phaṭaphaṭa: de ni phrin las nus mthu'i dbang ngo brtul zhugs kyi dbang bco brgyad ni dus mtshan chen mo gtad la hūṃ hrīX gnas la dbang bsgyur srid pa'i drwa ba gtor: bag chags drag po skye med dbyings su bcir snang ba thabs la stong pas bde rgyas 'debs dus mtshan dbang phyug 'bar ma'i dbang bskur ro: rlung la dbang bsgyur las rlung zil gnon shog: rtsa sngags mthar dz+nyā namu tra.a bhiṣiñtsa sno de nas ye yig gto la hūṃ trīḥ yul la dbang bsgyur bag chags drwa ba gtor:bde ba'i rang lam ye shes kun tu bskyil: snang cha gsal bar stong pas bde rgyas 'debs dus sbyor thabs mkhas chen mo'i dbang bskur ro: me la dbang bsgyur 'bar ba zil gnon shog: rtsa sngags mthar dz+nyā na tāya bhikhiñtsa sno de nas a shad gam la hūṃ trī rngams ma las kyi nye rgyu rab dben zhing: rbar nas bskul te g.yos pas ma yin par: dam tshig phyag rgya bde ba'i ro ltar bzhugs: rlung gi rjes 'gro bde ba zag med mthong: mi shig 'bar 'khyil gang ba'i dbang thob shog: ye: a snyiṣiñtsa nyi de nas gsatshul dbang mo

to la hrū mchog dang dman bdur khrod kun 'dzin zhing:sa lam dbang bsgyur sa kun sdog pas gnon:bde ba'i gsang mdzod nam mkha'i dbyings nas bskul chags ra 'khril ma bde dbyings dbab cing sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar sgo 0 nyude nas haṃ yig gtad la hrū kun 'byung dpa' 'angade ba'i bcom ldan 'das:las kyi rgyu grol dam cog dag pa ru gtum pa mo yis 'khor 'das rgyas gdab bskul dbab bskyil 'dren 'debs brtul zhugs dbang thob shog stim ༷ḍiñtsa nyishug sgrol 'bar ma gto la tshuX sgo ho be+elasar brten 4sa te he ru ka la rten 'brel che ba stobs:dbang bsgyur glog ltar myur 'debs phrin las can:sha za shugs sgro4bar ma'i dbang bskur ro rtsa gsamathar sgro 0 asnye 'dzi:ཿde nasa.a zug sna lnga gam la steḥkhams rnams zad cinga'abyed ldog thabs la mkhas:'byung dang 'byung 'gyur ye shes sang du sbyor bde nga spros bral dmigs bsam yul las 'das 'bras bu nyag gcig 1nga la dbang thog shog yi ma 3〉〉〉 lhade nas ye khaṃ ling gzugs 4sa pa gam la 〉〉༷bsgral bo'i

༄༅// dam tshig snying rje mchog la gnas: gsang chen spyod pa gsod gcod dam tshig bstan he ru ka la zhing bcu brngan du gtad rnal 'byor khyod kyis dang du len par bya e ma tram̐ duhra a snyi ༷༷ trīḥ skabs 'dir gser skyems mkhyen gzu dang ye bskyed 'gugs pa las bzhi dang gso ba tshe khrusaganas gsum bya de nas dbang phyug nag po gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ la :ngobadag pos srid pa zhabs kyis bsgyur grol 'khrul sa 'dzin legs nyes shan drang 'byed drag rtsal rngams yas zhing bcu dgra la 'debs dbang phyug 'char byed nag pos dbang bskur ro oṃ ma hā de wa j-i ka la a snyi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nas bsgral chas gam la hūṃ hrīḥ bdag med rtogs pa'i rang mdangs ye shes mtshon: sna tshogs las kyi phyag cha ngar dang ldan:zhing bcu'i snying la thog ltar myur 'bebs 'di: dpa' bo brtul zhugs spyod la mnga' gsol gtad sarba su ru ṭa sha hūṃ ma ra ya a snyi ṇiñtsat+t+waṃḥ de nas 'an rje yod po gto la hūṃ trīḥ gdug pa'i dgra la rngams pas brtul zhugs bskyed 'jigs pa'i mtshon brdar las kyi shan pa mdzad: pad+ma he ru'i bka' bzhin dam tshig 'dzinaX las gshin tshe bdag

'bar bas dbang bskur ro: yo yalan+ta ka shrī sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa ñtsa de nas thun rdzasagato la hū hrī zhing bcu'i lus la sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char shes rab ral gri ha la mtshe yungs thun: mda' rdo gtor ma khrag thun khol ma 'di: mngon spyod mdzad pa skyongs phyir bu la sbyin: sarba du co ma ra ya garma bh+yo dza a bhi ṇiñtsa trīḥ de nas bdud 2la kai la ya gtad la hū hrī 'dzan las no myur thogs pa mi mnga' ba: thal 'byin dgongs pa ye shes gzi byin can dpal chen stobs 'dus badz+ra ki la ya: rigs kyi bu la gtad do mngon spyod skyongs:oṃ badz+ra ki la ya dṛ ka la ru pa hū a bhi ṣiñtsa nyi de nas sgrol phur gam la hū hrīḥ ma rung rū tra'i snying 'byin rak+ta gzhib: rnam shes dbyings sbyor 'phrin las 'dus pa'i sras: sbyor sgrol dbyings bskul mngon spyod drag po'i dbang: rigs ldan khyod la sbyin no dang du longs: ki la ya spa ra ṇa phaṭa: bho dhi tsit+ta sang ha ra ṇa hūṃ: a dhi ṣiñtsa hrīX bsgral las bya'o de nas sang ha ḍik+ki sku gto la hā hrīḥ gzhan snang zil gnon byad phur g.yul ngo bzlog: nus mthu stobs rdzogs bde chen ye shes 'gyed: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro las la

༄༅// 'gyed bdud 'dul drag mo'i dbang bskur bu la sbyin: be karma seng ha ḍak+ki ni sarba garma yak+ka bh+yo dza a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉: de nas me hom gto la hūṃ hrīX gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin dri ma bsregs byed cing: ma rung rū tra'i phung khams dbyings su skems: rnam shes skye med bde ba chen por sbyor 'bar ba'i 'phrin las mthar phyin dbang thob regag: ak+ṣe ye dz+wa la reḥthegarnye puspyo ku wa sha ma ra ya phaṭa.a snyi ༷༷sa sa: bstab las bya'o de nas bzlog gtor ru dar sngags rgyan dug mtshe rtsang yungs ke shing me sgon brgyan pa can gtad la hūṃ hrī 47sa nyid zhi ba'i nyon mongs zhi bzlog bsgyur: shes rab 'bar bas bdud dpung dbyings su 'thar: snying rje yis ni 'gro drug 'khor ba stong ye shes kyis ni yid chos mtshan ma bzlog: donadam dgongs pasakun rdzob mtshangs kun rdol: srid zhu gnyis med mnyam nyid chos skur bzlog: dmigs bcas du tra rnam gsum 'ben gzugs la: lhag mthong rdo rje rjon po'i gtor zor gzir: dug gsum dbyengs sgor rta khyang drag khros gshe thabs shes lca spod dag pa'i thun mtshon 'debs: ma rig gsum gyi nasal 'khor

stong gyur cig de ltar khro rgyal stobs 'dus bzlog pa'i dbang rnal 'byor spyor sgol gsang 'dzin khyod la gtad: bka' bzhin zhi drag mnyam pas bzlog las skyong: shrī he ru ka sa ma ya bh+yoḥbazlog ba a snyi ༷༷ hūṃ bzlog bh+yo dmar gsum bya'o de ltar brtul zhugs dbang bco brgyad bdag gzhan don du mkhasapasaspyod sam shā khyad par gtad med ngang skyongs bzhin he ru'i brtul zhugs la brten nas rig pa hur byung nyams rtogasarbar ḍa dril gsal bzhin 'di skad do hū hūṃḥ gzung ba rnam dag yul med zang thal klong 'dzin pa rang grol ye shes he ru ka rten 'brel dbyings sbyor bde ba'i klong dang bsre: 'khor ba dong sprug bro dbang dang du longs a āḥ ji ltar snang yang ji snyed gzigs pa'i spyan: 'pho med dbyings las dgongs pa mi g.yo bzhin: sku gsum dbyer med spros bral kun bzang sang gnyis chos gdod nas dag pa'i gar la spyod: e āḥ mtshan ma tshig bral yi ge a: gcig ma: rten 'byung dbyangs gsal spros pa ka nas dag: brjod med dbyings las brda yi glu tshig 'di: ma rig ngo bo sangs phyir dngas du longs: a phaṭa: bdo tshig bro gar glu yi dbang rnal 'byor dam tshig

༄༅// ldan pas spyod samawā de nas bka' dbang ni ho bde ga gas 'dus zhal rang byung bcom ldan 'das sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan kun tu bzang: kha spyor bdun gyi 1nga las mi g.yo ba sku gsum ston pa'i bstan pa rin chen mchog: kun 'byung dka' thub dbang bsgyur rnam bzhag kyang: bstan don mthar thugs snying po a ti'i lam: theg pa kun rdzogs dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang: skal ldan dad brtson som nyi bral la sbyin: bka' lung man ngag dbang mchog yongs thob pas: bstan pa rin chen ris med skyong ba dang bslab gsum rgyan 'chang dam sdom rig pas srungs mi srung srung ba nyams med rgyal po lags: 'diskyong 'khor 'das ro mnyam mdzad pa bsgrub rtog ge'i blo 'og ma shor dam tshig can yid dpyod spros pa'i shoms ra mi 'tshal bar sprin bral rgya grol nyi ma kho nar spyod phyogs kyi mun pa sel lo a la la yi dharma sarba dz+nyazha sirnyis rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bka' dbang thob gzhan phan phrin las 'gyed la slob sa ma shā de nas smon lam gyi dbang ni 'o brgyud ldan rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang: grub brnyes rig 'dzin gong ma
