/mas kyis thugs bskyed zab mo'i mthus: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams la rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang bskur bsachos sku mtha' bral de bzhin nyid la longs spyod par gyur cig spros med brda' yi dbang bskur bas longs sku nges pa lnga ldan mi 'gyur khyab chen 'khor lo la dbang bsgyur bar gyur cig: don 'byed tshig gi dbang bskur bas sprul sku zhi khro rab 'byams dag mnyam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kho na la longs spyod par gyur cig nang don rig pa ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas phe bzhugs yi shes lnga la lam du byed par gyur cig brtul zhugs bde ba chen po'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs 'dod yon gang shar zhen med chen por grol bar gyur cig: khyab brdal 'od gsal chen po'i zhing dbang bskur bas zhing khams lnga lhun grub su rdzogs pa'i dpal la longs spyod par gyur cig: ma 'dres zig le sku yi dbang bskur bas bde chen yab lnga mtshan rtogs spros pa dang bral ba lam du byed par gyur cig mi dmigs dbyings kyi mkha' dbang bskur bas bde stong spros bral yum lnga ris med du snyoms 'jug nus par gyur

༄༅// cig: rig 'dus phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas yongs rdzogs rigs lnga 'ub chub kyi rgyal po la longs spyod par gyur cig: mi g.yo dgongs pas dbang bskur bas gter lnga la longs spyod par gyur cig mi dmigs chos kyi dbang bskur bas longs spyod lnga la spyod par gyur cig: mi zhakhrul ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas rin chen lnga la longs spyod par gyur cig: mi 'dzin ro mnyams kyi dbang bskur bas 'bru lnga la longs spyod par gyur cig: mi 'pho spros bral gyi dbang bskur bas dri lnga la longs spyod par gyur cig: ldog med he ru ga'i dbang bskur bas du tra rnam gsum dbyings su spyor zhing sgrol nus par gyur cig:shes rab bde ba'i lam dbang bskur bas zag med ye shes rjen pa mthong bar gyur cig: spros bral don gyi dbang bskur bas ye grol gdod ma'i rgyal sar mnga' brnyes par gyur cig:chos nyid glu yi dbang bskur bas bajod pa tshog gi spros pa ka nas dag par grur cig: ldog med bro yi dbang bskar bas a 'thas kyi 'dzin pa chos skur sangs bar khyar cig: 'pho med gar gyi dbang bskar bas chos can chos

nyed du 'ub chub par gyur cig rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur bas mdo sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho 'chad nyan sgom bskrub byed pa la dbang thob par gyur cig smon lam gyi dbang bskur bas mdzad pa 'dzan las mtha' yas pa la dbang bsgyur bar gyur cig smon lam dbang gi don gnyisa'agrub gzhan phan phrin la bsam yasa'abyung sam mā de nas sna bdun gto la hū hrī khams gsum dbang bsgyur 'khor lo rin po che: 'dod 'byung nor bu stobs ldan gnyis 'thung dang: rdzu 'phrul rkang ldan rta mchog rat+na'i brgyan dga' ba'i btsun mo blo ldan khyim bdag dpal: pha rol zil gnon dmag dpon rin chen rnams: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur mchog thob shog: ma hā rat+na sarba a bhi ṇiñtsa hrīḥ de nas sabargyad gto la hū hrī mdzes pa'i me long bkra shis bil ba dang dbang sdud li khri nad sel skṛ haṃ sman: bgegs 'joms nyung ba bcud ldan zho yis rdzas: bkra shis gdan bzang rgyang grags g.yas 'khyil bcas: rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur bde legs shog: ma ṇi rat+na a snyi ྅nyu shrīḥ de nasartags brgyad gto la hū hrīḥ rin chen gdugs mdzes mi

༄༅// nub rgyal mtshan dang dbyangs snyan chos dung mdangs ldan gser kyi nya: bdud rtsi bum bzang dri bral ka ma la: mi 'gyur dpal be'u kun 'dzom 'khor lo rnams: mtshan dpe thob phyir skal ldan bu la sbyin don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob shog: maṅga lam rat+na sarba a bhi 〉〉 hrīḥ de ltar bkra shis dbang gsum bskur srid dang zhi 'i bde legs sbyin slar yang de rjes bgo ba ni srung dang mi srung khyad par ba dam tshig kun kyang 'dzin khas len sgo gsum bdog pa bla mar 'bul dbang don ye shesabarten par bzhugs shisabarjod rab gnasame tog 'thor dga' ston tshogs 'bul glu gar bsgyur des ni bskyed rdzogs bsgom la dbang dngos grub bar chad med par thob don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur sa ma mā yi ma dbang chen gsung gi chos sde'i skor pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i gnas gsung gi mkha' 'gror gnyer gtad pa du kyi phyi nang rkyen gso phyir rgyal mtshog bshad pa'i rdo rjes bton rnam dkar rin chen shog skyar 'phrul dug gsum gdon gyi rma phab nas skye med dbyi sasu ar la gtad 'gags med gdul bya'i zhing kun skyid ngo mtshar gsar tshes dga' ston rgyas the tshom med do pad+ma'i bka'aḥ sam mā rgyargya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhesapa 'di'ang chosabadag 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i bkra shis lha reg rten snang bri

ba'i dam bca' bcasanas bskul ba dang zab gsang mdzod bka' bab pa dharmaṅgā sabakra shisame tog bkra ba'i gos bzang bcasanas bskul ba dang chos mdzod 'dzin pa kun bzang bstan 'jin dar rgyas nas bsnyen sgrub lhur len gyi zhabagatog bcas yang yang bskul ba dang grogasadang rig srasaganyisanas kyang nan tan gyis bskul ba rnamasartag rten 'brel bzang por mthong nas kho bo pad+ma 'gro 'dul dbang phyug gling pas mdo khams tsā ra'i thugs kyi yang rdzong gsang ba'i dben gnas nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab rmo dag par phab pa dge legasa'aphel sarbam la/

—8rdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las: drag khros me yi 'khor lo'itshe 'gugs pad+ma'ilcags kyu bzhugs so:badz+ra: na mogu rupad+ma shar ye: gaskartsashe tshe rdzas thams cad mdun du bkod la bdag nyid pad+ma drag po'i thugs srog dbang gi lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer gyis:stong lhalitshe bcud: bar mi yi sgog gi dwangs ma: 'og klu yibasod nams kyi dpal kha thams cad 'od lnga'i rnam par mer mer sib sib rug rug bsdus nas tshe rdzas rnams la bstims khyad par du bsrung bya'i bla tshe nyams pa 'thor ba zhig ral chad gus su gyur pa thams cad rang dbang med par 'bas se 'ubs sebasdus nas bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe gso ba'i ched du dmigs la: dbang gi mda' dar g.yab la hūṃ hrīḥ rang snang yishag zang mdog dpal gyi ri: lnga ldan pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: 'pho chen dwangs ma'i snar bzhengs pad 'byang: bde stong rgyas 'debs mkhar chen grub rgyal mo:grub brnyes rig 'ardzan bka' bab bu dgu sogs: 'phags bod paṇa chen dpa' bo kha' 'gro yis:

'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma tshe bcud bsdus: bdag cag sgrub mchog skal ldan rnams la stsol: bla 'khyams pa yod na rang gnas bsdus: dbugs sdud pa yod na rlung gis mthud tshe nyams pa yod na rloḥyis gso: sgog ral pa yod na dwangs mas bskyed: khams lnga 'dus 'di la tshe sba bstims:don 'ami med rdo rje'i sgog 'grub shog oṃ ma hwa pubye tshe hūṃ rno dza a ma ra ni dzi brnyi ye swā hā hū hrīḥ gdong dmar rak+ka srin gling brgyad cu'i rtser dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs dkyil nas: dpa' bo gar dbang rta khyung bshad pa rtsal dgongs pa'i rtsal g.yos skal ldan mos mtshor phyogs 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma tshe bcud bsdus bdag cag sgrub mchog skal ldan rnams la stsol: bla 'khyams pa yod na rang gnas bsdus: dbugs sdud pa yod na rlung gis mthud tshe nyams pa yod na zloḥyis gsos srog ral pa yod na dwangs mas bskyed khams lnga 'dus 'di la tshe sba bstims: don 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: sa ma hā pukhye tshe hūṃ zloḥ dza a ma ra ni dzi brnyi ye swā 1 hu trī: o rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling dbus

badz+ra: nas gnas kyi gtso mchog dus mtshan dmar mo dang: yul gyi tshogs rje dus sbyor sngon mo dang: dur khrod dpal 'dzin bde stong chags sbyor ma: he ru'i zhing skyongs shugs sgrol sprul 'khor bcas dga' bde'i ro la zil mig g.yo bzhin pheb: bcu drug dpa' bo 'dzum la spyod bzhin du: 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma tshe bcud bsdus: bdag cag sgrub mchog skal ldan rnams la stsol: bla 'khyams pa yod na rang gnas bsdus: dbugs sdud pa yod na rlung gis mthud: tshe nyams pa yod na rloḥyis gsos srog ral pa yod na dwangs mas bskyed: khams lnga 'dus 'di la tshe sba bstims: don 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: o ma hā pukhye tshe hūṃdz+nya dza a ma ra ṇi dzi brnyi ye swā sna — hrī byed ga ye shesazhal can spyan ras gzigs phyed ga 'jig rten khams skyong dbang phyug rgyal: sngon gyi thugs dam gnad bskul 'dir phyogs la sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bla tshe 'khyams dang ral rigs sngags dmod pa byad gtad mnan bcing bsdam: thams cad rang dbang med par sib sib bsdus: skal bzang rig pa 'dzin pa'i

dpal du stsol: bla 'khyams pa yod na rang gnas bsdus dbugs sdud pa yod na rlung gis mthud: tshe nyams pa yod na rjiḥyis gsos sgog ral pa yod na dwangs mas bskyed: khams lnga 'dus 'di la tshe sba bstims: don 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: ma ma hā pubye tshe t+t+waṃrjiḥdza a ma ra ḍi dzi brnyi ye swā hāḥ hū hrīX 'khor 'das srog la dbang za ya man+ta'i bka' yi bcud 'dzin las gshin 'bar ba rtsal: sngon gyi thugs dam gnad bskul 'dir phyogs la: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bla tshe 'khyams dang ral:rigs sngags dmod pasabyad gtad mnan bcing bsdam thams cad rang dbang med par sib sib bsdus: skal bzang rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du stsol: bla 'khyams pa yod na rang gnas bsdus dbugs sdud pa yod na rlung gi mthud: tshe nyams pa yod na hṝḥyis gsos srog ral pa yod na dwangs mas bskyed khams lnga 'dus 'di la tshe sba bstim: don 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: ma ma hā mkhye tshe hūṃ ḍi dza a ma ra ṇa dzi brnyi ye swā snya hūṃ hrīḥ srid pa'i snang shes dri ma thal 'byin pas: bdud 'dul bgegs

—8rdo: 'joms badz+ra ki la ya: sngon gyi thugs dam gnad bskul 'dir phyogs la sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bla tshe 'khyams dang ral: regs sngags dmad pas byad gtad mnan bcing bsdam thams cad rang dbang med par sib sib bsdus: skal bzang rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du stsol: bla 'khyams pa yod na rang gnas bsdus:dbugs sdud pa yod na na rlung gi mthud tshe nyams pa yod na dzha yis gsos srog ral pa yod na dwangs mas bskyed: khams lnga 'dus 'di la tshe sba bstim:don 'amimad rdo rje'i sgog 'grub shog: o mahā pubyetsho hūṃṇi dza.a mar ṇaṛ brnyiyi swāhwa:/ trī ban man kun rgyu'i log sbyor thad gar gcod: bdud 'dul drag mo 'jigs tshogs zil gnon dpal: sngon gyi thugs dam gnad bskul 'dir phyogs la sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bla tshe 'khyams dang ral: regs sngags dmadza pas byad gtad mnan bcing bsdam thams cad rang dbang med par sib sib bsdus: skal bzang rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du stsol: bla 'khyams pa yod na rang gnas bsdus:dbugs sdud pa yod na na

rlung gi mthud tshe nyams pa yod na dzāḥyis gsos: srog ral pa yod na dwangs mas bskyed khams lnga 'dus 'di la tshe sba bstim:don 'chi med rdo rje'i sgog 'grub shog:o ma hā pukhye tshe sbyo ṇi dza a ma ra ṇa ji brnyi ye swā hā: hū trīḥ dbang chen rta khyung drag po 'khor bcas kyi: bdag cag dpon slobs srung bya kun gyi tshe snub zad mar me zhun gyi gsos pa ltar: dwangs ma lnga 'dus 'byung lnga'i dpal gyis bskyed: skye 'chi med pa rdo rjes sgog 'grub nas lha dang skal pa mnyam par byin gyi rlobs: tshe gzungs brjod hū (ཿbum pa skye med tshe yi gzhal yas khang: kha rgyan dpag bsam shing las dgos 'dod 'byung mgul ching lug gu rgyud la tshe g.yang 'khyil: gzung thag 'od lnga'i rgyud nas dwangs bcud 'bebs tshe dang ye shes bsod nams kun 'dus pa: skal ldan sgrub pa po la phun tshogs rdzogag: kum+bha pa nyi a yu ṣe kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tsho zhes tshe bum gtadaḥ hū hrī rtsa khams dag pa lus kyi gzhal yas su: dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu dbab stel bkram: bde ba chen po'i rol par smin pa dang zag zad dwangs ma'i ska mchog myur thob shog

—8rdo: a dṛta rāg dzagad ni dhi bha la wāk+kas bhikhiñtsa ཿ zhesatshe 4 dang ril bu myongasasu gams hūṃ hrīḥ mi'agyur rdo rje 'chi med tshe yi rten 'brang rgyas g.yang dang bsod nams bcud 'khyil ba longs spyod dpal 'byor snang ba mtha' yas 'grub: skye 'chi 'gyur med ye shes tshe thob shog: badz+ra ayu skem hāb lirtetset+ta a snyi ṣiñtsa/: zhes tshe 'brang gam la trīḥ tshe mda' skyon bral skyes bu'i bla tshe brten rin chen g.yu byang ma sman bla rdo sgrub dung shā mig ldan byis pa'i srog skyabs byed: rin chen sna lnga phywa dang g.yang gi rten:bal ni longs spyod phri gang med pa'i rdzasaḥ dad ldan minor dpal gsum 'dzoms phyir gtad: 'byor ldan nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter thob nas tshe dang ye shes dpag med mnga' brnyes shog tshe gzungs bo da la smon lam gdab de nas shis brjod ni na mo skye'amimidamigs ye shes chos kyi sku zang thal 'gags med bde ba mchog gi gsang snang ba mtha' yas 'chi med bkra shis gang dam pa des kyang kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po mchog mdzan phrin thabs mkhas 'phrul

mtshan brgyad du grags: o rgyan pad+ma'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags can: sde brgyad dregs pa'i sgog 'phrog gtsug na spa: rta khyung drag po'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs re ga: de ltar tshe 'gugs zab mo yis 'phral rkyen rgud pa kun zhi zhi tshe ring nad med lang tsho 'phel don gnyisayid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur sam mā ye bde chen gsang ba gsung gi gnas pad+ma rak+ta 'khyil ba'i klong dge bsnyen sha mi dung 'phreng la gtad pa'i dam chos thugs gter dpal snyigasam lnga yi dus skab su nad mug mtshon cha'i gzing lang tshe nga sprul rgyalatshabasaskyesabu yis rted nasarang gzhan phan bde spel 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du bkod gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul bar byed nus mthu srid na ya mtshan 'phags lha 'dre ma gsum rang dbang bsgyur don gnyisalhun grub the ma tshomaḥ sam shā rgya rgya rgya gu kyi brda thi 3) zhes pa 'di'ang lung zinagragasapa'i mtshan can gyis thabs shes mtshon pasardzagadu mar bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i brda mdzod la bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni snying noraste masabagyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lo/

ba6sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ rtsa dbang gzhan snang zil gnon gyi lo rgyusagadul dka' zil gnon bzhugs soX badz+ra: na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā yeḥ shārgyasgros / dad dang spro bas 'di gsan 'tshal sngon tshe sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi bstan pa'i phyi rjes rgyal ba shākya'i bstan pa ma byung ba'i snga thogaḥ bdud ma tram̐ rū tra bsgral ba'i dus suX dpal chenarta phag yab yum gyi ru tra shin tu brgyang zhing lus sems ar la gtad tsheX 'dams dzob chen po'i khams gsum rmongs shing 'bog brgyal gas grum byed tsheḥ sangs rgyas rnam par snang byed mi'akhrugs pa'i rgyal po gti mug 'dul pa'i phyag rgyar bzhengs dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje'i dregs pa gza' 'dul sde brgyad dam la 'dogs pa'i gzigs pato zhal 'dren steng mkhas pa'i rol gar ngoms bsnams nas byung ba'iste/ bo dme bar brtsegs pa'i shin tu khro rngams gdug pa'i sdang mig can pad+ma 'chol bor khros pa'i zhal bzang 'gyedaḥ rdzas rnams dug gsum rnam par dag pa'i.a tsho ta ru byin gyis brlabs khams

gsum gting sprugs byed pa'i zab mo'i gter gyi phan bde mdzad dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad bkod la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i man ngag gi mdzod rin po che'i za ma tog gi tshul du gtams phyis su dpal chen po'i thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthus bka' bab rig 'dzin brgyad kyis gsang chen phyag rgyas btab pa'i sgo 'phar dus gcig la 'byed bye brag na gardzu na'i dregs pa gza' klu gnyan 'dul gyis dgongs pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrungs sems can la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad nas gu ru rin po che'i bka' bsgros nas gter chos brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa drug gter du sbas phyis su gter 'don lung bstan la sems can la bde skyid rgya che rgyun ring du 'byung bar mdzad doḥ de rjes o rgyan chen po pad ma sgod phreng rtsal gyis rgya bal bod yul gyi lha 'dre ar gtad la snyoms par zhugs tshe: rgya gar gyi lha 'dre gti mug gnyan 'dul gyi dgongs pas dam la btags bal yul gyi lha 'dre dbang chen bzhad pas glu yis bran du bkol bod khams kyi lha srin rjes chags 'dzum pa'i gar gyis 'dre ma sangs gdug pa can thams cad

btsasdo: ar la gtad ༷ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer byang bcol zab mo gter gyi srung mar bzhagaḥ skal bzang pad tshal skyongs ba'i gnyer kha bcolaḥmado sngags kyi sgron me mtha' dbus kun tu brdal bar badzad do phyisasu chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs rgya chos ma lus bod du drangasaḥ pa grub rgya mcho'i bshad sgrub kyi gzhi btsugasaX rgyal bstan nyin byed gsal ba'i 'od stong 'bar bar mdzadaḥde'idus su gu ru rin po che'i brag dmar mgrin bzang gi tshal zla gam dbang gi phug par gu ru drag la rta khyung bshad pa rtsal gyi skur bzhengs nas klu bdud srin rigs can thams cad dam la 'dogs tshe ye shes khyung dmar me yi phyag rgya can drag po rngams pa'i khro zhal dang ldan pa'idapa' rtags gar ngoms kyang gnas dus rten 'brel gyi dbang gis klu yid

la bcug nas mtsho dmar nag rak+ta khol 'dra'i gnas su sbas rgya mdzad doḥ phyisasu de 'don pa po o rgyan rgyal tshabs gter spyon bdud 'dul rdo rje'i sprul pa gcig dang 'phrad nas ma rung gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags dregs pa gza' klu 'dar zhing sngangs bar byedaḥ 'byung po dam sri 'bog brgyal du gtongaḥ sa 'og klu gnyan gtod kyi mgo 'phang sma phab par byed byad phur rbod gtong sogs dus kyi yo lang gi rgud pa sna tshogs sel mthu nam mkha' dang mnyamaX yon tan mtshungs zla las 'das che btsan srid na 'phagasaḥ gdug pa bdud kyi rgol ba gang la rtsub pa der phrin las glog ltar 'khyugs pa'i byin rlabs mkha' 'gro'i gsang srog dam chos bdud rtsi'i zer ma rta khyung bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal 'di'i dbang bskur ba la bdag slob dpon gyi bgyi 'os dkyil 'khor bdag mdun bum bzlas tshogs bsags rig me dor ba sogs yongs su grub nasaḥ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pas sgo gsum ltos med ci 'byor mnyam brdal chen pos maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar mdzod brgyud pa niḥ chos sku snang ba

—8rdo: mtha' yas longs sku nam mkha' rgyal poḥ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnasaḥ mnga' bdag chos rgyal yab srasaḥ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyalaḥ lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnasaḥ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyings grub chen khye'u chung lo tsāḥ bla ma grum gyi mkhar nag he pa chos kyi 'byung gnasaḥ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje dpa' bo bdud 'dul rol rtsalaḥ gar dbang bdud 'joms gling paḥ rig 'dzin nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nas drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar rim par brgyud ldan rig 'dzin gyi zam pa ma chad byin rlabs dngos grub kyi rno nus ma yalaḥ dam sel 'dres khyer gyis bslad ma zhugasaḥ 'brel tshad don ldan du byed pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid zhu phyir gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzodaḥ zhes pa sa mtshams sbyar dbang gzhung ltar byas pa sa 'phrin las lhun gyisagrub bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshosasrungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor cigaḥsamawā rgya rgyargya gu rgya brda thi 3kho zhes pa'ang lung zina'agyur med rdo rjes ngor kho bonu ldan rdo rje shar mar bris pa dge legs 'phelaḥsabo maskom/

bsnyerdo: o ma hā shu bye ta slob ma'i dngos mtshan mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las rab 'byams zhing gi lha tshogs thams cad bla ma rta khyung drag po'i rnam par kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon teḥ khyedarang slob ma rnams la sib sib thim par bsgomaḥ tshe gu ru.artsig badz+ra ashe sha ya phe pho ཿ doltar yishes dbab pa de nyid drag po chen po'i gsang gsum mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du brtan par gyur cig tiṣ+ṭha bas mig dar bkab cing me tog gto slob ma lhar gsal ye shes dbab brtan par bzhugs gsol me kho 'thor shis pa ba da la rab tu gnas de nas me r+ṣa dor ba ni heru ka dpal pad+ma 'dzum pa'i zhalaḥ bde mchog rig 'dus gsung gi da la rtsa rig pa'i me tog dad brgya'i 'dab ma can gus pa'i 'bul lo lhag pa'i lha der phobaḥ badz+rapukhye byudza nyo gsang mtshan 'thar byed rgyal poḥ shes rab la ru lu bde stobasaḥ zhes gdags par bya'o po bu dbang bskur du stsal la a pra ti j-i smra.e mi t+tami badz+ra de nas gdong bkrol ba ni hoḥ sangasargyas dngos grab 'khor 'das mnyam par ba'ags ye nas sma gsum rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor
༷// ༷ dīg gsum gyi sgrib pas gdos por bzungaḥ /ni ye shes rig pasadri ma bsal dzhanatsaḥpra she sha ya phaṭaḥ lha yang ngo sprad doḥ dbang rdzogasadregs pa'i grags rig las khol du byung

—8mi: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las sde brgyad las la gcun pa'i drag sgrub kyiX rtsa dbang gzhan snang zel gnas zhes bya ba zhugs soḥbadz+ra: na mogu rupad+ma shar yeḥ za(1 rgyal bsen dregs pa sde brgyad kyi srog sdud sbyor ba ga gar+ṣa pa'i dbang 'di do gal che la sbyin gang yang rung bar mi rung ngo de phyir srog las btsa' shes par bdag mdun bum bablos grub nas slar skal ba can la ster bar byaḥ las can gral bkod khrus bgegs bsal srung 'khor bsgom la bden don bshad maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni kyi 'arjes/ rten 1gyed pa mthar mdzad he ru gaḥ rta dbu khyung gdong rngams zhal 'chol khros skuḥ thugs rje brtse bas sgrub mchog rnams la dgongasaX phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsal du gsolaX lan gsumaḥhoḥ bzod dka' dus kyi nad gdon rkyen snang kunaḥ skad cig tsam gyis 'thar mdzad dpa' bo ngaḥ dran dang mthong dang thos pa tsam gyis kyang rab 'bar dus me 'bar ba'i stobs su stsolaḥ de nas rgyud sbyangs niḥ hrīḥ rta zhal khyung gdong rngams pa'i khro rgyal laḥ skyabs mchi 'jigs tshogs 'phrang las bsgral du gsol gzhan don sems bskyed

'khor ba khur du len dus kyi rgud pa 'joms pa'i nus mthu stsolaḥ snang srid rig par shar ba'i rgyan mchod 'bulaX thams cad sems kyi nongs pa'i 'khrul ba bshags de nyid lta ba dag pa'i phyag bgyi'oḥ srid pa'i rba klong skyobs la rjes yi rangasaḥ khams gsum rol rtsed bsgyur ba'i chos 'khor bskoraḥ sde brgyad ar la gtad pa'i dal bzhin bzhugs rgud tshogs ming lhag gyur phyir dge kun bsngoḥ drag po chen po'i gsang gsum mngon gyur shogaX lan gsumaḥhoX rab 'jigs 'chol bor khros pa bsnyen cing bsgrub sde brgyad dregs pa gdan du btang bar bya0 dbang chen rta yi 'dul glus ྅ tra btulaḥ de phyir brtul zhugs dbang gi dngos grub stsolaḥ zhugarjes dam chu niḥhoḥsgog gcod ma byen len dang mi tshang spyod rdzun smra sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga rnal 'byor spyod mchog grol ba nga yis bshad gtsang ma za zhing dkar ba tha dag kyang longs grol bde mchog thob par ma gnang naX sangs rgyas dngos grub bde ba mchog gi lamaḥ he ru ka dpal chen po'i dbang bskur stsolaX de yi dam tshig gzhung bzhin ma bsrung na mnar med gnas su

—'di: 'o brgyal na ra gaṇaḥ mig dar sbyin la me tog 'dzin slob ma lhar bskyed ye shes dbab dam ye ro gcig brtan par bya de nasabum dbang bskur ba ni nyu hrīḥ mthar byed rgyal po'i rang bzhin phyi yi dbang dbang chen 'dul glu mnyam sbyor nang gi dbang dregs 'joms me 'phreng mnyam nyid gsang ba'i dbang0 yongs rdzogs bum pa lha yi dngos grub mchogaX skal ldan rigs pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin0 dregs 'joms nus mthu 'dzom pa'i dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mthar kā yaya bhiṣiñtsa tshog de nasadrag po'i sku gam la / hrī rmongs pa klu 'dul khyung zhal phyi yi dpalaX zhe sdang rā tsa 'thar mdzad nang gi dpal 'dod chags dam sri tshar gcod gsang ba'i dpal dpal gsum 'dus pa drag po las kyi dbang0skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyinaḥ sde brgyad dam la 'dogs pa'i dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mthar gu dza ཿ1 ta ra dzas bhiṣiñtsa āX de nas gtor ma gam la nyu hrīḥ dbang chen me 'bar rwang nag 'dzabs ma'i rkong ga ra ngag 'khros kra 'dal khyang gtong giḥ gsang gsam 'angs pa dpal gyi gtor ma'i dbangaḥ smal lngan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sminaḥ

srid na 'gran zla bral ba'i dpal thob 31ga rtsa sngags mthar bā lingata a je ༷don hu mtha' rten gtad cing shesapa brjod bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdabaḥsam māḥ dbang 'di lan gcig thob pa yis sde brgyad rgyal bsen gdug rtsub gzhesaḥ nad gdon rgor ngan kun la zab no nus gnam lcags thogasalas myur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal byin rlabs can du a tham rgya skal med lag tu ma shor cig thugs 3 sras dang 'phradaparashogaḥ sa mashāḥ rgya rgyargya gurgya brda zim snyiḥ ces kyang sngags skyesadabang phyug dam pa kun bzang dang pad+ma rmos 'thel rgya marmo gnyis kyi bzhed ngor kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyisamatsho dmar nag rak+ta las spros pa'i 'od zer gyi brda las bkrol ba ma lam/

badz+ra: de na sna khrun gto laḥ / hrī khams gsum dbang bsgyur 'khor lo rin po che 'dod 'byung nor bu stobs ldan gnyis 'thung dang rdzu 'phrul rkang ldan rta mchog rat+na'i brgyan dga' ba'i btsun mo blo ldan khyim bdag dpalaḥ pha rol zil gnon dmag dpon rin chen rnams skal ldan bu la dbang bskur mchog thob shogaḥm hārat+na sarba.a bhiṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas rdzas brgyad gto laḥshā hrīḥmardzas pa'imo'ad bkra shis bil ba dang dbang sdud li khri nad sel ghi haṃ sman bgegs 'joms yungs dkar bcud ldan zho yi rdzasaḥ bkra shis gdan bzang rgyang grags g.yas 'khyil bcas regaldan bu la dbang bskur bde legs shog maṇingat+na asnyi ྅nyubyeḥ de nas rtags brgyad gam la / hrī reg chen gdugs mardzas mi nub rgya mtshan dang dbyangs snyan chos dung mdangs ldan gser gyi nyaḥ bdud rtsi bum bzang dri bral kā ma la mi 'gyur dpal be'u kun 'dzom 'khor lo rnamasaḥ mtshan dpe thob phyir skal ldan bu la sbyin donaganyis lhun rgyas grub pa'i dpal thob shog ma lamangat+na sarba.a bhiṣiñtsa hūṃ dbang rdzong dregs pa'i grog tig las khol du byung ba'o/
༄༅// dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa'i chos skor las rta khyung drag po'i dgu sgrub lugs kyi 'don 'grigs bzhugs/

dbyubyu/ / na mo gu runyerukaya kadag snye thed chosasku'i pho brang nas/ lhun grub sgyu 'phrul ye shes snang ba'i gzugs rigasadang dkyil 'khor 'dus zhal rdo rje 'chang / snyings bus dad brgya'i ze'u 'brur rtag tu rol/gang gi zab gter 'o ma'i chu gter las/ bdud rtsi'i zeg ma thugs gter 'dusapa'i skor/ sa gsum gdug pa'i dpa' skong snying 'dar ba'i/ drag po rta khyung gsang gsum sgrub thabs spro/ marung ru ṭa'i dpung chen gzings lang te/ shi gson dam sri mngon snang ji bzhin la/ thabs mchog 'di lasagadul byed srid na khu / de phyir zab chos 'di la yid ches nas/ dpal ldan pad+ma ka ra'i dgongs rgyud bcud/ ma dang mkha' 'gros bdo thabs phyag rgyas btab/ bdud 'dul nus ldan dpa' bo chen po yis/ bdag cag skal ba bzang po'i dpal du phyes/ de la 'dir dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal skyon bral la rdul tshon ris bris gang rung gi gzhi la/ sgrub gtor mda' dar tshe gtor tshe 'bra phur sgrom ril bu srog 'khor rtsa gsum sman raka gtor gsum sogs mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar bkod nas rnal 'byor ba rnams gdan bde ba la 'khod cing sgo gsum rnal du phab nas bzhugs la/ thog mar sta gon gyi rim pa la/ de'i dal bca' bshams legs par grub mthar/ dang po shā ces rgyan yul sogs tshig bdun gsol 'debs lan gsum sku phreng gsol 'debs las na 57 gu ra she: e ma therte: skye med sogs skye

༄༅/ / ba kun tu sogs regag snyen swā bha sogs mchod rdzas byin rlabs bsdus pa las/rig stong ye dag sogs ra ṇakho gsol 'debs las/ ye ma41: mtha' 11la 11nga yangs sogs dbyer med regag skyabs yul gsal gdab ni rang sa/snying ga'i sogs sa maya dza skyabs 'gro ni na mo skug11la sogs mchi: lan gsum sems bskyed ni/ ho: tha snyad sogs bskyed do: lan gsum yan bdun ni na mo: lta ba don sogs pu dzirta a sa: tshogs zhing 'od zhu bya/ sngon gtor 'bul ba la/ 31 maṇi pad+me/: sā bhawa dang mdzod sngags lan gsum a ka ro dang snyen ma hā gu ru sarba /: /dza: —1nga gsum sogs sa ma yā: chang glud 'bul ba la bdag nyid skad (skon gi sogs khug cig lan gsuma.o sarba bu lan gsum dza: dza hūṃ dze+e ho saṃ bha ra lan gsum sa ka ro mu rang nyid dbang chen sogs hūṃ phaṭa gzhung gi bka' bsgo las/ hūṃ trī: nga bdag mtshan mar sogs / hūṃ phaṭa: chang glud bsngo ba las ( trī: mi dbang log 'dren bhi4gas rtsa sngags mthar hūṃ bzhi'i sngags dang drag sngags so lnga'i sham gnod byed 'byung po sogs ta yaphaṭa: de nas bsrung 'khor dang byin

'beb mjug mchod dzos byin rlabs mjug tu spyan 'dren mjug mchod pa'i mjug bstod pa'i mjug 'dzab dang bsnyen pa nyung tsam dang pad+ma krota ra sogs khahūṃ bstod pa ni hū hrī drag pe khyung klus sogs bstod par 'os sogs bstod: dge ba 'di sogs 'god par 31ga de nas rta khyung las dkyil dang / rgyal mdos tshad ldan/ mnol bsang bcas grub rjes/ tho bzhi 'dzug pa la/ spos sna bas thog drangs nas ser phreng bsgrig te shar gyi rgyal tho'i mdun du rol mo mtshams bcad/ hrī: mi dmigs chos dbyings sogs spyan drangs bstim: kye lte na pa'i sogs shabha a hū: 31 dhita nga: sogs srung skyongs mdzad par gyur: des 'gre'i byang gi rgyal tho 'dzug rjes mdzad par gyur: zab dang rgya sogs bkra shis regag de nas ser phreng sgrub khang du log nas gdan la 'khod mthar lha sta gon la tshom bu bkod pa ni snying nge ba10da pa sogs sa mas sto sgrub phur la hūṃ sgrub mgo'i rak+ta haste hūṃ sogs kyisabyugs bdug brab gsum bya de nas gong ltar lha sngags yongs rdzogs la/ dz+nya na mu tra sa ma ya sto: btags la sgrub phur rnams 'bru gdan la legs par bkod nas lding khrir 'god pa ni hūṃ sgrub las hrīḥ bde che nga rje/sa sogs

ra༅tsho/ / tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas bum pa la bshal bdug brab gsum mthar lha sngags yongs rdzogs la 〈〈 āḥXs sogs btags pas dzos rnams blug la ldang khrir bkod de bum sgrub las tī:chos nyid mi 'gyur sogs ro gcig bsre: bar badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dza hūṃ rbaho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti puho: na ma ༷sarbata thug das pa ri sogs khā hi: bstod bsdus bya bum gzhung gi hrī dam tshog bskyed sogs 36pa bar dmigs: bsnyen sngags ci 'grub sgrub sngags gsum las sngags gsum mthar gong ltar mchod sngags bstod bsdus mthar tsas āḥ drag ste sa sogs par gyur bar las bum bskyed bzlas byas mthar mchod bstod 'od zhu bya bshags pa bsngo smon bsdu ldang bkra shis yan bya'o de nas rol mo byin rlabs na spyohrī rtags kyi sogs ā ༷ 'bor 'das mtshams rol brdung la bsang chu byin rlabs ni hūṃ bisne takrita sogs hūṃ phaṭa sngags nyer gcig lhanyid71da zhu sogs mchod jos byin bdud rtsi sbos byung tshig bdun lan gsum byin 'bebs las dmaldanasgub pa po sogs bsam la: bzhud pa sngon bsu bcas rol mo yongs rdzogs 〉hūṃ dza dbus mtha' med pa sogs tshig bzhi

dbyangs dang 'ur chem mtshams rol rngams brjed me ru sogs rnga kher brdung bcas sha ya a yis 'ur chem sum phab bzhag rol brdung 'phral hū hūṃ nam mkha' gang ba'i sogs bsam 31: 'dir las bum ni gter gsar rnying gang rung gi rdor sems bskyed bzlas byas la mchod bstod 'od zhu bya lha khrus la mtshams rol bcas rgyas par byas la/'di ni khrus mchog sogs dge ba 'di yis sogs rdo rje sems dpa' khyed sogs re ga/ snang grags sogs pad+ma'i rang lugs sogs rgyal dbang pad+ma'i sogs rgyal ba kun dpon ste/ba mi 'bral sogs bkra shis regag ces bya'o/ / phyir nang bla rnams sogs rgyun sgol ltar dang / gnyis pa dngos gzhi la phyi na gsang ba'i dam rgya bsdams smra bcad ma dang gdung mi sprad/ shub bu dang brdab skad ldang lugs sogs thun grol gyi bar tshul min gyi spyod pa thams cad dor la ma hā a nu a ti gang rung gi bskyed rim gnad smin gzhi thang nges can zhig dran shes bag yod kyis brten nas rags 'dus bla ma dran bskul tshag bdun lan gsum dang bsam lhun ni ces ma ho: sku gsum sogs sirnyi / brgyud 'debs na e ma ho: gdod nas ye sangs sogs

༄༅/ / zin par shog sku phreng gsol 'debs ni/ na mo gu ra we ye maho:skyemed sogs sangs rgyas shog skyeb kun tu sogs bsang chu dang mchod rdos byin rlabs ni hūṃ bisne bsang chu'i nang du sogs dmigs: ( bisne yin swābha stonge pa'i ngang las sogs ra ṇadza: mchod sngags ni yin badz+rak+tadz+nya sogs kho swāhwa spos byung ni a:dro med sogs a hūṃ gsol 'debs las yis masteng:mtha' 11la 11nga yangs sogs rol mo byin rlabs las hūṃ hrī: rtags kyi sogs a sno skyabs yul gsal gdab na mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs dmigs la: skyabs 'gro ni na mo yenas sogs mchi lan gsum sems bskyed ni ho galtar snang sogs bskyed do: tshogasabasagasani yin ā&: thams cad mnyam nyid sogs thob shog maṇ+ḍal yin āhūṃ stonge gsum sogs a sno dza/ baṃho sogs rdzogs par bsam mo: bar sngon gtor la yin mkhaṃ swā bhadang mdzod sngags gsum a garo dang yin badz+ram ༷gu rusarba hūṃ 〉dza stong gsum sogs mdzod nyin dang po la gong gi badz+ra ma ha

dang nam mkha' mdzod sngags 'di ru gsungs gzhan yang rnam 'gyur sogs ma yis da rka sngon gtor chang glud las/ bdag nyid skad cig sogs khug cig lan gsum yin sarbathu ta lan gsum dza hūṃb ho bha ra dang a gasdo sogs rang nyid dbang chen sogs hū phaṭa las byang gartsa gi hū hrī:nga bdag sogs hū phaṭasngon gtor hū hrī mi dbang 31ga sogs gasne spro na bden brjod dang rtsa sngags gab pa'i sham lnga min na rtsa sngags sham can dang sum bha ni lan gsum trī khrom trig shā sogs drag sngagasaso lnga lasabyang las hrī steng nyid lta ba sogs rak+ta sgro nyin dang po la sgo byang gnyisadang spro na srung dmigs ye dharmā bgegs regs stong phrag sogs rje gas pa'i byang chub sogs byin 'bebs thugasarjes lcags kyu las dam ldan (1ba pa sogs a yi bar la byang gzhung gi hū hrī chen gnas sogs/a yi mtshams rol hrī yul drug sogs ha rdo1 trī mchod sngags rnams dang mtshams rolahū: mtha' 17la sogs ring shing byer srung ba rtsa lha las bdag nyid pad ma sogs dal sgo 'byed las byang las sho lo ka dor nas

༄༅/ / de'i phyi rim sogs dbus su bskyed: bum bskyed las trī chothasanyid mi sogs gcig bsre: ril sgrub las trī ma skyes yo sogs bsre dbang bskur rgyas gdab las rang gi snying sogs sku mi 'gyur bar rgyas gdab: yo bud+dha sogs snang mtha' dmar po ā pad+ma sogs mi bskyod pa sngon po sogs hūṃ badz+ra dha ra sog tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra las byang gi lha tshogs gnas gsum sogs bsre: dbang bskur rgyas gdab las de nas rdo rje sogs bstim mo las byang gi hūṃ hrī: chags med sogs nas bzhugasagasol phyag 'tshal mchod pa sman mchod bstod pa 'dzab yan dang bgrangs phreng byin rlabs ni snyen sarba dharma sogs bya dril sgrub las bum pa hūṃ las sogs dmigs la: bsnyen pa sham dang bcas 'dzab dbyangasabargya dang rtsa bsnyen ci 'grub mthar bhasto bdud rtsi sgrub pa hūṃ: dum gsag sogasadamigs bsnyen pa bzla de nasadrag khros bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal sogs dbyangasagasal yig brgya rten snying gsum las byang gzhung gi mchod bstod bka' brgyad bla ma bstod par 'os pa bshags pa bsngo

smon bsdu ldang rtsa sngags bkra shis bya'o/ smon lam dang po de nas drag sgrub me lce'i 'khor lo gsungs te sngags rgyun bzungs/ mthar skyid pad+ma )sna ta rādza sa pa ri sogs khā hi: hū hrī: drag po khyung dza/tha sogs ba41da: las byang gnyis par mchod jos byin rlabs bsdus pa rol chen mchod rol gsol 'debs skyabs yul gsal gdab las byang gnyis pa nas bzhi pa'i bar skyabs sems yan bdun sogasagazhung ltar ro mchan skyabs sem yan bdun mtshamasarol tshogs zhing 'od zhu bka' bsgo hūṃ bzhi'i sngags bsrung 'khor na bzungasalha bskyed skabasasrung ba rtsa lha dang ril sgrub dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams sprad la spyan 'dren nas 'dzab yan gzhung ltar dang bgrangs phreng byin rlabs ril dmigs 'dzab dbyangs brgya dang bsnyen pa ci 'grub mthar bdud rtsa drag che sa bdud dpung zil gnon sogs dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod pa la mgo mjug gi blo ka gnyis dang bka' brgyud bla ma bache da par 'os pa dge ba 'di yi sogs / gsol kha la sngags drug phyag drug dang a ka ro'i mthar bdud rtsi phud bskang nas phrin bcol mgo bar dang drag po lha lnga'i gsol sgrub las gaste ra bye da bhan+ta sogs ye swā hā: bar dang ḍa bcas gsol mchod gsum ḍa bcas dbang phyug nag po gshin rje badz+ra ki

ra tsho / la ya seng gdong ma rnams kyi gsol bsdus dang gter srung gsol mchod gsung rjesagasolagazhung gi bstod pa05 ka ro dang rang mdun āḥlas sogasabastan srung yongasardzogasakyi byin rlabang dang spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol lha shan tsi'u dmar gsol mchod dang / chos nyid sgyu mar rol sogasadang sde mchod mthar phud kyi phrin bcol dang gsol sgrub kyi phrin bcol/ pad ma'i rang lugs sogs rgyaladabang pad ma'i sogs rgyalab kun gyi sogs sangasargyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs mtshams rol phud kyi bshags pa dang gsol sgrub kyi bshags pa yig brgya bcas bya'o/ de nas las byang gi bshags pa bsngo smon bsdu ldang rtsa sngags bkra shis sogs bya'o/ smon lam gnyis pa la drag sgrub dang bsnyen rgyun mchod bstod bcas sngar ltar ro las byang gsum pa la skyabs yul gsal gdab tshogs zhing 'od zhu hūṃ bzhi'i sngags srung ba rtsa lha dbang bskur rgyas gdab bgrangs phreng byin rlabs rnams mi dgos/ de min mchod bstod dge bsngos sogs sngar ltar ro/ ༈ tsharags ladang po rang snang phagashesakyi sogs ra ṇa rlu: bshags pa na a: gdod ma'i ye gzhi sogs a ya yig brgya jos bskang ni hūṃ hrī: bden chen dbang drag sogs chenardzasar rol

reye khaṃ sa āsdam ha ho hrī: tshogs bsdus ni ra yam̐ kha 37 ātu 'jigs tshogs sogs dong sprug shog sa twa bshags pa gang 'osasatwa brgya rtsa yig brgya dam tshig nyam chags thams cad sogs nam mkha'i mthar sogs dang tshogs zhusabya/ lasabyang mjug gi tshogs las hū hrī: brdal khyab ka nas sogs spyan 'dren tshog mchod dang dgyes bskyed tshogs phrin las tshogs bye da bhan+ta sogs gyur cig mdzod sngags rten snying bskang dzos rnams brgyud bskang dang bskang ba pad+ma'i phreng mdzes nas gnam phud mgo bar tshogasalasabashagasapa tshogs phrin las 31gas chend lcags khaṃ sogs bam̐ 21 tshogs gzhung las bsgral ba bstabasapa bya spro na mdzod sngagasadang yang le ber gyi bskang gsol mchod rol a ka ro sogs rdo rje mchos rab rtsal gyi bskang ba mchod gsol bskang ba pad+ma'i phreng mdzes kyi gnam phud dang mchod gsol tho gsos mchod gsol nyin dang po ma gtogs sgo byang gnyis po bya/mchod gsol drang ba bsam lhun rgyasabasdus he ru ka dpal sogs dang tshogasaphrin lasalhag ma'i sgod sog tshogasagazhung gi lhag ma bya tshogs mchod phul bas sogs

ra༅༅/ / dang las byang gi bshags pa bsngo smon bsdu ldang rtsa sngag bkra shis so/ smon lam gsum pa drag sgrub dang bsnyen rgyun re mo bya/ ga las byang bzhi pa la sngar ltar dang bum bskyed dor kyang rung ril sgrub mjug tu hūṃ sgrub las rdi chos nyid mi 'gyur sogs mngon gyur ngang: la byang gi lha tshogs gnasagasum sogs gzhung ltar dang ril dmigs 'dzab dbyangs bsnyen pa ci 'grub mthar bdud rtsi sgrub pa hūṃ sgrub las ༷ sku gsumarang la sogs/ gdab po hūṃ glu bdun ma sum sbrel dang hūṃ ci 'grub brjod/ bgegs rigasastong phrag sogs mchod bstod rgyas par bya dge ba 'di yis sogs dam 'dog la tshogs phrin las āḥlas bhan+ta lcang 'o/ sogs ā /: dam 'dogasabya/ gtor ma zag med ye shes sogs chad tho 'donatshogasaphrin las rin po che'i bye/da du sogs bstan ma bya tshogasaphrin las bro 'gugs bro sngags tshogasagazhung gi bro mnan tshogs phrin las gtor gasdong rat+na sogs/ swā hā:bdag mdun gyi sogs bsam la: nyu dngos su 'byor sogs rgya mtshos mchod: zhi pad+ma kro ta sogs shan+ta rū pa sogs spar she dharma ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling ta sta

na ga na sto dhi tsit+ta su dza hi: rdo rje'i lha mo sogs bsam la: hū: ma bcos spros bral sogs hū trī: drag po khyung sogs/ bka' brgyud bla ma sogs rgyal ba'i bstan sogs bstod par sogs slar mchod pa'i sogs bsam la: tshogs gzhung gi bshags pa yig brgya bsngo smon skyed 'dir ni sogs tshogs phrin las (1gas bcur nam mkha'i sogs ye swā hā tshogs gzhung ga bsdu ldang rtsa sngags tshogs phrin las/ rang gi snying ka sogs ye dharma sogs tshogs gzhung gi bkra shis dang gzhan yang bkra shis mtha' brgyan par bya'o ༈ bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen gnyis nyin gsum de'i 'gresasu bya'o/ / sgrub pa la zhugs nyin byin 'bebs zur bkod btsud mi dgos de min sngar ltar dang mdun bskyed rgyas pa ril sgrub sogasabasnyen pa yan sngar ltar 'dzab dbyangs mi dgos lhub 'don gyis ye shes lha tshogs sogs bag med nyams chags 'gal sogs/ bzod par gadregal ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling ta khā 38 kun thub gtong rdzogs pa'i byang chub sogs byin bskul la tshig bdun lan gsum byin bskul / dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas sogs byin

༄༅ 'bebs 'od zer phung po gnad bsdu bya mdun bskyed kyi 'dzab kha dbye ba/ hrī ga'o/dbyeras gdod nas las byang gi 'dzab bskul (rangasnang mi sogs sgrub 'dzab trī:chos nyid stong pa sogs trī:dam tshog bskyed pa'i sogs sgrub bsnyen 'dzab dbyangs mthar ril sgrub lasa.ātsharajig rten gyi khams sogs sgrub sngags bcas 'dzab dbyangs dang bsnyen pa ci 'grub mthara'adzi mahwa gu ru mchod bstod bkra shis yan sngar ltar ro/drag sgrub dang bsnyen rgyun mthar sku rogasalha tshogs sogs /las byang gnyis par bum bskyed dang ril sgrub sprad nas bsnyen pa yan sngar bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar ro sku regasalha tshangags spyan 'dren sogs kun thub rgyas par bya/byin 'bebs rgyas pa gnad bsdu sgrub 'dzab nas mchod bstod gsol kha sogs gong ltar ro las byang gsum par bum bskyed dang ril sgrub kun thub bsdu tsam dang tshig bdun bzhedas bskul gnad bsdu bya ba ma gtogs 'dra'o//las byang bzhi par bum bskyed ril sgrub hūṃ bsgrub gsum sprad la bsnyen snabs byin 'bebs ye shes gzi bskyed dang gnad bsdu ril dmigs rnams sprad nas 'dzab dbyangs dang bsnyen pa ci 'grub mthar hūṃ sgrub las snyi:skugadza/ma rang la sogs

rgyas gdab po: / bdun ma sum sbrel gsum hū: rlung gi rta byas sogs klong du ā hūṃ glu gong ltar dang hūṃ ci 'grub mthar bgegs rigs stong sogs mchod bstod sogasagong ltar mthar chagagasu bya'o sgrub pa nyin gcig / sgrub chen la bsnyen skabasayan sgrub pa'i skabs ltar la ril sgrub mtha'i lhub 'don gyi bde btagags rgyal kun sogs kun thub byin 'bebasaganyisagong ltar ro sgrub 'dzab bum 'dzab ril dmigs rtsa sngags sham skyon a ra pa sogs btags pasa'adzab dbyangs sgrub sngags ma dang ra tsa bsen 31 sogs dang gab pa'i sham lnga bcas 'dzab dbyangasadang srung ba rtsa lha las bdag nyid drag po'i rtsa ba'i sogs bsam la: rtsa sngags mthar sa a mi dhe wa sogs rbad sod: bar gsum gong gi kha bsgyur mdun bskyed drag po'i rtsa ba'i sogs bsam la: mdun bskyed mjug gi 31 gu ru artsig sogs tsa sha:na sa ma ya hū phaṭa: srung ba las kyi gab chung las 31 na mtshig man+ta sogs dhi hūṃ: bar gsum re bya bsnyen rnga bcas bsnyen pa ci 'grub skyon ma hwa gu ru sogs mthar mchod bstod bkra shis yan gong ltar drag sgrub dang bsnyen rgyun bsnyen bstod ni

ra༅༅// ye shes lha tshogs sogs ༈la byang gnyis par bum bskyed sogasagong ltar dang bsnyen skabs bdingapagags rgyal ba sogs kun thub dang byin 'bebs rgyas pa gnad bsdu sgrub 'dzab ril dmigs sogs rgyasapa'i skabs ltar byas mthar mchod bstod gsol kha sogs gong ltar ro/las byang gsum par bum bskyed ril sgrub sprad la bsnyen skabs/ bdobatagags rgyal sogs dang bzhengasabaskul gnad bsdu sgrub 'dzab sogs dang rtsa lha'i sngags dmigs dang sngags mthar mdun bskyed sngags dmigasador la rtsa sngags rnamasadang srung sngags rnams bzla ba dang mchod bstod sogs gong ltar ro 'dir tshogasa'akhor rgyas pa bya /las byang bzhi par bum bskyed ril sgrub hūṃ sgrub gsum sprad la bsnyen skabs bdobashagags rgyal sogs byin 'bebs gnad bsdu sgrub 'dzab ril dmigs rtsa sngags/a ra pa tsa sogs btagasal 'dzab dbyangs sgrub sngags sham dang sham ga rnam re re go cha'i sngags mthar bsnyen rnga bcas bsnyen pa ci 'grub mthar/ snyen ma hā gu ru sogs / sgrub la trī:sku gsum rang la sogs gong ltar la hūṃ ci 'grub mthar srung ba gab yo gi bdag nyid rta khyung drag po'i sogs srung sngags gsum po dang bgegs rigs stong

phrag sogs mchod bstod nas mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ sgrub chen nyin gcig / las sbyor la las byang gzhung la byin 'bebs rgya pa sprad nas sgrub skabs ltar gzhung 'gros ril sgrub 'dzab ril dmigs yan 'dra'o/ rtsa sngags ma can rnam 'dzab dbyangs go cha'i sngags dmigasadang sngags gsum sngagasarnams la rnga bkyags rnga bcasashing mdun bskyed sngags dmigs dang sngagasal rnga brdung nas srung 'khor srung sngags sogs bya/ ces mahā gu ru bde gshegs rgyal ba sogs dang las spyor 'dzab rnga 4sa hrī: khams gsum yongs sgrol sogs 'dzab mchod 'thul ril sgrub las hū ril bu rta khyung— sogs/ bsregs par bsam la: rtsa sngagasasham bcasa'adzab dbyangs mthar rtenatrīX baṃ: mtshams rol dang las sbyor sngags rnga bkyag rtsa sngags dang trī: khrom trigasho sogs hur thum sbyo: rtsa sngags dang rnga bkyag nas hab byung sogs yi swā ༈lan gsum hūṃ sgrub las e gzhi bzhengasapad+ma sogs hrī sku gsum rang la sogs gdab po: / glu ༷ rlang gi rtabyas sogs / glu nyi lta dman 'jigs tshogs sogs / glu de ltar lhar gsal ba rnams kyi sku yi sogs / gar mdzad cing zhal nas sngagasasgra

༄༅// di ri ri sgrog par bsam la:bsnyen rnga bcas bsnyen pa ci 'grub mthar srung sngags snyed pradun badz+ra sogs dang sngagasagasum po lan gsum rtsa sngagasamathar nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sgrib gnyis sogs swā 1lan bdun zhoba'iphren las rabs 'byams sogs dbyangs yig rten gsum 'dod gsol mchod bstod dang tshogs mjug gi dze+etshanaganas ye shes sogs bshags pa nas bkra shis yan bya'o/drag sgrub dang rtsa sngags ra tsa bse mo sogs gab shamasalnga la re re'i mthar bsnyen rgyun byas rjes/ pasarogs lha tshogs sogs bzod par bzhes mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol:kyang mnya pañtsa sogs /las byang gnyis par bum bskyed sogs sngar ltar dang bsnyen skab yisheg lha tshogs sogs nas kun thub byin 'bebs 'od zer phung po gnad bsdu bcas dang sgrub 'dzab sogasagong ltar nas las spyor gyi drag sngags rnams kyi mjug tu hūṃ sgrub las cas:ga'o pa bzhengs pad+ma sogs mngon gyur ngang:'og gi hrīcho ga chogs ma 'dres sogs bral bar rgyas:/ glu dang hūṃ ci 'grub mthar bsnyen rgyun bya rjes bsrung sngags gsum mthar rtsa sngags dang

sulapargyad pathupa / nyasasprad pa shu gabupadangapyag papa / nyadangagazubango /skangacalagugapaskud ngo /dal / nyald / dalag rto dang pha sbya za /ngo /nalargya ladu /zhuzuthupalas ma:gzhi bzhedas sogs ngang:'og gi hrī:'khrul ba dbyings 'ub chub dbang:/ glu dang hūṃ ci rigs mthar bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/srung sngags dang rtsa sngags mthar khams gsum srid gsum 'dod dgu'i dpal sogs swā hā:lan bdun dbang gi phrin las sogs mtshod bstod sogs bya'o//lasabyang bzhi par bum bskyed ril sgrub hūṃ sgrub gsum sprad la 'dzab dbyang nyer lnga mi mthar hūṃ sgrub lasahrī:yul med mthong ba'i sogs bdud 'dul drag hūṃ glu dang hūṃ ci 'grub mthar bsnyen pa ci rigs dang mtshamasarol rtsa sngagasal sbyor sngagasagasum rtsa sngags/ hrī:〈snam trig shwa sogs lan gsum rtsa sngags/ hab byung sogs lan gsum rtsa sngags/ dri ra tsa rgyal bo'i sogs gsum rtsa sngags trig 31 sogs

ra༅bya// gsum rtsa sngags bdud pra ma ni sogs gsum srung sngags tsang mdun badz+ra sogs sngags tshan gsum po lan gsum rtsa sngags dang gnad byed dug lnga dug gsum las byung ba'i sogs lago par lta ba thams cad ma ra yā phaṭa:swā hā lan bdun dragab yi brin las sogs 'dod gsol mchod bstod dngos grub dge bsngos spro na gsol sgrub las gtor snad bhan+ta sogs asnobar dang bskul ba rdo rje'i gad mo dam 'dogs sogs gong ltar mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ las sbyor nyin gnyis par las byang byin 'bebs sogs gong ltar la las sbyor 'dzab dbyangs mthar rtsa sngags brgya re dang zhi rgyas dbang gsum sham re re'i mthar bsnyen rnga bcas bsnyen pa ci 'thus dang mtshams rol nas las sngags gsum rtsa sngags hṝ41 ༷skon shwa sogs lan gsum rtsa sngags hababyung sogs gsum srung sngags tratun sogs gsum po dang rtsa sngags la drag po'i sham bcas bdun phrog las rab 'byamasathams cad thog pa med pa lhun gyis 'grub par gyur cigadabyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying 'dod gsol mchod bstod dge bsngos bya/phud bskang gsol kha rnams dang dbang phyug nag po lan

bdun dang gsol bsdus rnams la gsum mam re re'i mthar sngar ltar grub par byas nas bshags pa bsngo smon sogs bya/ drag sgrub dang rtsa sngags la ra tsa bse 31 dang gab pa'i sham lnga/ trī: khye1 rnams btags mthar rtsa sngags kyi rgyun byas nas me (shes lha 31gas sogs bya las byang gnyisapar sngar ltar bsnyen skabs su kun thub byin 'bebs ye shes gzi bskyed gnad bsdu bcas bya de min gong ltar mchod bstod dge bsngos yan bya'o ༈ smad le la dang po gsol sgrub las dril tshag byalote/ gtor bye da bhan+ta sogs ā hūṃ: bskulab/ hū bh+yo: chos dbyings dbus sogs sam yā: drag sgrub mtho dbal las 'dzab 'don byasate bdag nyid drag po'i sogs nyid du gyur: rtsa sngags mthar dril tshag/ dri ra tsa sogs dza rbad rbad: yedharma dang/ thun zor rnams sogs me swā snya de nas bsgral lasakyi ma swā bha wa sogs ha hohrī: kye skyabs kyi mchog sogs sam yā: gong gi stong pa'i ngang las sogs )hohrī: hū bh+yo mi mngon dbyings bsdo/gas sogs sa mayā: ebaskyed/ phaṭa: mdun du ma rig sogs nas 'gugs pa 'gugs thung ci rigs 'gugs 'ching sdom myos sogs nas gzhung ltar la

༄༅ thun gdab skabs su thun sngags la rtsa sngags dang snyen hūṃchag khro bh+yo sogs bzlog bh+yo:gzhung gidagra bgegs 'byung po'i sogs sod sod rbad rbad:gdags la gas brtu mgo' bar bya g.yo brtu ma ha kro ta bstabs pa bstod bsdus yig brgya bya bzlog pa na hūṃ bh+yo:chos dbyings dbus sogs ston mdzod cig snyenasku3'adzigu ru artsig sogs nyan dang por snyen hūṃchag khro sogs kun la 'dogs nyan gnyis par rtsa sngags mthar/ dri ra tsa rgyal po'i sogs dang trig sho gnyis re re byas nas 'og ma rnams la rtsa sngags da bdud pra ma sogs btags la mtha' bar ro/ bzlog phran rnams ni khyung bzlog go cha lha lnga'i bzlog pa khro bcu rtsang bzlog rnams bya'o/ las byang gsum par 'gros rim sngar ltar tshogs bskang sogs bya drag sgrab dang rtsa sngags sham rnams gong ltar ro ༈las byang bzhi par gong ltar nas las sbyor gyi drag sngags rnams da srung bsngags mthar hūṃ sgrub las sdi:sku gsum rang la sogs mtshams rnams su hūṃ glu sum sbrel gsum re byas la mtha' bor dang hūṃ glu ci rigs bgegs regs stong phrag sogs rtsa sngags sham du/gas da byed dug lnga dug

gsum sogs grin las rab 'byams sogs mchod bstod dngos grub dge bsngosadang / bsgral la bsdus pa la tshogs phrin las tshogasasnod zhesapa'i mal du ling sdod lcags khaṃ sogs gsal la gsol sgrub las 'gugs pa lan gsum tshogs bsgral ma ha 11 ta bstabs pa byas mthar bzlog pa gnam lcags spu gri la rtsa sngags dang drig khro dang bdud pra ma gnyis gong ltar btags la tshar grang bsegasadagos so/ / gsol sgrub kyi gtor 'gugs bskul ba dam 'dogasachad brtan sogasamatha' rgyas su bya'o/ las sbyor nyin gsum par las byang gsum pa'i mched bstod yan nyin gnyis pa'i skab ltar ro/ / sbyin bsregasadrag po'i lugs su blugs la thog mar sngagasadrug phyag drug gi mthar dgyes bskyed drag po las bsreg 'don skyid ādza ཿ thab ro/sa zung 954ga sogs 'i bra: hū hrī: me yi ngo bo sogs nga la ra hū hūṃ rlung gi ngo bo sogs t+t+waṃ phyung swā hā: o swā bha sogs spya 'don gyis/ ye nas mi dmigs sogs phreng ba can: la byang gi zhal gcig phyag bzhi sogs dbus su bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/lha tshogs gnas gsum sogs chen por bsre: dbang bskur las de nas rdo rje'i sogs/ bstem mo:

༄༅/ / las byang gi hūṃ hrī chags med sogs dza: nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod mjug tu/ sa pad+ma krota rā dza sa pa ripha ra sogs shabha prahaṃ tsa yi swā hā: phyi mchod brtung snyen pad+ma krota sogs du pa sogs dharma prartartsi swā hā: nang mchod bcang 3( pad ma sogs ma ha pañtsa rak+ta bha ling ta byu dza khakha khā hi: gsang mchod brdung bsreg gzhung gi bsreg 'don hūṃ hrī: mtshanaldan bhasto sogs 'bulaX rtsa sngags mthar mo sa rak+ta sogs kha tī: bdun re'i mthar bsdus pa gnyis dang rgyas pa gcig bcas gsum mthar tsos ā ( lcags si drag po'i sogs phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar sto dhi bhe k+ṣa yi ya phaṭa: btags la bdun re'i mtshams su ho dbang chen drag 11sa sogs mdzod cig rgyas bsdus gong ltar byas mthar rngam 'don gyis rang mdun e las sogs bzhin gsal: smad le'i 'gugs pa dgu'am gong 'og la gsum re byas kyang chog mthar gzhung gi 'gugs thung ci rigs dang rtsa sngags mthar dṛ triḥ.ad+ma sogs raṇaphaṭa: mahwa krota sogs bsgralardzas zag med tsosasku〉〉 skyed midadabyings kyi

sogs thegag: rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed rgyal bsen sogs btags pa bdun re'i mthar 'dod gsol re dang 'ur thugs rkang gcig re bya'o/ de 'dra bdun gyi mthar bzlog pa gnam lcags sbu gri dang bzlog sngags mthar gong gi rang mdun e las sogs 'gugs thung ci rigs dang rtsa sngags mthar rjo8) sogs bsgral bstabs 'don gsol gong ltar byas mthar: bzlog pa bzlog sngags mthar yang gong ltar gcig dang gsum gyi mthar las byang gzhung gi bstod pa spyi 'don bya/ bshags pa dzos bzhi tshogs bsdus bshags pa gang rung sa twa yig brgya dam tshig nyam chags sogs nam mkha'i mthar thugs sogs tshogs bskang ba mkha' dbyings sprin phung ltar nas lhag ma yan bya bsreg gzhung ga sreg 'don hūṃ hrī: skye med ce sa dbyings sogs stsal du gsol: yo pad+ma krota rā dza sa badz+ra argam sogs shabha du pa sogs dharma ma ha pañtsa a dṛta rak+ta bha be+eng ta khā hi: bstod pa hūṃ hrī: rnam dag 'khrul ba'i sogs bache/da: dngos grub gshegs skyems rgyas bsdus gsum bstod bsdus bzod gsol yag brgya gshegs gsol mjug gi 'khor lo bsdu dam chig pa sogs bsngo smon ye dharma

༄༅༅// sogs shis brjod 'di nas rol chen byasakyang ru ngo bskul ba dam 'dogs chad brtan sogs bkra shis yan bya'o/de nas tshig bdun gsum bzhengs bskul gnad bsdu dang dngos grub bskul len nas sgrub chen dal 'don kyi ho:bzhengs thegan rnga yab sogs dngos grub snyedapa:rtsa sngags mthar ka ya44) sogs btags pa brgya rtsa'i mthar sku ro sa lha tshogs sogs bsngo smon zhabs brtan bstan rgyas sogs bya'o//gachenal 'dabasaphyir nang tho rengs khar tshig bdun bsam lhun brgyud 'debs sku phreng gsol 'debasagrang ba kun tu sogs chab byung mchod rdzas byin rlabs spos byung gsol 'debs dang hūṃ trī:rtags kyi rdo rje sogs skyabs yul bskyed pa skyabs sems yan bdun rnams rgyas pa tshogs zhing bsdu ba dkar dmar bgegs gtor byin rlabs bka' bsgo glud bsngo bsrung 'khor nas srung ba rtsa lha dang lha bskyed mthar bum bskyed ril sgrub hūṃ sgrub dbang bskur rgyas gdab spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa sman mchod bstod pa 'dzab bgrangs phreng byin rlabs ril dmigs 'dzab dbyangs sgrub 'dzab ril dmigs bum bzlos 'dzab dbyangs sngags gnyis po bya/go cha'i

sngags dmigs dang sngags srung dmigs srung sngags hū hrī bde btagags rgyal ba sogs las sbyor 'dzab ril dmigs 'a ba dbyangs sngags gang skabs dang zhi rgyas dbang gsum sham re'i mthar mtshams rol las sngags dang rtsa sngags/hrī: khrom sogs rtsa sngags/ hab byung sogs bsrung sngags sra tun sog tshan gsum po bya/ hūṃ sgrub las hrī: sku gsum rang la sogs mtshams su hūṃ glu bdun ma sum sprel re dang mthar hūṃ ca rigs dang bgegs rigs stong sogs rtsa sngags mthar gnod byed dug lnga sogs grin las rab 'byams sogs dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying 'dod gsol mchod bstod dge bsngos bya/ sngags drug dang/ yi ka rngodas sogs phud bskang dregs pa sde bzhi'i gsol bsdus gcig re dang gter srung bstan srung yongs rdzogs rig 'jin rtsa brgyud sogs phud kyi phrin bcol/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs phud bshags bshags pa dzos bzhi dam tshig nyam chags sogs nam mkha'i mthar thugs sogs tshogs byin rlabs spyan 'dren tshogs phud bskang rdzas byin rlabs bskang ba tho gsos tshogs bshags bar kun thub tshig bdun

ra༅༅ byin 'bebs che ba gnad bsdu dngos grub bskul len gyi sgrub chen dal 'don gyis hūṃ trī: bdochen phyogs ris sogs stsal du gsol rtsa sngags ka ya sirnyi sogs btags pa brgya rtsa sman mchod bro bshags dngos grub bskul len gzhung gi gsol gdab bum dbang gsung dbang thugs dbang gtor dbang sgrom phur dbang tshe dbang ril dbang sgrub yig dang sku 'bag las bzhi trī 'jigs pa brgyad sogs dngosagrub 'grimasal rdosarnamasarar gnasasu bzhag nas tshogs 'gugs tshogs bsgral bstabs pa kun thub sngags gnam phud drangasab he na ka dpal sogs lhag ma byin rlabs lhag ma snangags mdzadad phul bas sogs tshogs phrin las bdag mdun gyi gnas sogs ho: dngos su 'byor dang sogs mchod sngags rnams dang rdo rje'i lha mo rnams sogs nas bstod pa rgyas par bya/ slar mchod pa'i lha mo kha bsgyur nas mdun bskyed kyi gnas sogs bshags pa bsngo smon bsdu ldang bkra shis sogs bya'o/ sgo byang gnyis dang tho bzhi bsdu ga gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la'ang mngon spyod drag po' zor las 'bar ba me yi kha

skong bdud bgegs dam sri mnan gzir pho nya dam can mchod thabs bdag gzhan rnal 'byor tshe bsreng bka' drin gso phyar gting rag mchod cing bstod sogs rgyas pa chags nyams 'gyed bcas bshags sbyang bkra shis mdzes pa'i mtha' brgyan rnams bya ba la thog mar mchod dzosabyin rlabs bsdus pa gsol 'debs skyabs yul gsal gdab las byang gi skyabs sems yan bdun dang tshogs zhing bsdu bgegs gtor byin rlabs dang bka' bsgo srung gur byin 'bebs mchod rlabs lha bskyed mdun bskyed rgyas pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab lha 37gas gnas gsum sogs spyon 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa sman mchod bstod pa mthar 'dzab bsnyen sham rnga bcas ci 'grub dang bsgrub bsnyen sngags sham bcas ca 'thus las sbyor dmigs sngags ci 'grub mthar gzhung gi sham rgyas pa bcasalan gsum srung ba lasakyi gab chung dang rnga bcas sngags rnams lan gsum re dang hūṃ sgrub las ces gzhi bzhengs pad+ma sogs bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bzlos dmigs hūṃ glu rnams grub phral bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs dang phrin las rab 'khyams sogs dbyangs yig rten gsum 'dod gsol mchod bstod dge bsngos rnams byas la ༈

ra༅༅ gsol kha phud nas bzung mjug bar sngar nyin ltar gtong tshogasal bshags pa rdzas bskang tshogs bsdus dang bshags bsdus sa twa brgya rtsa yig brgya dam tshog nyams chags sogs dang nam mkha'i mtha' thug sogs gzhung gi tshogasabyin rlabs nas bskang ba che chung skabs bstun ltar dang tho gsol ma gtogs thams cad dgosal ltag mjug bar ro / smad le bskul ba nas bzungs 'gugs pa gsum 'gugasathung nyer lnga dang gosab gsum sngagasalnga bcu re ma gtogs gong dang 'dra nas bzlog pa yongs rdzogs bcas grub rjes gser skyems a ka ros byin gyis brlabs te nang sgo dbye ba kyi dbus mtha' bral ba sogs sha yaphaṭa: skyems mchod sgo rtsang shab dngos grub kyi rdzas gtor kheb bcas tshogs gzhung gi sgrub chen dal 'don hrī7naganas ye shes sogs pha la ho lhub 'don gyis hrī: 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs sogs dngos grub stsol: zhes dngos grub kya dzosarnams 'grims la shis brjod me tog 'thor de nas phyi sgo dbye ba sgra gcan theb ldog dang bstun nas phyir byon te tha tshig bsgrags pa ni zor las nas dza sno: chungang pa nam mkhar sogs swā ha: a ka ros dkar skyems byin gyisabarlabasate phyi

sgo dbye ba ni hū trī sgrub pa chen po'i sogs phrin las mdzod zor sgo dbye ba ni hū /: thabs kyi gzhu mo sogs dza rbad: mda' lam gyis zor sgo phyesarte gtor lam phyes sogs mdzod cig bar dang sakhye1gas 'dir gnas sogs phrin bcol la gdan sar 'khod sngagasamachod phul/ mdun bskyed kyi mdun du bshams pa'i rnams lnga dang sman raka gtor ma la 'bul/ bstod bsdus bya rtsa sngagasadang skyi hūṃ trig khro sogs bzlog smyo thun ya thun ya zor ya zor ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po'i srog rtsa la rbad rbad: lan dgu brjod gtor ma'i/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs mthu ldan du dmigs so / phyi zor rnams mtshon dpal ngar bskyed ltar gzi byin phab par bya'o/ / gsol sgrub las gtor 'gugs dang bskul ba rdo rje'i gad mo gyer/ tshogs phrin las a las bhan+ta sogs dam 'dogasadang zor sgo dbye bskul las brtul zhugasabaskyed pa/ hū dza nga ni gang shar sogs duṣ+ṭan hūṃ phaṭa: gtor ma zag pa med pa sogs ra tho 'don gtor ma mja bsgyur bsgral gzhung mtha'i/ hā hūṃ: gtor ma dpal chen sogs bzlog bh+yo bar ro/ / phyi zor la ser phreng

༄༅/ / bsgrig te che bskyed ni sgo dbye'i zor bskul las / hūṃ nyu3 hūṃ snang srid rngams brjid sogs ltar kyang rung yang na zor las nas hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ bdag nyid gang shar sogs rdul brlag dmigs: rnga rol rkang gling 'ur chem rnga gdan dgu brtung mtshams rgya gnyis dang dgu 'azing mtshams rgya gnyis nasakun gyisayang bzlog sbu gri gyer bzhin dmigs ting gi gdengs ma shor bar spul nag 'khyil 'grogasu byon te rol mo sod cig sgrol zhig sgrol te lan re'i mtshamagasu ma ra ya de'i 'gres su pheb nas drag spyod kyi sar sleb tshe gong ltar mtshasargyas dgu 'thing bzhag rol byas te/ gser skyems dkar dmar gtor ma gshams la zor gzhung gi ram̐ yi khaṃ gtor ma zag pa med sogs (1rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin sogs sa ma yā bar lang bskyed 'gugs pa dgu 'gugs rol gsum/ 'gugs thung brgya nas 'gugs rol dang 'gugs 'chang sdom myos dbye dbab rnams bskul 'don phyag bzhes ltar dang bsgral ba ni / hūṃ bh+yo: snyegs ma'i las sogs a phab badz+ram ha kro ta sogs bsgral brdung rkang gling bcas mthar tshogs byang yar bzhengs te slob dpon he ru ga'i masasu zhugs nas zor rnamasaphyag tu bzhes shing 'phen gdab ma nor bar mdzad bzhin rtsa gsum rgyal ba

sogs/ mos la bzhud pa rkang gling rol mo rnga sang ltar bskul 'don byas nas hū bh+yo: dregs pa'i sgog 'phrog sog sngags dang yang bzlog dmod la rnga kher bab gsum la rkang re dang 'ur chem rkang gsum dza phob dza gsum la rkang gsum te dgu re'i 'gresasu byasate rdor nyung dug khrag phur mtshe mtshon mda' rdo gtor sdig khyung phag dang srid pa yo log byed pa'i gtor zor rnams rim bzhin brdab te 'ur chem nas dza phob dza spro na 'dir dmod bcol bya rngam rol zhal shes ltar mchan nas gtor brtung rgyasapar bya/ mjug gi 'ur chem gyi mgor gtad bcol ābasgrung ba sogs khā nyi: nas 'ur chem rnga sang ltar dang tshogasophrin las rin po che'i sogs sngon bsu rol mo 'ur chem rnga sang ltar brdung la brtan ma dang 'dod gsol las bcasarol mo 'ur chem nas dgu rkyang bya'o/ drag po mnan pa'i rigasadagos na 'dir bya'o/ tshogasaphrin/ na mo: bla ma drag po sogs 'gugs pa gsum sngags gcig mthar bro mnan dang bzhag rol mthar hūṃ bzhi'i sngagasare dang bsgrag nas 'jigs brgyad shidz+nya ku ru ye swā hā zhesadang 'phyor drug puṣ+ṭi ku brtan gasku wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgra bgegs ma ra yā phaṭa swā hā: bro zhal shes ltar du brtung nasatshur dal bus byon te sgrub khang gi sgo drung du pheb tshe rol mo

ra༅༅ yo sa rdzogs mkhar rngas bskul la sgrub khang la g.yas bskor du phyon te nang du phebs nas bdun brtung nyes mnyams nas rnal 'byor rgyal dbyangs ni e ya be+eḍūl lhun pa( sogs lha rgyal ma : rol mo 'ur chem sum brdung nas bzhag go tshogs phrin nas gtoragathegang rat+na sogs nas gdan so sor 'khod de g.yos sbyor mkhan rnams la bsang chen bkyags su bcugs rol mo yongs rdzogs bcas bdud rtsi phud bskang dang dregs pa sde bzhi'i gsol mchod gter srung bcas gsol bsdus dang sde mchod nas phud kyi phrin bcol dang pad+maliring lugs sogs rgyaladabang pad+ma'i sogs rgyalab kun gyi sangasargyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs chos spyong gi gtor ma rgyun 'joms rnams dung gling gis sna drangs te dar chen phyar la bsang du gshegs so/ bzod gsol dang shis brjod rgya chen byas la bzhag rol bya'o/ / tshe rdzas sgrub pa dang tshe 'gugasardzas gtad rnams rgyas par byas la tshogasaphrin nas bdagamadun gyi sogs dngosasu 'aX1ra dang sogs sngagasarnams kha phral la/ rdorje lha mo sogs bstod pa rgyas pa gzhud ltar dang bka' rgyud bla ma sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa sogs b.rungad par 'osapa sogs slaramatshad pa'i

sogs tshogs gzhung gi bzod gsol dang dbyangasagasal yig brgya lan gsum bsngo smon lan gsum (1gas ngas ra nam mkha'i sogs rten rnams la rab gnasame tog 'thor bsdu rim tshig gnyisakyi mthar mi shesakyi 'khor lo chos kyi dbyings su gshegs: badz+ra mu rgyun spyod lhar ldang mig gnyis kyi mthar dam chig pa bdag dang tha mi dad par mos la: rtsa sngags dang rang gi snying ka nas sogs shis brjod sho lo ka dang ston pa 'jig rten khamasagasum byon sogs gnas 'dir nyinamo sogs dpal ldan bla ma'i deng sogs 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni sogs 'dir ni rgyalab dgra sogs dnges 'dir rnal 'byor ba sogs bkra shis rol mo rgyas par brdung smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/phyir nyin gdan srung las byang gsol kha bskang tshogs rjes chog bkra smon gyisamadzes par byas la sgrub pa'i shul mi mngon par bya ba ni gnad kyi yang gces dam pa'o/ 'gyur khyad kyang sgrub pa spyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba 'di lta bu ni dung bcu gsum gyi 'gyur khyad thob par dam pa gong ma rnams kyis gsung bas kho bo yang yid chas dang spro 'phel lo/ 'dir smras pa zab gter rin chen ma gros rgya mtsho las/ gdeng can thod btegs bsam 'phel gcig ma

ra༅gyi 'di lha mi 'gro ba yongs kya phyag 'os gnas/ dpal mgon bla ma'i bka' drin lan brgyar bsngags/ bdag kyang skye ba'i phreng ba bcu gsum bar/ dam pasarjes bzungs 'khor rgya thu bo zhes/ lung dang zhal gyisaganang bsabaden pa mthong / phyin chad tshe rabs kun tu zhabs 'bring shog blo ldan legs bshad gsar bas rtog ge dang / tha snyad ne tsos chos gtam tsam min par/ dam pas rjes bzung gsar byung mtha' dag kun/ sgrub pa 'dir 'jug lhag bsam dkar ba'i blos/ phyag bzhes mi nyams ra bzos ma bslad par/ ja bzhin shes ngor tshud bzhin gsal bkod dge/ mar gyur mkha' mnyams 'gro ba yongasal bsngo/ kun kyang pad+ma'i spyan sngar 'khod gyur cig zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun dam pa gang gis 'don 'gragasasgrub pa 'i cha lag zhig ngesapar 'bri dgos zhes bka' gnang spyi bor son tshe bzlog tu ma spobs par sprang ban zab mo'i don la blo sems phyogasapapad+ma'i ming can nas bgyis pas rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang ba' rgyu ru 'gyur bar shog shig sarba ma lo/

ra༅gyi// rgyal bsen sbrags mdos bya ba ni/bca' bshamasasogs yig chung ltar grub rjes/drag sgrub me lce'i 'khor lo dang bsnyen pa 'dzab dbyangs ci 'grub dang gab pa'i sham lnga mig shā bcasagrub mthar/skyon pad+ma kro ta rā dza sogs kyisamachod hūṃ hrī drag po khyung klus sog bka' rgyud bla sogs bstod par 'os sogs dgeb 'di yis sogs shogam mdosalas/trī:mnyam nyid chos sku'i sogs dus la bab:mo 'dre kha phral las trī:yidamigasastong pa sogs gnas par dmigs:rgyal mdos las na mo:dkon mchog sogs bdun ra'i mtshamagasu 'gugs rol byas la nyer gcig gi mthar/mo 'dre kha phral las na modakon mchog sogs gong ltar nyer gcig la mi nyung bar brjod rgyal mdos las trī misrid dgu 'phrul sogs 'byung gyur cigs phral las kye:'phrul kyi mdos ra sogs phun tshogs gyur sngags drug phyag drug dang rgyal mdos las kye dgongs sdon dbyings dang sogs gnas gyar cigs phral las/kye:sna chogs 'phral gyi sogs bka' la nyon:dang chos bshad kye:ma rig pa las sogs barbal gyar cig

rgyal mdos las saṃ bha ra dang mtshan bzhi brjod kye: zhen cing chags pa'i sogs tshan pa drug de ci mang bsngo kha phral las saṃ bha ra dang mtshan bzhi brjod khyer cig sogs ci mang gisabasngosarjes rgyal mdos las rkye sngon tshe brag dmar sogs gastso kha phral las bye ho: yang dag chos nyid sogs gasno las byang gzhung gi hū hrī: nga bdag mtshan mar sogs hū hūṃ phaṭa: rtsa sngagasadang gab pa'i sham lnga'i hūṃ bzhi'i sngags gsum dang rtsa sngags dang / hrīgs trig shā sogs nyung thum bh+yo: drag sngags so lnga dang bgegs brdung bya/ hrī: che nga nyid lta ba sogs dz+nya na rak+ta hūṃ: rgyal mdos las gnas 'di pad+ma sogs rak+ta k+ta: 'ur bzhag zab mdo dang bzlog pa lan gsum chenags pa'i byang chub sogs bgegs rigs stong sog bde legs regag pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bsgrigs pa ma le/

ra༅༅/ / dam chosathugasagartar 'dus pa' chos skor las/rta khyung drag po'i sgrub lugasakyi 'don 'grigs bzhugs/ sgrub gtor mda' dar tshe gtor tshe 'brang rtsa gsum sman raka gtor gsum sogs mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar bkod nas rig 'dus bla ma dran bskul tshig bdun spyan 'dren lan gsum ye martenaḥ sku gsum sogs sirnyi hūṃ: brgyud 'debs ni ye ma4sto: gdod nas sogs zin par 31ga sku 'phreng gsol 'debs na mogu rashe e mardengaḥ skye med sogs sangs rgyas regagaX skyob kun tu sogs bsang chu byin rlabasani hūṃ bisneta krid sā byawa bsang chu'i nang du dmigs hūṃ bisne lha nyid sogs dmigs mchod rdzas byin rlabs ( bisne sā bhawa stong pa'i ngang las sogs ra ṇakhi mchod sngags khyen badz+ragarnye sogs khaṃ swāhwa sbosabyung hūṃ bisne swā bhawa a(dro med sogs ā hūṃ gsol 'debs ye ma41 mtha' grol sogs dbyer med 31ga / rol mo byin rlabs hūṃ trīḥ rtags kyi rdo rje sogs ā hūṃ skyabs yul gsal gdab mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs dmigs la

skyabs 'gro ni namo ye nas sogs mchi lan gsum sems skyed ni hū gnyis snang sogs bskyed ro/ lan gsum tshogs bsags ni skyid āX: thams cad mnyam nyid sogs thob sgo ga maṇ+ḍal 6 ā2): stong gsum sogs ā hūṃ dza hūṃ baṃ ho sogs rdzogs par bsam sngon gtor la 3 ma ḍi su bha wa mdzod sngags a ka ro sa badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūṃ hū dza stong gsum sogs sa ma ya sngon gtor chang glud las bdag nyid skad cig sogs khug cig lan gsum 31 sarba bu ta lan gsum dza hūṃ be ho so bha ra a ka ro rang nyid dbang chen sogs hūṃ phaṭa las byang gzhung gi hū hrī nga bdag sogs hūṃ phaṭa glud gtor bsngo ba hū hrī mi dbang sogs gats+tsha rtsa sngags gab pa'i sham lnga'i rjes sum bha ni hrī khro trig 31 drags sngags so lnga ma ra ya phaṭa las byang las hri stong nyid lta ba sogs rak+ṣa hūṃ nyin dang por ye dharma bgegs rigs stong rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshang dang lha dbang

ra༅bya byin 'bebs thugs rje'i lcags kyu las dam ldan sgrub pa po a yi gzhung gi hūṃ hrī shānaganas sogs a ā hūṃ hūṃ nam mkha' gang ba'i sogaja bsam mo trī yul drug sogs ha hot+t+waṃ sarba pañtsadang rak+ta bha lirnya bcas arnya nas shasta prahaṃ tsam swāhwa hūṃ mtha' grol sogs ring zhing byer srung ba rtsa lha bdag nyid pad+ma sogs dal sgo 'byed gzhung gideyi phyi rim sogs dbus su bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab las rang gi snying sogs sku mi 'gyur bar rgyas gdab o brnye snang mtha' dmar po a pad+madha ra mi bskyod pa hūṃ badz+radha ra sogs tiṣ+ṭhabadz+ra las byang ga lha chogs sogs bsre dbang bskur rgyas gdab las gnas rdo rjes sogs bstim mo las byang gi hūṃ trī chags med sogs nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa sman mchod bstod pa 'dzab dang bgrang phreng byin rlabs tsan sarba dharma bsnyen pa ja bzhi pa bar 'don de nas sgrub 'dzab dang las sbyor bcas ci 'grub bzlas rjes mchod bstod la drag 41sa bdud dpung rtsal gyi

dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'grub par gyur cig nas dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bcas sbrel ma gsum drag khros bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi sogs 'dod gsol rjes las byang gzhung ga mchod bstod bka' rgyud bla ma bache da par dge ba 'di yis sogs regag/ gsol kha la tshig bdun spyan 'dren dang sngags drug phyag drug dang a ka ro'i mthar bdud rtsiphud bskang grin bcol mgo bar dang drag po lha lnga'i gsol sgrub las gtor snod bhasto sogs ye swā hā bar dang ḍa 4sa gsol mchod dbang phyug nag po gsum gshin rje badz+ra ki la ya seng gdong ma gter srung gsol mchod gsol gzhung gi bstod pa a ka ro rang mdun a las sogs rang lug kyi rgyun gsol 'don tshar rjes phud kyi phrin bcol dang gsol sgrub kyi phrin bcol/ pad+ma'i rang lugs rgyal dbang pad+ma'i rgyal bi kun gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa phud kyi bshagasapa gsol sgrub kyi bshags pa yig rgya che/na tshe snyen rgyan de nas tshogs la rang snang ye shes sogs ra ṇa kho bshags pa ā gdod ma'i ye gzhi sogs

༄༅/ / a ā yig rgya ci 'thub rdzas bskang hūṃ trī bde chen dbang drag sogs chen por rol tshogs bsdus re ye kho blang āX shā:'jigs chogs zil gnon sogs sa twa bshags pa gang 'os sa twa brgya rtsa sogs yig rgya dam chig nyam chags nam mkha'i mthar thug hūṃ hrī brdal khyab sogs spyan 'dren tshogs phud tshogs phrin las ngesags sa da bhasto sogs gyur cig mdzod sngags rten snying bskangs brdzas rnams sogs ra ṇa khaṃ brgyud bskang dang bskang ba pad+ma'i phreng mdzes kyi gnam phud kyi mgo bar bar bshags tshogs phrin las dzadags spyodad lcags khang sogs bam rdo bsgral ba bstab pa mdzod sngags dang yang le ber gyi bskang gsol— a ka ro rdo rje mchog rab rtsal gyi bskang ba bskang ba las gnam phud drang ba bsam lhun rgyas bsdus gang rung he dza ka dpal sogs tshogs phrin las lhag ma'i byedad sogs lhag ma/ tshogs mchod phul bas tshogs phrin las asapas bhan+ta sogs ā hūṃ dam 'dogs garta ra ma zag med

chad mdo tshogs phrin las rin po che'i sne da bstan ma tshogs phran las dro 'gugs bro sngags bro mnan tshogs phran las garte ra gasdod rat+na sogs swā hā bdag mdun gyi sogs bsam la hūṃdarngos su 'byor dang sogs rgya mtshos mchod zlo pad+ma krota sogs shabha rūpa sogs spar she dharmam hāpañtsa rak+ta bha lirnyata nagan bho dhi tsit+ta pu dza khā hi rdo rje'i lha sogs bsam la hū ma bcos sprol sogs hū : drag pokhyung klus bka' rgyud bla ma rgyal ba'ibastan pa bstod par 'os pa slarayang mchod pa'i sogs bsam la gzhung gi bshags pa yig rgya bsngo smon 'der ni rten tshogs phrin las phyogs bcu nam mkha'i sogs ye swā hā bsdu la rtsa sngags tshogs phrin las rang gi snying ka sogs ye dharma bkra shis gzhan yang bkra shis kyas mtha' brgyan no/ smon lam na 31 sa/ na hūṃ sdo na 31gas sogs mtha' sdud sogs 'don jo / nyin gnyas pa la skyabs yul bskyed pa ma gtogs skyabs sems zur bkol mi dgos maṇ+ḍal dgos byin 'bebs ye shes gza bskyed

ra༅༅/ / dbang bskur rgyas gdab kya mgor mdun bskyed e mi 'gyur sogs ma ya dza dza de min sngar nyin ltar la sgrub pa da las sbyor gnyis kya bsnyen pa mang dgos snyen gu ru artsig nertsig hrīḥhūṃ khro phaṭaḥ ca 'grub song rjes ra tsa 'khu na rnga bkyag te tshar gsum de nas bsnyen bstod sogs sngar nyin ltar la nyan rjes ma rnams su brgyud bskang ma bton kyang chog lhag ma'i rjes smad le la gsol sgrub las gtor snod sogs ā hūṃ bskul pa hūṃ bh+yo tshos dbyings dbus sogs sa ma ya mtshon dbal las 'dzab 'don byas te bdag nyid drag po'i sogs nyid du gyur rtsa sngags mthar dri ra tsa sogs rnga dang bcas ci 'grub de bzhin drig shwa drig shwa na ga brang tshal sogs ci 'grub mthar drag 'ur bzhag rol ye dharma thun zor sogs ye swā hā bsgral las nas nyes swā bha wa sogs ha ho trīX kye skyabs kyi sogs sa ma yā yang gong gi stong pa'i ngang las sogs ha ho hrīḥ hūṃ bh+yo mi mngon dbyings bzhugs sogs sa ma yā e bskyed phaṭa mdun du sogs nas 'gugs ring 'gugs thung ci 'grub

'gugs 'ching sdom myos sags gzhung ltar la thun gdab skabs hū bh+yo gathe ma bral rig rnye nga sogs mtshon char 'bebs/ rtsa sngags 'og gi 61 hūṃ trig khye rje sogs bacho ga rje dam nyams rgyal bsen sogs rbad rbad de'i 'gres so gtun brdung rjes ces ma hā 11 ta bstab pa bstod bsdus yig brgya bzlog pa tshogs phrin las a las bhasto sogs skyi aḥhū: hū bh+yo chos dbyings dbus sogs 'gres byang 'dod ye na brgyan pa'i sogs ston mdzod cig skye ā2) oṃ gu ru artsig sogs nyin gnyis par 31 hūṃ trig 〈sna bye sogs 'gres byang kun la 'dogs nyin gsum par rtsa sngags mthar dri ra tsa rgyal rnge 'i sogs dang drag shā gnyis re mos byed nyin bzhi par rtsa sngags mthar bdud pra ma btags dgos bzlog bsdus hū dza ma skyes sogs ci 'grub bton rjes khyung bzlog go cha lha lnga khro bcu rtsang bzlog rnam bya de nas dam 'dogs man chod rjes chog sngar nyin ltar ro ga nyin gsum pa sngar nyan ltar la byan 'bebs 'od zer phung po bcud dgos nyin bzha par gzhan rnams sngar nyin ltar la byin 'bebs zur bkod sprad mi dgos gsol kha bton de

༄༅/ phud kyi phrin bcol mgor gang dzaX/ yid la sngon mi o rgyan rol mo sum brdung 'ur chem bas rol de nas tshogs kyi bshags pa nas bzung smad las kyi rtsang bzlog gi mjug bar sngar ltar la de nas phyi sgo dbye ba ni a ka ro 0)dbus mtha' sogs sha ya phaṭa dngos grub len pa la sgrub chen dal 'don kyis las byang gzhung gi hūṃmi gnas ye shes sogs a las ho phyi sgo dbye ba phyi ru phebs te a ka ro slob dmas chen po sogs kha hi a ka ro hūṃ trī sgrub pa chen po'i sogs brin las mdzod a ko gtore lam phyes sogs mdzod cig de nas phyar gral du 'khod nas 'dzi pad+ma/sha ta sogs sngags mchod phul mdun bskyed mdun gyi rnam lnga dang sman raka gtor ma la phul te bstod bsdus bya/rtsa sngags mthar dang yod sam khrosgro thun mthun ya za yapa ya dgra bgakes 'byung po'i sgog rtsa la rbad bod:lan dgu brjod/ gtore mala'i sha༄ pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs mthu ldan du dmigs so gsol sgrub las gtor 'gugs dang bskul ba rdo rje'i gad mo tshogasaphrin las a las bhan+ta sogs dam 'dogs gnyam

ma zag pa med pa sogs chad mdo gtor ma maza bsgyur bsgral gzhung mtha'i hū hūṃ gtor ma dpal chen sogs bzlog bh+yo gtor brdung bya rin po che'i snod du sogs brtan ma bro 'gugs bro mnan gtang rag gi mchod bstod bsdus pa grub rjes gsol kha mchod pa la ram̐ yi khaṃ ces āḥbye nam mkha' mdzod sngags phud kyi phrin bcol dang gsol sgrub kyi phran bcol pad+ma'i rang lugs rgyal dbang pad+ma'i rgyal ba kun gyi bshags pa gnyis grub 'phral tshe 'gugs rgyas par byas la tshogs phran las bdag mdun gyi sogs dngos su 'byor sogs mchod bstod pa bzod gsol bsngo smon lan gsum rten bzhugs byas rjes ye shes kyi 'khor lo chos kyi dbyings su gshegs badz+ra rlu bsdu ldang rjes dam tshig pa bdag dang tha mi dad par mos la rtsa sngags dang rang gi snying ka nas sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ dge'o/

btsasdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las: drag bsgrub me lce'i 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i tshogs bsags bsdus pa bzhugs so:btsasdo na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: (1༅1sna bza' bcas btung dang bgo ba'i rigs pongs rdzogs tshogs su 'tshogs byas nas sbyangs spel 'bul bstab bya ba ni mos gus dad spro tshad med pa sa hūṃ trī: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i yid chos dri ma kun zhi lag rig pa'i rang mdangs me rlung chus bsreg gtor bkrus la dag chen ye shes kyi: dga' ston tshogs sprin 'khor lor lhun gyis grub: ma āḥhūṃ: gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma bral ba'i dbyings klong nas: rig stong mi shig rta khyung drag po rtsal: sgyu 'phrul rol pa 'khor gyis tshogs dang bcas gang shar rang grol dgongs pa'i dpal mtshor byon thabs chen dpa' bo shes rab ṭak+ki dang: mnyam par sbyor ba ār+ya lnga bcu dang gnyis med mnyam pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa: bla ma drag po'i gsang gsum bskangs phyir 'bul: rab yang nam mkha'i khyon la mnyam brdal ba'i: yul drug ltan mo'i phyi nang gsang ba'i chos gzung 'dzan dri ma'i rdul

bral rig pa'i sprin kun bzang dgongs mnyam chen po'i bskang bar bgyi med la yod par bzung ba sems kyi nongs yid dbyod lta spyod rtog ge tha snyad chos:gang yang sems kyi 'khrul bun mtha' yas pa:mtha' bral don dam chos sku'i 1nga du bshags:chos kyi rtogs pas nga bdag mtshan ma bcom:ye shes gzigs pa'i chos can 'khrul zhenabasgral:shes rab mtshon rnon thal 'byin phur bus gzir:he ru ka dpal dgongs grong bstabs po bzhes:sngags kyi 'dod yon tshim pa drug ldan gyis:myong grol pañtsa a mṛ nyams su myong:pha:ye shes phung po chos nyid dgongs klong tu:rdo rje'i mdzad skyongs phrin las bzhi la gnas:thog med stobs ldan lhag skyongs 'dar byon la:pham phab bzhes la bka' yi gnyer skyongs shigs:ma ma hrī ba ling ta khā hi:hrī:pad+ma'i rigs mchog bde ba kun gyi gsang:dug gsum gdon la gshe rngams gdug rtsub ston:dgyes chags rta skad rmongs 'dul khyung glu sgrogs:drag po'i zhal ngom thal 'byin phrin las myur nga bdag mtshan mo'i gdon gyi gshed du bskul:kun rdzob rgyu ma'i nyes rgyud sna tshogs

badz+ra: bzlog:rten 'brel legs yon yar ngo'i zla ltar bskyod:'bras bu'i rnal 'byor kun bzang dgongs 1nga sbyor:don gnyis gegs med 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod:bh+yo:tshogs kyi bdag po bka' dam la gnas pa'i:dregs pa cho rgyud pho mo ma ning rigs:thog mtha' bar gsum rdo rje'i bka' gnas pa'i:tha tshig can gyis pho nya 'khor dang bcas:'dir byon cha tho brngan bzhes phrin las sgrub:rten 'brel dus 'dzin ma mo bcu gnyis ni:srid pa'i bde sdug legs nyes so srung zhing bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin dpung bcas 'dir byon la bshal chus brngan bzhes phrin las rab 'byams sgrub:mabh+yo dzahrīng bā linganya kha tī:yi:rang bzhen rnam dag chos dbyings sgrom rgya phukun rdzob don dam bden mthu bslu med mthus:gnyis snang dam sri ru tra kun brub nas:mnan no sdang med chos sku'i klong du rgya bzod nas lhan skyes gnas lugs sangs rgyas kyang:snang tshul tsam du sgrib gnyis dri las bslad:don la ma grub glo bur skad cig ma:ye shes rig pas bshags so tshangs bar bgyi:snang srid rnam dag rnga yab dpal
